topics.topic: Subject Pronouns — Olmoshni tanlash qoidasi · 1-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
Olmoshni tanlash qoidasi:
• Bitta erkak → he
• Bitta ayol → she
• Bitta narsa yoki hayvon → it
• Bir nechta (odam, narsa, hayvon — farqi yo'q) → they
Rasmda nechta va nima borligiga qarang.

topics.topic: The Verb "to be" — short forms — Qolip: noto'g'ri taxmin bilan savol → inkor javob → to'g'risini aytish · 7-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
Qolip: noto'g'ri taxmin bilan savol → inkor javob → to'g'risini aytish.
'Are they policemen? No, they aren't. They're doctors.'
Birlik bo'lsa Is/it/isn't, ko'plik bo'lsa Are/they/aren't.
Diqqat: a lemon (undosh) — an apple (unli), a television — an umbrella.

topics.topic: The Verb "to be" — short forms — "to be" — qisqa shakllar · 8-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
Bu to'liq suhbat — tanishuv dialogi. Unit 1 ning barcha qoidalari bir joyda: tasdiq, inkor, so'roq va qisqa javob.
Kasb aytilganda a/an esdan chiqmasin: a singer, a guitarist, a drummer, a pop singer.

topics.topic: Indefinite Article: A/An — Qoida: so'zning BIRINCHI TOVUSHIGA qarang · 11-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
Qoida: so'zning BIRINCHI TOVUSHIGA qarang.
• Unli tovush (a, e, i, o, u) → an
• Undosh tovush → a
Bu sahifadagi 'umbrella' va 'envelope' unli bilan boshlanadi → an.
'house' da 'h' o'qiladi → undosh → a.

topics.topic: the indefinite article a/an — Ikki bosqichli mashq · 15-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
Ikki bosqichli mashq:
1) Har kasbga a yoki an tanlang (birinchi TOVUSHGA qarang).
2) Rasmdagi odamning ismi va yoshi berilgan — ular haqida savol-javob tuzing.
Diqqat: artist, astronaut, engineer — unli tovush bilan boshlanadi → an.

⚠ A yoki AN — TOVUShGA QARANG, HARFGA EMAS:

  Bu betdagi uchtasi AN bilan:
     an Astronaut, an Artist, an Engineer

  ⚠ Ular unli TOVUSH bilan boshlanadi.


⚠ ISTISNOLAR (kelajakda kerak bo'ladi):

  a University   — 'U' harfi, lekin
     tovushi 'yu' (undosh kabi)
  a European     — xuddi shunday
  an Hour        — 'H' harfi, lekin
     JIM ('auer' deb o'qiladi)
  an MP          — 'M' harfi, lekin
     'em-pi' deb o'qiladi

  ⚠ Ya'ni qoida HARF haqida emas,
  TOVUSH haqida.

topics.topic: Indefinite article — QOIDA: so'zning birinchi TOVUSHIGA qarang · 8-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
QOIDA: so'zning birinchi TOVUSHIGA qarang.
• Unli tovush (a, e, i, o, u) → an
• Undosh tovush → a

Skanerdagi o'quvchi 12 tadan 6 tasini xato qilgan. Sabab — u so'zning MA'NOSIGA yoki tasodifga qarab tanlagan. Aslida faqat BIRINCHI TOVUSH muhim.
Oson tekshiruv: so'zni ovoz chiqarib ayting. Og'zingiz unli bilan ochilsa — an.

topics.topic: The Verb "have got" — Qolip uch qismli · 3-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
Qolip uch qismli:
  1) SAVOL:  Has/Have + EGA + got + NARSA?
  2) JAVOB:  Yes, EGA has/have.  yoki  No, EGA hasn't/haven't.
  3) TUZATISH (agar javob inkor bo'lsa): EGA + 's/'ve got + TO'G'RISI.

DIQQAT — sanaladigan otlar oldidan 'a' qo'yiladi:
  a basketball, a guitar, a beard, a hat, a newspaper, a computer
Lekin KO'PLIK bo'lsa artikl yo'q: 'Have they got books?'
'hair' ham artiklsiz: 'Has she got dark hair?'

topics.topic: The Verb "can" — Qolip: 'What can he/she/it do?' → 'He/She/It can + FE'L.' · 4-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
Qolip: 'What can he/she/it do?' → 'He/She/It can + FE'L.'

DIQQAT — ba'zi harakatlar 'the' oladi, ba'zilari yo'q:
  • CHOLG'U asboblari 'the' bilan: play THE guitar, play THE violin
  • SPORT turlari 'the' siz: play football, play basketball
Bu qoidani yodlab qo'ying — imtihonlarda tez-tez so'raladi.

'ride' — ustiga minib boshqarish: ride a bicycle, ride a horse
'drive' — ichida o'tirib boshqarish: drive a car
'fly'  — uchirmoq: fly a plane

topics.topic: The Verb "can" — "can" fe'li · 5b-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
Qolip: 'Can + ISM + FE'L?' → 'Yes, he/she can.' yoki 'No, he/she can't.'

Qisqa javobda asosiy fe'l TAKRORLANMAYDI:
  'Can Jack dance?' → 'No, he can't.' ('No, he can't dance' ortiqcha)

topics.topic: Revision: Units 1 - 2 — Qoida: birinchi TOVUSH unli bo'lsa AN, undosh bo'lsa A · 8-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
Qoida: birinchi TOVUSH unli bo'lsa AN, undosh bo'lsa A.

Bu betdagi tuzoqlar:
  • an umbrella — 'u' bu yerda unli tovush
  • an hour     — 'h' o'qilmaydi (bu betda yo'q, lekin bilib qo'ying)
  • an Italian school — 'I' unli
  • a large house, a helicopter — undosh

DIQQAT: 'ice cream' — 'ai' unli → AN ice cream.

topics.topic: can — Qolip: 'Can you see a ...?' → 'Yes, I can.' / 'No, I can't.' · 12a-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
Qolip: 'Can you see a ...?' → 'Yes, I can.' / 'No, I can't.'

DIQQAT: 'see' — ko'rmoq. Bu yerda 'can' qobiliyat emas, IMKONIYAT
ma'nosida: rasmda bormi-yo'qmi.

Ro'yxatda 11 ta so'z bor, lekin rasmda faqat 8 tasi. Uchtasi YO'Q —
o'sha uchtasiga 'No, I can't' deb javob beriladi.

topics.topic: can — Qolip: 'I can hear a ..., but I can't hear a ...' · 12b-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
Qolip: 'I can hear a ..., but I can't hear a ...'

'but' — qarama-qarshilik bog'lovchisi. Ikki gapni bitta gapga birlashtiradi:
  I can hear a cat. + I can't hear a motorbike.
  → I can hear a cat, BUT I can't hear a motorbike.

'but' oldidan VERGUL qo'yiladi.

topics.topic: Qolip: 'Can + ISM + FE'L?' → 'Yes, he/she can.' / 'No, he/she can't.' · 6b-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
Qolip: 'Can + ISM + FE'L?' → 'Yes, he/she can.' / 'No, he/she can't.'
Jadvaldagi 18 katakning har biri uchun savol tuzsa bo'ladi.

topics.topic: have got — table — DIQQAT — 'or' inkor gapda · 8a-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
DIQQAT — 'or' inkor gapda:
  'They haven't got a camera OR a computer.'
  Inkor gapda 'and' emas, 'OR' ishlatiladi!

  Tasdiq: 'She has got a camera AND a TV.'
  Inkor:  'She hasn't got a camera OR a TV.'

Bu o'zbek o'quvchilari kam biladigan, lekin muhim qoida.

topics.topic: have got — table — have got — jadval · 8b-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
Qolip: 'Has/Have + EGA + got + a NARSA?' → 'Yes, EGA has/have.' / 'No, EGA hasn't/haven't.'
Qisqa javobda 'got' takrorlanmaydi.

topics.topic: Some/Any - A/An — IKKI SAVOL BILAN HAL QILINADI · 8-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
IKKI SAVOL BILAN HAL QILINADI:

  1) Ot BIRLIKMI yoki KO'PLIKMI?
  2) Gap TASDIQMI yoki INKORMI?

     BIRLIK  → a / an   (tasdiq ham, inkor ham)
     KO'PLIK + tasdiq → some
     KO'PLIK + inkor  → any

MATNDAGI QOLIP: 'There are/is ... BUT there aren't/isn't ...'
Har bir gapda bittasi bor, bittasi yo'q.

RASMDA: yotoqxona — yog'och shipli, devorlarda rasmlar,
katta karavot va yostiqlar, qizil kreslo, chiroq, pardalar,
polda gilam.

topics.topic: Plurals — Kitobdagi qoida · 7a-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
Kitobdagi qoida:
  Most nouns take -s in the plural.
  Nouns ending in ................ take -es in the plural.

Jadvalga qarang: address, bus, brush, bench — ularning
oxirgi harflari qanday? Ana o'sha javob.

topics.topic: this / that / these / those — Kitobdagi qoida · 7b-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
Kitobdagi qoida:
  We use this/these for things near us.
  We use ........./......... for things far from us.

topics.topic: There is - There are — Kitobdagi to'ldirilishi kerak bo'lgan uchta qoida · 9-mashq
topics.rule_uz: Kitobdagi to'ldirilishi kerak bo'lgan uchta qoida.

topics.topic: prepositions with the cat and the basket — Oltita rasm — bitta mushuk va bitta savat, oltita xil holat · 3-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
Oltita rasm — bitta mushuk va bitta savat, oltita xil holat.
Bu — predloglarni o'rganishning ENG YAXSHI usuli: narsalar
bir xil, faqat JOY o'zgaradi.

Predloglar: behind, in, on, under, in front of, near

Namuna: 1  The cat is near the basket.

QOLIP: The cat is + PREDLOG + the basket.

⚠ ENG QIYIN UChLIK — near / in front of / behind:

  O'zbekchada uchtasi ham 'yonida' deb
  tarjima qilinishi mumkin. Farqi:

  NEAR = yaqinida
     Qaysi tomonda ekani MUHIM EMAS.

  IN FRONT OF = oldida
     Kuzatuvchiga YAQINROQ tomonda.

  BEHIND = orqasida
     Narsa uni TO'SIB turadi (5-rasmda
     mushukning faqat boshi va dumi
     ko'rinadi).

  ⚠ 2 va 5-rasmni solishtiring: ikkalasida
  ham mushuk savatga tegmaydi, lekin
  birida oldida, ikkinchisida orqasida.

topics.topic: prepositions with the cat and the basket — Namuna: The cat is near the basket · 3-gaplar-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
Namuna: The cat is near the basket.

QOLIP: The cat IS + predlog + THE basket.
Har bir gapda 'the' ikki marta keladi — 'the cat' va 'the basket'.

topics.topic: Prepositions with places on the map — GEOGRAFIYA PREDLOGLARI — aniq qoidasi bor · 9-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
GEOGRAFIYA PREDLOGLARI — aniq qoidasi bor:

  IN the north/south/east/west OF + mamlakat
     Milan is IN the north OF Italy.
     (mamlakat ICHIDAGI qism)

  ON the ... coast OF + mamlakat
     Patras is ON the west coast OF Greece.
     ('coast' = qirg'oq — bu CHIZIQ, yuza → ON)

  IN + hudud/qit'a
     Norway is a country IN northern Europe.

ESLAB QOLING:
  'north' bo'lsa    → IN the north of
  'coast' bo'lsa    → ON the ... coast of

KITOBDAGI KOMPAS: north (shimol), south (janub),
east (sharq), west (g'arb).

QO'SHIMCHA — 'at home' va 'at work':
  Mr Jones isn't AT home. He is AT work.
  Bu turg'un birikmalarda 'the' YO'Q.

topics.topic: Possessives — OSON QOIDA: keyin OT bormi? · 16-egalik-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
OSON QOIDA: keyin OT bormi?
  Bor  → egalik SIFATI (my, your, his, her, its, our, their)
  Yo'q → egalik OLMOSHI (mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs)

topics.topic: Present Simple — the full table — KITOBDAGI TO'RT QOIDA · 17-imlo-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI TO'RT QOIDA:

  1) Ko'p fe'llar oddiy -s oladi:
     I work → he works

  2) -ss, -sh, -ch, -x, -o bilan tugasa → -es:
     I finish → he finishes,  I go → he goes

  3) UNDOSH + y bilan tugasa → y tushadi, -ies:
     I fly → he flies

  4) UNLI + y bilan tugasa → oddiy -s:
     I play → he plays

3 va 4-qoidani ajratish uchun 'y' dan OLDINGI harfga qarang.

topics.topic: Possessive Pronouns / Adjectives — RASMLAR JADVALI — kim nimaga egalik qiladi · 3-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
RASMLAR JADVALI — kim nimaga egalik qiladi:

  Mark           — trumpet (karnay)
  Claire         — computer (kompyuter)
  Jason          — motorbike (mototsikl)
  Joanne         — TV (televizor)
  Jessica        — telephone (telefon)
  Mike           — balloons (sharlar)
  Bill & Laura   — car (mashina)
  Andrew & Lucy  — house (uy)
  Paul           — books (kitoblar)
  Linda          — flowers (gullar)
  John           — umbrella (soyabon)
  Denise         — pen (ruchka)

NAMUNA:
  A: Is that Mark's trumpet?
  B: Yes, it's HIS. It's HIS trumpet.

QOLIP — javob TO'G'RI bo'lsa:
  Yes, it's + EGALIK OLMOSHI. It's + EGALIK SIFATI + ot.

QOLIP — javob NOTO'G'RI bo'lsa:
  No, it isn't + EGALIK OLMOSHI. It's + HAQIQIY EGASI + 's.

DIQQAT: birinchi bo'shliqda ot YO'Q → olmosh (his, hers, theirs).
Ikkinchisida ot BOR → sifat (his, her, their) yoki ism + 's.

topics.topic: Possessive Pronouns / Adjectives (continued) — 18-betdagi rasmlar jadvalining davomi · 3-davomi-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
18-betdagi rasmlar jadvalining davomi:
  Linda  — flowers (gullar)
  John   — umbrella (soyabon)
  Denise — pen (ruchka)

QOLIP o'zgarmaydi:
  Birinchi bo'shliq — OT YO'Q → egalik OLMOSHI (his, hers, theirs, mine, yours)
  Ikkinchi bo'shliq — OT BOR  → egalik SIFATI (his, her, their) yoki ism + 's

topics.topic: Possessive Pronouns / Adjectives (continued) — KASBLAR RO'YXATI · 4-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KASBLAR RO'YXATI:
  vet           — veterinar (hayvon shifokori)
  farmer        — dehqon, fermer
  firefighters  — o't o'chiruvchilar (KO'PLIK!)
  music teacher — musiqa o'qituvchisi
  ballerina     — balerina
  chef          — oshpaz (restoranda bosh oshpaz)

RASMLAR:
  1) baletda raqsga tushayotgan ayol → ballerina (namuna)
  2) sariq kiyimdagi ikki kishi      → firefighters
  3) oq qalpoqdagi erkak             → chef
  4) mushuk ushlagan erkak           → vet
  5) traktordagi erkak               → farmer
  6) pianino chalayotgan ayol        → music teacher

SAVOL QOLIPI:
  BIRLIK:  What's his/her job?  — He's/She's a ...
  KO'PLIK: What are their jobs? — They're ...

DIQQAT:
  • birlikda kasb oldida A/AN SHART: She's A ballerina.
  • ko'plikda artikl QO'YILMAYDI: They're firefighters.
  • ko'plikda 'job' ham ko'plikda: their jobS

topics.topic: Possessive adjectives — NAMUNA · 6-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
NAMUNA:
  cousin/Wendy → That's my cousin. Her name's Wendy.

QOLIP:
  1-gap: That's my + QARINDOSHLIK.
  2-gap: EGALIK SIFATI + name's + ISM.

EGALIK SIFATINI TANLASH:
  erkak qarindosh (son, brother, husband) → His
  ayol qarindosh (daughter, sister, wife) → Her
  hayvon                                  → Its
  'cousin' — ismga qarab: Wendy ayol → Her

QISQARTMA: name's = name is

topics.topic: Present Simple — Barchasi 3-shaxs birlik ('he') uchun · 9-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
Barchasi 3-shaxs birlik ('he') uchun.

IMLO QOIDALARI:
  oddiy -s  — ko'p fe'llar
  -es       — -ss, -sh, -ch, -x, -o bilan tugasa
  -ies      — undosh + y

IKKI ISTISNO — bu fe'llar QOIDAGA BO'YSUNMAYDI:
  I am  → he IS   ('ams' EMAS!)
  I have → he HAS  ('haves' EMAS!)

Bu ikkalasi eng ko'p ishlatiladigan fe'llar, shuning uchun
ularning noto'g'ri shaklini yodlab olish shart.

topics.topic: Present Simple — NAMUNA · 11-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
NAMUNA:
  Theresa (✓) exercising (✗) reading
  → Theresa likes exercising but she doesn't like reading.

QOLIP:
  EGA + likes/like + ✓ + BUT + olmosh + doesn't/don't like + ✗

IKKI QAROR:
  1) Ega 3-shaxs birlikmi?
     Ha  → likes ... doesn't like
     Yo'q → like ... don't like

  2) Ikkinchi qismda ISM o'rniga OLMOSH ishlatiladi:
     Theresa → she,  Nicole → she,  He → he,
     They → they,    We → we

DIQQAT: 'like' dan keyin fe'l -ING oladi (exercising, reading).
Lekin ot bo'lsa o'zgarmaydi (football, tennis, dogs, cats).

topics.topic: Revision: Units 1 - 4 — TAKRORLASH — 1, 2, 3 va 4-unitlarning barcha grammatikasi · 15-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
TAKRORLASH — 1, 2, 3 va 4-unitlarning barcha grammatikasi:

  Unit 1: to be, a/an, kelib chiqish (from), kasb
  Unit 2: have got, can, tashqi ko'rinish
  Unit 3: there is/are, some/any, o'rin predloglari
  Unit 4: olmoshlar, egalik, Who's/Whose, Present Simple

Xato qilsangiz — o'sha unit qoidasini qayta ko'rib chiqing.

topics.topic: Possessive Case — Qoidani mustahkamlash uchun qo'shimcha mashq · 8-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
Qoidani mustahkamlash uchun qo'shimcha mashq.
Har birida ot birlikmi-ko'plikmi ekaniga qarang.

topics.topic: Possessive Pronouns — Har bir gapda IKKI tanlov bor — ikkalasini ham to'g'ri qiling · 16-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
Har bir gapda IKKI tanlov bor — ikkalasini ham to'g'ri qiling.

QAROR QOIDASI:
  • Keyin OT kelsami? → egalik SIFATI (my, your, his, her, our, their)
  • Ot YO'QMI?        → egalik OLMOSHI (mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs)
  • Savol odam haqidami? → Who's
  • Savol egasi haqidami (keyin ot kelsa)? → Whose

topics.topic: Present Simple — Kitobdagi to'ldirilishi kerak bo'lgan ikkita qoida · 17-mashq
topics.rule_uz: Kitobdagi to'ldirilishi kerak bo'lgan ikkita qoida.

topics.topic: Present Simple — Har bir fe'l uchun IMLO qoidasini tanlang · 18-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
Har bir fe'l uchun IMLO qoidasini tanlang:

  oddiy -s     — ko'pchilik fe'llar
  -es          — -ss, -sh, -ch, -x, -o bilan tugasa
  -ies         — UNDOSH + y bilan tugasa (y tushadi)
  oddiy -s     — UNLI + y bilan tugasa (y qoladi)

topics.topic: Present Simple — Uchala qoidani ham aralash mashq qilamiz · 18-imlo-mashq
topics.rule_uz: Uchala qoidani ham aralash mashq qilamiz.

topics.topic: Present Simple — Tonining xati BUTUNLAY Present Simple da yozilgan — · 19-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
Tonining xati BUTUNLAY Present Simple da yozilgan —
chunki u DOIMIY holatlar va KUNDALIK tartib haqida.

Har bir fe'lni topganda ikki narsaga qarang:
  1) egasi kim? (I / he / she / we)
  2) -s bormi yoki yo'qmi?

Qoidani tekshiring: -s faqat he/she/it bilan bo'lishi kerak.

topics.topic: jobs — KASBLAR RO'YXATI · 5-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KASBLAR RO'YXATI:
  surgeons    — jarrohlar (KO'PLIK!)
  actress     — aktrisa
  astronaut   — kosmonavt
  doctor      — shifokor
  taxi driver — taksi haydovchisi
  dentist     — tish shifokori

RASMLAR:
  1) stetoskopli ayol            → doctor (namuna)
  2) skafandrdagi odam           → astronaut
  3) tishni davolayotgan odam    → dentist
  4) operatsiya xonasidagi odamlar → surgeons
  5) taksi yonidagi erkak        → taxi driver
  6) sahnadagi ayol              → actress

UCHTA QOIDA:
  1) BIRLIKDA kasb oldida A yoki AN SHART
  2) A yoki AN — keyingi so'zning TOVUSHIGA qarab:
     a doctor, a dentist, a taxi driver  (undosh)
     an astronaut, an actress            (unli)
  3) KO'PLIKDA artikl QO'YILMAYDI va savol ham o'zgaradi:
     What are their jobs? — They're surgeons.

topics.topic: jobs — RASMLAR JADVALI — kim nimaga egalik qiladi · 6-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
RASMLAR JADVALI — kim nimaga egalik qiladi:

  Lucy          — pencils (qalamlar)
  Mark and John — CDs (disklar)
  Bill          — dog (it)
  Tom           — hat (shlyapa)
  Greg          — bicycle (velosiped)
  Joe           — boots (etiklar)
  Rob and Jane  — car (mashina)
  Tim           — basketball (basketbol to'pi)
  Carol         — books (kitoblar)
  Sarah         — cat (mushuk)

NAMUNA:
  A: Are these pencils Lucy's?
  B: Yes, they're HERS. They're HER pencils.

QOLIP:
  Birinchi bo'shliq — OT YO'Q  → egalik OLMOSHI
                                 (mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs)
  Ikkinchi bo'shliq — OT BORmi?
                     bor  → egalik SIFATI (his, her, their) yoki ism + 's
                     yo'q → ism + 's

DIQQAT — JINSGA qarang:
  Lucy, Sarah, Carol, Jane — AYOL → hers / her
  Mark, John, Bill, Tom, Greg, Joe, Tim, Rob, Jeff — ERKAK → his
  ikki kishi — theirs / their

topics.topic: Adverbs of Frequency — SO'Z TARTIBI QOIDASI · 1-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
SO'Z TARTIBI QOIDASI:

  EGA + (RAVISH) + FE'L + TO'LDIRUVCHI + JOY + VAQT

NAMUNA:
  at / the morning / he / seven o'clock / in / gets up
  → He gets up at seven o'clock in the morning.
     ↑    ↑        ↑                ↑
    ega  fe'l    aniq vaqt      umumiy vaqt

VAQT IFODALARI TARTIBI: ANIQDAN UMUMIYGA
  at seven o'clock (aniq) → in the morning (umumiy)
  ✅ at seven o'clock in the morning
  ❌ in the morning at seven o'clock

RAVISH QAYERDA:
  oddiy fe'l bilan → fe'ldan OLDIN
  'to be' bilan    → fe'ldan KEYIN

topics.topic: Adverbs of Frequency — RO'YXAT (8 ta ibora) · 2-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
RO'YXAT (8 ta ibora):
  get up early         — erta turmoq
  clean my room        — xonamni tozalamoq
  play football        — futbol o'ynamoq
  go for a walk        — sayrga chiqmoq
  go to school         — maktabga bormoq
  watch TV             — televizor ko'rmoq
  play computer games  — kompyuter o'yini o'ynamoq
  go out with friends  — do'stlar bilan sayrga chiqmoq

NAMUNA:
  I USUALLY get up early on Mondays.

QOLIP:
  I + RAVISH + fe'l + ON MONDAYS.

DIQQAT:
  'on Mondays' — KO'PLIKDA, 'har dushanba' degani
  'I' bilan fe'l -s OLMAYDI (get, play, watch — s siz)
  ravish fe'ldan OLDIN turadi

topics.topic: Prepositions of Time: at, in, on — KATTA HARF QOIDASI (kitobdagi yulduzchali eslatma) · 22-katta-harf-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KATTA HARF QOIDASI (kitobdagi yulduzchali eslatma):

  KATTA harf bilan:
    oylar:       January, February, March, ...
    hafta kunlari: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, ...
    millat:      English, Uzbek, Spanish
    mamlakat:    England, Uzbekistan
    tillar:      English, Uzbek

  KICHIK harf bilan:
    fasllar:     spring, summer, autumn, winter
    kun qismlari: morning, afternoon, evening, night

Bu farqni yodda tuting — fasllar KATTA harf bilan YOZILMAYDI!

topics.topic: Prepositions of Time — O'nta gap, ba'zilarida IKKI bo'shliq · 4-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
O'nta gap, ba'zilarida IKKI bo'shliq.

QOIDANI ESLANG:
  AT — soat, the weekend, night, noon
  ON — hafta kunlari, aniq kunning qismlari, sanalar
  IN — oylar, fasllar, yillar, the morning/evening/afternoon

topics.topic: Present Simple (continued) — DIQQAT — SAVOL MENDIGA BERILADI! · 10b-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
DIQQAT — SAVOL MENDIGA BERILADI!
Shuning uchun 'you' ishlatiladi va javob 'I' bilan beriladi:

  SA: Do YOU go to the café at six o'clock?
  SB: Yes, I do.

Agar ega boshqa bo'lsa — 'they' bilan:
  SA: Do THE OTHER WAITERS arrive at six o'clock?
  SB: No, THEY don't. They arrive at seven o'clock.

JAVOB QOIDASI:
  Matndagi vaqt savoldagi vaqt bilan MOS kelsa → Yes, I do.
  Mos kelmasa → No, I don't. + TO'G'RI ma'lumot.

MATNDAGI VAQTLAR (tekshirish uchun):
  Mendi kafega — 6:00
  boshqa ofitsiantlar — 7:00
  birinchi mijozlar — 7:30
  tanaffus — 10:00
  ish tugaydi — 2:00
  uyga yetadi — 3:00

topics.topic: Adverbs of Frequency — KITOBDAGI NAMUNALAR · 11-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNALAR:
  I USUALLY get up at half past seven in the morning.
  I am NEVER late for school.

Birinchi gapda 'usually' fe'l 'get up' dan OLDIN.
Ikkinchi gapda 'never' fe'l 'am' dan KEYIN.

QOIDA: 'Adverbs of frequency usually come ____ the main verb,
but ____ the verb to be.'

topics.topic: Adverbs of Frequency — JADVAL: 6 ta mashg'ulot × 6 ta chastota · 12a-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
JADVAL: 6 ta mashg'ulot × 6 ta chastota

  MASHG'ULOTLAR:
    go climbing    — toqqa chiqish
    wash the car   — mashina yuvish
    go to the gym  — sport zaliga borish
    cook           — ovqat pishirish
    go on a picnic — piknikka borish
    go dancing     — raqsga borish

  CHASTOTA SHKALASI:
    never 0% | rarely 10% | sometimes 25% |
    often 50% | usually 75% | always 100%

NAMUNA (kitobda berilgan):
  Laura NEVER goes climbing on Sundays.

QOLIP:
  Laura + RAVISH + fe'l+S + on Sundays.

DIQQAT: 'on Sundays' — KO'PLIKDA, 'har yakshanba' degani.

topics.topic: Adverbs of Frequency — RO'YXAT (11 ibora) · 12b-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
RO'YXAT (11 ibora):
  do the washing-up  — idish yuvish
  go jogging         — yugurishga chiqish
  go to the cinema   — kinoga borish
  go shopping        — xaridga borish
  eat out            — tashqarida ovqatlanish
  watch TV           — televizor ko'rish
  go fishing         — baliq ovlashga borish
  visit museums      — muzeylarga borish
  go climbing        — toqqa chiqish
  go windsurfing     — vindserfing qilish
  meet friends       — do'stlar bilan uchrashish

QOLIP (o'zingiz haqingizda — fe'l -s OLMAYDI):
  I + RAVISH + fe'l + on Sundays.
  I always meet friends on Sundays.

DIQQAT — 'go' bilan mashg'ulotlar:
  go jogging, go shopping, go fishing, go climbing,
  go windsurfing, go dancing — hammasi 'go + -ing'
  LEKIN: go TO the cinema (joyga borish — 'to' bilan)

topics.topic: Prepositions of Time — JADVAL · 16-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
JADVAL:
         DATE          MONTH   YEAR   TIME    PART OF DAY
  Tom    Friday 22nd   March   1957   10:30   night
  Mary   Monday 6th    July    ?      2:00    ?
  Roy    ? 3rd         August  1955   ?       afternoon
  You    (o'zingiz)

NAMUNA GAP (kitobda berilgan):
  Tom was born ON Friday the 22nd of March, IN 1957,
  AT half past ten AT night.

QOLIP — TO'RTTA PREDLOG bir gapda:
  was born ON + kun va sana
           IN + yil
           AT + soat
           AT night / IN the morning / IN the afternoon

SANA O'QILISHI:
  Friday 22nd March → Friday the twenty-second of March
  ('the' va 'of' qo'shiladi!)

TARTIB SONLAR:
  1st first, 2nd second, 3rd third, 4th fourth,
  6th sixth, 22nd twenty-second, 3rd third

topics.topic: Prepositions of Time — SANA O'QILISHIDA 'the' va 'of' QO'SHILADI · 16-sana-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
SANA O'QILISHIDA 'the' va 'of' QO'SHILADI:

  Yozilishi: 22 March
  O'qilishi: the twenty-second OF March

  Yozilishi: Friday 22nd March 1957
  O'qilishi: Friday THE twenty-second OF March, nineteen fifty-seven

TARTIB SONLAR QOIDASI:
  1 → first (1st)      2 → second (2nd)    3 → third (3rd)
  4 → fourth (4th)     5 → fifth (5th)     6 → sixth (6th)
  ...
  20 → twentieth (20th)
  21 → twenty-first    22 → twenty-second  23 → twenty-third
  30 → thirtieth (30th) 31 → thirty-first

topics.topic: work and routine — JADVAL · 7-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
JADVAL:
  NAME  | JOB       | PLACE            | START | FINISH
  Bob   | doctor    | hospital         | 06:30 | 20:30
  Brett | life-guard| swimming pool    | 09:00 | 19:15
  Jean  | reporter  | newspaper office | 10:45 | 18:30

NAMUNA (Bob):
  Bob is a doctor. He works at a hospital.
  He starts work at half past six in the morning.
  He finishes work at half past eight in the evening.

QOLIP — TO'RT GAP:
  1) ISM + is a + KASB.
  2) He/She works at a + JOY.
  3) He/She starts work at + VAQT + kun qismi.
  4) He/She finishes work at + VAQT + kun qismi.

DIQQAT — 24 SOATLIK VAQTNI 12 SOATLIKKA aylantiring:
  06:30 → half past six IN THE MORNING
  20:30 → half past eight IN THE EVENING (20 − 12 = 8)
  19:15 → a quarter past seven IN THE EVENING (19 − 12 = 7)
  18:30 → half past six IN THE EVENING (18 − 12 = 6)
  10:45 → a quarter to eleven IN THE MORNING

JEAN — AYOL ismi, shuning uchun 'She'.

topics.topic: work and routine — FOIZ SHKALASI (kitobdagi chiziq) · 8-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
FOIZ SHKALASI (kitobdagi chiziq):
  0%   never
  10%  rarely
  25%  sometimes
  50%  often
  75%  usually
  100% always

FEYNING MASHG'ULOTLARI:
  1  have / shower / evening      (75%)
  2  play / tennis / afternoon    (25%)
  3  eat / a croissant / morning  (100%)
  4  drink / coffee / night       (0%)
  5  go / theatre / weekend       (50%)
  6  listen / music / evening     (10%)

NAMUNA:
  Faye USUALLY HAS a shower IN THE evening.

QOLIP:
  Faye + RAVISH + fe'l+S + to'ldiruvchi + vaqt predlogi.

UCH NARSAGA DIQQAT:
  1) ravish fe'ldan OLDIN
  2) fe'l 3-shaxs -s oladi (Faye — ayol ismi)
  3) vaqt predlogi to'g'ri bo'lsin:
     in the evening / afternoon / morning
     AT night (istisno!)
     AT the weekend (istisno!)

topics.topic: Sally's weekend — Matnda BESHTA takrorlanish ravishi bor · 10a-ravish-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
Matnda BESHTA takrorlanish ravishi bor.
Har birini toping va Salli nima qilishini ayting.

QOLIP:
  Sally ALWAYS + fe'l+S + ...
  She USUALLY + fe'l+S + ...
  They SOMETIMES + fe'l + ...  ('they' ko'plik → -s YO'Q)

topics.topic: Sally's weekend — O'ZINGIZ haqingizda — fe'l -s OLMAYDI · 10b-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
O'ZINGIZ haqingizda — fe'l -s OLMAYDI:
  Sally always GETS up. (u)
  I always GET up.      (men)

QOLIP:
  I + RAVISH + fe'l + ... + vaqt.

Dam olish kunlari uchun vaqt iboralari:
  at the weekend  — dam olish kunlari
  on Saturdays    — shanba kunlari
  on Sunday mornings — yakshanba ertalablari

topics.topic: Sally's weekend — 18 TA IBORA, uch guruhga bo'linadi (har birida 6 ta) · 12-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
18 TA IBORA, uch guruhga bo'linadi (har birida 6 ta).

RO'YXAT:
  May, spring, Monday, 5 o'clock, the weekend, 1959,
  the evening, 13th May, winter, Friday, the morning,
  night, 11:30, noon, Wednesday morning, 2 o'clock,
  4th January, Tuesday night

QOIDA:
  IN — oy, fasl, yil, kun qismi (kun nomisiz)
  AT — soat, the weekend, night, noon
  ON — hafta kunlari, sanalar, kun nomi bilan kun qismi

ENG CHALKASH JUFTLIKLAR:
  'night' (yolg'iz)        → AT night
  'Tuesday night' (kun nomi bilan) → ON Tuesday night

  'the morning' (yolg'iz)  → IN the morning
  'Wednesday morning' (kun nomi bilan) → ON Wednesday morning

QOIDA: KUN NOMI bo'lsa — DOIM ON.

topics.topic: Theory — Questions and Irregular Plurals — Nazariya — So'roq so'zlari va noto'g'ri ko'plik (1)
topics.rule_uz:
O'NTA SO'ROQ SO'ZI VA ULARNING VAZIFASI:

  WHO ......... kim?              — odam
  WHERE ....... qayerda?          — joy
  WHY ......... nega?             — sabab (javob: Because ...)
  WHEN ........ qachon?           — vaqt
  WHAT ........ nima?             — narsa, hayvon, ish
  HOW LONG .... qancha vaqt?      — davomiylik
                qancha uzun?      — uzunlik
  HOW MUCH .... qancha?           — og'irlik, narx, SANALMAYDIGAN miqdor
  HOW MANY .... nechta?           — SANALADIGAN miqdor
  HOW OFTEN ... qanchalik tez-tez? — chastota
  HOW ......... qanday?           — usul, yo'l

SAVOL TUZILISHI:
  So'roq so'zi + DO/DOES + ega + fe'l (asos shakli)?
     Where DO kangaroos LIVE?
     How often DOES a dog EAT?

  'be', 'can', 'have got' bilan DO/DOES KERAK EMAS:
     Who IS Michael?
     What CAN a sea lion do?
     How many legs HAS a lion GOT?
examples: Who is Michael? — He's my brother.
Where do kangaroos live? — They live in Australia.
Why do dolphins learn easily? — Because they're intelligent.
When do tigers sleep? — They sleep during the day.
What do koalas eat? — They eat eucalyptus leaves.
How long do sea lions live? — They live for about 15 years.
How much does an elephant weigh? — About 4,000 kilos.
How many legs has a lion got? — A lion has got four legs.

topics.topic: Theory — Questions and Irregular Plurals — Nazariya — So'roq so'zlari va noto'g'ri ko'plik (2)
topics.rule_uz:
IKKI GURUH:

  1) O'ZAK O'ZGARADI
       man    → men       (erkak)
       woman  → women     (ayol)
       tooth  → teeth     (tish)
       child  → children  (bola)
       person → people    (shaxs)
       foot   → feet      (oyoq kafti)
       mouse  → mice      (sichqon)
       goose  → geese     (g'oz)
       ox     → oxen      (ho'kiz)

  2) SHAKL O'ZGARMAYDI
       deer  → deer   (kiyik)
       fish  → fish   (baliq)
       sheep → sheep  (qo'y)

DIQQAT: bularning hech biriga -S QO'SHILMAYDI.
'mans', 'childs', 'mouses', 'sheeps', 'fishs' — HAMMASI XATO.
examples: man - men
woman - women
tooth - teeth
child - children
person - people
foot - feet
mouse - mice
goose - geese

topics.topic: counting with irregular plurals — KITOBDAGI NAMUNA: I can see three giraffes · 6-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA: I can see three giraffes.

QOLIP: I can see + son + hayvon (KO'PLIKDA).

RASMDA 8 XIL HAYVON BOR, JAMI 25 TA:
  baliq (fish) ....... 5
  kapalak (butterfly)  4
  sichqon (mouse) .... 4
  jirafa (giraffe) ... 3
  g'oz (goose) ....... 3
  kiyik (deer) ....... 2
  qo'y (sheep) ....... 2
  ho'kiz (ox) ........ 2

DIQQAT — BU MASHQ ATAYLAB TUZILGAN:
sakkiz hayvonning OLTITASI noto'g'ri ko'plikka ega —
fish, deer, sheep, mice, geese, oxen.
Faqat 'giraffes' va 'butterflies' oddiy qoida bo'yicha yasaladi.

topics.topic: counting with irregular plurals — KALIT (Key) · 7-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KALIT (Key):
  +++  =  very   (juda)
  ++   =  quite  (ancha)

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA: Deer have got quite long legs.
  (deer: ++ long legs → QUITE long legs)

QOLIP:
  Hayvon (ko'plik) + have got + very/quite + sifat + ot.

DIQQAT — BITTA yoki KO'PLIK tana qismi:
  Juft bo'lgan qismlar KO'PLIKDA: legs, ears, eyes, claws, antlers
  Bittalik qismlar 'a' bilan BIRLIKDA: a tail, a trunk
     Elephants have got A very long trunk.
  (Ko'plik shakli ham to'g'ri: ... very long trunkS.)

topics.topic: Theory — Present Continuous — Nazariya — Hozirgi davomli zamon (1)
topics.rule_uz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS — TO'LIQ JADVAL

  TASDIQ            SO'ROQ                 INKOR
  I'm playing       Am I playing?          I'm not playing
  you're playing    Are you playing?       you aren't playing
  he's playing      Is he playing?         he isn't playing
  she's playing     Is she playing?        she isn't playing
  it's playing      Is it playing?         it isn't playing
  we're playing     Are we playing?        we aren't playing
  you're playing    Are you playing?       you aren't playing
  they're playing   Are they playing?      they aren't playing

UCH SHAKLNI SOLISHTIRING:
  TASDIQ:  ega + be + fe'l-ing
  SO'ROQ:  be + ega + fe'l-ing?   ('be' oldinga chiqadi)
  INKOR:   ega + be + NOT + fe'l-ing

DIQQAT: barcha shakllarda ASOSIY FE'L o'zgarmaydi —
faqat 'to be' o'zgaradi.
examples: I'm playing. / Am I playing? / I'm not playing.
You're playing. / Are you playing? / You aren't playing.
He's playing. / Is he playing? / He isn't playing.
She's playing. / Is she playing? / She isn't playing.
It's playing. / Is it playing? / It isn't playing.
We're playing. / Are we playing? / We aren't playing.
They're playing. / Are they playing? / They aren't playing.

topics.topic: Theory — Present Continuous — Nazariya — Hozirgi davomli zamon (2)
topics.rule_uz:
YASALISHI (Form):
  'to be' fe'li + asosiy fe'lning asos shakli + -ING

ISHLATILISHI (Use):
  1) HOZIR, gapirayotgan paytda sodir bo'layotgan ish:
       I'm playing tennis now.
  2) Gapirish PAYTI ATROFIDA davom etayotgan ish:
       We're looking for a flat at the moment.
     (Aynan hozir qidirmayotgan bo'lishi ham mumkin,
      lekin bu kunlarda shu ish davom etyapti.)

VAQT IFODALARI:
  now (hozir), at the moment (ayni paytda),
  at present (hozirda)

IMLO (Spelling) — UCH QOIDA:
  1) Ko'pchilik fe'l: shunchaki -ing → look - looking
  2) Ikki undosh ORASIDAGI bitta urg'uli unli bo'lsa,
     oxirgi undosh IKKILANADI → run - running
  3) -e bilan tugasa, -e TUSHADI → take - taking
examples: We form the present continuous with the verb "to be" and add -ing to the base form of the main verb.
We use the present continuous for actions happening now, at the moment of speaking. — I'm playing tennis now.
We also use the present continuous for actions happening around the time of speaking. — We're looking for a flat at the moment.
Time expressions used with the present continuous: now, at the moment, at present.
Most verbs take -ing after the base form of the main verb. — look - looking
Verbs ending in one stressed vowel between two consonants double the last consonant and take -ing. — run - running
Verbs ending in -e drop the -e and take -ing. — take - taking

topics.topic: Theory — Present Continuous — Nazariya — Hozirgi davomli zamon (3)
topics.rule_uz:
QISQA JAVOBLAR JADVALI:

  Are you ...?   → Yes, I am.     / No, I'm not.
                   Yes, we are.   / No, we aren't.

  Is he/she/it ...? → Yes, he/she/it is.
                      No, he/she/it isn't.

  Are they ...?  → Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.

QOIDA:
  Qisqa javobda 'Yes' yoki 'No', EGA OLMOSHI va
  'to be' fe'lining to'g'ri shakli ishlatiladi.
  Asosiy fe'l (-ing bilan) TAKRORLANMAYDI.

  TO'G'RI: Is he playing? — Yes, he is.
  XATO:    Yes, he is playing.  (takrorlanmaydi)
  XATO:    Yes, he's.           (tasdiqda qisqartma yo'q)

DIQQAT — SAVOL 'YOU' BILAN BO'LSA:
  Javob 'I' yoki 'WE' bilan beriladi — kimga qaratilganiga qarab.
examples: Are you playing? — Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
Are you playing? — Yes, we are. / No, we aren't.
Is he playing? — Yes, he is. / No, he isn't.
Is she playing? — Yes, she is. / No, she isn't.
Is it playing? — Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.
Are they playing? — Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.
In short answers we use "Yes" or "No", the subject pronoun and the verb "to be" in the correct form. We do not repeat the main verb with the -ing.

topics.topic: Theory — Present Continuous — Nazariya — Hozirgi davomli zamon (4)
topics.rule_uz:
IKKI ZAMONNI SOLISHTIRISH — ENG MUHIM MAVZU

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS          PRESENT SIMPLE
  (be + fe'l-ing)             (fe'l / fe'l-s)

  HOZIR sodir bo'layotgan     ODAT va KUNDALIK tartib
  ish uchun:                  uchun:
    I'm studying now.           I go to work every day.

  Gapirish PAYTI ATROFIDA     DOIMIY holat uchun:
  davom etayotgan ish:          He lives in Manchester.
    He is working late
    these days.

VAQT SO'ZLARI BILAN FARQLASH:
  Present Continuous: now, at the moment, at present,
                      today, these days
  Present Simple:     every day, usually, always,
                      often, sometimes, never

MISOL — BIR FE'L, IKKI ZAMON:
  I'm studying now.        — hozir o'qiyapman (vaqtinchalik)
  I study every evening.   — har kuni kechqurun o'qiyman (odat)
examples: We use the present continuous for actions happening now. — I'm studying now.
We also use the present continuous for actions happening around the time of speaking. — He is working late these days.
We use the present simple for habits or daily routines. — I go to work every day.
We also use the present simple for permanent states. — He lives in Manchester.
topics.source: Grammar Book, 30-bet, Present Continuous vs Present Simple

topics.topic: Present Continuous vs Present Simple — QAYSI ZAMONNI TANLASH — VAQT SO'ZIGA QARANG · 5-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
QAYSI ZAMONNI TANLASH — VAQT SO'ZIGA QARANG:

  PRESENT SIMPLE (odat, doimiy holat):
     usually, always, often, sometimes, never,
     every day / every Sunday / every afternoon,
     in her free time, in the summer

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS (hozir sodir bo'layotgan ish):
     now, at the moment, at present, today

PRESENT SIMPLE YASALISHI:
  I / you / we / they  → fe'l (asos shakli)
  he / she / it        → fe'l + S

  -s QO'SHISH QOIDALARI:
     oddiy:                wake up → wakes up
     -ch, -sh, -s, -x, -o: watch → watches;  go → goes
     undosh + y:           study → studies

PRESENT CONTINUOUS YASALISHI:
  ega + am/is/are + fe'l-ING

topics.topic: Present Continuous — Hozirgi davomli zamon
topics.rule_uz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS (hozirgi davomli zamon)

TASDIQ (Affirmative):
  I           AM     playing
  you         ARE    playing
  he/she/it   IS     playing
  we/you/they ARE    playing

INKOR (Negative):
  I           'M NOT  playing
  you         AREN'T  playing
  he/she/it   ISN'T   playing
  we/you/they AREN'T  playing

QOLIP: ega + to be + fe'l + ING

QACHON ISHLATILADI:
  HOZIR, gapirayotgan paytda sodir bo'layotgan ish uchun.

VAQT SO'ZLARI:
  now (hozir), at present (hozirda), at the moment (ayni paytda)

MISOLLAR:
  She's playing football now.
  She isn't eating an ice-cream at the moment.

O'ZBEKCHADA: '-yapti' qo'shimchasi bilan beriladi.
  She is playing → U o'ynayapti
examples: I am playing. / I'm not playing.
You are playing. / You aren't playing.
He is playing. / He isn't playing.
She is playing. / She isn't playing.
It is playing. / It isn't playing.
We are playing. / We aren't playing.
They are playing. / They aren't playing.
She's playing football now.

topics.topic: Present Continuous — QOIDA (bo'shliq bilan) · 12-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
QOIDA (bo'shliq bilan):
  'To form the present continuous we use the verb "to be"
   and add ............ to the base form of the main verb.'

  = Present Continuous yasash uchun 'to be' fe'lini ishlatamiz
    va asosiy fe'lning asos shakliga ............ qo'shamiz.

topics.topic: Present Continuous — -ING QO'SHISHNING UCH QOIDASI · 13-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
-ING QO'SHISHNING UCH QOIDASI:

  1) KO'PCHILIK FE'LLAR — shunchaki -ing qo'shiladi
       snow → snowing,  wear → wearing,
       rain → raining,  enjoy → enjoying

  2) BITTA URG'ULI UNLI + BITTA UNDOSH bilan tugasa —
     UNDOSH IKKILANADI
       swim → swiMMing,  run → ruNNing,  sit → siTTing
     Sabab: unli qisqa qolishi kerak.

  3) -E bilan tugasa — E TUSHADI
       make → makIng,  decorate → decoratIng,
       shine → shinIng,  write → writIng

DIQQAT: 'enjoy' -y bilan tugasa ham -ing oddiy qo'shiladi
(y dan oldin UNLI bor: enjOY).

topics.topic: Present Continuous — SO'ROQ SHAKLI (Interrogative) · 14-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
SO'ROQ SHAKLI (Interrogative):
  'be' fe'li EGADAN OLDIN chiqadi:
     Am I playing?    Are you playing?
     Is he playing?   Are they playing?

QISQA JAVOB QOIDASI:
  Yes, + ega + to'liq 'be' shakli.   (qisqartma YO'Q!)
  No,  + ega + qisqargan inkor shakli.

  TO'G'RI: Yes, I am.      XATO: Yes, I'm.
  TO'G'RI: No, I'm not.

JADVAL TO'LIQ HOLDA:
  Am I playing?      → Yes, I am.      / No, I'm not.
  Are you playing?   → Yes, you are.   / No, you aren't.
  Is he playing?     → Yes, he is.     / No, he isn't.
  Is she playing?    → Yes, she is.    / No, she isn't.
  Is it playing?     → Yes, it is.     / No, it isn't.
  Are we playing?    → Yes, we are.    / No, we aren't.
  Are you playing?   → Yes, you are.   / No, you aren't.
  Are they playing?  → Yes, they are.  / No, they aren't.

topics.topic: Present Continuous — correcting sentences — KITOBDAGI NAMUNA · 16-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  S1: Is Tony watching TV?
  S2: No, he isn't. He's playing tennis.

QOLIP:
  SAVOL:  Is/Are + ega + fe'l-ING?
  JAVOB:  No, he isn't/she isn't/they aren't. + He's/She's/They're + to'g'ri fe'l-ing.

Savolda BELGILANMAGAN variant so'raladi,
javobda esa BELGILANGAN variant aytiladi.

OLMOSHLAR:
  Tony → he;  Stella → she;  James → he
  Bob & Keith → they;  They → they;  She → she

topics.topic: Present Simple vs Present Continuous — KITOBDAGI IKKI MISOL · 22-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI IKKI MISOL:

  John usually WEARS jeans and T-shirts.
     = Jon odatda jinsi shim va futbolka kiyadi.  (ODAT)

  John's WEARING a suit and tie today.
     = Jon bugun kostyum va galstuk kiygan.  (BUGUN, HOZIR)

BIR ODAM, BIR FE'L — IKKI ZAMON:
  'usually' bor  → PRESENT SIMPLE
  'today' bor    → PRESENT CONTINUOUS

TO'LDIRILADIGAN QOIDALAR:
  We use ............ to talk about habits and daily routines.
  We use ............ to talk about actions happening now,
  at the moment of speaking.

  = Odat va kundalik tartib haqida gapirish uchun ...... ishlatamiz.
    Hozir, gapirayotgan paytda sodir bo'layotgan ish haqida
    gapirish uchun ...... ishlatamiz.

topics.topic: Present Continuous — UCH IMLO QOIDASI · 5-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
UCH IMLO QOIDASI:
  1) oddiy -ing:        read → reading
  2) undosh ikkilanadi: run → running
  3) -e tushadi:        make → making

topics.topic: Present Continuous — RASMDA ZIYOFAT (party) MANZARASI · 6a-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
RASMDA ZIYOFAT (party) MANZARASI:

  Joanna — chapda, kurtka va kalta yubkada, qo'lida stakan,
           ICHAYAPTI
  Hannah — uzun ko'ylakda, Ben bilan RAQSGA TUSHAYAPTI
  Ben    — kostyum va galstukda, Hannah bilan RAQSGA TUSHAYAPTI
  Thomas — o'rtada, kurtkada, qo'lida stakan,
           Amanda bilan GAPLASHAYAPTI
  Amanda — o'ngda, ko'ylakda, Thomas bilan GAPLASHAYAPTI
  Adam   — pastda o'tirgan, ko'ylakda, idishdan ichimlik QUYAYAPTI

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  Ben is wearing a suit and tie. He is dancing.

QOLIP (ikki gap):
  1) Ism + is wearing + kiyim.
  2) He/She + is + fe'l-ING.

topics.topic: Present Continuous — KITOBDAGI NAMUNA · 7-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  you/cook/dinner  →  Are you cooking dinner?

SAVOL QOLIPI:
  Am/Is/Are + ega + fe'l-ING + qolgan qism?

SO'ROQ SO'ZI BO'LSA:
  So'roq so'zi + is/are + ega + fe'l-ING?
     what/he/do/at the moment
     → What IS HE DOING at the moment?

'BE' FE'LINI TANLASH:
  you → ARE;  Jennifer, the dog, he, she → IS

topics.topic: Present Simple vs Present Continuous — HAR BANDDA UCH QISM BOR · 8-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
HAR BANDDA UCH QISM BOR:
  1) ODAT gapi (usually / often bilan) — Present Simple
  2) SAVOL (now bilan) — Present Continuous
  3) JAVOB — rasm va yordamchi so'zga qarab

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  Frank usually watches TV in the evenings.
  Is he watching TV now?
  No, he isn't. He is working on a computer.

JAVOB QOLIPI:
  No, he isn't / they aren't. + He's/They're + fe'l-ING.

RASM VA YORDAMCHI SO'ZLAR:
  1 — kompyuter oldida o'tirgan odam → work on a computer
  2 — stol ustida uxlayotgan odam (zZZZ) → sleep
  3 — plyajda qumda o'ynayotgan bolalar → play on the beach

topics.topic: Present Simple vs Present Continuous — HAR JUFTLIKDA FAQAT BITTASI TO'G'RI · 10-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
HAR JUFTLIKDA FAQAT BITTASI TO'G'RI.

MUHIM QOIDALAR:

  1) CHASTOTA RAVISHLARI (always, usually, often,
     sometimes, never) — PRESENT SIMPLE bilan keladi:
        Bob NEVER SWIMS  (to'g'ri)
        Bob is never swimming  (XATO)

  2) 'every day/morning' — PRESENT SIMPLE:
        Phil GETS UP every morning  (to'g'ri)

  3) 'in your free time' — ODAT → PRESENT SIMPLE:
        What DO you DO in your free time?  (to'g'ri)

  4) HOZIR sodir bo'layotgan ish — PRESENT CONTINUOUS:
        Dad IS WATCHING the game now.
        The baby IS SLEEPING.  ('Be quiet!' — hozir uxlayapti)

KITOBDA BERILGAN: 1a to'g'ri.

topics.topic: Theory — Plurals — Nazariya — Ko'plik (1)
topics.rule_uz:
KO'PLIK YASASHNING TO'RT QOIDASI:

  1) -F yoki -FE bilan tugasa → -VES
       loaf - loaVES,  knife - kniVES
     LEKIN ISTISNOLAR: cliff - cliffS,  roof - roofS

  2) UNDOSH + Y bilan tugasa → -IES
       cherry - cherrIES,  lady - ladIES

  3) UNLI + Y bilan tugasa → -S
       boy - boyS,  toy - toyS

  4) -O bilan tugasa → -ES
       tomato - tomatoES,  potato - potatoES
     LEKIN ISTISNOLAR: radio - radioS,  photo - photoS

DIQQAT — 2 va 3-QOIDANI FARQLASH:
  'y' dan OLDINGI harfga qarang:
     cherRY  — 'r' UNDOSH → cherrIES
     boY     — 'o' UNLI   → boyS

ISTISNOLARNI YOD OLING:
  -f/-fe lekin -S: cliff, roof, chief, belief
  -o lekin -S:     radio, photo, piano, video
examples: Some nouns ending in -f or -fe drop the -f or -fe and take -ves to form their plural. — loaf - loaves, knife - knives
BUT: cliff - cliffs, roof - roofs
Nouns ending in a consonant + y, drop the -y and take -ies. — cherry - cherries, lady - ladies
Nouns ending in a vowel + y, take -s. — boy - boys, toy - toys
Some nouns ending in -o take -es. — tomato - tomatoes, potato - potatoes
BUT: radio - radios, photo - photos

topics.topic: Theory — Plurals — Nazariya — Ko'plik (2)
topics.rule_uz:
SANALADIGAN OTLAR (Countable):
  • sanash mumkin: one lemon, two lemons, three lemons
  • BIRLIK va KO'PLIK shakli bor
  • BIRLIKDA: a/an bilan → a cherry, an orange
  • KO'PLIKDA: some bilan → some cherries, some oranges

SANALMAYDIGAN OTLAR (Uncountable):
  • sanab bo'lmaydi
  • faqat BIRLIK shakli bor
  • 'breads', 'butters' — XATO
  • some bilan → some bread, some butter
  • a/an bilan ISHLATILMAYDI

MIQDOR IBORALARI (phrases of quantity):
  slice, cup, bottle, glass, piece, carton, kilo, loaf, packet
  + OF + ot
     a bottle OF water
     a kilo OF apples

Bu iboralar SANALADIGAN otlar bilan ham,
SANALMAYDIGAN otlar bilan ham ishlatiladi.
examples: Countable nouns are those nouns which we can count. They have singular and plural forms. — one lemon, two lemons, three lemons
We use a/an with countable nouns in the singular. — a cherry, an orange
We use some with countable nouns in the plural. — some cherries, some oranges
Uncountable nouns are those nouns which we cannot count. They have only singular forms. — bread, butter (NOT: breads, butters)
We can use some with uncountable nouns. — some bread, some butter
We can use countable and uncountable nouns in phrases of quantity such as: slice, cup, bottle, glass, piece, carton, kilo, loaf, packet + of. — a bottle of water, a kilo of apples

topics.topic: Theory — Plurals — Nazariya — Ko'plik (3)
topics.rule_uz:
HOW MUCH / HOW MANY:
  how MUCH → SANALMAYDIGAN
     How much bread do you want?
  how MANY → SANALADIGAN
     How many potatoes do you want?

A FEW / A LITTLE:
  a FEW (= not many; some) → SANALADIGAN
     I want a few biscuits.
  a LITTLE (= not much; some) → SANALMAYDIGAN
     I want a little milk.

SOME / ANY:
  SOME → TASDIQ gapda
           sanaladigan KO'PLIK: some biscuits
           sanalmaydigan:       some milk
       → SAVOLDA, agar TAKLIF (offer) yoki ILTIMOS (request):
           Would you like some biscuits?   (offer)
           Can I have some water, please?  (request)

  ANY  → INKOR gapda
           I haven't got any strawberries.
       → oddiy SAVOLDA (ma'lumot so'rash)
           Have you got any milk?

ESLAB QOLISH USULI:
  MANY va FEW — SANALADIGAN
  MUCH va LITTLE — SANALMAYDIGAN
examples: We use how much with uncountable nouns. — How much bread do you want?
We use how many with countable nouns. — How many potatoes do you want?
We use a few (= not many; some) with countable nouns. — I want a few biscuits.
We use a little (= not much; some) with uncountable nouns. — I want a little milk.
We use some in the affirmative with countable nouns in the plural and uncountable nouns. — I want some biscuits and some milk.
We use some in the interrogative form for offers or requests. — Would you like some biscuits? (offer) Can I have some water, please? (request)
We use any in the negative and interrogative form. — I haven't got any strawberries. Have you got any milk?
topics.source: Grammar Book, 34-bet, nazariya (How Much/How Many, A Few/A Little, Some/Any)

topics.topic: Plurals — JADVAL · 6-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
JADVAL:
  SINGULAR   PLURAL
  loaf     - loaVES
  cherry   - cherrIES
  boy      - boyS
  tomato   - tomatoES

TO'LDIRILADIGAN QOIDALAR:

  1) Some nouns ending in -f or -fe drop the -f and take
     ............ to form their plural.
     = -f yoki -fe bilan tugagan ba'zi otlar -f ni tashlab,
       ko'plik yasash uchun ...... oladi.

  2) Nouns ending in a consonant + y, drop the -y and take
     ...... .
     = UNDOSH + y bilan tugagan otlar -y ni tashlab ...... oladi.

  3) Nouns ending in a vowel + y take -s.  (BERILGAN)
     = UNLI + y bilan tugagan otlar -s oladi.

  4) Some nouns ending in -o take ............ .
     = -o bilan tugagan ba'zi otlar ...... oladi.

DIQQAT — 2 va 3-QOIDANI SOLISHTIRING:
  cherRY  — 'r' UNDOSH + y → cherrIES
  boY     — 'o' UNLI + y  → boyS

topics.topic: Plurals — Har bir so'z uchun 6-mashqdagi QAYSI qoida ishlashini aniqlang · 7-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
Har bir so'z uchun 6-mashqdagi QAYSI qoida ishlashini aniqlang:
  -f / -fe → -VES
  undosh + y → -IES
  unli + y → -S
  -o → -ES

topics.topic: Plurals — Ko'plik
topics.rule_uz:
IKKI TURDAGI OT:

  COUNTABLE (sanaladigan)
     Sanash mumkin: 1/2/3/4 apples
     BIRLIK va KO'PLIK shakli bor: an apple / apples
     'a/an' bilan keladi

  UNCOUNTABLE (sanalmaydigan)
     Sanab bo'lmaydi: some meat, some sugar
     Faqat BIRLIK shakli bor
     'a/an' bilan KELMAYDI

QOIDALAR:
  • A/AN faqat SANALADIGAN otning BIRLIGI bilan:
       a tomato, an egg
       'A SUGAR' XATO!
  • SOME ikkalasi bilan ham:
       sanaladigan KO'PLIK: some biscuits
       sanalmaydigan:       some bread

QANDAY ANIQLASH:
  Otning oldiga son qo'yib ko'ring:
     'two apples' — mumkin → SANALADIGAN
     'two sugars' — mumkin emas → SANALMAYDIGAN

SANALMAYDIGAN OTLAR ODATDA:
  suyuqlik (water, milk, juice, coffee, tea)
  kukun/donador (sugar, salt, flour, rice)
  massa (bread, cheese, meat, butter, jam, honey, ham)
examples: Countable nouns are those which we can count. They have singular and plural forms. — 1/2/3/4 apples
Uncountable nouns are those which we cannot count. They have only singular forms. — some meat/sugar
A/An is only used with countable nouns in the singular. — a tomato / an egg (NOT: a sugar)
Some is used with either countable nouns in the plural or uncountable nouns. — some bread / some biscuits

topics.topic: Phrases of quantity — Miqdor iboralari
topics.rule_uz:
MIQDOR IBORALARI — SANALMAYDIGAN OTNI SANASH USULI.

QOLIP: a/two/three + MIQDOR SO'ZI + OF + ot

  a slice OF bread     — bir bo'lak non
  a bottle OF wine     — bir shisha vino
  a glass OF water     — bir stakan suv
  a packet OF crisps   — bir paket chips
  a kilo OF sugar      — bir kilo shakar
  a loaf OF bread      — bir non (butun)
  a cup OF tea         — bir piyola choy
  a carton OF milk     — bir paket sut
  a piece OF cheese    — bir bo'lak pishloq
  a bowl OF soup       — bir kosa sho'rva

DIQQAT: 'OF' HECH QACHON TUSHIB QOLMAYDI.
  'a glass water' XATO → 'a glass OF water'

KO'PLIK: miqdor so'zi ko'plikka o'tadi, ot esa o'zgarmaydi:
  two glassES of water,  three cupS of tea
examples: a slice of bread / cake / pizza
a bottle of wine / water / Coke
a glass of wine / water / juice
a packet of crisps / cereal / sugar
a kilo of sugar / flour / potatoes
a loaf of bread
a cup of tea / coffee
a carton of milk / juice

topics.topic: Phrases of quantity — OTLAR: Coke, flour, cake, juice, water, tea, cereal, sugar · 9b-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
OTLAR: Coke, flour, cake, juice, water, tea, cereal, sugar

9a-RO'YXAT: slice, bottle, glass, packet, bowl, loaf,
            cup, carton, piece

BA'ZI OTLAR BIR NECHA MIQDOR SO'ZI BILAN KELADI —
qanday IDISHDA ekaniga qarab.

UMUMIY QOIDALAR:
  suyuqlik → bottle, glass, carton, cup
  kukun    → packet, kilo
  qattiq   → slice, piece
  yumshoq/donador → bowl, packet

topics.topic: How Much / How Many — A Few / A Little — KITOBDAGI MISOLLAR · 11-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI MISOLLAR:

  SA: How MUCH milk do you need?
  SB: Just a LITTLE.

  SA: How MANY carrots do you need?
  SB: Just a FEW.

TO'LDIRILADIGAN QOIDALAR:
  We use ...... and ...... with UNCOUNTABLE nouns.
  We use ...... and ...... with COUNTABLE nouns.

ASOSIY JADVAL:

  SANALMAYDIGAN (milk, bread, flour)
     savol:  HOW MUCH ...?
     javob:  A LITTLE  (bir oz)

  SANALADIGAN (carrots, eggs, bananas)
     savol:  HOW MANY ...?
     javob:  A FEW  (bir nechta)

ESLATMA — ESLAB QOLISH USULI:
  MANY va FEW — ikkalasida ham SANALADIGAN otlar
  MUCH va LITTLE — ikkalasida ham SANALMAYDIGAN otlar

DIQQAT: 'just' = shunchaki, atigi — javobni yumshatadi.

topics.topic: How Much / How Many — A Few / A Little — XARID RO'YXATI (Shopping List) · 12-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
XARID RO'YXATI (Shopping List):
  2 kilos of meat  ✓ (kerak — kitobda belgilangan)
  10 eggs          ✗ (kerak emas — kitobda chizib tashlangan)
  1 kilo of cheese
  20 slices of ham
  2 loaves of bread
  1 kilo of tomatoes
  2 packets of flour
  3 bottles of Coke
  1 carton of orange juice
  8 bananas

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  S1: How MUCH meat does she need?
  S2: She needs two kilos of meat. How MANY eggs does she need?
  S3: She doesn't need any eggs. ...

SAVOL QOLIPI:
  SANALMAYDIGAN → How MUCH ... does she need?
     meat, cheese, ham, bread, flour, Coke, orange juice
  SANALADIGAN → How MANY ... does she need?
     tomatoes, bananas, eggs

JAVOB QOLIPI:
  KERAK bo'lsa:     She needs + miqdor + of + ot.
  KERAK EMAS bo'lsa: She doesn't need ANY + ot.

DIQQAT — INKORDA 'ANY':
  She doesn't need ANY eggs.
  ('She doesn't need some eggs' XATO)

DIQQAT — 'tomatoes' BILAN 'How MANY':
  Ro'yxatda '1 kilo of tomatoes' deyilgan bo'lsa ham,
  'tomatoes' o'zi SANALADIGAN ot → How MANY tomatoes?
  Yoki miqdorga qarab: How MUCH is a kilo of tomatoes?

topics.topic: Some — Any — KITOBDAGI DIALOG · 13-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI DIALOG:

  SA: Is there ANY milk in the fridge?
  SB: No, I'm afraid there isn't ANY milk.
      Would you like SOME Coke instead?
  SA: Yes, please. I'd love SOME.
      Can I have SOME ice too?
  SB: Yes, of course.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  SA: Muzlatgichda sut bormi?
  SB: Yo'q, afsuski sut yo'q. Uning o'rniga kola xohlaysizmi?
  SA: Ha, iltimos. Juda xohlardim. Muz ham olsam bo'ladimi?
  SB: Ha, albatta.

TO'LDIRILADIGAN QOIDALAR:
  We use SOME in the affirmative. We also use ......
  in the interrogative form for OFFERS or REQUESTS.
  We use ...... in the negative and interrogative form.

ASOSIY QOIDA:

  SOME →  TASDIQ gapda
            There is some milk.
          + SAVOLDA, agar TAKLIF yoki ILTIMOS bo'lsa
            Would you like SOME Coke?   (taklif)
            Can I have SOME ice?        (iltimos)

  ANY  →  INKOR gapda
            There isn't ANY milk.
          + oddiy SAVOLDA (ma'lumot so'raganda)
            Is there ANY milk in the fridge?

DIQQAT — 'I'm afraid' = afsuski (yomon xabarni yumshatadi).
DIQQAT — 'instead' = o'rniga (gap oxirida turadi).

topics.topic: Some — Any — BERILGAN SO'ZLAR (uch guruh, har birida 3 ta so'z) · 13c-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
BERILGAN SO'ZLAR (uch guruh, har birida 3 ta so'z):
  orange juice - coffee - biscuits
  cheese - ham - bread
  bananas - strawberries - sugar

DIALOG QOLIPI (dialogdagi kabi):
  SA: Is there any [1-so'z] in the fridge?
  SB: No, I'm afraid there isn't any [1-so'z].
      Would you like some [2-so'z] instead?
  SA: Yes, please. I'd love some.
      Can I have some [3-so'z] too?
  SB: Yes, of course.

DIQQAT — SANALADIGAN OTLAR:
  'biscuits', 'bananas', 'strawberries' — KO'PLIK.
  Savolda: 'Is there any ...?' → 'ARE there any ...?'
  Ko'plik ot bilan 'are' ishlatiladi.

topics.topic: Countable / Uncountable — sorting — KITOBDAGI NAMUNALAR · 2b-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNALAR:
  S1: There IS A knife.
  S2: There ARE SOME eggs.
  S3: There IS SOME butter.

UCH QOLIP:
  SANALADIGAN BIRLIK  → There IS A/AN ...
  SANALADIGAN KO'PLIK → There ARE SOME ...
  SANALMAYDIGAN       → There IS SOME ...

DIQQAT — FE'L SHAKLI:
  Faqat KO'PLIKDA 'are' bo'ladi.
  Sanalmaydigan ot BIRLIK hisoblanadi → IS.

topics.topic: countable/uncountable and quantities — TANLOV: some/any, is/are, much/many · 7b-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
TANLOV: some/any, is/are, much/many

DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda):
  H: I'd like SOME bread, please.
  A: Certainly. How MUCH would you like?
  H: Two loaves, please. ARE there ANY eggs?
  A: Of course. How MANY do you want?
  H: Six, please.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  H: Menga non bering, iltimos.
  A: Albatta. Qancha xohlaysiz?
  H: Ikkita non, iltimos. Tuxum bormi?
  A: Albatta. Nechta xohlaysiz?
  H: Oltita, iltimos.

QOIDALAR:
  'bread' — SANALMAYDIGAN → SOME, HOW MUCH
  'eggs'  — SANALADIGAN KO'PLIK → ARE, HOW MANY
  MA'LUMOT savoli → ANY

H = Mrs Hardy (mijoz)
A = assistant (sotuvchi)

topics.topic: countable/uncountable and quantities — KITOBDAGI NAMUNA · 7c-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: I'd like some POTATOES, please.
  SB: Certainly. How MANY would you like?
  SA: TWO KILOS, please. Is there any WINE? etc

QOLIP:
  SA: I'd like some [mahsulot], please.
  SB: Certainly. How much/many would you like?
  SA: [miqdor], please. Is/Are there any [boshqa mahsulot]?

MUHIM — HAR SAFAR TEKSHIRING:
  Mahsulot SANALADIGANMI yoki YO'Q?
     sanaladigan (potatoes, eggs, sausages, bananas,
                  oranges, lettuces, pizzas)
        → How MANY,  ARE there any
     sanalmaydigan (bread, milk, wine, flour, salami)
        → How MUCH,  IS there any

XARID RO'YXATIDAGI MIQDORLAR:
  2 bottles of wine, 3 kilos of potatoes, 2 cartons of milk,
  12 slices of salami, 2 loaves of bread, 4 packets of flour,
  6 eggs, 2 lettuces, 12 sausages, 2 frozen pizzas,
  5 bananas, 6 oranges

topics.topic: Quantifiers — practice — HAR JUFTLIKDA FAQAT BITTASI TO'G'RI · 10-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
HAR JUFTLIKDA FAQAT BITTASI TO'G'RI.

TEKSHIRILADIGAN QOIDALAR:
  • TAKLIF savolida 'Would you like' (Do you like emas)
  • Savolda 'anything' (something emas)
  • Rad etishda 'I don't like ...'
  • 'I like + sanalmaydigan/umumiy ot' (birlik)
  • NARX uchun 'How much'
  • Savolda DO/DOES yordamchi fe'li shart
  • INKOR gapda ANY

KITOBDA BERILGAN: 1a to'g'ri.

topics.topic: Prepositions of Place — Joy predloglari (1)
topics.rule_uz:
Kitobda BESH predlog sichqon va pishloq rasmlari bilan
ko'rsatilgan:

  BETWEEN — sichqon IKKI pishloq ORASIDA o'tiribdi
  OPPOSITE — ikki sichqon panjara orqali YUZMA-YUZ
  NEXT TO — sichqon pishloq YONIDA o'tiribdi
  IN FRONT OF — sichqon pishloqning OLDIDA
  BEHIND — sichqon pishloqning ORQASIDAN qarab turibdi

SXEMA:

     [pishloq]  🐭  [pishloq]      → BETWEEN (orasida)

     🐭 | 🐭                        → OPPOSITE (ro'parasida)
        panjara/ko'cha

     [pishloq] 🐭                   → NEXT TO (yonida)

     🐭 [pishloq]                   → IN FRONT OF (oldida)

  ⚠ Shuning uchun bu mashqda chegara
  1900-yil deb OLINADI — kitob shunday
  mo'ljallagan.

  ⚠ Bu xato emas: eski kitoblarda 'now',
  'today', 'X years ago' kabi so'zlar
  KITOB YOZILGAN vaqtga nisbatan
  tushuniladi.


⚠ IXTIRO SANALARI TEKShIRILDI — HAMMASI

topics.topic: Had (past simple of "have") — KITOBDAGI NAMUNA · 14b-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  They had hot-air balloons 100 years ago, BUT they didn't
  have helicopters.

QOLIP:
  They HAD [✓ narsa] 100 years ago, BUT they DIDN'T HAVE
  [✗ narsa].

Har bir gapda BITTA ✓ va BITTA ✗ juftlashtiriladi.
Ma'no jihatidan yaqin juftlarni tanlash yaxshiroq:
  yozuv mashinkasi ↔ kompyuter (yozish vositalari)
  telefon ↔ televizor (aloqa/media)
  mashina ↔ kompakt disk

DIQQAT — 'BUT':
  'but' ikki QARAMA-QARSHI fikrni bog'laydi.
  Oldidan vergul qo'yiladi: ..., but ...

DIQQAT — 'DIDN'T HAVE' ('didn't had' EMAS):
  they didn't HAVE   ✓
  they didn't HAD    ✗ XATO

topics.topic: Could (past simple of "can") — Could ('can' fe'lining o'tgan zamoni) (2)
topics.rule_uz:
COULD — 'can' fe'lining O'TGAN ZAMONI

  TASDIQ       I/you/he, etc  COULD swim.
  INKOR        I/you/he, etc  COULDN'T swim.
  SO'ROQ       COULD I/you/he, etc  swim?
  QISQA JAVOB  Yes, I/you/he, etc COULD.
               No,  I/you/he, etc COULDN'T.

UCH MUHIM QOIDA:

  1) HAMMA EGA UCHUN BIR XIL — COULD.
     I could, he could, they could — -S YO'Q.

  2) KEYINGI FE'L ASOSIY SHAKLDA, 'to' SIZ:
        I could swim.       ✓
        I could to swim.    ✗ XATO
        I could swam.       ✗ XATO

  3) 'DID' KERAK EMAS:
        Could you swim?     ✓
        Did you could swim? ✗ XATO

QISQARTMA:
  could not → couldn't

MA'NOSI:
  could = qo'lidan kelardi, bila olardi (O'TGAN QOBILIYAT)
  Misol: I could swim when I was five.
         (Besh yoshimda suza olardim.)

DIQQAT — WHEN va UNTIL:
  ... COULD ... WHEN he was one.
     = bir yoshida ALLAQACHON qila olardi
  ... COULDN'T ... UNTIL he was two.
     = ikki yoshigacha qila OLMASDI
       (ya'ni ikki yoshida boshladi)
  'until' DOIM inkor bilan keladi.
examples: I / you / he, etc could swim.
I / you / he, etc couldn't swim.
Could I / you / he, etc swim?
Yes, I could. / No, I couldn't.
can → could
when + tasdiq
until + inkor

topics.topic: Could (past simple of "can") — Could ('can' fe'lining o'tgan zamoni) (3)
topics.rule_uz:
JADVAL (kitobda bosilgan holi):

                      PAUL      DOUG
  talk                 1        .....
  count              .....        3
  read                 2          5
  walk                 2        .....
  ride a bicycle     .....       10
  swim                 4        .....

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA GAPDAN BITTA KATAK TO'LADI:
  'Paul could talk when he was ONE, but Doug couldn't
   talk until he was TWO.'
  → Doug / talk = 2

SHUNDAY QILIB TO'LIQ BILINADIGAN QATORLAR:
  talk  →  Paul 1, Doug 2   (namunadan)
  read  →  Paul 2, Doug 5   (kitobda bosilgan)

QOLGAN 4 KATAK FAQAT AUDIODAN ANIQLANADI:
  Paul / count            = ?
  Paul / ride a bicycle   = ?
  Doug / walk             = ?
  Doug / swim             = ?

Bu raqamlar kitobda YOZILMAGAN — audio tinglanmasa
bilib bo'lmaydi. Shuning uchun bu yerda TO'QIB
yozilmadi. Audioni tinglaganingizda o'zingiz
to'ldirasiz va quyidagi qolip bilan gap tuzasiz.

GAP QOLIPI:
  Paul could [fe'l] when he was [yosh], but Doug
  couldn't [fe'l] until he was [yosh].

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to count = sanamoq
  to ride a bicycle = velosiped haydamoq
  an age = yosh
examples: talk — Paul: 1, Doug: 2
read — Paul: 2, Doug: 5
count — Paul: ?, Doug: 3
walk — Paul: 2, Doug: ?
ride a bicycle — Paul: ?, Doug: 10
swim — Paul: 4, Doug: ?

topics.topic: was/were — IKKI SAVOL BILAN HAL QILINADI · 3-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
IKKI SAVOL BILAN HAL QILINADI:

  1) Ega BIRLIKmi yoki KO'PLIKmi?
       I, he, she, it, birlik ot → was / wasn't
       you, we, they, ko'plik ot → were / weren't

  2) TASDIQmi yoki INKORmi?
       'any' bo'lsa — deyarli DOIM inkor
       'No, ...' javobi — inkor
       'but' oldingi fikrga qarama-qarshi qo'yadi

DIQQAT — 'THERE WAS' va 'THERE WERE':
  'there' ga emas, KEYINGI OTGA qaraladi:
     Was there A SUPERMARKET?   (birlik)
     Were there ANY CINEMAS?    (ko'plik)

DIQQAT — 'MY FRIENDS AND I':
  Bu birikma KO'PLIK ('we' bilan bir xil) → WERE.
  Ingliz tilida 'I' oxirida turadi (odob qoidasi):
     My friends and I  ✓
     I and my friends  ✗

topics.topic: was/were — KITOBDAGI NAMUNA · 5-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  Marilyn Monroe / musician / actress
  Was Marilyn Monroe a musician?
  No, she wasn't. She was an actress.

QOLIP:
  WAS/WERE + ism + [1-ma'lumot]?
  No, he/she/they WASN'T/WEREN'T.
  He/She/They WAS/WERE + [2-ma'lumot].

BIRINCHI ma'lumot — NOTO'G'RI (shuning uchun 'No').
IKKINCHI ma'lumot — TO'G'RI.

DIQQAT — BIRLIK yoki KO'PLIK:
  bitta odam    → Was ... ?  No, he/she wasn't.
  bir necha odam → Were ...? No, they weren't.

DIQQAT — KASB OLDIDAN ARTIKL:
  She was AN actress.   ('a/an' SHART)
  They were inventors.  (ko'plikda artikl YO'Q)

DIQQAT — MILLAT OLDIDAN ARTIKL YO'Q:
  He was FRENCH.     ✓  (sifat)
  He was A French.   ✗ XATO

DIQQAT — 'FROM + MAMLAKAT':
  They were FROM Holland.  (mamlakat nomi)
  They were DUTCH.         (millat sifati)

topics.topic: was/were
topics.rule_uz:
JADVAL:

                      5 yoshda    Hozir (20 yoshda)
  read and write        ✗              ✓
  ski                   ✗              ✗
  swim                  ✗              ✓
  ride a bicycle        ✗              ✓

topics.topic: had / didn't have (Amy) — IKKI RO'YXAT · 7a-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
IKKI RO'YXAT:

  AMY, FIFTEEN YEARS AGO     AMY, TODAY
  (10 years old)             (25 years old)

  long hair                  short hair
  pet cat                    pet dog
  bicycle                    car
  a lot of toys              a computer
  a record player            a CD player

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  Amy DIDN'T HAVE short hair fifteen years ago.
  She HAD long hair.

QOLIP — DIQQAT, TARTIB TESKARI:
  Amy DIDN'T HAVE [BUGUNGI narsa] fifteen years ago.
  She HAD [O'SHANDAGI narsa].

  Ya'ni AVVAL bugungi narsani INKOR qilamiz,
  SO'NG o'shandagi narsani TASDIQLAYMIZ.

ENG MUHIM QOIDA:
  didn't HAVE   ✓   (had EMAS!)
  She HAD       ✓   ('did' yo'q → had)

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a record player = plastinka pleyeri (eski)
  a CD player     = disk pleyeri (yangi)
  a pet           = uy hayvoni

topics.topic: had / didn't have (Amy) — KITOBDAGI NAMUNA · 7b-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: Did Amy have short hair when she was ten years old?
  SB: No, she didn't. She had long hair.

QOLIP:
  SA: DID Amy HAVE [bugungi narsa] when she WAS ten years old?
  SB: No, she DIDN'T. She HAD [o'shandagi narsa].

DIQQAT — 7a DAN FARQI:
  7a da 'fifteen years ago' edi,
  7b da 'when she was ten years old' — ma'no bir xil
  (15 yil oldin u 10 yoshda edi).

UCH QOIDA:
  1) So'roqda 'HAVE' (had EMAS)
  2) Qisqa javobda 'DIDN'T' (hadn't EMAS)
  3) Tasdiqda 'HAD' ('did' yo'q)

topics.topic: Past Simple: regular verbs — Oddiy o'tgan zamon: to'g'ri fe'llar (1)
topics.rule_uz:
TO'LIQ JADVAL:

  TASDIQ           SO'ROQ              INKOR
  I worked         Did I work?         I didn't work
  you worked       Did you work?       you didn't work
  he worked        Did he work?        he didn't work
  she worked       Did she work?       she didn't work
  it worked        Did it work?        it didn't work
  we worked        Did we work?        we didn't work
  you worked       Did you work?       you didn't work
  they worked      Did they work?      they didn't work

QISQA JAVOBLAR:
  Did I/you/he, etc work ...?
     → Yes, I/you/he, etc DID.
     → No,  I/you/he, etc DIDN'T.

ENG MUHIM UCH KUZATUV:

  1) TASDIQda fe'l HAMMA EGA uchun BIR XIL —
     'worked'. Hech qanday -s yo'q.
        he workeds  ✗ XATO

  2) SO'ROQ va INKORda fe'l ASOSIY shaklda —
     'work' ('worked' EMAS).
        Did he worked?    ✗ XATO
        He didn't worked? ✗ XATO

  3) QISQA javobda faqat 'did/didn't' —
     asosiy fe'l TAKRORLANMAYDI.
        Yes, I worked.  ✗
        Yes, I did.     ✓

SABABI: 'did' allaqachon O'TGAN zamonni ko'rsatgan.
Bir gapda o'tgan zamon IKKI MARTA ko'rsatilmaydi.
examples: I worked — Did I work? — I didn't work
you worked — Did you work? — you didn't work
he worked — Did he work? — he didn't work
she worked — Did she work? — she didn't work
it worked — Did it work? — it didn't work
we worked — Did we work? — we didn't work
you worked — Did you work? — you didn't work
they worked — Did they work? — they didn't work

topics.topic: Past Simple: regular verbs — Oddiy o'tgan zamon: to'g'ri fe'llar (2)
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI TO'RT QOIDA:

  1) Ko'pchilik TO'G'RI fe'lning TASDIQ shaklini
     fe'lga -ED qo'shib yasaymiz.
        I work  →  I worked

  2) Boshqa fe'llarning NOTO'G'RI tasdiq shakli bor.
        I see  →  I saw
     (Kitobning oxiridagi noto'g'ri fe'llar ro'yxatiga qarang.)

  3) Oddiy o'tgan zamonning SO'ROQ shaklini
     DID + KISHILIK OLMOSHI + FE'LNING ASOSIY SHAKLI
     bilan yasaymiz.
        DID HE WORK yesterday?
        DID YOU SEE Tom yesterday?

  4) INKOR shaklini DIDN'T + FE'LNING ASOSIY SHAKLI
     bilan yasaymiz.
        I DIDN'T WORK yesterday.
        I DIDN'T SEE Tom yesterday.

  5) Ijobiy qisqa javobni DID bilan,
     salbiy qisqa javobni DIDN'T bilan yasaymiz.
        Did you call me?  →  Yes, I DID.
        Did he tell you?  →  No, he DIDN'T.

DIQQAT — 3 va 4-QOIDALARDAGI ENG MUHIM SO'Z:
  'BASE FORM OF THE VERB' = fe'lning ASOSIY shakli.
  Ya'ni lug'atdagi shakl: work, see, go, have.
  O'tgan shakl EMAS: worked, saw, went, had.

  NOTO'G'RI FE'LLARDA bu ayniqsa muhim:
     Did you SEE Tom?    ✓
     Did you SAW Tom?    ✗ XATO
     I didn't SEE Tom.   ✓
     I didn't SAW Tom.   ✗ XATO
examples: We form the affirmative of most regular verbs by adding -ed to the verb. I work - I worked
Other verbs have irregular affirmative forms. I see - I saw
We form the interrogative of past simple with did + subject pronoun + base form of the verb. Did he work yesterday? Did you see Tom yesterday?
We form the negative of past simple with didn't + base form of the verb. I didn't work yesterday. I didn't see Tom yesterday.
We form positive short answers with did and negative short answers with didn't. Did you call me? Yes, I did. Did he tell you? No, he didn't.

topics.topic: Past Simple: regular verbs — Oddiy o'tgan zamon: to'g'ri fe'llar (3)
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI UCH QOIDA:

  1) Oxiri -E bilan tugagan fe'lga -D qo'shamiz.
        I live  →  I lived

  2) UNDOSH + Y bilan tugagan fe'lda -Y tushadi,
     o'rniga -IED qo'shiladi.
        I marry  →  I married

  3) IKKI UNDOSH ORASIDA BITTA URG'ULI UNLI bo'lgan
     fe'lda oxirgi undosh IKKILANADI, so'ng -ED qo'shiladi.
        I stop  →  I stopped

3-QOIDANI BATAFSIL TUSHUNTIRAMIZ:

  'stop' so'zini ko'ring:  s-T-O-P
     'o' — unli, ikki tomonida undosh (t va p)
     va u URG'ULI (bir bo'g'inli so'z — urg'u shu yerda)
     → oxirgi undosh 'p' IKKILANADI → stoPPed

  Boshqa misollar:
     plan  → planned   (a — urg'uli, n ikkilanadi)
     stop  → stopped
     shop  → shopped
     drop  → dropped

  IKKILANMAYDIGAN holatlar:
     visit  → visited   (urg'u BIRINCHI bo'g'inda: VI-sit)
     open   → opened    (urg'u birinchi bo'g'inda: O-pen)
     rain   → rained    (ikki unli: 'ai')
     work   → worked    (ikki undosh: 'rk')

  BRITANCHA ISTISNO:
     travel → travelled  (britanchada L DOIM ikkilanadi,
                          urg'u birinchi bo'g'inda bo'lsa ham)
     Amerikachada: traveled.

QO'ShIMCHA (kitobda yo'q, lekin bilish kerak):
  UNLI + Y bo'lsa, -Y QOLADI:
     play → played;  enjoy → enjoyed;  stay → stayed
examples: We add -d to verbs ending in -e. I live - I lived
Verbs ending in a consonant + y drop the -y and add -ied. I marry - I married
Verbs ending in one stressed vowel between two consonants double the last consonant and add -ed. I stop - I stopped

topics.topic: Past Simple: regular verbs — Oddiy o'tgan zamon: to'g'ri fe'llar (4)
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA (Use):

  Oddiy o'tgan zamonni O'TMISHDA ANIQ BIR VAQTDA
  sodir bo'lgan yoki tugagan harakatlar uchun ishlatamiz.

     He GRADUATED in 1998.
     (When did he graduate? In 1998.)

  ENG MUHIM SO'Z: 'a DEFINITE time' = ANIQ vaqt.
  Ya'ni voqea QACHON bo'lgani ma'lum.

VAQT IBORALARI (past simple bilan ishlatiladi):

  yesterday                      kecha
  last night                     kecha kechqurun
  last week / year / Monday      o'tgan hafta/yil/dushanba
  a month ago                    bir oy oldin
  two years ago                  ikki yil oldin
  three years ago                uch yil oldin
  in 1964                        1964-yilda

IKKI GURUH — JOYI HAR XIL:

  'LAST ...' → gap OXIRIDA yoki BOSHIDA
     I saw him last week.
     Last week I saw him.

  '... AGO' → 'ago' DOIM oxirida turadi
     I saw him two years AGO.
     'ago two years' XATO.

DIQQAT — 'LAST' va 'AGO' BIRGA ISHLATILMAYDI:
     last week        ✓
     a week ago       ✓
     last week ago    ✗ XATO

DIQQAT — 'IN + YIL':
     in 1964, in 1998 — yil oldidan DOIM IN.

YANGI SO'Z:
  to graduate = (o'quv yurtini) tugatmoq, bitirmoq
  a graduate  = bitiruvchi
examples: We use the past simple for actions which happened or finished at a definite time in the past.
He graduated in 1998. (When did he graduate? In 1998.)
yesterday
last night / week / year / Monday
a month / two years / three years ago
topics.source: Grammar Book, 42-bet, Use va Time Expressions

topics.topic: A/An/The — A/An/The (artikllar) (1)
topics.rule_uz:
ASOSIY QOIDA:

  A/AN — biror narsa haqida BIRINCHI MARTA gapirganda
  THE  — ILGARI AYTILGAN narsa haqida gapirganda

  MISOL:
     There's A dog in the garden.       (birinchi marta)
     THE dog is near the swimming-pool. (o'sha it)

THE QO'YILADI:

  • daryo nomlari      → the Nile, the Amazon
  • dengiz nomlari     → the Mediterranean Sea
  • okean nomlari      → the Pacific, the Atlantic
  • tog' tizmalari     → the Himalayas, the Alps
  • millat nomlari     → the Polish, the Italians
  • oila nomlari       → the Johnsons, the Browns
  • qabila nomlari     → the Navajo, the Inuit

THE QO'YILMAYDI:

  • atoqli otlar       → Paul, Warsaw
  • mamlakat nomlari   → Spain, Turkey
  • ovqat nomlari      → dinner, breakfast
  • sport/o'yin nomlari → basketball, cards

ESLATMA — 'THE INUIT':
  Workbook 39-betdagi matn aynan inuitlar haqida edi.
  Qabila nomi bo'lgani uchun 'THE Inuit' deb yoziladi.

ESLATMA — MILLAT NOMLARIDA IKKI SHAKL:
  the Polish   — 'the' + SIFAT (butun xalq)
  the Italians — 'the' + KO'PLIK OT (butun xalq)
  Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri, faqat shakli boshqacha.

A yoki AN — TOVUShGA qaraladi, yozilishga emas:
  UNDOSH tovush → A   (a dog, a university /juː/)
  UNLI tovush   → AN  (an egg, an hour /aʊ/ — 'h' jim)

DIQQAT — MAMLAKAT NOMLARIDAGI ISTISNO:
  Oddiy nomlarda THE yo'q: Spain, Turkey, Uzbekistan
  Lekin ko'plik yoki 'union/kingdom/republic' bo'lsa THE:
     the USA, the UK, the Netherlands, the Philippines

⚠ IKKI ATAMA HAQIDA OGOHLANTIRISh:

  1) 'NATIONALITIES: the POLISH, the
     ITALIANS'

     ⚠ Kitob bu yerda IKKI XIL qolipni
     bitta qatorga qo'ygan:
        'the Polish'   — SIFAT shakli
           (the French, the British,
            the Chinese kabi)
        'the Italians' — KO'PLIK OT
           (the Germans, the Russians kabi)

     ⚠ Ikkalasi ham TO'G'RI ingliz tili,
     lekin qolipi boshqa. Har millat uchun
     qaysi shakl ishlatilishini alohida
     yodlash kerak.


  2) 'NAMES OF TRIBES: the NAVAJO,
     the INUIT'

     ⚠ 'TRIBE' (qabila) so'zi bugungi

     ESKIRGAN va ba'zan qo'pol

        'Indigenous peoples'

We use the to talk about something we have mentioned before.
There's a dog in the garden. The dog is near the swimming-pool.
