topics.topic: A/An/The — A/An/The (artikllar) (2)
topics.rule_uz:
'THE' IKKI XIL O'QILADI:

  /ðə/  — UNDOSH tovush bilan boshlangan so'z oldidan
           the glass  /ðə ɡlɑːs/
           the baby   /ðə ˈbeɪbi/

  /ðiː/ — UNLI tovush bilan boshlangan so'z oldidan
           the egg    /ðiː eɡ/
           the apple  /ðiː ˈæpl/

QOIDA 'A/AN' BILAN BIR XIL MANTIQDA:
  a dog / an egg
  the /ðə/ dog / the /ðiː/ egg

DIQQAT — TOVUShGA QARALADI, HARFGA EMAS:

  'university' — U harfi bilan boshlanadi, lekin
     /juːnɪˈvɜːsɪti/ deb o'qiladi — 'y' TOVUSHI (undosh).
     → A university,  the /ðə/ university

  'hour' — H harfi bilan boshlanadi, lekin
     /aʊə/ deb o'qiladi — 'h' JIM, unli tovush.
     → AN hour,  the /ðiː/ hour

  'honest' — 'h' jim → an honest man, the /ðiː/ honest man

AMALIY MASLAHAT:
  So'zni ovoz chiqarib ayting. Birinchi TOVUSH unli bo'lsa
  → /ðiː/;  undosh bo'lsa → /ðə/.
examples: The is pronounced /ðə/ before words which begin with a consonant sound: the glass, the baby
The is pronounced /ðiː/ before words which begin with a vowel sound: the egg, the apple
a university → the /ðə/ university
an hour → the /ðiː/ hour

topics.topic: Will (for predictions) — Will (bashorat uchun)
topics.rule_uz:
TO'LIQ JADVAL — UZUN va QISQA SHAKLLAR:

  TASDIQ                        INKOR
  UZUN          QISQA           UZUN            QISQA
  I will go     I'll go         I will not go   I won't go
  you will go   you'll go       you will not go you won't go
  he will go    he'll go        he will not go  he won't go
  she will go   she'll go       she will not go she won't go
  it will go    it'll go        it will not go  it won't go
  we will go    we'll go        we will not go  we won't go
  you will go   you'll go       you will not go you won't go
  they will go  they'll go      they will not go they won't go

UCH MUHIM QOIDA:

  1) 'WILL' HAMMA EGA UCHUN BIR XIL.
        he wills  ✗ XATO

  2) 'will' dan keyin fe'l ASOSIY shaklda, 'to' SIZ:
        He will GO.        ✓
        He will TO go.     ✗ XATO
        He will GOES.      ✗ XATO
        He will WENT.      ✗ XATO

  3) SO'ROQda 'do/does/did' KERAK EMAS —
     'will' o'zi gap boshiga chiqadi:
        WILL he go?        ✓
        Does he will go?   ✗ XATO

QISQARTMALAR:
  I will   → I'LL      /aɪl/
  you will → YOU'LL    /juːl/
  he will  → HE'LL     /hiːl/
  she will → SHE'LL
  it will  → IT'LL
  we will  → WE'LL     /wiːl/
  they will → THEY'LL

  will not → WON'T     /wəʊnt/
  DIQQAT: 'willn't' shakli YO'Q!
  'won't' — yozilishi butunlay boshqacha, yodlash kerak.

ISHLATILISHI — BASHORAT:
  'will' ni kelajak haqidagi FIKR va TAXMIN uchun
  ishlatamiz.
     I think it will rain tomorrow.
     Perhaps they will win the match.

BASHORAT SO'ZLARI ('will' bilan birga):
  I think ...   = menimcha
  I hope ...    = umid qilaman
  Perhaps ...   = ehtimol
  Maybe ...     = balki
  I'm sure ...  = ishonchim komil
examples: I will go — I'll go
you will go — you'll go
he will go — he'll go
she will go — she'll go
it will go — it'll go
we will go — we'll go
they will go — they'll go
I will not go — I won't go

topics.topic: Will — interrogative, form and use — Will — so'roq shakli, yasalishi va ishlatilishi (1)
topics.rule_uz:
SO'ROQ JADVALI:

  Will I go?        Will we go?
  Will you go?      Will you go?
  Will he go?       Will they go?
  Will she go?
  Will it go?

QISQA JAVOBLAR:
  Will you/he, etc go out tonight?
     → Yes, I/you/he, etc WILL.
     → No,  I/you/he, etc WON'T.

KITOBDAGI FORM QOIDALARI:

  1) Kelasi zamonning TASDIQ shaklini
     WILL + FE'LNING ASOSIY SHAKLI bilan yasaymiz.
        I'LL SEE you tomorrow.

  2) SO'ROQ shaklini
     WILL + KISHILIK OLMOSHI + FE'LNING ASOSIY SHAKLI
     bilan yasaymiz.
        WILL YOU COME tomorrow?

  3) INKOR shaklini
     WON'T + FE'LNING ASOSIY SHAKLI bilan yasaymiz.
        I WON'T SEE Judy.

UCHALA QOIDADA HAM BIR XIL SO'Z:
  'BASE FORM OF THE VERB' = fe'lning ASOSIY shakli.
     see, come, go — 'saw', 'came', 'went' EMAS.

DIQQAT — PAST SIMPLE BILAN SOLISHTIRING:
  past simple so'roq:  DID you come?
  future simple so'roq: WILL you come?
  Ikkalasida ham fe'l ASOSIY shaklda — bu umumiy qoida.

USE (ishlatilishi):
  'will' ni BASHORAT qilish uchun ishlatamiz.
     I think HE'LL COME tomorrow.

VAQT IBORALARI (will bilan ishlatiladi):
  after            keyin
  tomorrow         ertaga
  next week        keyingi hafta
  next year        keyingi yil
  next month       keyingi oy
  tonight          bugun kechqurun
  soon             tez orada

SOLISHTIRING — 42-BETDAGI PAST SIMPLE IBORALARI:
  O'TGAN:  yesterday, last week, ... ago, in 1964
  KELASI:  tomorrow, next week, tonight, soon
  Vaqt iborasi zamonni ANIQLAB beradi.
examples: Will I go? Will you go? Will he go? Will she go? Will it go? Will we go? Will they go?
Will you/he, etc go out tonight? — Yes, I/you/he, etc will. No, I/you/he, etc won't.
We form the affirmative of the future simple with will + base form of the verb. I'll see you tomorrow.
We form the interrogative with will + subject pronoun + base form of the verb. Will you come tomorrow?
We form the negative with won't + base form of the verb. I won't see Judy.
We use will to make predictions. I think he'll come tomorrow.
Time Expressions: after, tomorrow, next week/year/month, tonight, soon, etc.

topics.topic: Will — interrogative, form and use — Will — so'roq shakli, yasalishi va ishlatilishi (2)
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA:
  Bog'lovchilarni gaplarni BIRLAShTIRISH uchun ishlatamiz.

BESH BOG'LOVCHI VA KITOBDAGI MISOLLAR:

  AND — qo'shimcha ma'lumot qo'shadi
     Tony worked hard AND became famous.
     (Toni ko'p ishladi va mashhur bo'ldi.)

  BECAUSE — SABABNI ko'rsatadi
     Mary left early BECAUSE she wanted to catch the bus.
     (Meri erta ketdi, chunki avtobusga yetib olmoqchi edi.)

  BUT — QARAMA-QARShILIKNI ko'rsatadi
     Bob had a lot of money BUT he lost it all.
     (Bobda ko'p pul bor edi, lekin hammasini yo'qotdi.)

  UNTIL — harakatning OXIRINI ko'rsatadi
     She continued travelling UNTIL the day she died.
     (U vafot etgan kunigacha sayohat qilishda davom etdi.)

  WHEN — VAQTNI ko'rsatadi
     I learned to play tennis WHEN I was five.
     (Besh yoshimda tennis o'ynashni o'rgandim.)

QAY BIRINI TANLASH — SAVOL BERING:

  Ikkinchi gap SABABNI aytadimi?      → BECAUSE
  Ikkinchi gap QARAMA-QARShIMI?       → BUT
  Ikkinchi gap QACHONligini aytadimi? → WHEN
  Birinchi harakat QACHONGACHA davom etdi? → UNTIL
  Shunchaki QO'ShIMCHA ma'lumotmi?    → AND

DIQQAT — 'BUT' OLDIDAN VERGUL:
  Bob had a lot of money, BUT he lost it all.
  ('and' oldidan odatda vergul qo'yilmaydi.)

DIQQAT — 'BECAUSE' va 'SO' FARQI:
  ...BECAUSE... → SABAB keladi
     He was tired BECAUSE he worked hard.
  ...SO...      → NATIJA keladi
     He worked hard, SO he was tired.
  Ma'no bir xil, tartib teskari.

DIQQAT — 'UNTIL' va 'WHEN' FARQI:
  UNTIL — harakat O'ShA PAYTGACHA davom etadi
     She travelled until she died. (o'lgunicha sayohat qildi)
  WHEN  — harakat O'ShA PAYTDA bo'ladi
     She travelled when she was young. (yosh paytida)

BOG'LOVCHI GAP BOSHIDA HAM KELISHI MUMKIN:
  WHEN I was five, I learned to play tennis.
  BECAUSE she wanted to catch the bus, Mary left early.
  Bunda o'rtaga VERGUL qo'yiladi.
  ('and' va 'but' gap boshida kelmaydi.)
examples: We use linking words to join sentences.
Tony worked hard and became famous.
Mary left early because she wanted to catch the bus.
Bob had a lot of money but he lost it all.
She continued travelling until the day she died.
I learned to play tennis when I was five.

YIGIRMA FE'L, TO'RT QUTI:

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

TO'LIQ TAQSIMOT:

  -ED QUTISI (5 ta):

  -D QUTISI (5 ta) — oxiri -E bo'lgan fe'llar:

DIQQAT — 'PLAY' NEGA -ED QUTISIDA?

DIQQAT — 'BE' NING IKKI SHAKLI:

topics.topic: Past Simple — TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda) · 3-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Charles Dickens WAS a famous English writer. He was born
  in Portsmouth, England on 7th February, 1812. He WENT to
  school at the age of nine but he didn't finish his
  education. In 1824, he WORKED at a shoe polish factory
  and WENT back to school a year later. He TOOK a job as a
  legal clerk in 1827 and ENJOYED success as a reporter two
  years later.

  Dickens MARRIED Catherine Hogarth in 1836. He WROTE 'The
  Pickwick Papers' that same year. This book MADE him
  famous. He wrote many popular books and was considered to
  be England's finest writer.

  He DIVORCED his wife in 1858 and DIED on 9th June, 1870.
  They BURIED him in Westminster Abbey.


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Charlz Dikkens mashhur ingliz yozuvchisi edi. U 1812-yil
  7-fevralda Angliyaning Portsmut shahrida tug'ilgan.
  To'qqiz yoshida maktabga bordi, lekin ta'limini
  tugatmadi. 1824-yilda poyabzal moyi fabrikasida ishladi
  va bir yildan keyin maktabga qaytdi. 1827-yilda huquqiy
  kotib bo'lib ishga kirdi va ikki yildan keyin muxbir
  sifatida muvaffaqiyatga erishdi.
  Dikkens 1836-yilda Ketrin Xogartga uylandi. O'sha yili
  'Pikvik klubi yozuvlari' ni yozdi. Bu kitob uni mashhur
  qildi. U ko'plab mashhur kitoblar yozdi va Angliyaning
  eng zo'r yozuvchisi deb hisoblanardi.
  U 1858-yilda xotinidan ajrashdi va 1870-yil 9-iyunda
  vafot etdi. Uni Vestminster abbatligida dafn etishdi.


SAVOLGA JAVOB — QAYSI FE'LLAR NOTO'G'RI?
  be    → WAS    (1-band)
  go    → WENT   (2 va 4-bandlar)
  take  → TOOK   (5-band)
  write → WROTE  (8-band)
  make  → MADE   (9-band)

  Qolganlari TO'G'RI fe'l:
  worked, enjoyed, married, divorced, died, buried

DIQQAT — 'ENJOY' → 'ENJOYED':
  'y' oldida UNLI ('o') → -IED qoidasi ISHLAMAYDI.
  2-mashqdagi 'play → played' bilan bir xil.

DIQQAT — 'BURY' → 'BURIED':
  'y' oldida UNDOSH ('r') → -IED qo'shiladi.

CHARLZ DIKKENS HAQIDA:
  Ingliz adabiyotining eng mashhur yozuvchilaridan biri.
  Asarlari: 'Oliver Twist', 'David Copperfield',
  'A Christmas Carol', 'The Pickwick Papers'.
  Bolaligida kambag'allikni ko'rgan (fabrikada ishlagan) —
  shuning uchun asarlarida kambag'allar hayoti tasvirlangan.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a shoe polish factory = poyabzal moyi fabrikasi
  a legal clerk         = huquqiy kotib
  success               = muvaffaqiyat
  a reporter            = muxbir
  to be considered      = hisoblanmoq
  finest                = eng zo'r (fine ning ustun darajasi)
  an abbey              = abbatlik (katta cherkov)

⚠⚠ KITOBDAGI FAKT XATOSI — 'DIVORCED':

  Matnda: 'He DIVORCED his wife in 1858'
  (1858-yilda xotinidan AJRAShDI).

  ⚠ Bu NOTO'G'RI. Dikkens 1858-yilda
  xotini Ketrindan AJRALIB YAShAY
  boshlagan (separated), lekin ular
  HECH QAChON RASMAN AJRAShMAGAN.

  ⚠ Sabab: Viktoriya davri Angliyasida
  ajrashish deyarli imkonsiz edi — buning
  uchun parlament qarori yoki juda og'ir
  sud jarayoni kerak bo'lardi.

  ⚠ Ketrin 1879-yilgacha, ya'ni Dikkens
  vafotidan keyin ham to'qqiz yil
  yashagan — hamon uning xotini sifatida.

  ⚠ To'g'ri ifoda:
     'He SEPARATED FROM his wife in 1858'

  ⚠ FARQNI ESLAB QOLING:
     to separate from = ajralib yashamoq
        (nikoh saqlanadi)
     to divorce = rasman ajrashmoq
        (nikoh bekor bo'ladi)

  ⚠ Mashqning javobi 'divorced' bo'lib
  qoladi (fe'l qavsda berilgan), lekin
  tarixiy haqiqat shu.


⚠ QOLGAN FAKTLAR TO'G'RI:
  1812-yil 7-fevral, Portsmut — tug'ilgan
  1824 — poyabzal bo'yog'i fabrikasida
     ishlagan (12 yoshida)
  1827 — yuridik kotib
  1836 — Ketrin Xogartga uylangan va
     'Pikvik klubi yozuvlari'ni yozgan
  1870-yil 9-iyun — vafot etgan
  Vestminster abbatligi, 'Shoirlar burchagi'
     — dafn etilgan

topics.topic: Will — KITOBDAGI NAMUNA · 17-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  It/not be/sunny today.
  SA: It WON'T BE sunny today.
  SB: WILL it BE sunny tomorrow, then?

IKKI GAP QOLIPI:
  SA (INKOR):  [ega] WON'T [asosiy fe'l] ... TODAY/TONIGHT.
  SB (SO'ROQ): WILL [ega] [asosiy fe'l] ... TOMORROW, THEN?

UCH DIQQAT:

  1) SA da BUGUN, SB da ERTAGA —
     ko'rsatmadagi vaqt SB da 'tomorrow' ga o'zgaradi.

  2) 'then' = unda, u holda —
     gap OXIRIDA, oldidan VERGUL.

  3) 'won't' va 'will' dan keyin fe'l ASOSIY shaklda.

DIQQAT — SB DAGI EGA:
  Agar SA da 'I' bo'lsa, SB da 'YOU' bo'ladi —
  chunki boshqa odam gapiryapti.
     SA: I won't tidy MY room.
     SB: Will YOU tidy YOUR room tomorrow?

topics.topic: Will — MANTIQQA QARAB TANLANADI · 18-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
MANTIQQA QARAB TANLANADI:

  Gap IJOBIY bashoratmi yoki OGOHLANTIRIShmi?
     → WILL
  Gap SALBIY bashoratmi yoki 'bo'lmaydi' degan
  ma'nodami?
     → WON'T

ENG MUHIM QOLIP — 'OR' BILAN OGOHLANTIRISH:
  [buyruq] OR you WILL/WON'T ... !
  = ...qil, aks holda ...

  Ikki xil natija bo'lishi mumkin:
     Hurry OR you WON'T catch the bus.
     (Shoshil, aks holda avtobusga YETIB OLMAYSAN.)
     Watch out OR you'LL hit your head.
     (Ehtiyot bo'l, aks holda boshingni URIB OLASAN.)

  Farqi: birinchisida YAXShI narsa bo'lmaydi (won't),
  ikkinchisida YOMON narsa bo'ladi (will).

DIQQAT — 8-BAND ALDAMCHI:
  'I DON'T THINK it ...... be sunny tomorrow.'
  Inkor 'don't think' da — shuning uchun keyingi
  qismda WILL (won't EMAS).
  Ingliz tilida inkor BIRINCHI fe'lga ko'chiriladi.

topics.topic: Dates — Sanalar
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

  YOZAMIZ:  26/8/1959   yoki   26th August, 1959

  AYTAMIZ:  the twenty-sixth of August, nineteen fifty-nine
            YOKI
            August the twenty-sixth, nineteen fifty-nine

IKKI XIL AYTISH USULI:

  1-USUL:  THE + tartib son + OF + oy + yil
           the twenty-sixth of August, nineteen fifty-nine

  2-USUL:  oy + THE + tartib son + yil
           August the twenty-sixth, nineteen fifty-nine

  Ikkalasi ham TO'G'RI — farqi yo'q.

DIQQAT — KUN DOIM TARTIB SON:
  1st  = the first        2nd  = the second
  3rd  = the third        4th  = the fourth
  5th  = the fifth        8th  = the eighth
  13th = the thirteenth   16th = the sixteenth
  21st = the twenty-first 25th = the twenty-fifth
  29th = the twenty-ninth 31st = the thirty-first

DIQQAT — YIL QANDAY O'QILADI:
  Yil IKKI JUFTGA bo'linadi:
     1959 → 19 | 59 → nineteen fifty-nine
     1935 → 19 | 35 → nineteen thirty-five
     1825 → 18 | 25 → eighteen twenty-five
     1899 → 18 | 99 → eighteen ninety-nine

  ISTISNO — oxiri '00' bo'lsa:
     1900 → nineteen hundred
     1980 → nineteen eighty  ('nineteen eight-oh' EMAS)
     2000 → two thousand
     2010 → two thousand and ten / twenty ten

DIQQAT — BRITAN va AMERIKA YOZILISHI FARQ QILADI:
  Britancha:  26/8/1959  (kun/oy/yil)
  Amerikacha: 8/26/1959  (oy/kun/yil)
  Chalkashmaslik uchun oy nomini YOZISH yaxshiroq.

⚠⚠ KITOB XATOSI (imlo) — 'PIÈRRE':

  Kitobda ism 'PIÈRRE Curie' deb yozilgan
  — 'e' ustida urg'u belgisi bilan.

  ⚠ To'g'ri yozilishi — PIERRE, URG'USIZ.
  Fransuz tilida ham, ingliz tilida ham bu
  ismda urg'u belgisi YO'Q.

  ⚠ Xuddi shu xato 73-betda ham bor:
  'Pièrre-Auguste Renoir'.

  ⚠ Ammo 12-betda kitob shu ismni TO'G'RI
  yozgan — 'Pierre'. Demak bu nashriyot
  xatosi, ataylab emas.
examples: We write: 26/8/1959 or 26th August, 1959
We say: the twenty-sixth of August, nineteen fifty-nine
or August the twenty-sixth, nineteen fifty-nine
Time expressions: yesterday, ago, in 1950, last Monday/week/month

topics.topic: Dates — UCH ODAM · 7-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
UCH ODAM:
  Elvis Presley     8th January, 1935 - 16th August, 1977
  Alfred Hitchcock  13th August, 1899 - 29th April, 1980
  Johann Strauss    25th October, 1825 - 3rd June, 1899

  Elvis Presley was born on January the eighth,

  was born ON ... and died ON ...

KIMLAR BU ODAMLAR:

  JOHANN STRAUSS   — avstriyalik bastakor, 'vals qiroli'

topics.topic: Past Simple — Oddiy o'tgan zamon
topics.rule_uz:
PAST SIMPLE FORM (jadval):

  TASDIQ       I/you/he, etc  WATCHED TV last night.
  INKOR        I/you/he, etc  DIDN'T WATCH TV last night.
  SO'ROQ       DID I/you/he, etc  WATCH TV last night?
  QISQA JAVOB  Yes, I/you/he, etc DID.
               No,  I/you/he, etc DIDN'T.

QANDAY YASALADI:

  TASDIQ:  fe'l + -ED  (yoki noto'g'ri fe'l shakli)
           watch → watched;  make → made
           HAMMA EGA UCHUN BIR XIL — -s YO'Q!

  INKOR:   DIDN'T + fe'lning ASOSIY shakli
           I didn't WATCH   ✓
           I didn't WATCHED ✗ XATO

  SO'ROQ:  DID + ega + fe'lning ASOSIY shakli
           Did you WATCH?   ✓
           Did you WATCHED? ✗ XATO

  QISQA JAVOB: did / didn't (asosiy fe'l TAKRORLANMAYDI)
           Yes, I did.      ✓
           Yes, I watched.  ✗

ENG MUHIM QOIDA:
  'DID' yoki 'DIDN'T' bor bo'lsa — fe'l ASOSIY shaklda.
  Sababi: 'did' allaqachon o'tgan zamonni ko'rsatgan.
  Bu — 9-unitdagi 'didn't have' qoidasining o'zi.

USE (ishlatilishi):
  Past simple ni O'TMISHDA sodir bo'lgan va QAYTA
  TAKRORLANMAYDIGAN harakatlar uchun ishlatamiz.
     Diana MARRIED Prince Charles in July, 1981.
     (When did she marry him? In July, 1981.)

  VAQT IBORALARI (past simple belgilari):
     yesterday       = kecha
     ... ago         = ...oldin
     in 1950         = 1950-yilda
     last Monday     = o'tgan dushanba
     last week/month = o'tgan hafta/oy

WAS/WERE BILAN SOLISHTIRING (9-unit):
  'to be'  → did KERAK EMAS:  Were you at home?
  boshqa fe'l → did KERAK:    Did you watch TV?
examples: I/you/he, etc watched TV last night.
I/you/he, etc didn't watch TV last night.
Did I/you/he, etc watch TV last night?
Yes, I/you/he, etc did. — No, I/you/he, etc didn't.
We use the past simple for actions which happened in the past and won't happen again.
Diana married Prince Charles in July, 1981.
Time expressions: yesterday, ago, in 1950, last Monday/week/month, etc.
topics.source: Coursebook, 72-bet, Past Simple jadvali va Use qutisi

topics.topic: Past Simple — MASHQNING MAQSADI · 9-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
MASHQNING MAQSADI:
  Kitob javoblarni BERMAYDI — siz SAVOL berib bilib olasiz.
  Bu — so'roq gap tuzishni mashq qilish uchun.

OLTI SAVOL:
  1  When was she born?          → 1) bo'shliq
  2  Where was she born?         → 2) bo'shliq
  3  When did she marry Pièrre Curie?  → 3) bo'shliq
  4  What did they discover?     → 4) bo'shliq
  5  When did Pièrre die?        → 5) bo'shliq
  6  When did she die?           → 6) bo'shliq

SAVOL QOLIPLARI:
  'to be' bilan  → When/Where WAS she born?  ('did' YO'Q)
  boshqa fe'l    → When DID she MARRY? ('did' + asosiy shakl)

TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Marie Sklodowska (Marie Curie) was a famous scientist.
  She was born in 1867 in Warsaw, Poland. She studied
  physics and mathematics at the Sorbonne in Paris. She
  married Pièrre Curie in 1895. Together they discovered
  polonium and radium in 1898. In 1903, the Curies received
  the Nobel Prize for Physics. Pièrre died in a road
  accident in 1906. Marie continued their work on radium.
  In 1911, she received the Nobel Prize for Chemistry.
  She died of leukaemia in 1934.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Mariya Sklodovska (Mari Kyuri) mashhur olima edi.
  U 1867-yilda Polshaning Varshava shahrida tug'ilgan.
  U Parijdagi Sorbonnada fizika va matematika o'qidi.
  1895-yilda Pyer Kyuriga turmushga chiqdi. Ular birgalikda
  1898-yilda poloniy va radiyni kashf etishdi. 1903-yilda
  Kyurilar fizika bo'yicha Nobel mukofotini olishdi.
  Pyer 1906-yilda yo'l-transport hodisasida halok bo'ldi.
  Mariya radiy ustidagi ishlarini davom ettirdi. 1911-yilda
  u kimyo bo'yicha Nobel mukofotini oldi. U 1934-yilda
  leykemiyadan vafot etdi.

JAVOBLAR QAYERDAN OLINDI:
  1867 va 1934 — 70-betdagi rasm izohida yozilgan
                 ('Polish scientist 1867 - 1934').
  Qolgan yillar — tarixiy faktlar.
  Kitobning o'zida bu javoblar YO'Q — o'qituvchi aytadi.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  physics      = fizika
  mathematics  = matematika
  to discover  = kashf etmoq
  to receive   = olmoq
  the Nobel Prize = Nobel mukofoti
  chemistry    = kimyo
  a road accident = yo'l-transport hodisasi
  leukaemia    = leykemiya (qon saratoni)
  radium       = radiy
  polonium     = poloniy (Polsha nomidan)

topics.topic: Past Simple — RO'YXAT (10 ta ish) · 10-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
RO'YXAT (10 ta ish):
  study, make a cake, play football, cut the grass,
  watch TV, cook dinner, listen to music, do the shopping,
  go for a walk, buy clothes

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  I made a cake yesterday but I didn't cook dinner.

QOLIP:
  I [o'tgan zamon fe'li] yesterday BUT I DIDN'T [asosiy fe'l].

ENG MUHIM DIQQAT — IKKI XIL SHAKL BIR GAPDA:
  I MADE a cake        (tasdiq → o'tgan shakl)
  I DIDN'T COOK dinner (inkor → ASOSIY shakl)

  'I didn't cooked' XATO!

RO'YXATDAGI FE'LLARNING O'TGAN SHAKLI:

  TO'G'RI FE'LLAR (-ed):
     study        → studied      (Y → I + ED)
     play         → played
     watch        → watched
     cook         → cooked
     listen       → listened

  NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR (yodlash kerak):
     make         → MADE
     cut          → CUT          (O'ZGARMAYDI!)
     do           → DID
     go           → WENT
     buy          → BOUGHT

DIQQAT — 'CUT':
  'cut' o'tgan zamonda ham 'cut' bo'lib qoladi.
  I cut the grass yesterday.  (o'tgan zamon)
  Shunga o'xshash: put → put, let → let, hit → hit.

topics.topic: Past Simple — RO'YXAT: with, in, on, to, at, round, of · 11-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
RO'YXAT: with, in, on, to, at, round, of

7 ta predlog, 13 ta bo'shliq — demak ba'zilari
BIR NECHA MARTA ishlatiladi:
  in  → 5 marta
  at  → 2 marta
  on  → 2 marta
  qolganlari → 1 martadan

Hamma ibora 71-betdagi Diana haqidagi maqoladan olingan.

SANA va JOY PREDLOGLARI — QISQA QOIDA:
  ON + aniq sana yoki kun    → on 1st July;  on Monday
  IN + oy, yil, shahar, mamlakat → in July;  in 1961;
                                    in Norfolk
  AT + aniq bino yoki nuqta  → at a school;
                               at St Paul's Cathedral

topics.topic: Spelling — past simple — Yozilishi — oddiy o'tgan zamon
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI TO'RT QOIDA:

  1) Ko'pchilik TO'G'RI fe'lga -ED qo'shamiz.
        I work  →  I worked

  2) Oxiri -E bilan tugagan fe'lga faqat -D qo'shamiz.
        I love  →  I loved

  3) UNDOSH + Y bilan tugagan fe'lda -Y tushadi,
     o'rniga -IED qo'shiladi.
        I study  →  I studied

  4) Boshqa fe'llarning NOTO'G'RI shakli bor.
        become  →  became
        say     →  said
     Kitobning OXIRIDAGI noto'g'ri fe'llar ro'yxatiga qarang.

ENG MUHIM DIQQAT — 3-QOIDA FAQAT UNDOSH + Y UCHUN:

  UNDOSH + Y  →  Y tushadi, -IED
     stUDy   → studied   (d — undosh)
     marRY   → married   (r — undosh)
     carRY   → carried
     buRY    → buried
     tRY     → tried

  UNLI + Y   →  Y QOLADI, faqat -ED
     enjOY   → enjoyed   (o — unli)
     plAY    → played    (a — unli)
     stAY    → stayed

  12-mashqdagi 'BUT enjoy' shu farqni ko'rsatish uchun.

QO'ShIMCHA QOIDA (kitobda yo'q, lekin foydali):
  Bir bo'g'inli, oxiri UNDOSH+UNLI+UNDOSH bo'lgan fe'lda
  oxirgi undosh IKKILANADI:
     stop → stopped;  plan → planned;  travel → travelled
examples: We add -ed to most regular verbs. I work - I worked
We add -d to verbs ending in -e. I love - I loved
Verbs ending in consonant + y drop the -y and add -ied. I study - I studied
Other verbs have irregular forms: become - became, say - said.
Look at the list of irregular verbs at the back of the book.
BUT: vowel + y keeps the -y. enjoy - enjoyed

topics.topic: Spelling — past simple — MASHQ UCH QUTIGA BO'LINGAN — HAR BIRI BOSHQA QOIDA · 12-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
MASHQ UCH QUTIGA BO'LINGAN — HAR BIRI BOSHQA QOIDA:

  1-QUTI (chap): work, watch, call, appear, end, return
                 → oddiy + ED
     1-QUTI (o'ng): complete, love, care, divorce,
                    continue, die
                 → oxiri -E, faqat + D

  2-QUTI: study, marry  BUT  enjoy
                 → undosh+Y → IED,  LEKIN unli+Y → ED

  3-QUTI: write, buy, make, go
                 → NOTO'G'RI fe'llar (yodlash kerak)

Qutilarning o'zi qoidani ko'rsatib turibdi.

topics.topic: past simple forms — O'N OLTI FE'L — TO'G'RI va NOTO'G'RI ARALASH · 5-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
O'N OLTI FE'L — TO'G'RI va NOTO'G'RI ARALASH.

TO'G'RI FE'LLAR (7 ta):
  appear → appeared    (oddiy + ED)
  stop   → stopped     (undosh IKKILANADI)
  star   → starred     (undosh IKKILANADI)
  travel → travelled   (britancha: L ikkilanadi)
  finish → finished    (oddiy + ED)
  move   → moved       (oxiri -E → + D)
  produce → produced   (oxiri -E → + D)
  direct → directed    (oddiy + ED)

NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR (8 ta):
  buy   → bought
  write → wrote
  sing  → sang
  come  → came
  win   → won
  sink  → sank
  eat   → ate
  lose  → lost

DIQQAT — UNDOSH IKKILANIShI:
  stop → stoPPed;  star → staRRed
  Sababi: bir bo'g'inli, oxiri UNDOSH+UNLI+UNDOSH,
  urg'u shu bo'g'inda → oxirgi undosh ikkilanadi.
  (Grammar 42-betdagi 3-qoida.)

DIQQAT — 'SING' va 'SINK' JUFTLIGI:
  sing → SANG  (qo'shiq aytmoq)
  sink → SANK  (cho'kmoq)
  Ikkalasi ham 'i' → 'a' ga aylanadi — bir xil naqsh.

topics.topic: past simple forms — ENG MUHIM QOIDA — BU MASHQDA 'DID' YO'Q! · 6a-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
ENG MUHIM QOIDA — BU MASHQDA 'DID' YO'Q!

  Savol so'zi ('Who', 'Which film', 'Which country',
  'Which ship') EGA vazifasini bajaryapti.

  EGA so'ralganda 'did' KERAK EMAS —
  fe'l TO'G'RIDAN-TO'G'RI o'tgan shaklda turadi:

     Who DIRECTED E.T.?        ✓
     Who DID direct E.T.?      (odatda ishlatilmaydi)

SOLISHTIRING — Grammar 44-betdagi 7-mashqning 5-bandi:
  'WHO did you visit last week?'
  U yerda 'who' TO'LDIRUVChI edi (kimni?) → 'did' KERAK.

  Bu yerda esa:
  'WHO directed E.T.?'
  'who' EGA (kim?) → 'did' KERAK EMAS.

FARQNI ANIQLASH USULI:
  Javob EGA bo'lsa → 'did' yo'q
     Who wrote it? — DICKENS wrote it.  (Dickens = ega)
  Javob TO'LDIRUVChI bo'lsa → 'did' bor
     Who did you visit? — I visited MY AUNT.

⚠ 2-BAND — ANIQLIK:

  Savol: 'Who became President of the USA
  in 1992?'  Javob: Bill Clinton.

  ⚠ Aniqrog'i: Klinton 1992-yil noyabrda
  SAYLANDI, lekin prezidentlik lavozimini
  1993-yil YANVARDA egalladi.

  ⚠ AQShda saylov noyabrda, qasamyod esa
  keyingi yil yanvarda bo'ladi.

  ⚠ Kitob 'saylandi' ma'nosida yozgan.


⚠ QOLGAN OLTI BAND TO'G'RI:
  Spielberg — E.T. (1982)
  Ben Hur — 11 ta 'Oskar' (1960-yilgi marosim)
  Elton John — 'Candle in the Wind' (1997,
     malika Diana xotirasiga)
  Fransiya — Jahon chempioni (1998)
  Charlz Dikkens — 'Oliver Tvist'
  'Titanik' — 1912-yilda cho'kkan

topics.topic: past simple forms — KITOBDAGI NAMUNA · 6b-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  Spielberg directed E.T. The Extra-Terrestrial.

QOLIP:
  [javob = EGA] + [o'tgan zamon fe'li] + [qolgan qismi].

Savolni GAPGA aylantirasiz:
  savol:  WHO directed E.T.?
  javob:  Steven Spielberg
  gap:    SPIELBERG DIRECTED E.T.

DIQQAT: savol so'zi ('Who', 'Which film') o'rniga
JAVOB qo'yiladi, fe'l shakli O'ZGARMAYDI —
chunki savolda ham 'did' yo'q edi.

topics.topic: famous people and their achievements — KITOBDAGI NAMUNA · 7b-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  Pele/star in Top Gun?
  SA: DID Pele STAR in Top Gun?
  SB: No, he DIDN'T. Tom Cruise STARRED in Top Gun.

QOLIP:
  SA: DID + ism + ASOSIY fe'l + ...?
  SB: No, he DIDN'T. + to'g'ri ism + O'TGAN fe'l + ... .

ENG MUHIM DIQQAT — BIR DIALOGDA IKKI SHAKL:
  Savolda:  DID Pele STAR    (asosiy shakl)
  Javobda:  Tom Cruise STARRED (o'tgan shakl)

  'Did Pele starred' XATO.

DIQQAT — SAVOLDA 'DID' BOR:
  Bu yerda ega ISM ('Pele') — savol so'zi EMAS.
  Shuning uchun 'did' KERAK.
  40-betdagi 6-mashq bilan SOLISHTIRING:
     'WHO directed E.T.?' — 'who' EGA → 'did' YO'Q
     'DID Pele star ...?'  — 'Pele' ega, savol so'zi emas → 'did' BOR

topics.topic: uch zamon va bog'lovchilar — QOIDALARNI ESLANG (Grammar 42-betdan) · 14-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
QOIDALARNI ESLANG (Grammar 42-betdan):

  THE QO'YILADI:
     daryo nomlari      the Tiber, the Nile
     tog' tizmalari     the Himalayas, the Alps
     millat nomlari     the Americans, the British
     oila nomlari       the Smiths, the Browns
     ilgari aytilgan    the film
     ma'lum narsa       the red car outside

  THE QO'YILMAYDI:
     shahar nomlari     Rome, Liverpool
     qit'a nomlari      Asia
     odam ismlari       Jason
     ovqat nomlari      dinner
     sport nomlari      baseball

  A / AN QO'YILADI:
     birinchi marta, birlik  a river, an excellent film

DIQQAT — 5-BAND ENG MUHIM:
  'There was AN excellent film ... THE film was about ...'
  Birinchi marta → AN;  ikkinchi marta → THE.
  Bu — artikl qoidasining o'zagi.

⚠ ESKIRGAN ATAMA — 'THE ZULU TRIBE':

  5-bandda 'the Zulu TRIBE' deyilgan.

  ⚠ 'tribe' (qabila) so'zi bugungi kunda
  Afrika xalqlariga nisbatan ESKIRGAN va
  ba'zan qo'pol hisoblanadi.

  ⚠ Bugungi to'g'ri variantlar:
     the Zulu PEOPLE
     the Zulu NATION
     yoki shunchaki 'the Zulu'

  ⚠ Zulular — Janubiy Afrikadagi eng katta
  xalq, taxminan 12 million kishi.
  'Qabila' so'zi ularning sonini ham,
  tarixini ham kichraytirib ko'rsatadi.

  ⚠ Grammatik qoida ('the' ishlatiladi)
  TO'G'RI. Xuddi shu qayd Grammar
  42-betda ham bor.

topics.topic: Adjectives — Sifatlar
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

  Sifat OTNI aniqlaydi.
  Sifat BIRLIKDA ham, KO'PLIKDA ham BIR XIL bo'ladi.

  Look at this TALL tree.    (birlik — bitta daraxt)
  Look at these TALL trees.  (ko'plik — bir necha daraxt)


ENG MUHIM QOIDA — SIFAT HECH QAChON -S OLMAYDI:

  tall trees      ✓
  talls trees     ✗ XATO

  beautiful flowers   ✓
  beautifuls flowers  ✗ XATO

  Bu — o'zbek tilidan farq qiladigan muhim nuqta.
  Ingliz tilida OT ko'plik bo'ladi, SIFAT esa O'ZGARMAYDI.


DIQQAT — 'THIS' va 'THESE' O'ZGARADI:
  THIS tall tree    (birlik)
  THESE tall trees  (ko'plik)

  Ko'rsatish olmoshi OT bilan birga o'zgaradi,
  lekin SIFAT o'zgarmaydi.

  To'liq jadval:
     this  → these   (yaqin)
     that  → those   (uzoq)


SIFAT GAPDA QAYERDA TURADI:

  1) OTDAN OLDIN:
        a TALL tree;  a BEAUTIFUL day;  SCARY animals

  2) 'TO BE' dan KEYIN:
        The tree is TALL.
        The animals were SCARY.

  3) 'FEEL', 'LOOK', 'SEEM' dan KEYIN:
        He felt FRIGHTENED.
        They look FRIENDLY.


BIR NEChTA SIFAT BIRGA KELSA:
  Coursebook 77-betdagi hikoyada:
     'One GORGEOUS, SUNNY day' — ikki sifat, vergul bilan.
     'a little old cottage' — ikki sifat, vergulsiz.

  Odatdagi tartib:
     baho → o'lcham → yosh → rang → material
     a nice   little   old    white   silk   dress
examples: Adjectives describe nouns.
They are the same in the singular and the plural.
Look at this tall tree.
Look at these tall trees.

topics.topic: Adverbs — Ravishlar
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

  Ravish odatda FE'LNI aniqlaydi.
     He drives CAREFULLY.
     (How does he drive? CAREFULLY.)
     = U qanday haydaydi? Ehtiyotkorlik bilan.


FORM — UChTA QOIDA:

  1) Ravishni odatda sifatga -LY qo'shib yasaymiz.
        careful → carefully

  2) Sifat UNDOSH + Y bilan tugasa, -Y ni tushirib,
     -ILY qo'shamiz.
        lucky → luckily

  3) Ba'zi ravishlar SIFAT bilan BIR XIL shaklda bo'ladi.
        hard  → hard
        fast  → fast
        early → early

     ESLATMA:  good → WELL


SIFAT va RAVISHNI QANDAY AJRATISH:

  Savol bering:
     'WHAT KIND OF ...?' (qanday?)     → SIFAT
     'HOW ...?' (qanday qilib?)        → RAVISH

  Misol:
     He is a CAREFUL driver.  (qanday haydovchi? → SIFAT)
     He drives CAREFULLY.     (qanday haydaydi? → RAVISH)


GAPDA JOYI:
  SIFAT  — otdan OLDIN yoki 'to be' dan KEYIN
  RAVISH — fe'ldan KEYIN (yoki ba'zan oldin)


DIQQAT — -LY BILAN TUGAGAN SIFATLAR:
  friendly, lovely, silly, lonely, ugly — bular SIFAT!
  Ular RAVISH EMAS.
     He smiled in a FRIENDLY way.  ✓
     He smiled FRIENDLY.           ✗ XATO


DIQQAT — 'HARD' va 'HARDLY':
  hard   = qattiq, ko'p   (He works HARD.)
  hardly = deyarli emas   (He HARDLY works.)
  Ma'nosi BUTUNLAY TESKARI!

  Shunga o'xshash:
     late   = kech           ↔  lately = so'nggi paytda
     near   = yaqin          ↔  nearly = deyarli
examples: Adverbs usually describe verbs. He drives carefully. (How does he drive? Carefully.)
We usually form adverbs by adding -ly to the adjective. careful - carefully
When the adjective ends in a consonant + y, we drop -y and add -ily. lucky - luckily
Some adverbs have the same form as their adjectives. hard → hard, fast → fast, early → early
Note: good → well

topics.topic: Linking Words: and, because, but, so, then, when — Bog'lovchilar: and, because, but, so, then, when
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA:
  Gaplarni BIRLAShTIRISh uchun bog'lovchilardan
  foydalanamiz.

OLTI MISOL — HAR BIRI IKKI SHAKLDA BERILGAN:

  AND — qo'shimcha, ketma-ketlik
     He locked the door. He left the house.
     → He locked the door AND left the house.
     DIQQAT: ikkinchi 'he' TUShIB QOLDI.

  BUT — QARAMA-QARShILIK
     Tom wanted to watch TV. I didn't.
     → Tom wanted to watch TV, BUT I didn't.

  BECAUSE — SABAB
     Julie was happy. She didn't have any homework.
     → Julie was happy BECAUSE she didn't have any homework.

  SO — NATIJA
     I was very tired. I decided to go to bed.
     → I was very tired, SO I decided to go to bed.

  THEN — KETMA-KETLIK
     She parked the car. She went inside.
     → She parked the car, THEN she went inside.

  WHEN — VAQT
     He was at work. He heard the news.
     → He was at work WHEN he heard the news.


QAY BIRINI TANLASH — SAVOL BERING:

  Ikkinchi gap SABABNI aytadimi?         → BECAUSE
  Ikkinchi gap birinchisining NATIJASImi? → SO
  Ikkinchi gap QARAMA-QARShImi?          → BUT
  Ikkinchi gap QAChON bo'lganini aytadimi? → WHEN
  Ketma-ket sodir bo'ldimi?               → AND yoki THEN


BECAUSE va SO — TARTIBI TESKARI:

     NATIJA + BECAUSE + SABAB
        I went to bed BECAUSE I was tired.

     SABAB + SO + NATIJA
        I was tired, SO I went to bed.

  Ma'no BIR XIL, faqat tartib boshqacha.


VERGUL QOIDASI:
  BUT, SO, THEN oldidan → VERGUL qo'yiladi
  AND, BECAUSE, WHEN oldidan → odatda vergul YO'Q


EGA TUShIB QOLIShI:
  'AND' va 'THEN' bilan bog'langanda, ega BIR XIL bo'lsa
  ikkinchisida tushirib qoldirsa bo'ladi:
     He locked the door and (he) left the house.  ✓

  Lekin kitobdagi 'then' misolida ega SAQLANGAN:
     She parked the car, then SHE went inside.
  Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.
examples: We use linking words to join sentences.
He locked the door. He left the house. → He locked the door and left the house.
Tom wanted to watch TV. I didn't. → Tom wanted to watch TV, but I didn't.
Julie was happy. She didn't have any homework. → Julie was happy because she didn't have any homework.
I was very tired. I decided to go to bed. → I was very tired, so I decided to go to bed.
She parked the car. She went inside. → She parked the car, then she went inside.
He was at work. He heard the news. → He was at work when he heard the news.

topics.topic: Prepositions of Movement — Harakat predloglari (1)
topics.rule_uz:
O'N RASM VA O'N PREDLOG:

  PAST     — pochta qutisi YONIDAN o'tib
  TOWARDS  — ayol TOMON borish
  ACROSS   — ko'chani KESIB o'tish
  ALONG    — ko'cha BO'YLAB yurish
  UP       — zinadan YUQORIGA
  DOWN     — zinadan PASTGA
  UNDER    — ko'prik OSTIDAN
  INTO     — eshikdan IChKARIGA
  OVER     — to'siq USTIDAN sakrab
  THROUGH  — tunnel IChIDAN


ENG KO'P ADAShTIRILADIGAN JUFTLIKLAR:

  ALONG ↔ ACROSS
     ALONG  — UZUNASIGA (ko'cha bo'ylab yurish)
     ACROSS — KO'NDALANG (ko'chani kesib o'tish)
     Rasmlarda aniq ko'rinadi: 'across' da odam
     ZEBRA yo'lakda ko'chani kesib o'tyapti,
     'along' da esa piyodalar yo'lida yurib ketyapti.

  THROUGH ↔ ACROSS
     THROUGH — biror narsaning IChIDAN
               (tunnel, o'rmon — tepasi yopiq)
     ACROSS  — biror narsaning USTIDAN, yuzasi bo'ylab
               (ko'cha, dala — tepasi ochiq)

  OVER ↔ UNDER
     OVER  — USTIDAN (tegmasdan sakrab)
     UNDER — OSTIDAN

  UP ↔ DOWN
     UP   — yuqoriga
     DOWN — pastga

  INTO ↔ OUT OF
     INTO   — ichkariga
     OUT OF — tashqariga
     (kitobda faqat 'into' berilgan)

  TO ↔ TOWARDS
     TO      — yetib borish (maqsad)
     TOWARDS — ...TOMON (yo'nalish)


DIQQAT — 'PAST' IKKI XIL SO'Z:
  'past' PREDLOG = yonidan o'tib
     He walked PAST the postbox.
  'the past' OT = o'tmish
     'the past simple' = oddiy o'tgan zamon (10-unit)


ESLATMA:
  Coursebook 78-betda ham shu predloglar bor edi
  (Ralf ot minadigan hikoyada).
examples: past
towards
across
along
up
down
under
into

topics.topic: Adverbs — OLTI SIFAT — UChALA QOIDA HAM SINALADI · 2-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
OLTI SIFAT — UChALA QOIDA HAM SINALADI:

  UNDOSH + Y → -ILY:
     easy   → easily
     happy  → happily
     sleepy → sleepily

  ODDIY + LY:
     proud → proudly
     close → closely

  ISTISNO:
     good → WELL

DIQQAT — 'CLOSE' IKKI XIL O'QILADI:
  'close' SIFAT/RAVISh (/kləʊs/) = yaqin
     He lives CLOSE to the school.
  'close' FE'L (/kləʊz/) = yopmoq
     Please CLOSE the door.
  Ravishi: CLOSELY (/ˈkləʊsli/) = diqqat bilan, yaqindan
     Look CLOSELY at the picture.

topics.topic: Linking Words — RO'YXAT: and, but, so, because, when · 6-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
RO'YXAT: and, but, so, because, when

5 ta bog'lovchi, 10 ta bo'shliq — demak ba'zilari
BIR NEChA MARTA ishlatiladi:
  and     → 3 marta
  but     → 2 marta
  so      → 2 marta
  when    → 2 marta
  because → 1 marta

TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Sally was tired, SO she decided to go to bed. She was
  asleep WHEN the telephone rang. She got up AND answered
  the phone BUT no one spoke on the other end. Sally hung
  up the phone AND went back to bed. She couldn't sleep, SO
  she went into the kitchen AND made some tea. She was
  still in the kitchen WHEN the phone rang again. Sally
  didn't want to answer it, BUT she did. Once again, no one
  spoke on the other end. Sally hung up the phone. She felt
  nervous BECAUSE she was alone in the house. Suddenly,
  there was a knock at the door!


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Salli charchagan edi, shuning uchun yotishga qaror qildi.
  U uxlab yotgan edi, o'shanda telefon jiringladi. U turdi
  va telefonga javob berdi, lekin narigi tomondan hech kim
  gapirmadi. Salli go'shakni qo'ydi va yana yotdi. U uxlay
  olmadi, shuning uchun oshxonaga bordi va choy damladi. U
  hali oshxonada edi, o'shanda telefon yana jiringladi.
  Salli javob bermoqchi emas edi, lekin javob berdi. Yana
  bir bor narigi tomondan hech kim gapirmadi. Salli
  go'shakni qo'ydi. U asabiylashdi, chunki uyda yolg'iz
  edi. To'satdan eshik taqilladi!

DIQQAT — BU HAM HIKOYA:
  Matn qo'rqinchli hikoya uslubida yozilgan.
  Oxiri ochiq qoldirilgan ('Suddenly, there was a knock
  at the door!') — bu Coursebook 79 va 81-betlardagi
  hikoya yozish qoidalariga mos.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  asleep       = uxlab yotgan
  to ring (rang) = jiringlamoq
  to hang up   = go'shakni qo'ymoq
  on the other end = narigi tomonda (telefonda)
  once again   = yana bir bor
  alone        = yolg'iz
  a knock      = taqillatish
  to make tea  = choy damlamoq

topics.topic: Revision: Units 1 - 11 — KITOBDAGI NAMUNA · 10-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  JOHN drove to work.
     → WHO drove to work?


ENG MUHIM QOIDA — QALIN SO'Z EGAMI YOKI TO'LDIRUVChIMI:

  Agar qalin so'z EGA bo'lsa (gapning boshida, harakatni
  bajaruvchi):
     → WHO ...?  va 'DID' KERAK EMAS
     → fe'l O'TGAN shaklda qoladi

        JOHN drove to work.
        → Who DROVE to work?      ('did' YO'Q)

  Agar qalin so'z TO'LDIRUVChI bo'lsa (harakat tushadigan
  narsa):
     → WHAT ...?  va 'DID' KERAK
     → fe'l ASOSIY shaklda

        Kate did THE SHOPPING.
        → What DID Kate DO?       ('did' BOR)

  Agar qalin so'z JOY bo'lsa:
     → WHERE ...?  va 'DID' KERAK

        They went to THE BEACH.
        → Where DID they GO?


BU MASHQDAGI TAQSIMOT:

  EGA so'ralgan ('did' YO'Q) — 1, 3, 5, 7, 9-bandlar:
     John, Alex, Sean, Helen, Jimmy

  TO'LDIRUVChI so'ralgan ('did' BOR) — 2, 4, 6, 8-bandlar:
     the shopping, the door, noises, a red dress

  JOY so'ralgan ('did' BOR) — 10-band:
     the beach


DIQQAT — 9-BAND BOShQAChA:
  'Jimmy IS a careful driver.' — 'to be' fe'li,
  hozirgi zamon → 'WHO IS a careful driver?'
  ('did' ham, o'tgan zamon ham yo'q)

topics.topic: Linking words for events — Voqealar ketma-ketligi so'zlari
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA:
  first, then, after that, just then, next, finally va h.k.
  so'zlarini BIRIN-KETIN sodir bo'lgan voqealar haqida
  gapirish uchun ishlatamiz.

KITOBDAGI MISOL:
  Tony decided to go on a picnic. FIRST, he made some
  sandwiches, THEN he packed the picnic basket. ...

OLTI SO'Z VA ULARNING O'RNI:

  FIRST      — BIRINCHI voqea
               First, they drove into the park.

  THEN       — keyingi voqea
               Then he stopped the car.

  AFTER THAT — shundan keyin
               After that, he tried to start the car.

  NEXT       — keyin (= then)
               Next, smoke came out of the engine.

  JUST THEN  — AYNAN shu payt (KUTILMAGANDA)
               Just then, a park ranger came along.

  FINALLY    — NIHOYAT, eng oxirgi voqea
               Finally, another jeep chased the lions away.

DIQQAT — VERGUL:
  Gap boshida kelsa, keyin VERGUL qo'yiladi:
     FIRST, they drove into the park.
     JUST THEN, a park ranger came along.
  'then' esa vergulsiz ham kelishi mumkin:
     Then he stopped the car.

DIQQAT — 'JUST THEN' ning ALOHIDA ma'nosi:
  Boshqalari shunchaki ketma-ketlikni bildiradi,
  'just then' esa KUTILMAGAN, to'satdan bo'lgan
  voqeani ta'kidlaydi.
  Hikoyada aynan qutqaruv kelganda ishlatilgan.

BOSHQA FOYDALI SO'ZLAR (hikoyadan):
  suddenly            = to'satdan
  soon                = tez orada
  a few minutes later = bir necha daqiqadan keyin
  almost immediately  = deyarli darhol
  when                = ...ganda
  in the end          = oxir-oqibat
examples: We use first, then, after that, just then, next, finally, etc to talk about events which happened one after the other.
Tony decided to go on a picnic. First, he made some sandwiches, then he packed the picnic basket.
first
then
after that
next
just then
finally

topics.topic: Prepositions of Movement — Harakat predloglari (2)
topics.rule_uz:
TO'QQIZ RASM VA TO'QQIZ PREDLOG:

  a  PAST      — kulba YONIDAN o'tib ketish
  b  TOWARDS   — biror narsa TOMON borish
  c  ACROSS    — dala BO'YLAB (bir chetdan ikkinchisiga)
  d  UP / DOWN — tepalikka CHIQISh va TUShISh
  e  ALONG     — yo'l BO'YLAB (uzunasiga)
  f  UNDER     — ko'prik OSTIDAN
  g  INTO      — ko'lga ICHKARIGA (tushib ketish)
  h  THROUGH   — tunnel IChIDAN o'tib
  i  OVER      — panjara USTIDAN sakrab

ENG KO'P ADASHTIRILADIGAN JUFTLIKLAR:

  ALONG ↔ ACROSS
     ALONG  — UZUNASIGA (yo'l bo'ylab yurish)
     ACROSS — KO'NDALANG (bir chetdan ikkinchisiga)

  THROUGH ↔ ACROSS
     THROUGH — biror narsaning IChIDAN
               (tunnel, o'rmon, tepa yopiq)
     ACROSS  — biror narsaning USTIDAN, yuzasi bo'ylab
               (dala, ko'cha, tepa ochiq)

  OVER ↔ UNDER
     OVER  — USTIDAN (tegmasdan)
     UNDER — OSTIDAN

  INTO ↔ OUT OF
     INTO   — ICHKARIGA
     OUT OF — TAShQARIGA

  TO ↔ TOWARDS
     TO      — yetib borish (maqsad)
     TOWARDS — ...TOMON (yo'nalish, yetib borish shart emas)

DIQQAT — 'PAST' IKKI XIL SO'Z:
  'past' PREDLOG = yonidan o'tib
     He walked PAST the shop.
  'the past' OT = o'tmish
     'the past simple' = oddiy o'tgan zamon

topics.topic: Prepositions of Movement — RASMLAR TARTIBI matnga qarab aniqlanadi · 8b-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
RASMLAR TARTIBI matnga qarab aniqlanadi.

Kitob 'e' rasmini '1' deb raqamlagan.

TO'LIQ TARTIB:
  1 → e (along the road)
  2 → h (through the tunnel)
  3 → b (towards the forest)
  4 → d (up the hill)
  5 → d (down the other side)
  6 → a (past the cottage)
  7 → f (under the bridge)
  8 → c (across a field)
  9 → i (over the fence)
  10 → g (into the lake)

DIQQAT: 'd' rasmi IKKI marta (4 va 5) —
kitobda uning qutisida qiya chiziq bor.

HIKOYANI SO'ZLASHDA ketma-ketlik so'zlaridan foydalaning
(77-betdagi qoida):
  First, ... Then, ... After that, ... Suddenly, ...
  Finally, ...

topics.topic: Adjectives & Adverbs — Sifat va ravish
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

  SIFAT (adjective) — OTNI aniqlaydi.
     He is a CAREFUL DRIVER.
     (What kind of driver is he? CAREFUL.)
     = U qanday haydovchi? Ehtiyotkor.

  RAVISH (adverb) — odatda FE'LNI aniqlaydi.
     He drives CAREFULLY.
     (How does he drive? CAREFULLY.)
     = U qanday haydaydi? Ehtiyotkorlik bilan.

QANDAY ANIQLASH — SAVOL BERING:

  'WHAT KIND OF ...?' (qanday?) → SIFAT
     a careful driver, a beautiful day, scary animals

  'HOW ...?' (qanday qilib?) → RAVISH
     drives carefully, roared loudly, screamed desperately

GAPDA JOYI:

  SIFAT:
     otdan OLDIN:        a CAREFUL driver
     'to be' dan KEYIN:  He is CAREFUL.

  RAVISH:
     fe'ldan KEYIN:      He drives CAREFULLY.
                         The lions roared LOUDLY.

RAVISH YASALIShI — SIFAT + LY:
  careful → carefully
  loud    → loudly
  quick   → quickly
  tight   → tightly
  desperate → desperately

ISTISNOLAR:
  good → WELL   ('goodly' YO'Q!)
  fast → FAST   (o'zgarmaydi)
  hard → HARD   (o'zgarmaydi)
  early → EARLY (o'zgarmaydi)

DIQQAT — -LY BILAN TUGAGAN SIFATLAR HAM BOR:
  friendly, lovely, lonely, silly — bular SIFAT!
  'He smiled friendly' XATO →
  'He smiled in a friendly way' ✓


IKKINCHI QUTI — SIFATLAR HIKOYANI QIZIQARLI QILADI:

  Sifatlar hikoyalarimizni qiziqarliroq qiladi.
  'One day last summer, they went to the park ...'
  o'rniga
  'One BEAUTIFUL SUNNY day last summer, they went to the
  park ...' deb yozishimiz mumkin.

  77-betdagi hikoya ham shunday boshlangan:
  'One GORGEOUS, SUNNY day last summer ...'
examples: Adjectives describe nouns.
He is a careful driver. (What kind of driver is he? Careful.)
Adverbs usually describe verbs.
He drives carefully. (How does he drive? Carefully.)
careful → carefully
good → well (not 'goodly')
fast, hard, early — same form
friendly, lovely, silly — these are ADJECTIVES

topics.topic: Form & Spelling of Adverbs — KITOBDAGI MISOLLAR · 11-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI MISOLLAR:

  He was a CAREFUL driver.  →  He drove CAREFULLY.
  The HAPPY child smiled.   →  The child smiled HAPPILY.
  She was a FAST runner.    →  She could run very FAST.
  They were GOOD singers.   →  They sang very WELL.

UCHTA QOIDA:

  1) Ravishni odatda sifatga -LY qo'shib yasaymiz.
        careful → carefully
        loud    → loudly
        quick   → quickly

  2) Sifat UNDOSH + Y bilan tugasa, -Y ni tushirib,
     -ILY qo'shamiz.
        happy  → happily
        easy   → easily
        lucky  → luckily

  3) Ba'zi ravishlar SIFAT bilan BIR XIL shaklda bo'ladi.
        hard  → hard
        fast  → fast
        early → early
     LEKIN:  good → WELL

DIQQAT — 2-QOIDA FAQAT UNDOSH + Y UCHUN:
  UNDOSH + Y → -ILY
     hapPY  → happily   (p — undosh)
     easY   → easily    (s — undosh)
  Bu — o'tgan zamondagi -IED qoidasiga o'xshash
  (marry → married).

DIQQAT — 3-QOIDADAGI TUZOQ:
  'hardly' shakli BOR, lekin ma'nosi BOShQA!
     hard   = qattiq, ko'p  (He works HARD.)
     hardly = deyarli emas  (He HARDLY works.)
  Ikkalasi BUTUNLAY teskari ma'no beradi.

  Shunga o'xshash:
     late   = kech          (He came LATE.)
     lately = so'nggi paytda (I haven't seen him LATELY.)

topics.topic: Form & Spelling of Adverbs — SAKKIZ SIFAT — UCHALA QOIDA HAM SINALADI · 12-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
SAKKIZ SIFAT — UCHALA QOIDA HAM SINALADI:

  ODDIY + LY:
     strange → strangely
     desperate → desperately
     quick → quickly

  UNDOSH + Y → -ILY:
     happy → happily
     easy  → easily

  SIFAT bilan BIR XIL:
     hard → hard
     fast → fast

  ISTISNO:
     good → WELL

topics.topic: Joining Sentences — Gaplarni bog'lash
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI OLTI MISOL:

  AND — qo'shimcha, ketma-ketlik
     She stood up AND walked towards the door.
     (U o'rnidan turdi va eshik tomon yurdi.)

  BUT — QARAMA-QARShILIK
     He looked out of the window, BUT he couldn't see
     anything.
     (U derazadan qaradi, lekin hech narsa ko'ra olmadi.)

  BECAUSE — SABAB
     He closed the window BECAUSE it was very cold outside.
     (U derazani yopdi, chunki tashqarida juda sovuq edi.)

  SO — NATIJA
     It was very late, SO he decided to go home.
     (Juda kech edi, shuning uchun uyga ketishga qaror qildi.)

  THEN — KETMA-KETLIK
     He opened the door, THEN turned on the lights.
     (U eshikni ochdi, so'ng chiroqlarni yoqdi.)

  WHEN — VAQT
     He was in bed WHEN he heard a strange noise.
     (U to'shakda edi, o'shanda g'alati shovqin eshitdi.)


ENG MUHIM JUFTLIK — 'BECAUSE' va 'SO':

  Ikkalasi ham SABAB-NATIJA aloqasini ko'rsatadi,
  lekin TARTIBI TESKARI:

     NATIJA + BECAUSE + SABAB
        He closed the window BECAUSE it was cold.
        (yopdi ← chunki sovuq edi)

     SABAB + SO + NATIJA
        It was cold, SO he closed the window.
        (sovuq edi → shuning uchun yopdi)

  Ma'no BIR XIL, faqat tartib boshqacha.

DIQQAT — VERGUL:
  'but' va 'so' oldidan odatda VERGUL qo'yiladi.
  'and', 'because', 'when' oldidan odatda vergul YO'Q.

DIQQAT — EGA TAKRORLANMASLIGI:
  'and' va 'then' bilan bog'langanda, ega BIR XIL bo'lsa
  ikkinchisida tushirib qoldirsa bo'ladi:
     She stood up and (she) walked towards the door.
     He opened the door, then (he) turned on the lights.
examples: She stood up and walked towards the door.
He looked out of the window, but he couldn't see anything.
He closed the window because it was very cold outside.
It was very late, so he decided to go home.
He opened the door, then turned on the lights.
He was in bed when he heard a strange noise.

topics.topic: Prepositions of Movement — Harakat predloglari (3)
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA — JUDA MUHIM:

  who, which, what savol so'zlari savolning EGASI bo'lsa,
  fe'l TASDIQ shaklida bo'ladi.

  who, which, what savolning TO'LDIRUVChISI bo'lsa,
  fe'l SO'ROQ shaklida bo'ladi.


BUNI SODDA QILIB TUShUNTIRAMIZ:

  EGA so'ralganda → 'DID' KERAK EMAS
     WHO wrote this book?
     (fe'l 'wrote' — TASDIQ shaklida)
     Javob: DICKENS wrote it.  (Dickens = EGA)

  TO'LDIRUVChI so'ralganda → 'DID' KERAK
     WHAT did you write?
     (fe'l 'write' — SO'ROQ shaklida, 'did' bilan)
     Javob: I wrote A LETTER.  (a letter = TO'LDIRUVChI)


QANDAY ANIQLASh — JAVOBGA QARANG:

  Javob gapning BOShIDA (harakatni bajaruvchi) bo'lsa
     → EGA → 'did' YO'Q

  Javob gapning OXIRIDA (harakat tushadigan narsa) bo'lsa
     → TO'LDIRUVChI → 'did' BOR


MISOLLAR JUFTLAB:

  WHO called you?         — TOM called me.     (ega)
  WHO did you call?       — I called TOM.      (to'ldiruvchi)

  WHAT happened?          — AN ACCIDENT happened.  (ega)
  WHAT did you see?       — I saw AN ACCIDENT.     (to'ldiruvchi)

  WHICH bus goes to town? — THE NUMBER 5 goes.  (ega)
  WHICH bus did you take? — I took THE NUMBER 5. (to'ldiruvchi)


ESLATMA:
  Grammar 50-betdagi 10-mashq va Workbook 40-betdagi
  6-mashq aynan shu qoidani mashq qildiradi.
examples: When who, which, what are the subject of the question, the verb is in the affirmative form.
When who, which, what are the object of the question, the verb is in the interrogative form.
Who called you? — Tom called me. (subject)
Who did you call? — I called Tom. (object)
What happened? — An accident happened. (subject)
What did you see? — I saw an accident. (object)

topics.topic: Subject and Object questions — Ega va to'ldiruvchi savollari
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI IKKI CHIZMA — ENG MUHIM QOIDA:

  CHIZMA A — EGA so'raladi

     [SUBJECT]      [       ]      [OBJECT]
        Ann     —   married   —     Peter
         ↕
     WHO married Peter?
     (not: Who DID marry Peter?)

     Savol so'zi EGA ('Ann') o'rniga turibdi →
     'DID' KERAK EMAS.
     Fe'l TASDIQ shaklida qoladi: 'married'.


  CHIZMA B — TO'LDIRUVChI so'raladi

     [SUBJECT]      [       ]      [OBJECT]
        Ann     —   married   —     Peter
                                       ↑
     WHO did Ann marry?

     Savol so'zi TO'LDIRUVChI ('Peter') o'rniga turibdi →
     'DID' KERAK.
     Fe'l ASOSIY shaklda: 'marry'.


QANDAY ANIQLASh — QALIN SO'Z QAYERDA:

  Qalin so'z gapning BOShIDA (harakatni BAJARUVChI)?
     → EGA → 'did' YO'Q, fe'l O'TGAN shaklda

  Qalin so'z gapning OXIRIDA (harakat TUShADIGAN narsa)?
     → TO'LDIRUVChI → 'did' BOR, fe'l ASOSIY shaklda


ENG MUHIM XATO:
  'Who DID MARRY Peter?' — kitob buni ATAYLAB
  '(not: ...)' deb ko'rsatgan.
  Ega so'ralganda 'did' ISHLATILMAYDI.


BIR XIL SAVOL SO'ZI, IKKI XIL MA'NO:

  WHO married Peter?   — Piterga KIM turmushga chiqdi?
     javob: ANN married Peter.

  WHO did Ann marry?   — Ann KIMGA turmushga chiqdi?
     javob: Ann married PETER.

  Ikkalasi ham 'Who' bilan boshlanadi, lekin
  BUTUNLAY BOShQA narsani so'raydi.


ESLATMA:
  45-betning oxiridagi qoida qutisi va Grammar 50-betdagi
  10-mashq ham aynan shu haqda.
examples: A: Ann (SUBJECT) married Peter (OBJECT). → Who married Peter?
(not: Who did marry Peter?)
B: Ann (SUBJECT) married Peter (OBJECT). → Who did Ann marry?
SUBJECT = ega (the doer of the action)
OBJECT = to'ldiruvchi (the receiver of the action)

topics.topic: Subject and Object questions — KITOBDAGI NAMUNA · 11-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  Where/you/buy/it/from?
  → Where DID YOU BUY it FROM?

QOLIP:
  [savol so'zi] + DID + ega + ASOSIY fe'l + qolgan qismi?

DIQQAT — BU MASHQDA HAMMA BANDDA 'DID' BOR:
  Chunki savol so'zi hech qayerda EGA emas —
  hammasi JOY, VAQT, NARSA yoki USUL so'raydi.

DIQQAT — PREDLOG GAP OXIRIDA QOLADI:
  'Where did you buy it FROM?'
  'Who did you go WITH?'
  Predlog savol so'zi bilan birga oldinga ChIQMAYDI.

topics.topic: Subject and Object questions — KITOBDAGI BOShLANISh · 12-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI BOShLANISh:
  S1: It was a cold, windy night and I was at home, all
      alone.
  S2: Suddenly, I heard a noise outside.

KALIT SO'ZLAR (16 ta):
  home/alone - hear/noise - look/window - see/dark shadow -
  feel/scared - see/strange/face - close/curtains/quickly -
  sb knock/on/window - scream/loudly - phone/police -
  hide/bed - still hear/scary noises - police/arrive -
  open/door - mother/in the garden - feel/silly

  ('sb' = somebody = kimdir)

O'YIN QOIDASI:
  Navbat bilan (S1, S2, S1, S2 ...) har biringiz
  bitta kalit so'zdan gap tuzasiz va hikoyani
  davom ettirasiz.


TO'LIQ NAMUNA HIKOYA:

  It was a cold, windy night and I was at home, all alone.
  Suddenly, I heard a noise outside. I looked out of the
  window and saw a dark shadow in the garden. I felt very
  scared. Then I saw a strange face at the window! I closed
  the curtains quickly. A few seconds later, somebody
  knocked on the window. I screamed loudly and phoned the
  police. Then I hid under the bed. I could still hear
  scary noises outside. After ten minutes, the police
  arrived. I opened the door — and there was my mother in
  the garden! She lost her keys and couldn't get in.
  I felt very silly!


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  Sovuq, shamolli tun edi va men uyda yolg'iz edim.
  To'satdan tashqarida shovqin eshitdim. Derazadan
  qaradim va bog'da qora soyani ko'rdim. Juda qo'rqib
  ketdim. So'ng derazada g'alati yuzni ko'rdim! Pardalarni
  tez yopdim. Bir necha soniyadan keyin kimdir derazani
  taqillatdi. Baland ovozda qichqirdim va militsiyaga
  qo'ng'iroq qildim. Keyin karavot ostiga yashirindim.
  Tashqaridan hali ham qo'rqinchli shovqinlar eshitilardi.
  O'n daqiqadan keyin militsiya yetib keldi. Eshikni
  ochdim — va bog'da onam turgan ekan! U kalitini
  yo'qotib qo'ygan va uyga kira olmagan ekan.
  O'zimni juda ahmoq his qildim!


HIKOYANING TUZILIShI (Coursebook 81-betdagi qoida):
  1-qism — BOShLANISh: qachon, qayerda, kim
     'It was a cold, windy night ... I was at home, alone.'
  2-3-qism — RIVOJLANISh va ASOSIY VOQEA:
     shovqin → soya → yuz → taqillatish → qichqiriq →
     militsiya → yashirinish
  4-qism — TUGALLANMA: oxirida nima bo'ldi va qanday
     his qildi
     'It was my mother! I felt very silly.'

DIQQAT — KUTILMAGAN OXIR:
  Hikoya o'g'ri haqidadek boshlanadi, lekin oxirida
  ONASI ekani ma'lum bo'ladi — bu KULGILI burilish.
  Shuning uchun oxirgi kalit so'z 'feel/SILLY'
  (o'zini ahmoq his qilmoq).

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a shadow   = soya
  a face     = yuz
  curtains   = pardalar
  to knock on = taqillatmoq
  to hide (hid) = yashirinmoq (yashirindi)
  silly      = ahmoq, bema'ni

topics.topic: Comparisons — jadval — Qiyoslash — jadval (1)
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI ASOSIY JADVAL:

 ┌───────────────┬───────────┬────────────────┬──────────────────┐
 │               │ ADJECTIVE │  COMPARATIVE   │   SUPERLATIVE    │
 │               │  (sifat)  │   (qiyosiy)    │    (orttirma)    │
 ├───────────────┼───────────┼────────────────┼──────────────────┤
 │ ONE-SYLLABLE  │  cheap    │ cheapER (than) │ THE cheapEST     │
 │  adjectives   │  large    │ largER (than)  │ THE largEST      │
 │ (bir bo'g'inli)│  big      │ bigGER (than)  │ THE bigGEST      │
 ├───────────────┼───────────┼────────────────┼──────────────────┤
 │ -Y adjectives │  noisy    │ noisIER (than) │ THE noisIEST     │
 ├───────────────┼───────────┼────────────────┼──────────────────┤
 │ TWO OR MORE   │ expensive │ MORE expensive │ THE MOST         │
 │  SYLLABLES    │           │      (than)    │      expensive   │
 ├───────────────┼───────────┼────────────────┼──────────────────┤
 │               │  good     │ better (than)  │ THE best         │
 │  IRREGULAR    │  bad      │ worse  (than)  │ THE worst        │
 │  adjectives   │ much/many │ more   (than)  │ THE most         │
 │ (noto'g'ri)   │  little   │ less   (than)  │ THE least        │
 └───────────────┴───────────┴────────────────┴──────────────────┘


DIQQAT — JADVALDAGI IKKI QAVSNING MA'NOSI:

  QIYOSIY ustunida '(than)' —
     qiyosiy daraja odatda THAN bilan keladi.

  ORTTIRMA ustunida 'the' QALIN yozilgan —
     orttirma daraja DOIM 'THE' bilan keladi.


BU JADVAL Coursebook 84-BETDAGI JADVALNING
AYNAN O'ZI — kitob bir qoidani IKKI KITOBDA
ham beradi. Grammar Book qo'shimcha tafsilotlar
('of/in', bo'g'inlar soni, urg'u) qo'shadi.
examples: one-syllable adjectives: cheap → cheaper (than) → the cheapest
large → larger (than) → the largest
big → bigger (than) → the biggest
-y adjectives: noisy → noisier (than) → the noisiest
adjectives with two or more syllables: expensive → more expensive (than) → the most expensive
irregular: good → better (than) → the best
irregular: bad → worse (than) → the worst
irregular: much / many → more (than) → the most

topics.topic: Comparisons — jadval — Qiyoslash — jadval (2)
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI 'FORM' QUTISI — BESh QOIDA:


1) BIR BO'G'INLI sifatlar '-(e)r' / '-(e)st'
   qo'shadi.

     large  -  largER (than)  -  THE largEST (of/in)
     cheap  -  cheapER (than) -  THE cheapEST (of/in)

   DIQQAT — '(e)' QAVSNING MA'NOSI:
     Sifat allaqachon '-e' bilan tugasa,
     yana bitta 'e' QO'ShILMAYDI:
        large → largER ('largeer' XATO)
        nice  → nicER
        safe  → safER
     '-e' bilan tugamasa, to'liq '-er' qo'shiladi:
        cheap → cheapER
        old   → oldER


2) BIR BO'G'INLI sifatlar IKKI UNDOSh ORASIDA
   BITTA URG'ULI UNLI bilan tugasa —
   oxirgi undosh IKKILANADI va '-er'/'-est'
   qo'shiladi.

     big  -  bigGER (than)  -  THE bigGEST (of/in)

   QOIDANI QANDAY TEKShIRISh — UCh ShART:
     • bir bo'g'inli
     • oxiri: UNDOSh + UNLI + UNDOSh
     • unli URG'ULI

     b-i-g   →  b (undosh) + i (unli) + g (undosh) ✓
     h-o-t   →  h + o + t  ✓  → hotTER
     f-a-t   →  f + a + t  ✓  → fatTER
     t-h-i-n →  th + i + n ✓  → thinNER
     s-a-d   →  s + a + d  ✓  → sadDER

   ISTISNOLAR (ikkilanmaydi):
     • ikki unli bo'lsa:  cheap (ea) → cheapER
     • ikki undosh bo'lsa: fast (st) → fastER
     • 'w', 'x', 'y' bilan tugasa:
        new  → newER   (newwer XATO)
        slow → slowER


3) IKKI BO'G'INLI sifatlar UNDOSh + '-Y' bilan
   tugasa — '-y' tushadi va '-ier'/'-iest'
   qo'shiladi.

     heavy  -  heavIER (than)  -  THE heavIEST (of/in)

   DIQQAT — 'UNDOSh + Y' ShARTI:
     heavy  → heav + y   → 'v' undosh ✓ → heavIER
     noisy  → nois + y   → 's' undosh ✓ → noisIER
     easy   → eas + y    → 's' undosh ✓ → easIER
     happy  → happ + y   → 'p' undosh ✓ → happIER
     busy   → bus + y    → 's' undosh ✓ → busIER
     pretty → prett + y  → 't' undosh ✓ → prettIER

     Agar '-y' dan oldin UNLI bo'lsa —
     '-y' TUShMAYDI:
        grey → greyER (greier XATO)


4) IKKI VA UNDAN KO'P BO'G'INLI sifatlar
   'MORE' / 'MOST' oladi.

     careful  -  MORE careful (than)
              -  THE MOST careful (of/in)

   Boshqa misollar:
     expensive   → more expensive
     beautiful   → more beautiful
     interesting → more interesting
     comfortable → more comfortable


5) NOTO'G'RI sifatlarning O'Z shakllari bor
   (yuqoridagi jadvalga qarang).

     good/bad/much/many/little


DIQQAT — 3 va 4-QOIDA CHALKAShIShI MUMKIN:
  'heavy' ham IKKI BO'G'INLI, 'careful' ham.
  FARQI:
     heavy   — '-y' bilan tugaydi → -IER
     careful — '-y' bilan tugaMAYDI → MORE
  Ya'ni 3-qoida 4-qoidadan KUCHLIROQ:
  ikki bo'g'inli sifat '-y' bilan tugasa,
  MORE emas, -IER oladi.
examples: One-syllable adjectives add -(e)r/-(e)st to form their comparative and superlative forms.
large - larger (than) - the largest (of/in), cheap - cheaper (than) - the cheapest (of/in)
One-syllable adjectives ending in one stressed vowel between two consonants, double the last consonant and add -er/-est.
big - bigger (than) - the biggest (of/in)
Two-syllable adjectives ending in a consonant + -y, drop -y and add -ier/-iest.
heavy - heavier (than) - the heaviest (of/in)
Adjectives of two or more syllables take more/most.
careful - more careful (than) - the most careful (of/in)

topics.topic: Comparisons — jadval — Qiyoslash — jadval (3)
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI 'NOTE' QUTISI — IKKI ESLATMA:


1) Qiyoslashni ko'pincha 'THAN' bilan qilamiz.

     The city is noisier THAN the country.
     An elephant is heavier THAN a mouse.
     Trains are more expensive THAN buses.

   DIQQAT: 'than' o'zbekchada '... dan' ga
   to'g'ri keladi:
     'noisier THAN the country'
     = 'qishloqDAN shovqinliroq'


2) Orttirma daraja oldidan 'THE' qo'yamiz.

     THE cheapest hotel
     THE most expensive restaurant
     THE best

   Bu — ENG KO'P UNUTILADIGAN QOIDA.
   'He is tallest boy' XATO.
   'He is THE tallest boy' TO'G'RI.

   SABABI: orttirma daraja narsani ANIQ
   ko'rsatadi (bittasi, yagona) — shuning uchun
   aniq artikl 'the' kerak.


ESLAB QOLISh UChUN:
     QIYOSIY   →  THAN bilan
     ORTTIRMA  →  THE bilan (va OF/IN bilan)
examples: We often make comparisons using than.
We use the before the superlative form.

topics.topic: Comparisons — jadval — Qiyoslash — jadval (4)
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI 'USE' QUTISI — TO'RT QOIDA:


1) QIYOSIY DARAJA — IKKI odam, narsa, joyni
   solishtiradi. Odatda 'THAN' bilan.

     'The city is NOISIER THAN the country.'
     (Shahar qishloqdan shovqinliroq.)


2) ORTTIRMA DARAJA — bitta odam yoki narsani
   O'ZI MANSUB BO'LGAN BUTUN GURUH bilan
   solishtiradi.
   'THE ... OF' yoki 'THE ... IN' bilan.

     'The giraffe is THE TALLEST animal OF all.'
     (Jirafa hamma hayvonlardan eng balandi.)

   DIQQAT — 'OF' va 'IN' FARQI:
     OF + guruh:
        the tallest OF all
        the best OF the three
        the oldest OF my friends
     IN + joy:
        the tallest building IN the USA
        the cheapest hotel IN town
        the largest desert IN the world


3) (NOT) AS + sifat + AS — ikki odam, joy yoki
   narsa O'XShASh yoki O'XShASh EMASligini
   aytadi.

     'My brother is AS TALL AS my father.'
     (Akam otamchalik baland bo'yli.)

   IKKI XIL MA'NO:
     AS ... AS      = TENG
        'as tall as' = bir xil bo'yda
     NOT AS ... AS  = KAMROQ
        'not as tall as' = undan pastroq

   DIQQAT: 'as' va 'as' orasiga sifatning
   ODDIY shakli qo'yiladi.
     'as taller as' XATO
     'as tall as' TO'G'RI


4) MUCH + QIYOSIY daraja.

     'An elephant is MUCH HEAVIER than a mouse.'
     (Fil sichqondan ancha og'irroq.)

   'much' farqni KUChAYTIRADI.
   DIQQAT: faqat QIYOSIY daraja bilan.
     'much heavy' XATO
     'much heavier' TO'G'RI


UMUMIY XULOSA — QAYSI QOLIP QAChON:

  IKKI narsa, farq bor      →  -ER/MORE ... THAN
  IKKI narsa, farq KATTA    →  MUCH -ER/MORE ... THAN
  IKKI narsa, TENG          →  AS ... AS
  IKKI narsa, teng EMAS     →  NOT AS ... AS
  BUTUN GURUHdan eng yuqori →  THE -EST/MOST ... OF/IN
examples: We use the comparative form to compare two people, things, places, etc. We usually use than with comparative adjectives.
The city is noisier than the country.
We use the superlative form to compare a person or thing with the whole group they belong to. We use the ... of/in with superlative adjectives.
The giraffe is the tallest animal of all.
We use (not) as + adjective + as to say that two people, places or things are/are not similar.
My brother is as tall as my father.
We use much + comparative form.
An elephant is much heavier than a mouse.

topics.topic: Comparisons — jadval — Qiyoslash — jadval (5)
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI:

  'very', 'quite' yoki 'too' kabi so'zlarni
  biror narsa yoki odam QANChALIK sovuq/yaxshi/
  qiziqarli ekanini ko'rsatish uchun ishlatamiz.


KITOBNING UCh MISOLI VA IZOHI:

  It is QUITE dark.
     ( = It is A BIT dark. )
     = Ancha qorong'i. (biroz qorong'i)

  It is VERY dark.
     ( = It is EXTREMELY dark. )
     = Juda qorong'i. (o'ta qorong'i)

  It is TOO dark.
     ( = It is SO dark THAT I CAN'T SEE. )
     = Haddan tashqari qorong'i.
       (shunchalik qorong'iki, ko'ra olmayman)


ENG MUHIM FARQ — DARAJA CHIZIG'I:

     quite  <  very  <  too
      (+)       (++)     (−)
     biroz     juda    haddan
                       tashqari

  DIQQAT: 'too' shunchaki 'very' dan kuchliroq
  EMAS. 'too' butunlay BOShQA narsani aytadi —
  u MUAMMO borligini bildiradi.

     'very dark'  → qorong'i, lekin muammo yo'q
     'too dark'   → shunchalik qorong'iki,
                    biror ishni QILA OLMAYMAN

  Kitob buni izohda ANIQ ko'rsatgan:
     'It is SO dark THAT I CAN'T SEE.'
     ('can't' — imkonsizlik)


Coursebook 86-BET BILAN BOG'LIQ:
  U yerda AYNAN shu qoida mehmonxona narxlari
  bilan ko'rsatilgan edi:
     £95 → 'VERY expensive'  (qimmat, lekin
                              £100 ichida)
     £120 → 'TOO expensive'  (£100 dan OShADI —
                              SOTIB OLA OLMAYDI)
  Va kalit qutisida:
     quite noisy (+), very noisy (++),
     much noisier (+++), too noisy (−)


QOIDA — QAYSI SHAKL BILAN KELADI:

  quite + ODDIY sifat    →  quite dark
  very  + ODDIY sifat    →  very dark
  too   + ODDIY sifat    →  too dark
  much  + QIYOSIY daraja →  much darker

  DIQQAT: 'much' bu uchtadan FARQ QILADI —
  u faqat QIYOSIY daraja bilan ishlatiladi.


QO'ShIMChA MISOLLAR:
  It's quite cold.  = Ancha sovuq.
  It's very cold.   = Juda sovuq.
  It's too cold.    = Haddan tashqari sovuq
                      (tashqariga chiqib bo'lmaydi).

  The film was quite good.  = Film ancha yaxshi edi.
  The film was very good.   = Film juda yaxshi edi.
  The tea is too hot.       = Choy haddan tashqari
                              issiq (ichib bo'lmaydi).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a bit      = biroz
  extremely  = o'ta darajada
  dark       = qorong'i
  so ... that = shunchalik ... ki
examples: We use words like very, quite or too, to show how cold/good/interesting, etc something or someone is.
It is quite dark. (= It is a bit dark.)
It is very dark. (= It is extremely dark.)
It is too dark. (= It is so dark that I can't see.)

topics.topic: Comparisons — mashqlar — JADVALDA HAR QATORDA BITTA yoki IKKI shakl · 1-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
JADVALDA HAR QATORDA BITTA yoki IKKI shakl
BERILGAN — qolganini topish kerak.

TO'LDIRILGAN JADVAL:

 ┌─────────────┬──────────────────┬─────────────────────┐
 │  ADJECTIVE  │   COMPARATIVE    │    SUPERLATIVE      │
 ├─────────────┼──────────────────┼─────────────────────┤
 │  expensive  │  MORE EXPENSIVE  │ the most expensive  │
 │  bad        │  worse           │ THE WORST           │
 │  OLD        │  older           │ the oldest          │
 │  SMALL      │  smaller         │ the smallest        │
 │  much/many  │  MORE            │ the most            │
 │  tiny       │  tinier          │ THE TINIEST         │
 │  high       │  HIGHER          │ the highest         │
 │  HOT        │  hotter          │ the hottest         │
 └─────────────┴──────────────────┴─────────────────────┘

(QALIN — kitob bergan shakl; qolganini siz
to'ldirasiz.)


HAR QATOR QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  1-qator: 'more expensive' berilgan.
     'more' → uzun sifat → asosiy shakl
     EXPENSIVE, orttirmasi THE MOST EXPENSIVE.

  2-qator: 'the worst' berilgan.
     Bu — NOTO'G'RI sifat. Jadvaldan:
     bad → worse → the worst.

  3-qator: 'old' berilgan.
     Bir bo'g'inli → OLDER, THE OLDEST.

  4-qator: 'small' berilgan.
     Bir bo'g'inli → SMALLER, THE SMALLEST.

  5-qator: 'more' (yolg'iz) berilgan.
     'more' — NOTO'G'RI sifatning qiyosiy shakli:
     much/many → more → the most.
     DIQQAT: 1-qatorda ham 'more' bor, lekin u
     yerda 'more EXPENSIVE' — sifat bilan birga.
     Bu yerda 'more' YOLG'IZ turibdi → 'much/many'.

  6-qator: 'the tiniest' berilgan.
     '-iest' → '-y' bilan tugagan sifat:
     TINY → TINIER → the tiniest.
     'tiny' = juda kichkina.

  7-qator: 'higher' berilgan.
     '-er' → HIGH → THE HIGHEST.

  8-qator: 'hot' berilgan.
     Bir bo'g'inli, undosh+unli+undosh →
     't' IKKILANADI: HOTTER, THE HOTTEST.


DIQQAT — 5-QATORDAGI 'MORE' ALDAMChI:
  Yolg'iz turgan 'more' — 'much' yoki 'many' ning
  qiyosiy shakli.
  Agar 'more + sifat' bo'lsa (1-qatordagidek),
  u uzun sifatning qiyosiy shakli.

DIQQAT — 6 va 8-QATORLAR MAXSUS QOIDALAR:
  tiny → tinIER    ('-y' tushadi)
  hot  → hotTER    (undosh ikkilanadi)

topics.topic: Comparisons — mashqlar — RASMDA UCh HAYVON · 4-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
RASMDA UCh HAYVON:
  FIL (the elephant)      — eng katta, eng og'ir
  SHER (the lion)         — eng xavfli, eng tez
  ShIMPANZE (the chimpanzee) — eng kichik, eng do'stona


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  The chimpanzee is NOT AS BIG AS (big) the
     elephant.

  Namuna MUHIM narsani ko'rsatadi: javobga
  'as' va 'as' ning IKKALASI ham kiradi.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  is not AS BIG AS the elephant        (NAMUNA)
  2  The lion is SMALLER THAN the elephant.
  3  The lion is not AS FRIENDLY AS the chimpanzee.
  4  The elephant is THE HEAVIEST animal of all.
  5  The lion is THE MOST DANGEROUS animal of all.
  6  The chimpanzee is not AS FAST AS the lion.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Shimpanze filchalik katta emas.
  2  Sher fildan kichikroq.
  3  Sher shimpanzechalik do'stona emas.
  4  Fil hamma hayvonlardan eng og'iri.
  5  Sher hamma hayvonlardan eng xavflisi.
  6  Shimpanze sherchalik tez emas.


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — UCh XIL QOLIP:

  'is NOT ...... [ot]' → AS ... AS
     (1, 3, 6-bandlar)
     Bo'shliqdan keyin BIRDAN ot kelsa va 'not'
     bo'lsa — 'as ... as' kerak.

  'is ...... [ot]' (not YO'Q) → QIYOSIY + THAN
     (2-band)
     'The lion is ...... the elephant' —
     'than' ham bo'shliqqa kiradi:
     'SMALLER THAN'.

  'is ...... animal OF ALL' → ORTTIRMA
     (4, 5-bandlar)
     'of all' — ORTTIRMA darajaning belgisi.


SIFATLARNING YASALIShI:
  big       → as BIG as      (oddiy shakl)
  small     → SMALLER than   (1 bo'g'in → -ER)
  friendly  → as FRIENDLY as (oddiy shakl)
  heavy     → THE HEAVIEST   ('-y' → -IEST)
  dangerous → THE MOST DANGEROUS (3 bo'g'in)
  fast      → as FAST as     (oddiy shakl)


DIQQAT — 2-BANDDA 'THAN' HAM KERAK:
  'The lion is ...... (small) the elephant.'
  Gapda 'than' BOSILMAGAN — u ham bo'shliqqa
  kiradi: 'SMALLER THAN'.
  Bu — namunadagi 'as big as' bilan bir xil
  mantiq (u yerda ham ikkala 'as' javobga kirgan).

O'N YETTI BAND — mashqning eng katta qismi.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  My father is OLDER THAN my mother. (old)
  Javobga sifat ham, 'than' ham kiradi.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  older than           (NAMUNA)
   2  noisy                ('very' dan keyin — ODDIY)
   3  more ... than
   4  the fastest ... of
   5  expensive            ('very' dan keyin — ODDIY)
   6  the best             (noto'g'ri sifat)
   7  the driest ... in
   8  bigger than
   9  famous               ('very' dan keyin — ODDIY)
  10  the tallest ... of
  11  the largest ... in
  12  prettier than
  13  more dangerous than
  14  safer ... than
  15  more crowded than
  16  tall                 ('quite' dan keyin — ODDIY)
  17  the kindest


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
   1  Otam onamdan katta.
   2  Bu shahar juda shovqinli.
   3  Uning opasidan ko'proq o'yinchog'i bor.
   4  Gepard hamma hayvonlardan eng tezi.
   5  U ko'ylak juda qimmat.
   6  Bu hammasidan eng yaxshi film edi.
   7  Chili dunyodagi eng quruq joy.
   8  Uning kvartirasi biznikidan kattaroq.
   9  Tom Kruz juda mashhur.
  10  Jirafa hamma hayvonlardan eng balandi.
  11  AQShdagi eng katta shahar qaysi?
  12  Mishel Jenniferdan chiroyliroq.
  13  Mototsikllar samolyotlardan xavfliroq.
  14  Sizning pulingiz bankda uydagidan xavfsizroq.
  15  Plyaj o'tgan yilgidan gavjumroq.
  16  Jo ancha baland bo'yli.
  17  Opam men biladigan eng mehribon odam.


ENG MUHIM DARS — 'VERY' va 'QUITE' DAN KEYIN
SIFAT O'ZGARMAYDI:

  2-band:  'This city is VERY ...... .'   → NOISY
  5-band:  'That dress is VERY ...... .'  → EXPENSIVE
  9-band:  'Tom Cruise is VERY ...... .'  → FAMOUS
  16-band: 'Joe is QUITE ...... .'        → TALL

  Bu to'rt bandda QIYOSLASh YO'Q — shunchaki
  daraja ko'rsatilyapti.
  Grammar 52-betdagi 'Quite/Very/Too' qoidasi:
  'quite/very/too' + ODDIY sifat.

  Ular gapning OXIRIDA nuqta bilan tugaydi —
  bu ham ip: solishtiriladigan narsa YO'Q.


QANDAY ANIQLASh — TO'RT BELGI:

  'very' / 'quite' bor      →  ODDIY shakl
                               (2, 5, 9, 16)
  gapdan keyin ikkinchi narsa →  QIYOSIY + THAN
                               (1, 3, 8, 12, 13,
                                14, 15)
  'of all' bor              →  THE ... OF
                               (4, 10)
  'in the world/the USA' bor →  THE ... IN
                               (7, 11)
  'of all' yoki 'I know' bor →  THE ...
                               (6, 17)


ALOHIDA IZOHLAR:

  3-BAND: 'She has got ...... TOYS ...... her sister.'
     'many' → 'MORE' (noto'g'ri sifat) + THAN.
     'toys' — SANALADIGAN ot → 'many' to'g'ri edi.

  6-BAND: 'That was ...... film OF ALL.'
     'good' → 'THE BEST' (noto'g'ri sifat).
     'of all' bor, lekin javobda faqat 'the best' —
     'of all' gapda ALLAQAChON bor.

  7-BAND: 'Chile is ...... place ...... the world.'
     'dry' → '-y' tushadi → THE DRIEST + IN.
     Coursebook 85-bet, 12-mashqning 4-bandi
     ham aynan shu fakt (Atakama cho'li).

  14-BAND: 'Your money is ...... IN THE BANK ......
     it is AT HOME.'
     'safe' → '-e' → SAFER + THAN.
     Bankdagi pul uydagidan xavfsizroq.

  17-BAND: 'My sister is ...... person I KNOW.'
     'I know' — guruhni chegaralaydi
     (men biladigan odamlar orasida) → ORTTIRMA.
     'kind' → THE KINDEST.


SIFATLARNING YASALIShI:
  old       → oldER          (1 bo'g'in)
  many      → MORE           (noto'g'ri)
  fast      → the fastEST    (1 bo'g'in)
  good      → the BEST       (noto'g'ri)
  dry       → the drIEST     ('-y' → -IEST)
  big       → bigGER         (undosh ikkilanadi)
  tall      → the tallEST    (1 bo'g'in)
  large     → the largEST    ('-e' → faqat -ST)
  pretty    → prettIER       ('-y' → -IER)
  dangerous → MORE dangerous (3 bo'g'in)
  safe      → safER          ('-e' → faqat -R)
  crowded   → MORE crowded   (2 bo'g'in, '-y' yo'q)
  kind      → the kindEST    (1 bo'g'in)

topics.topic: Comparisons — mashqlar (davomi) — KITOB BERGAN OLTI SIFAT · 6-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KITOB BERGAN OLTI SIFAT:
  old, tall, patient, short, good, friendly

KITOBDAGI IKKI NAMUNA:
  'My father is TALLER THAN my mother.'
     → QIYOSIY daraja + THAN (ikki odam)
  'My brother is THE TALLEST IN our family.'
     → ORTTIRMA daraja + IN (butun oila)

  Kitob ataylab IKKALA qolipni ham ko'rsatgan —
  siz ham ikkalasidan foydalanishingiz kerak.


HAR SIFATNING SHAKLLARI:
  old      →  older      /  the oldest
  tall     →  taller     /  the tallest
  patient  →  MORE patient / THE MOST patient
                              (2 bo'g'in, '-y' yo'q)
  short    →  shorter    /  the shortest
  good     →  BETTER     /  THE BEST  (noto'g'ri!)
  friendly →  friendlIER /  the friendlIEST  ('-y')


OLTI NAMUNA GAP (o'z oilangizga moslang):

  1  My father is older than my mother.
     (Otam onamdan katta.)

  2  My brother is the tallest in our family.
     (Akam oilamizdagi eng baland bo'yli.)

  3  My mother is more patient than my father.
     (Onam otamdan sabrliroq.)

  4  My sister is the shortest in our family.
     (Singlim oilamizdagi eng past bo'yli.)

  5  My grandmother is a better cook than my mother.
     (Buvim onamdan yaxshiroq oshpaz.)

  6  My cousin is the friendliest person in our
     family.
     (Amakivachcham oilamizdagi eng do'stona odam.)


DIQQAT — 'GOOD' NOTO'G'RI SIFAT:
  'gooder' / 'the goodest' XATO.
  'BETTER' / 'THE BEST' to'g'ri.

DIQQAT — 'PATIENT' 2 BO'G'INLI, '-Y' YO'Q:
  → MORE patient ('patienter' XATO).
  'patient' = sabrli.
  DIQQAT: 'a patient' (ot) = bemor — boshqa so'z.

DIQQAT — 'FRIENDLY' '-Y' BILAN TUGAGAN:
  → friendlIER / the friendlIEST.
  '-ly' bilan tugasa ham bu SIFAT.


OILA A'ZOLARI LUG'ATI:
  father, mother, brother, sister,
  grandfather, grandmother,
  uncle (amaki/tog'a), aunt (amma/xola),
  cousin (amakivachcha/xolavachcha)

topics.topic: Making Comparisons — Qiyoslash (1)
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI JADVAL — TO'LIQ:

 ┌──────────────┬───────────┬───────────────┬──────────────────┐
 │              │ adjective │  comparative  │   superlative    │
 │              │  (sifat)  │   (qiyosiy)   │    (orttirma)    │
 ├──────────────┼───────────┼───────────────┼──────────────────┤
 │ BIR BO'G'INLI│  cheap    │  cheapER      │ THE cheapEST     │
 │   sifatlar   │  large    │  largER       │ THE largEST      │
 │              │  big      │  bigGER       │ THE bigGEST      │
 ├──────────────┼───────────┼───────────────┼──────────────────┤
 │ -Y bilan     │  noisy    │  noisIER      │ THE noisIEST     │
 │  tugaganlar  │           │               │                  │
 ├──────────────┼───────────┼───────────────┼──────────────────┤
 │ IKKI yoki    │ expensive │ MORE expensive│ THE MOST         │
 │ undan ko'p   │           │               │  expensive       │
 │  bo'g'inli   │           │               │                  │
 ├──────────────┼───────────┼───────────────┼──────────────────┤
 │              │  good     │  better       │ THE best         │
 │  NOTO'G'RI   │  bad      │  worse        │ THE worst        │
 │   sifatlar   │ much/many │  more         │ THE most         │
 │              │  little   │  less         │ THE least        │
 └──────────────┴───────────┴───────────────┴──────────────────┘


QOIDALAR — TO'RT GURUH:

1) BIR BO'G'INLI sifatlar
   qiyosiy:  sifat + -ER
   orttirma: THE + sifat + -EST

   MAXSUS HOLATLAR:
     • '-e' bilan tugasa → faqat -R / -ST
        large → largER → the largEST
        safe  → safER  → the safEST
     • BITTA unli + BITTA undosh bilan tugasa →
       oxirgi undosh IKKILANADI
        big → bigGER → the bigGEST
        hot → hotTER → the hotTEST
        fat → fatTER → the fatTEST

2) '-Y' bilan tugagan sifatlar
   '-y' tushadi, '-IER' / '-IEST' qo'shiladi
     noisy  → noisIER  → the noisIEST
     easy   → easIER   → the easIEST
     happy  → happIER  → the happIEST
     dirty  → dirtIER  → the dirtIEST

3) IKKI va undan KO'P BO'G'INLI sifatlar
   qiyosiy:  MORE + sifat
   orttirma: THE MOST + sifat
     expensive → MORE expensive → THE MOST expensive
     modern    → MORE modern    → THE MOST modern
     beautiful → MORE beautiful → THE MOST beautiful

4) NOTO'G'RI sifatlar — YODLASh kerak
     good        → better → the best
     bad         → worse  → the worst
     much / many → more   → the most
     little      → less   → the least

   DIQQAT: 'gooder', 'baddest', 'more good' —
   HAMMASI XATO.


ENG KO'P UChRAYDIGAN XATOLAR:
  ✗ more cheaper    ✓ cheaper
  ✗ more noisier    ✓ noisier
  ✗ the most oldest ✓ the oldest
  ✗ gooder          ✓ better
  ✗ cheapest city   ✓ THE cheapest city

  ASOSIY QOIDA: -ER/-EST va MORE/MOST ni
  BIRGA ishlatib bo'lmaydi.
  ORTTIRMA daraja DOIM 'THE' bilan keladi.
