examples: one-syllable adjectives: cheap → cheaper → the cheapest
large → larger → the largest
big → bigger → the biggest
-y adjectives: noisy → noisier → the noisiest
adjectives with two or more syllables: expensive → more expensive → the most expensive
irregular: good → better → the best
irregular: bad → worse → the worst
irregular: much / many → more → the most

topics.topic: Making Comparisons — Qiyoslash (2)
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI 'USE' QUTISI — TO'RT QOIDA:


1) QIYOSIY DARAJA (comparative form)
   IKKI odam, narsa, joyni solishtiradi.
   Odatda 'THAN' bilan keladi.

   NAMUNA:
     'The Parthenon is OLDER THAN the Colosseum.'
     (Parfenon Kolizeydan eskiroq.)


2) ORTTIRMA DARAJA (superlative form)
   IKKIDAN KO'P odam, narsa, joyni solishtiradi.
   'THE ... OF' yoki 'THE ... IN' bilan keladi.

   NAMUNA:
     'The Great Pyramid of Cheops is THE OLDEST OF ALL.'
     (Xeops piramidasi hammasidan eng eski.)


3) (NOT) AS + sifat + AS
   Ikki narsani TENGLIK bo'yicha solishtiradi.

   NAMUNA:
     'Stratford-upon-Avon ISN'T AS NOISY AS LA.'
     (Stratford LA-chalik shovqinli emas.)

   DIQQAT — IKKI XIL MA'NO:
     'A is AS big AS B'      = A B chalik katta (TENG)
     'A ISN'T AS big AS B'   = A B chalik katta emas
                               (A kichikroq)

   DIQQAT: 'as ... as' orasiga sifatning ODDIY
   shakli qo'yiladi ('as noisier as' XATO).


4) MUCH + qiyosiy daraja
   Farqni KUChAYTIRADI ('ancha', 'juda').

   NAMUNA:
     'Stratford is MUCH QUIETER than LA.'
     (Stratford LA dan ancha tinchroq.)

   DIQQAT: 'much' faqat QIYOSIY daraja bilan,
   oddiy sifat bilan EMAS ('much quiet' XATO).


BETDAGI UCh TARIXIY YODGORLIK (rasmlarda):

  The Great Pyramid of Cheops  —  2465 BC (m.a.)
     Misrdagi Xeops piramidasi — ENG ESKI

  The Parthenon                —  438 BC (m.a.)
     Afinadagi Parfenon ibodatxonasi — o'rtada

  The Colosseum                —  82 AD (milodiy)
     Rimdagi Kolizey — ENG YANGI

  'BC' = Before Christ = miloddan avvalgi
  'AD' = Anno Domini   = milodiy

  DIQQAT — SANALARNI TAQQOSLASh:
  'BC' sanalarida son KATTA bo'lsa,
  vaqt UZOQROQ (eskiroq).
  2465 BC > 438 BC → piramida Parfenondan ESKIROQ.


ShU UCh YODGORLIK BILAN GAPLAR:
  The Parthenon is older than the Colosseum.
  The Great Pyramid is older than the Parthenon.
  The Great Pyramid of Cheops is the oldest of all.
  The Colosseum is the newest of the three.
  The Colosseum isn't as old as the Parthenon.
  The Great Pyramid is much older than the Colosseum.
examples: We use the comparative form to compare two people, things, places etc. We usually use than with comparative adjectives.
The Parthenon is older than the Colosseum.
We use the superlative form to compare more than two people, things, places etc. We use the ... of/in with superlative adjectives.
The Great Pyramid of Cheops is the oldest of all.
We can also use (not) as + adjective + as to compare two places, things, people, etc.
Stratford-upon-Avon isn't as noisy as LA.
We use much + comparative degree.
Stratford is much quieter than LA.

topics.topic: Making Comparisons — KITOBDAGI NAMUNA JADVALI · 9-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA JADVALI:

 ┌───────────┬─────────────┬────────────────┐
 │ adjective │ comparative │  superlative   │
 ├───────────┼─────────────┼────────────────┤
 │  large    │  larger     │  the largest   │
 │  sunny    │  sunnier    │  the sunniest  │
 └───────────┴─────────────┴────────────────┘

83-betdagi maqolada tagi chizilgan sifatlar
asosida jadvalni davom ettiring.


TO'LIQ JADVAL — MAQOLADAGI HAMMA SIFAT:

  BIR BO'G'INLI (-ER / THE -EST):
    large   →  larger   →  the largest      (NAMUNA)
    tall    →  taller   →  the tallest
    clean   →  cleaner  →  the cleanest
    cheap   →  cheaper  →  the cheapest
    old     →  older    →  the oldest
    safe    →  safer    →  the safest

  -Y BILAN TUGAGAN (-IER / THE -IEST):
    sunny   →  sunnier  →  the sunniest     (NAMUNA)
    noisy   →  noisier  →  the noisiest
    heavy   →  heavier  →  the heaviest
    lovely  →  lovelier →  the loveliest

  IKKI VA UNDAN KO'P BO'G'INLI (MORE / THE MOST):
    expensive     →  more expensive
                  →  the most expensive
    interesting   →  more interesting
                  →  the most interesting
    exciting      →  more exciting
                  →  the most exciting
    famous        →  more famous
                  →  the most famous
    delicious     →  more delicious
                  →  the most delicious
    fashionable   →  more fashionable
                  →  the most fashionable
    unforgettable →  more unforgettable
                  →  the most unforgettable
    modern        →  more modern
                  →  the most modern
    crowded       →  more crowded
                  →  the most crowded
    fascinating   →  more fascinating
                  →  the most fascinating
    popular       →  more popular
                  →  the most popular


DIQQAT — MAQOLADA ALLAQAChON ISHLATILGANLARI:
  'the second LARGEST city'
  'MORE EXPENSIVE than'
  'one of THE MOST EXCITING museums'
  'Hollywood's OLDEST restaurant'
  'THE MOST DELICIOUS Mexican dishes'


DIQQAT — 'SAFE' VA 'LARGE':
  '-e' bilan tugagani uchun faqat -R va -ST:
     safe  → safER  → the safEST
     large → largER → the largEST

DIQQAT — 'LOVELY':
  '-ly' bilan tugasa ham bu SIFAT (ravish emas),
  shuning uchun '-y' qoidasiga bo'ysunadi:
     lovely → lovelIER → the lovelIEST

topics.topic: Making Comparisons — RO'YXAT (13 ta sifat) · 10-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
RO'YXAT (13 ta sifat):
  large, clean, noisy, polluted, crowded, small, dirty,
  safe, expensive, old, modern, peaceful, cheap

KITOBDAGI BESh NAMUNA — TO'RT XIL QOLIP:

  1  LA is LARGER THAN my town.
     → qisqa sifat + -ER + THAN

  2  My town is CLEANER THAN LA.
     → qisqa sifat + -ER + THAN (teskari yo'nalishda)

  3  LA is MUCH NOISIER THAN my town.
     → MUCH + qiyosiy daraja (kuchaytirish)

  4  My town is AS NOISY AS LA.
     → AS + oddiy sifat + AS (tenglik)

  5  My town ISN'T AS POLLUTED AS LA.
     → ISN'T AS + oddiy sifat + AS (inkor)


BARCHA 13 SIFAT BILAN NAMUNA GAPLAR
(o'z shahringiz nomini qo'ying):

   large     — LA is larger than my town.
   clean     — My town is cleaner than LA.
   noisy     — LA is much noisier than my town.
   polluted  — My town isn't as polluted as LA.
   crowded   — LA is more crowded than my town.
   small     — My town is smaller than LA.
   dirty     — LA is dirtier than my town.
   safe      — My town is safer than LA.
   expensive — LA is much more expensive than my town.
   old       — My town is older than LA.
   modern    — LA is more modern than my town.
   peaceful  — My town is more peaceful than LA.
   cheap     — My town is cheaper than LA.


QAYSI SIFAT QANDAY YASALADI:

  -ER oladiganlar (bir bo'g'inli):
     large → larger,  small → smaller,
     safe  → safer,   old   → older,
     clean → cleaner, cheap → cheaper

  -IER oladiganlar ('-y' bilan tugagan):
     noisy → noisier,  dirty → dirtier

  MORE oladiganlar (uzun):
     polluted  → more polluted
     crowded   → more crowded
     expensive → more expensive
     modern    → more modern
     peaceful  → more peaceful


DIQQAT — 'MUCH MORE EXPENSIVE':
  'much' + 'more expensive' — ikkalasi birga
  KELISHI mumkin, chunki 'more expensive' —
  bitta qiyosiy shakl, 'much' esa uni kuchaytiradi.

DIQQAT — QARAMA-QARShI JUFTLIKLAR RO'YXATDA:
  large ↔ small        clean ↔ dirty
  noisy ↔ peaceful     expensive ↔ cheap
  old   ↔ modern
  Har juftlikning BIRINI tanlab, gapni
  ikki xil aytish mumkin:
     'LA is larger than my town.'
     'My town is smaller than LA.'
  Ma'no BIR XIL.

YANGI SO'Z:
  peaceful = tinch, osoyishta
             ('peace' — tinchlik dan)

topics.topic: Comparisons (practice) — KITOBDAGI IKKI TO'LIQ NAMUNA · 11b-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI IKKI TO'LIQ NAMUNA:

  1  Edinburgh is smaller than London.  T
     'THAT'S TRUE. London ISN'T AS SMALL AS Edinburgh.
      ACTUALLY, Edinburgh is MUCH SMALLER THAN London.'

  2  Edinburgh is more dangerous than London.  F
     'THAT'S FALSE. Edinburgh ISN'T AS DANGEROUS AS
      London. ACTUALLY, London is MUCH MORE DANGEROUS
      THAN Edinburgh.'


JAVOBNING QOLIPI — UCh QISM:

  1-qism:  'That's true.'  yoki  'That's false.'
           (rozi / rozi emas)

  2-qism:  'X ISN'T AS [sifat] AS Y.'
           (tenglikni INKOR qilish)

  3-qism:  'ACTUALLY, X is MUCH [qiyosiy] THAN Y.'
           ('actually' = aslida; 'much' kuchaytiradi)


DIQQAT — 'T' VA 'F' UChUN QOLIP FARQ QILADI:

  T bo'lsa:  gapdagi TARTIB saqlanadi
     (Edinburgh smaller → Edinburgh MUCH smaller)

  F bo'lsa:  tartib TESKARI bo'ladi
     (Edinburgh more dangerous → LONDON much more
      dangerous)


BARCHA BESh JAVOB:

  1  That's true. London isn't as small as Edinburgh.
     Actually, Edinburgh is much smaller than London.

  2  That's false. Edinburgh isn't as dangerous as
     London. Actually, London is much more dangerous
     than Edinburgh.

  3  That's false. Edinburgh isn't as noisy as London.
     Actually, London is much noisier than Edinburgh.

  4  That's true. Edinburgh isn't as polluted as London.
     Actually, London is much more polluted than
     Edinburgh.

  5  That's false. London isn't as cheap as Edinburgh.
     Actually, Edinburgh is much cheaper than London.


YANGI SO'Z:
  actually = aslida, aslini olganda
     Fikrni TUZATISh yoki ANIQLAShTIRISh uchun.
     DIQQAT: 'hozir' ma'nosini BERMAYDI
     (bu ko'p uchraydigan xato).

topics.topic: Comparisons (practice) — KITOBDAGI NAMUNA · speaking-12-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  S1: 'WHICH IS the largest desert in the world?'
  S2: 'THE LARGEST DESERT IN THE WORLD IS the Sahara.
       Which ...'

QOLIP — JAVOBDA SAVOL TAKRORLANADI:
  Savol:  Which is THE [orttirma] [ot] in the world?
  Javob:  THE [orttirma] [ot] in the world IS + nom.

Bu — javobni TO'LIQ gap bilan berish usuli.
Og'zaki mashqda shunday javob berish talab qilinadi
(faqat 'the Sahara' deyish emas).

DIQQAT: har bir o'quvchi javob bergandan keyin
NAVBATDAGI savolni beradi ('Which ...' bilan
davom etadi).

topics.topic: Comparisons (practice) — KITOB BERGAN YETTI KO'RSATMA · 14-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KITOB BERGAN YETTI KO'RSATMA:
  old building, large park, busy road, popular cafe,
  expensive restaurant, famous square, pretty building

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: 'WHICH IS THE OLDEST BUILDING in ...?'
  SB: 'I THINK the Town Hall is the oldest building in
       my city. WHICH IS THE LARGEST PARK?'


QOLIP:
  Savol:  Which is THE [orttirma] [ot] in your city?
  Javob:  I THINK + [nom] is the [orttirma] [ot] in
          my city.  +  keyingi savol

  'I think ...' — o'z FIKRINGIZNI bildiradi
  (aniq fakt emas, shuning uchun yumshoqroq).


HAR BIR KO'RSATMANING ORTTIRMA ShAKLI:

  old building        →  the OLDEST building
  large park          →  the LARGEST park
  busy road           →  the BUSIEST road
  popular cafe        →  the MOST POPULAR cafe
  expensive restaurant→  the MOST EXPENSIVE restaurant
  famous square       →  the MOST FAMOUS square
  pretty building     →  the PRETTIEST building


DIQQAT — YASALISh QOIDALARI:
  old    → oldEST      (bir bo'g'in)
  large  → largEST     ('-e' → faqat -ST)
  busy   → busIEST     ('-y' → -IEST)
  pretty → prettIEST   ('-y' → -IEST)
  popular   → THE MOST popular    (3 bo'g'in)
  expensive → THE MOST expensive  (3 bo'g'in)
  famous    → THE MOST famous     (2 bo'g'in)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a Town Hall = shahar hokimiyati binosi
  a square    = maydon
  pretty      = chiroyli, ko'rkam
  busy        = gavjum, band

topics.topic: Comparisons — BARCHA JAVOBLAR · 8-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  the tallest building IN New York
  2  faster THAN travelling by train
  3  the most expensive OF all
  4  more comfortable THAN the Paradise Hotel
  5  not AS exciting AS the nightlife in LA
  6  the most famous sights IN London
  7  THE oldest church in the country


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Butunjahon savdo markazi Nyu-Yorkdagi eng
     baland bino.
  2  Samolyotda sayohat qilish poyezdda sayohat
     qilishdan tezroq.
  3  Mening shahrimda beshta restoran bor.
     'Pierre's' hammasidan qimmat.
  4  'Sandy Beach' mehmonxonasi 'Paradise'
     mehmonxonasidan qulayroq.
  5  Bostondagi tungi hayot Los-Anjelesdagi
     tungi hayotchalik qiziqarli emas.
  6  Big Ben Londondagi eng mashhur diqqatga
     sazovor joylardan biri.
  7  Avliyo Meri cherkovi mamlakatdagi eng eski
     cherkov.


QOIDA — QAYSI SO'Z QAChON:

  THAN   — sifat QIYOSIY shaklda
              (faster, more comfortable)
              → 2, 4-bandlar

  IN     — ORTTIRMA daraja + JOY
              (in New York, in London)
              → 1, 6-bandlar

  OF     — ORTTIRMA daraja + GURUH
              (of all)
              → 3-band

  AS...AS — sifat ODDIY shaklda + 'not'
              → 5-band

  THE    — ORTTIRMA daraja OLDIDAN
              → 7-band


DIQQAT — 5-BANDDA IKKI BO'ShLIQ:
  'is not ...... exciting ...... the nightlife'
  Ikkalasi ham 'AS':
  'is NOT AS exciting AS the nightlife in LA'

DIQQAT — 7-BANDDA 'THE' TUShIB QOLGAN:
  'St Mary's is ...... oldest church'
  Bo'shliqdan keyin 'oldEST' — orttirma daraja →
  oldidan 'THE' kerak.
  Bu — eng ko'p unutiladigan qoida.

DIQQAT — 1 va 6-BANDLAR SOLIShTIRING:
  1: 'the tallest building IN New York'
  6: 'one of the most famous sights IN London'
  Ikkalasida ham ORTTIRMA daraja + ShAHAR → IN.
  6-bandda 'one of the ...' → keyin KO'PLIK ot
  ('sightS').


ATOQLI OTLAR:
  The World Trade Center — Nyu-Yorkdagi osmono'par
     binolar (2001-yilda vayron qilingan)
  Big Ben — London parlamenti minorasidagi mashhur
     soat
  St Mary's — Avliyo Meri cherkovi


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a church  = cherkov
  a sight   = diqqatga sazovor joy
  a plane   = samolyot

topics.topic: Comparisons — KITOBDAGI NAMUNA · 10-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  The Colosseum is/interesting/sight in Rome
     → 'The Colosseum is THE MOST INTERESTING
        sight in Rome.'

  Ya'ni: chiziqchalar orasidagi so'zlarni to'liq
  gapga aylantirish kerak — kerakli daraja,
  artikl va 'than'/'as' ni O'ZINGIZ qo'shasiz.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  The Colosseum is THE MOST INTERESTING sight
     in Rome.                            (NAMUNA)

  2  Big cities are usually MORE POLLUTED THAN
     small towns.

  3  Swimming in the sea is MORE DANGEROUS THAN
     swimming in a pool.

  4  Is the Nile LONGER THAN the Thames?

  5  Last night was THE MOST ROMANTIC night of my
     life.

  6  The blue one is AS EXPENSIVE AS the white one.

  7  We paid LESS for accommodation THAN for
     entertainment.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Kolizey Rimdagi eng qiziqarli diqqatga
     sazovor joy.
  2  Katta shaharlar odatda kichik shaharchalardan
     ifloslanganroq.
  3  Dengizda suzish hovuzda suzishdan xavfliroq.
  4  Nil Temzadan uzunroqmi?
  5  Kechagi kecha hayotimdagi eng romantik kecha
     edi.
  6  Ikki mashina bir xil narxda. Ko'k mashina oq
     mashinachalik qimmat.
  7  Biz turar joy uchun ko'ngilocharga
     qaraganda kamroq to'ladik.


QAYSI QOLIP QAChON — HAR BANDNI TAHLIL QILING:

  1, 5 — ORTTIRMA daraja
     Belgisi: 'in Rome', 'of my life' —
     guruh yoki joy chegaralangan.
     → THE MOST + sifat

  2, 3, 4 — QIYOSIY daraja + THAN
     Belgisi: ikki narsa qatorda berilgan
     (big cities / small towns;
      the sea / a pool;
      the Nile / the Thames).

  6 — AS ... AS (TENGLIK)
     Belgisi: 'The two cars are THE SAME PRICE.'
     Kitob ataylab aytgan: narx BIR XIL →
     tenglik qolipi.
     'more expensive than' XATO bo'lardi.

  7 — 'LITTLE' NING QIYOSIY ShAKLI + THAN
     'little' → LESS (noto'g'ri sifat,
     6-mashqdagi jadvaldan).
     'We paid LESS ... THAN ...'


ENG MUHIM BAND — 6-BAND:
  'The two cars are THE SAME PRICE.'
  Bu gap javobni ANIQ ko'rsatib turibdi:
  narxlar TENG → 'AS EXPENSIVE AS'.
  Agar bu jumla bo'lmasa, 'more expensive than'
  ham mumkin bo'lardi.

DIQQAT — 7-BANDDAGI SO'Z TARTIBI:
  'We paid LESS for accommodation THAN for
   entertainment.'
  'less' fe'ldan keyin, 'than' esa taqqoslanadigan
  ikkinchi qismdan oldin.


ATOQLI OTLAR:
  the Colosseum — Kolizey (Rim), Coursebook
     84-betdagi rasmda ham bor edi
  the Nile      — Nil daryosi (dunyodagi eng uzun)
  the Thames    — Temza daryosi (London)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a pool           = hovuz
  the same price   = bir xil narx
  accommodation    = turar joy
  entertainment    = ko'ngilochar
  to pay (paid)    = to'lamoq (to'ladi)

topics.topic: Comparisons (davomi) — 49-BETDAGI 10-MAShQNING DAVOMI · 10-davomi-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
49-BETDAGI 10-MAShQNING DAVOMI.

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   8  Travelling by train ISN'T AS EXPENSIVE AS
      travelling by plane.

   9  Isn't this THE DULLEST place OF ALL?

  10  When I lived here it was MUCH QUIETER THAN
      it is today.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
   8  Poyezdda sayohat qilish samolyotda sayohat
      qilishchalik qimmat emas.
   9  Bu hammasidan zerikarli joy emasmi?
  10  Men bu yerda yashaganimda, u bugungidan
      ancha tinchroq edi.


HAR BIRINING TAHLILI:

  8  'ISN'T' bor → INKOR → AS ... AS qolipi.
     'isn't AS EXPENSIVE AS'
     ('expensive' ODDIY shaklda qoladi).
     Poyezd samolyotdan arzonroq — bu haqiqat ham
     mos keladi.

  9  'OF ALL' bor → ORTTIRMA daraja.
     'dull' — 1 bo'g'in → THE DULLEST.
     DIQQAT: savol INKOR shaklda
     ('ISN'T this ...?') — bu ajablanish yoki
     shikoyatni bildiradi.
     'dull' = zerikarli (48-betdagi 4-mashqda
     sinonimi 'boring').

  10  'MUCH' bor → QIYOSIY daraja + THAN.
      'quiet' — 1 bo'g'in → QUIETER.
      'much quieter THAN it is today'
      = bugungidan ancha tinchroq.
      DIQQAT: 'much' faqat QIYOSIY daraja bilan
      (Grammar 52-bet).


UCh XIL QOLIP — BIR MAShQDA:
   8  → AS ... AS      (tenglik inkori)
   9  → THE ... OF ALL (orttirma)
  10  → MUCH ... THAN  (kuchaytirilgan qiyosiy)

topics.topic: Comparisons (davomi) — KITOBDAGI JADVAL · 11-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI JADVAL:

 ┌──────────┬────────────┬────────────┬────────────┐
 │  Name:   │  SANDRA    │  TERESA    │  RUTH      │
 ├──────────┼────────────┼────────────┼────────────┤
 │  Age:    │  8         │  26        │  58        │
 │  Height: │ 1.30 metres│ 1.75 metres│ 1.60 metres│
 │  Weight: │  35 kilos  │  60 kilos  │  75 kilos  │
 └──────────┴────────────┴────────────┴────────────┘

RASMDA (chapdan o'ngga):
  SANDRA — kichkina qiz, uzun sochli
  TERESA — yosh ayol, uzun sochli
  RUTH   — keksa ayol, kalta sochli, ko'zoynakli


HAR KO'RSATKICh BO'YIChA TARTIB:

  YOSh:     Sandra 8  <  Teresa 26  <  Ruth 58
            → RUTH eng katta

  BO'Y:     Sandra 1.30 < Ruth 1.60 < Teresa 1.75
            → TERESA eng baland
            → SANDRA eng past

  VAZN:     Sandra 35 < Teresa 60 < Ruth 75
            → RUTH eng og'ir
            → SANDRA eng ozg'in


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  Ruth is OLDER (old) than Teresa but she's
     MUCH OLDER THAN (old) Sandra.

  Namuna QOLIPNI ko'rsatadi:
     birinchi bo'shliq  → oddiy QIYOSIY daraja
     ikkinchi bo'shliq  → MUCH + QIYOSIY + THAN
  ('much' — farq KATTAROQ ekanini bildiradi:
   Ruth 58 va Teresa 26 farqi 32 yil,
   Ruth 58 va Sandra 8 farqi esa 50 yil)


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  Ruth is OLDER than Teresa but she's
     MUCH OLDER THAN Sandra.            (NAMUNA)
     (58 > 26;  58 >> 8)

  2  Sandra is SHORTER than Ruth but she's
     MUCH SHORTER THAN Teresa.
     (1.30 < 1.60, farq 0.30;
      1.30 < 1.75, farq 0.45)

  3  Ruth is HEAVIER than Teresa but she's
     MUCH HEAVIER THAN Sandra.
     (75 > 60, farq 15;  75 > 35, farq 40)

  4  Teresa has LONGER hair than Ruth but Sandra
     has got THE LONGEST hair of all.
     (rasmga qarang: Rut kalta sochli)

  5  Ruth is TALLER THAN Sandra but Teresa is
     THE TALLEST of all.
     (1.60 > 1.30;  1.75 — eng baland)

  6  Teresa is THINNER THAN Ruth but Sandra is
     THE THINNEST of all.
     (60 < 75;  35 — eng yengil)


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Rut Teresadan katta, lekin Sandradan ancha
     katta.
  2  Sandra Rutdan past, lekin Teresadan ancha
     past.
  3  Rut Teresadan og'ir, lekin Sandradan ancha
     og'ir.
  4  Teresaning sochi Rutnikidan uzun, lekin
     Sandraning sochi hammasidan uzun.
  5  Rut Sandradan baland, lekin Teresa
     hammasidan baland.
  6  Teresa Rutdan ozg'in, lekin Sandra
     hammasidan ozg'in.


DIQQAT — 5 va 6-BANDLARDA 'THAN' YO'Q:
  'Ruth is ...... (tall) Sandra'
  Gapda 'than' BOSILMAGAN → u ham javobga kiradi:
  'TALLER THAN Sandra'.
  Xuddi shunday 6-bandda: 'THINNER THAN Ruth'.

DIQQAT — 5 va 6-BANDLARNING IKKINChI QISMI
ORTTIRMA:
  'but Teresa is ...... (tall) OF ALL'
  'of all' → ORTTIRMA daraja: THE TALLEST.
  1, 2, 3-bandlardan FARQ QILADI (u yerda
  ikkinchi qism ham QIYOSIY edi).

DIQQAT — 4-BAND JADVALDA YO'Q:
  Soch uzunligi jadvalda berilmagan —
  faqat RASMDAN ko'rinadi:
     Sandra — eng uzun soch
     Teresa — uzun soch
     Ruth   — kalta soch


SIFATLARNING YASALIShI:
  old   → older     (1 bo'g'in)
  short → shorter   (1 bo'g'in)
  heavy → heavIER   ('-y' → -IER)
  long  → longer / THE LONGEST
  tall  → taller / THE TALLEST
  thin  → thinNER / THE thinNEST
          (undosh IKKILANADI!)

topics.topic: Comparisons (davomi) — KITOBDAGI NAMUNA · 12-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  It's only 5°C. Can the children play in the
     garden?  (cold)
     → 'NO, THEY CAN'T. IT'S TOO COLD.'

  QOLIP — IKKI QISM:
     1) 'No, [olmosh] can't.'
     2) '[olmosh] + is/are TOO + sifat.'

  'TOO' = HADDAN TAShQARI — ya'ni biror ishni
  QILIB BO'LMAYDI (Grammar 52-bet qoidasi).


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  No, they can't. It's too cold.        (NAMUNA)
     (5°C — bog'da o'ynash uchun juda sovuq)

  2  No, we can't. It's too heavy.
     (quti to'la — ko'tarib bo'lmaydi)

  3  No, he can't. He's too old.
     (80 yosh — vindserfing uchun juda keksa)

  4  No, I can't. It's too expensive.
     (£300 — sotib olish uchun juda qimmat)

  5  No, she can't. She's too young.
     (10 yosh — mashina haydash uchun juda yosh)


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Yo'q, o'ynay olmaydilar. Juda sovuq.
  2  Yo'q, ko'tara olmaymiz. Juda og'ir.
  3  Yo'q, qila olmaydi. U juda keksa.
  4  Yo'q, sotib ololmayman. U juda qimmat.
  5  Yo'q, hayday olmaydi. U juda yosh.


DIQQAT — OLMOShLARGA E'TIBOR BERING:
  Savoldagi ega → javobdagi olmosh:

  'Can THE CHILDREN play ...?'  → THEY
  'Can WE carry it?'            → WE
  'Can HE windsurf?'            → HE
  'Can YOU buy it?'             → I
  'Can SHE drive a car?'        → SHE

  DIQQAT — 4-BANDDA OLMOSh O'ZGARADI:
  Savolda 'YOU' → javobda 'I'
  (chunki javob beruvchi o'zi haqida gapiradi).


DIQQAT — 'IT' yoki OLMOSh:
  Gapning ikkinchi qismida NIMA 'too ...' ekaniga
  qarang:

  1  ob-havo sovuq  → IT'S too cold
  2  quti og'ir     → IT'S too heavy
  3  ODAM keksa     → HE'S too old
  4  narsa qimmat   → IT'S too expensive
  5  ODAM yosh      → SHE'S too young

  1, 2, 4 — NARSA/holat haqida → 'IT'
  3, 5 — ODAM haqida → 'HE'/'SHE'


DIQQAT — 'TOO' va 'VERY' FARQI:
  'It's VERY cold' — sovuq, lekin o'ynash mumkin
  'It's TOO cold'  — shunchalik sovuqki, O'YNAB
                     BO'LMAYDI
  Bu mashqda DOIM 'too' — chunki javob 'No, ...
  can't' (imkonsizlik).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to carry     = ko'tarib yurmoq, tashimoq
  to windsurf  = vindserfing bilan shug'ullanmoq
  full         = to'la
  young        = yosh
  °C (degrees Celsius) = Selsiy gradusi

topics.topic: Comparisons (davomi) — TO'LIQ DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda) · 13c-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
TO'LIQ DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Tonia: DO YOU KNOW where my blue jacket is, Mum?
  Mum:   ISN'T IT in your wardrobe?


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  Toniya: Ko'k kurtkam qayerdaligini bilasanmi,
          oyi?
  Onasi:  U shkafingda emasmi?


HAR BIR BO'ShLIQ:

  1) '...... (you/know) where my blue jacket is?'
     → 'DO YOU KNOW'
     'know' — HOLAT fe'li → '-ing' OLMAYDI.
     'Are you knowing' XATO.
     PRESENT SIMPLE so'roq: DO + you + KNOW.

  2) '...... (it/not be) in your wardrobe?'
     → "ISN'T IT"
     'be' fe'lining INKOR SO'ROQ shakli.
     'it' → is → isn't → 'ISN'T IT ...?'
     DIQQAT: 'did' yoki 'do' KERAK EMAS —
     'be' fe'li o'zi oldinga chiqadi.


DIQQAT — INKOR SO'ROQ NIMA UChUN:
  'Isn't it in your wardrobe?'
  = 'Shkafingda emasmi?'
  Onasi kurtka o'sha yerda DEB O'YLAYDI va
  buni tasdiqlashni so'rayapti.
  Inkor savol shunday ma'noda ishlatiladi.


DIQQAT — SO'Z TARTIBI:
  'Do you know WHERE MY BLUE JACKET IS?'
  Bu — ERGASh gap, savol EMAS.
  Shuning uchun tartib TASDIQ gapdagidek:
     'where my jacket IS'  ✓
     'where IS my jacket'  ✗ (bu to'g'ridan-to'g'ri
                              savolda ishlatiladi)


HOLAT FE'LLARI — '-ING' OLMAYDIGANLAR:
  know, need, want, like, love, hate,
  understand, believe, remember, seem

  13-mashqning UChALA dialogida ham shu qoida
  sinalgan:
     a) want  → 'Do you want ...?'
     b) need  → 'Do you need ...?'
     c) know  → 'Do you know ...?'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a jacket   = kurtka, pidjak
  a wardrobe = kiyim shkafi

topics.topic: Comparisons (davomi) — ANTIGUA HAQIDAGI MATN — sakkiz xato · 14-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
ANTIGUA HAQIDAGI MATN — sakkiz xato.

TO'LIQ MATN (tuzatilgan holda):

  The small, sunny island of Antigua is one of
  THE MOST beautiful islands in the Caribbean.

  Two hundred years ago, many of the large
  buildings were houses or shops. Today, they ARE
  nice hotels with comfortable rooms.

  The Carlisle Bay club is close TO a beautiful
  beach and is MUCH less expensive than some of
  the other hotels.

  There are many interesting places to visit.
  The most popular WITH tourists are the Ebenezer
  Church and the Admiral's Museum.

  You can buy great gifts for your friends and
  family. The souvenir shops in English Harbour
  are THE CHEAPEST and the best.

  There are also many wonderful restaurants. For
  some of the MOST delicious Caribbean dishes, go
  to the Calypso Cafe in Redcliffe Street.

  For a romantic and peaceful holiday, there is
  nowhere nicer THAN Antigua.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  Antiguaning kichik, quyoshli oroli Karib
  dengizidagi eng go'zal orollardan biri.

  Ikki yuz yil oldin katta binolarning ko'pi uy
  yoki do'kon edi. Bugun esa ular qulay xonalari
  bo'lgan yaxshi mehmonxonalar.

  'Carlisle Bay' klubi go'zal plyajga yaqin va
  boshqa ba'zi mehmonxonalardan ancha arzonroq.

  Borib ko'radigan qiziqarli joylar ko'p.
  Sayyohlar orasida eng mashhurlari — Ebenezer
  cherkovi va Admiral muzeyi.

  Do'stlaringiz va oilangiz uchun zo'r sovg'alar
  sotib olishingiz mumkin. English Harbour dagi
  sovg'a do'konlari eng arzon va eng yaxshisi.

  Shuningdek ko'plab ajoyib restoranlar bor. Eng
  mazali Karib taomlari uchun Redcliffe
  ko'chasidagi 'Calypso' kafesiga boring.

  Romantik va tinch ta'til uchun Antiguadan
  yaxshiroq joy yo'q.


SAKKIZ XATONING TAHLILI:

  1  'one of the MORE beautiful islands'
     → 'one of the MOST beautiful islands'
     'one of the ...' — ORTTIRMA daraja qolipi.
     'MORE' — qiyosiy, 'THE MOST' — orttirma.
     Bu ENG KO'P UChRAYDIGAN xato.

  2  'Today, they WERE nice hotels'
     → 'Today, they ARE nice hotels'
     'TODAY' → HOZIRGI zamon.
     Oldingi gap o'tgan zamonda edi ('Two hundred
     years ago ... were'), lekin bu gap BUGUN
     haqida.

  3  'is close BY a beautiful beach'
     → 'is close TO a beautiful beach'
     'close TO' — turg'un birikma.
     'close by' boshqa ma'noda ishlatiladi
     ('yaqin atrofda'), lekin ot bilan 'to' kerak.

  4  'is VERY less expensive'
     → 'is MUCH less expensive'
     'less expensive' — QIYOSIY daraja.
     'very' ODDIY sifat bilan, 'MUCH' esa
     QIYOSIY daraja bilan ishlatiladi.
     Grammar 52-bet qoidasi.

  5  'The most popular FOR tourists'
     → 'The most popular WITH tourists'
     'popular WITH ...' — turg'un birikma.
     48-betdagi 5-mashqning 2-bandi ham shu.

  6  'are the MOST CHEAP and the best'
     → 'are THE CHEAPEST and the best'
     'cheap' — 1 bo'g'inli sifat → '-EST'.
     'the most cheap' XATO.
     DIQQAT: yonidagi 'the BEST' to'g'ri —
     u noto'g'ri sifatning orttirma shakli.

  7  'some of the MUCH delicious dishes'
     → 'some of the MOST delicious dishes'
     'some of the ...' — ORTTIRMA daraja.
     'delicious' — 3 bo'g'in → THE MOST.
     'much' bu yerda umuman mos emas.

  8  'there is nowhere nicer AS Antigua'
     → 'there is nowhere nicer THAN Antigua'
     'nicER' — QIYOSIY daraja → THAN.
     'as' faqat 'as ... as' qolipida.


XATOLARNING TURLARI:
  DARAJA xatosi:   1, 6, 7  (more/most, cheapest)
  KUChAYTIRUVChI:  4        (very → much)
  BOG'LOVChI:      8        (as → than)
  PREDLOG:         3, 5     (by → to, for → with)
  ZAMON:           2        (were → are)


ANTIGUA HAQIDA:
  Antigua — Karib dengizidagi kichik orol davlat
  (Antigua va Barbuda). Plyajlari va quyoshli
  ob-havosi bilan mashhur.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an island    = orol ('s' O'QILMAYDI: 'AY-land')
  the Caribbean = Karib dengizi hududi
  a harbour    = port, bandargoh
  nowhere      = hech qayerda
  a gift       = sovg'a

topics.topic: Be Going To (1)
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI JADVAL — 'BE GOING TO' NING TO'RT
ShAKLI:

 ┌───────────────┬──────────────────────────────┐
 │ AFFIRMATIVE   │ I AM / You ARE / He IS, etc  │
 │ (tasdiq)      │ GOING TO buy a car.          │
 ├───────────────┼──────────────────────────────┤
 │ NEGATIVE      │ I'M NOT / You AREN'T /       │
 │ (inkor)       │ He ISN'T, etc                │
 │               │ GOING TO buy a car.          │
 ├───────────────┼──────────────────────────────┤
 │ INTERROGATIVE │ AM I / ARE you / IS he, etc  │
 │ (so'roq)      │ GOING TO buy a car?          │
 ├───────────────┼──────────────────────────────┤
 │ SHORT ANSWERS │ Yes, I AM / you ARE /        │
 │ (qisqa javob) │      he IS, etc.             │
 │               │ No, I'M NOT / you AREN'T /   │
 │               │     he ISN'T, etc.           │
 └───────────────┴──────────────────────────────┘


HAR ShAXS UChUN TO'LIQ:

  TASDIQ:
     I AM going to buy a car.      → I'M going to
     You ARE going to buy a car.   → You'RE going to
     He IS going to buy a car.     → He'S going to
     She IS going to buy a car.    → She'S going to
     It IS going to buy a car.     → It'S going to
     We ARE going to buy a car.    → We'RE going to
     They ARE going to buy a car.  → They'RE going to

  INKOR:
     I'M NOT going to buy a car.
     You AREN'T going to buy a car.
     He ISN'T going to buy a car.
     We AREN'T going to buy a car.
     They AREN'T going to buy a car.

  SO'ROQ:
     AM I going to buy a car?
     ARE you going to buy a car?
     IS he going to buy a car?
     ARE they going to buy a car?


ENG MUHIM QOIDA:
  'be going to' da O'ZGARADIGAN QISM faqat
  'BE' fe'li (am / is / are).
  'going to' HECh QAChON o'zgarmaydi.


DIQQAT — 'DO/DOES' KERAK EMAS:
     'Are you going to buy a car?'   ✓
     'Do you going to buy a car?'    ✗
     'I'm not going to buy a car.'   ✓
     'I don't going to buy a car.'   ✗


DIQQAT — QISQA JAVOBDA 'GOING TO' TAKRORLANMAYDI:
     'Are you going to buy a car?'
     'Yes, I AM.'                 ✓
     'Yes, I am going to buy.'    — to'liq javob,
                                    qisqa emas


Bu jadval Coursebook 93-betdagi quti bilan
AYNAN bir xil.
examples: Affirmative: I am / You are / He is, etc going to buy a car.
Negative: I'm not / You aren't / He isn't, etc going to buy a car.
Interrogative: Am I / Are you / Is he, etc going to buy a car?
Short answers: Yes, I am / you are / he is, etc. No, I'm not / you aren't / he isn't, etc.
topics.source: Grammar Book, 56-bet, Be Going To jadvali

topics.topic: Be Going To (2)
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI 'FORM' QUTISI — UCh QOIDA:


1) TASDIQ ShAKLI:
   'We form the AFFIRMATIVE with the verb TO BE
    (is, am, are) + GOING TO + the BASE FORM of
    the verb.'

   = Tasdiq shaklini 'to be' fe'li (is, am, are)
     + 'going to' + fe'lning ASOSIY shakli bilan
     yasaymiz.

   NAMUNA:
     'He IS GOING TO VISIT his friends.'

   DIQQAT — 'BASE FORM' NIMA:
     Fe'lning lug'atdagi shakli — hech qanday
     qo'shimchasiz:
        visit  ✓   ('visits', 'visiting',
                    'visited' XATO)
        go     ✓
        buy    ✓


2) SO'ROQ ShAKLI:
   'We form the INTERROGATIVE by putting the verb
    TO BE BEFORE the SUBJECT PRONOUN.'

   = So'roq shaklini 'to be' fe'lini EGA
     OLMOShIDAN OLDIN qo'yish bilan yasaymiz.

   NAMUNA:
     Tasdiq: 'HE IS going to visit his friends.'
     So'roq: 'IS HE going to visit his friends?'

   Ya'ni EGA va 'BE' O'RIN ALMAShADI.


3) INKOR ShAKLI:
   'We form the NEGATIVE by putting NOT AFTER the
    verb TO BE.'

   = Inkor shaklini 'not' ni 'to be' fe'lidan
     KEYIN qo'yish bilan yasaymiz.

   NAMUNA:
     'He IS NOT / ISN'T going to visit his
      friends.'

   DIQQAT — QISQARGAN ShAKLLAR:
     is not   → isn't
     are not  → aren't
     am not   → 'm not
        ('amn't' YO'Q — 'I'm not' deyiladi)


UCh QOIDANI ESLAB QOLISh:
     TASDIQ:  ega  +  BE  +  going to + fe'l
     SO'ROQ:   BE  +  ega +  going to + fe'l ?
     INKOR:   ega  +  BE  +  NOT + going to + fe'l

  Ya'ni HAMMASI 'BE' fe'li bilan hal bo'ladi.
examples: We form the affirmative with the verb to be (is, am, are) + going to + the base form of the verb.
He is going to visit his friends.
We form the interrogative by putting the verb to be before the subject pronoun.
Is he going to visit his friends?
We form the negative by putting not after the verb to be.
He is not / isn't going to visit his friends.

topics.topic: Be Going To (3)
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI 'USE' QUTISI — IKKI VAZIFA:


1) KELAJAK REJALARI va NIYATLARI
   'We use BE GOING TO to talk about our FUTURE
    PLANS or INTENTIONS.'

   NAMUNA:
     'I AM GOING TO start a computer course.'
     (Kompyuter kursini boshlamoqchiman.)

   → Bu qarorni ALLAQAChON qabul qilganman.
     Oldindan o'ylangan.


2) HOZIRGI DALILGA ASOSLANGAN BAShORAT
   'We also use BE GOING TO for PREDICTIONS BASED
    ON EVIDENCE IN THE PRESENT.'

   NAMUNA:
     'There are dark clouds in the sky.
      IT'S GOING TO rain.'
     (Osmonda qora bulutlar bor. Yomg'ir yog'adi.)

   → DALIL: qora bulutlar HOZIR ko'rinib turibdi.


IKKI VAZIFANING FARQI:

  1-vazifa — ODAM haqida (reja):
     'I'm going to ...'  'She's going to ...'
     Kimdir biror ishni QILMOQChI.

  2-vazifa — HODISA haqida (bashorat):
     'It's going to rain.'
     'He's going to fall!'
     Biror narsa SODIR BO'LADI — chunki dalil bor.


QO'ShIMChA MISOLLAR — 2-VAZIFA:

  'Look at that boy! He'S GOING TO fall off his
   bike!'
     DALIL: bola muvozanatini yo'qotdi.

  'The sky is very dark. There'S GOING TO be a
   storm.'
     DALIL: osmon qorayib ketdi.

  'She's driving too fast. She'S GOING TO have an
   accident!'
     DALIL: juda tez haydayapti.


DIQQAT — 'WILL' BILAN FARQI:
  'It'S GOING TO rain.'
     → DALIL bor (qora bulutlar KO'RINIB turibdi)
  'I think it WILL rain.'
     → shunchaki FIKR, dalil YO'Q

  Ikkalasi ham bashorat, lekin ASOSI boshqa.


Bu quti Coursebook 93 va 94-betlardagi
qoidalarni BIRLAShTIRADI.
examples: We use be going to to talk about our future plans or intentions.
I am going to start a computer course.
We also use be going to for predictions based on evidence in the present.
There are dark clouds in the sky. It's going to rain.
Look at that boy! He's going to fall off his bike!

topics.topic: Future Simple (will) — Kelasi oddiy zamon (will) (1)
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI JADVAL — 'WILL' NING BARCHA ShAKLLARI:

 ┌──────────────┬──────────────┬─────────────────┐
 │ AFFIRMATIVE  │ AFFIRMATIVE  │ INTERROGATIVE   │
 │ (uzun shakl) │ (qisqa shakl)│                 │
 ├──────────────┼──────────────┼─────────────────┤
 │ I will leave │ I'll leave   │ Will I leave?   │
 │ you will     │ you'll leave │ Will you leave? │
 │      leave   │              │                 │
 │ he will      │ he'll leave  │ Will he leave?  │
 │      leave   │              │                 │
 │ she will     │ she'll leave │ Will she leave? │
 │      leave   │              │                 │
 │ it will      │ it'll leave  │ Will it leave?  │
 │      leave   │              │                 │
 │ we will      │ we'll leave  │ Will we leave?  │
 │      leave   │              │                 │
 │ you will     │ you'll leave │ Will you leave? │
 │      leave   │              │                 │
 │ they will    │ they'll      │ Will they       │
 │      leave   │      leave   │      leave?     │
 └──────────────┴──────────────┴─────────────────┘

 ┌──────────────────────┬──────────────────────┐
 │ NEGATIVE (uzun)      │ NEGATIVE (qisqa)     │
 ├──────────────────────┼──────────────────────┤
 │ I will not leave     │ I won't leave        │
 │ you will not leave   │ you won't leave      │
 │ he will not leave    │ he won't leave       │
 │ she will not leave   │ she won't leave      │
 │ it will not leave    │ it won't leave       │
 │ we will not leave    │ we won't leave       │
 │ you will not leave   │ you won't leave      │
 │ they will not leave  │ they won't leave     │
 └──────────────────────┴──────────────────────┘


ENG MUHIM KUZATUV — 'WILL' HECh QAChON
O'ZGARMAYDI:

  'be going to' da 'be' fe'li ega bo'yicha
  o'zgaradi (am / is / are).

  'WILL' da esa HAMMA shaxs uchun BIR XIL:
     I will, you will, he will, she will,
     it will, we will, they will

  Bu — 'will' ni ANChA OSON qiladi.


QISQARGAN ShAKLLAR:
     I will    → I'LL
     you will  → YOU'LL
     he will   → HE'LL
     she will  → SHE'LL
     it will   → IT'LL
     we will   → WE'LL
     they will → THEY'LL

     will not  → WON'T

  DIQQAT: 'will not' → 'WON'T' (o'zgargan shakl!)
  'willn't' shakli YO'Q.


SO'ROQ — 'WILL' OLDINGA ChIQADI:
     'Will I leave?'
     'Will you leave?'
     'Will they leave?'

  Hech qanday 'do/does/did' KERAK EMAS.


QISQA JAVOBLAR:
     'Will you leave?'
     'Yes, I WILL.'  /  'No, I WON'T.'

  DIQQAT: qisqa javobda fe'l TAKRORLANMAYDI.
examples: Affirmative (long form): I will leave, you will leave, he will leave, etc.
Affirmative (short form): I'll leave, you'll leave, he'll leave, etc.
Interrogative: Will I leave? Will you leave? Will he leave? etc.
Negative (long form): I will not leave, you will not leave, etc.
Negative (short form): I won't leave, you won't leave, etc.
Short answers: Yes, I will. / No, I won't.

topics.topic: Future Simple (will) — Kelasi oddiy zamon (will) (2)
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI 'FORM' QUTISI — UCh QOIDA:


1) TASDIQ ShAKLI:
   'We form the FUTURE SIMPLE with WILL and the
    BASE FORM of the verb.'

   = Kelasi oddiy zamonni 'will' va fe'lning
     ASOSIY shakli bilan yasaymiz.

   NAMUNALAR:
     'He WILL GO to the park.'
     'They WILL BUY a new house.'

   DIQQAT — 'BASE FORM':
     'will GO'      ✓   ('will goes' ✗,
                         'will going' ✗,
                         'will to go' ✗)
     'will BUY'     ✓

   DIQQAT — 3-ShAXS BIRLIKDA HAM '-S' YO'Q:
     'He will GO.'      ✓
     'He will goes.'    ✗
     Bu — modal fe'llarning umumiy qoidasi.


2) SO'ROQ ShAKLI:
   'We form the INTERROGATIVE by putting WILL
    BEFORE the SUBJECT PRONOUN.'

   = So'roq shaklini 'will' ni EGA OLMOShIDAN
     OLDIN qo'yish bilan yasaymiz.

   NAMUNALAR:
     Tasdiq: 'HE WILL go to the park.'
     So'roq: 'WILL HE go to the park?'

     Tasdiq: 'THEY WILL buy a new house.'
     So'roq: 'WILL THEY buy a new house?'

   Ya'ni EGA va 'WILL' O'RIN ALMAShADI.


3) INKOR ShAKLI:
   'We form the NEGATIVE by putting NOT AFTER
    WILL.'

   = Inkor shaklini 'not' ni 'will' dan KEYIN
     qo'yish bilan yasaymiz.

   NAMUNALAR:
     'He WILL NOT / WON'T go to the park.'
     'They WILL NOT / WON'T buy a new house.'


UCh QOIDANI ESLAB QOLISh:
     TASDIQ:  ega  +  WILL  +  ASOSIY fe'l
     SO'ROQ:  WILL +  ega   +  ASOSIY fe'l ?
     INKOR:   ega  +  WILL  +  NOT + ASOSIY fe'l

  'be going to' bilan SOLIShTIRING:
     u yerda 'BE' fe'li o'zgaradi,
     bu yerda 'WILL' O'ZGARMAYDI.


ENG KO'P UChRAYDIGAN XATOLAR:
     ✗ He will goes.       ✓ He will go.
     ✗ He will going.      ✓ He will go.
     ✗ He will to go.      ✓ He will go.
     ✗ Does he will go?    ✓ Will he go?
     ✗ He doesn't will go. ✓ He won't go.
     ✗ He willn't go.      ✓ He won't go.
examples: We form the future simple with will and the base form of the verb.
He will go to the park. They will buy a new house.
We form the interrogative by putting will before the subject pronoun.
Will he go to the park? Will they buy a new house?
We form the negative by putting not after will.
He will not / won't go to the park. They will not / won't buy a new house.

topics.topic: Use — Future Simple, Present Continuous — Qo'llanishi — Kelasi oddiy zamon, Present Continuous (1)
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI 'USE' QUTISI — IKKI VAZIFA:

  We use the FUTURE SIMPLE:

  1) TO MAKE PREDICTIONS BASED ON WHAT WE BELIEVE
     OR IMAGINE
     (biz IShONGAN yoki TASAVVUR QILGAN narsaga
      asoslangan bashorat)

     'There WILL BE rain in Paris tomorrow.'
     (Ertaga Parijda yomg'ir bo'ladi.)

     → Bu shunchaki FIKR yoki tasavvur.
       Ko'rinib turgan DALIL yo'q.

  2) TO MAKE ON-THE-SPOT DECISIONS
     (shu payt qabul qilingan qaror)

     A: 'The phone is ringing.'
        (Telefon jiringlayapti.)
     B: 'I'LL ANSWER it.'
        (Men javob beraman.)

     → Qaror AYNI DAMDA qabul qilindi.
       Oldindan rejalashtirilmagan.


KELASI ZAMON BILAN IShLATILADIGAN VAQT IBORALARI:
     tomorrow                (ertaga)
     soon                    (yaqinda)
     next week/month/etc.    (keyingi hafta/oy)
     the day after tomorrow  (indinga)


ENG MUHIM FARQ — 'WILL' ↔ 'BE GOING TO':

  BAShORATDA:
     'I think there WILL BE rain tomorrow.'
        → IShONCh, TASAVVUR (dalil yo'q)
     'There are dark clouds. It'S GOING TO rain.'
        → DALIL bor (bulutlar ko'rinib turibdi)

  QARORDA:
     'I'LL answer it.'
        → AYNI DAMDA hal qilindi
     'I'M GOING TO join a gym.'
        → OLDINDAN o'ylangan reja


ESLAB QOLISh:
     Qaror QAChON qabul qilingan?
        HOZIRGINA  →  WILL
        ALLAQAChON →  BE GOING TO

     Bashorat NIMAGA asoslangan?
        FIKRGA / tasavvurga  →  WILL
        KO'RINIB turgan DALILGA  →  BE GOING TO
examples: We use the future simple to make predictions based on what we believe or imagine.
There will be rain in Paris tomorrow.
We use the future simple to make on-the-spot decisions.
A: The phone is ringing. B: I'll answer it.
Time expressions: tomorrow, soon, next week/month/etc., the day after tomorrow, etc.

topics.topic: Use — Future Simple, Present Continuous — Qo'llanishi — Kelasi oddiy zamon, Present Continuous (2)
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI — IKKI VAZIFA:


1) QAT'IY BELGILANGAN KELAJAK IShLARI
   'We can use the present continuous to talk
    about FIXED FUTURE ARRANGEMENTS.'

   'I AM SEEING John tonight.'
   (Bugun kechqurun Jon bilan uchrashaman.)

   → Kelishilgan, vaqti belgilangan.


   HARAKAT FE'LLARI BILAN AYNIQSA KO'P:
   'With verbs of movement such as: COME, GO,
    FLY, TRAVEL, LEAVE etc.'

   'I AM FLYING to Athens TOMORROW.
    My plane IS LEAVING at 6 am.'
   (Ertaga Afinaga uchaman. Samolyotim ertalab
    soat 6 da jo'naydi.)

   → Chipta olingan, reys vaqti aniq.


2) HOZIR SODIR BO'LAYOTGAN HARAKAT
   'We also use the present continuous for
    ACTIONS HAPPENING NOW, at the moment of
    speaking.'

   'IT'S SNOWING at the moment.'
   (Hozir qor yog'yapti.)

   → Gapirayotgan paytda sodir bo'lmoqda.


HARAKAT FE'LLARI (verbs of movement) — RO'YXAT:
     come    (kelmoq)
     go      (bormoq)
     fly     (uchmoq)
     travel  (sayohat qilmoq)
     leave   (jo'nab ketmoq)
     arrive  (yetib kelmoq)
     start   (boshlamoq)
     return  (qaytmoq)

  Bu fe'llar kelajak rejasi haqida gapirganda
  deyarli DOIM present continuous da keladi.


ENG MUHIM — UCh XIL KELAJAKNI AJRATISh:

  BE GOING TO   →  REJA/NIYAT, aniq vaqt YO'Q
     'I'm going to visit John.'

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS →  BELGILANGAN, aniq vaqt BOR
     'I'm seeing John tonight.'

  WILL          →  TAXMIN yoki AYNI DAMDAGI qaror
     'I think I'll see John.'


DIQQAT — 'I AM SEEING':
  'see' odatda HOLAT fe'li ('-ing' olmaydi):
     'I SEE a bird.' (ko'raman)
  LEKIN 'uchrashmoq' ma'nosida HARAKAT fe'li:
     'I AM SEEING John tonight.' (uchrashaman)
  Ikki xil ma'no — ikki xil qoida.


Coursebook 93 va 94-betlardagi qoidalar
shu yerda BIRLAShTIRILGAN.
examples: We can use the present continuous to talk about fixed future arrangements.
I am seeing John tonight.
With verbs of movement such as: come, go, fly, travel, leave etc.
I am flying to Athens tomorrow. My plane is leaving at 6 am.
We also use the present continuous for actions happening now, at the moment of speaking.
It's snowing at the moment.

topics.topic: Use — Future Simple, Present Continuous — Qo'llanishi — Kelasi oddiy zamon, Present Continuous (3)
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI:

  'IT WILL BE + ADJECTIVE (SIFAT)'
     'IT WILL BE FOGGY tomorrow.'
     (Ertaga tumanli bo'ladi.)

  'THERE WILL BE + NOUN (OT)'
     'THERE WILL BE FOG tomorrow.'
     (Ertaga tuman bo'ladi.)


QOIDA:
  Bo'shliqdan keyin SIFAT bormi yoki OT?
     SIFAT  →  IT will be
     OT     →  THERE will be


OB-HAVO JUFTLIKLARI:

     SIFAT          OT
     ─────────────  ─────────────
     foggy          fog
     rainy          rain
     sunny          sunshine
     snowy          snow
     windy          strong winds
     cloudy         clouds
     stormy         a storm

  Har juftlik uchun IKKI xil gap:
     'IT will be FOGGY tomorrow.'
     'THERE will be FOG tomorrow.'
     Ma'no BIR XIL.


ENG SODDA IP:
  Ob-havo so'zi '-y' bilan tugasa — SIFAT → IT.
  '-y' siz bo'lsa — OT → THERE.


YUQORIDAGI 'USE' QUTISIDA HAM ShU QOIDA:
  'THERE will be RAIN in Paris tomorrow.'
     ('rain' — OT → THERE)


Coursebook 95-betdagi quti bilan AYNAN bir xil.
examples: It will be + adjective: It will be foggy tomorrow.
There will be + noun: There will be fog tomorrow.
foggy ↔ fog; rainy ↔ rain; sunny ↔ sunshine; snowy ↔ snow; windy ↔ strong winds
topics.source: Grammar Book, 57-bet, It will be / There will be

topics.topic: Use — Future Simple, Present Continuous — Qo'llanishi — Kelasi oddiy zamon, Present Continuous (4)
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI:

  • SABABNI 'BECAUSE' bilan, NATIJANI 'SO' bilan
    ifodalaymiz.
  • SABAB yoki MAQSADNI 'TO + INFINITIVE' bilan
    ham ifodalaymiz (maqsad infinitivi).


UCh NAMUNA — BIR XIL FIKR, UCh XIL SHAKL:

  1) REASON (SABAB) — 'because'
     'She's going to save money BECAUSE she wants
      to go on holiday.'
     (U pul yig'moqchi, ChUNKI ta'tilga bormoqchi.)

  2) RESULT (NATIJA) — 'so'
     'She wants to go on holiday, SO she's going
      to save money.'
     (U ta'tilga bormoqchi, ShUNING UChUN pul
      yig'moqchi.)

  3) PURPOSE (MAQSAD) — 'to + fe'l'
     'She's going to save money TO GO on holiday.'
     (U ta'tilga borish UChUN pul yig'moqchi.)


ENG MUHIM — GAP TARTIBI TESKARI:

  BECAUSE:
     [NATIJA] because [SABAB]
     'save money'  ←  'wants to go on holiday'

  SO:
     [SABAB], so [NATIJA]
     'wants to go on holiday'  →  'save money'

  Ya'ni bir xil ikki fikr, lekin O'RINLARI
  ALMAShADI.


'TO + fe'l' (maqsad infinitivi):
  Eng QISQA shakl.
  Ergash gapda EGA YO'Q:
     'to go on holiday'      ✓
     'to she goes on holiday' ✗


QANDAY TANLASh:
  Ergash gapda EGA va FE'L bormi?
     HA   →  'because' yoki 'so'
     YO'Q →  'to + fe'l'


Coursebook 95-betdagi quti bilan AYNAN bir xil.
Coursebook 93-betdagi Speaking mashqi ham
shu qoidaga asoslangan edi.
examples: We express reason with because and result with so.
We also express reason or purpose with to + infinitive (infinitive of purpose).
She's going to save money because she wants to go on holiday. (reason)
She wants to go on holiday, so she's going to save money. (result)
She's going to save money to go on holiday. (purpose)
topics.source: Grammar Book, 57-bet, Expressing Reason, Result or Purpose

topics.topic: Mashqlar — TOM VA XEZERNING KUNDALIGI · 1-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
TOM VA XEZERNING KUNDALIGI:

     Monday    -  go to the cinema
     Tuesday   -  visit Heather's parents
     Wednesday -  take the car to a mechanic
     Thursday  -  buy a computer
     Friday    -  clean the house
     Saturday  -  have a dinner party
     Sunday    -  go on a picnic


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'They'RE GOING to the cinema ON MONDAY.'


NEGA PRESENT CONTINUOUS:
  Bu ishlar KUNDALIKKA yozilgan —
  ya'ni QAT'IY BELGILANGAN (fixed arrangements).
  Har birining ANIQ KUNI bor.

  57-betdagi qoida: belgilangan kelajak ishi →
  PRESENT CONTINUOUS.


QOLIP:
  They'RE + fe'l-ING + ... + ON + [kun].

  DIQQAT: KUN bilan 'ON' predlogi.


BARCHA YETTI GAP:

  1  They're going to the cinema on Monday.
                                        (NAMUNA)
  2  They're visiting Heather's parents on
     Tuesday.
  3  They're taking the car to a mechanic on
     Wednesday.
  4  They're buying a computer on Thursday.
  5  They're cleaning the house on Friday.
  6  They're having a dinner party on Saturday.
  7  They're going on a picnic on Sunday.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Dushanba kuni kinoga borishadi.
  2  Seshanba kuni Xezerning ota-onasinikiga
     borishadi.
  3  Chorshanba kuni mashinani ustaga olib
     borishadi.
  4  Payshanba kuni kompyuter sotib olishadi.
  5  Juma kuni uyni yig'ishtirishadi.
  6  Shanba kuni kechki ziyofat qilishadi.
  7  Yakshanba kuni piknikka borishadi.


FE'LLARNING '-ING' ShAKLI:
     go     → GOING
     visit  → VISITING
     take   → TAKING     ('-e' TUShADI)
     buy    → BUYING
     clean  → CLEANING
     have   → HAVING     ('-e' TUShADI)

  DIQQAT: '-e' bilan tugagan fe'llarda 'e'
  TUShADI: take → taking, have → having.


DIQQAT — IKKI XIL 'GO':
  1-gap: 'going TO the cinema'
     → 'go TO + JOY'
  7-gap: 'going ON a picnic'
     → 'go ON a picnic' (turg'un ibora)

  Shunday: go ON holiday, go ON a trip,
  go ON a journey, go ON a picnic.


DIQQAT — 'HAVE A DINNER PARTY':
  'have a party' = ziyofat qilmoq.
  'make a party' XATO.
  Bu yerda 'have' — HARAKAT fe'li → '-ing' oladi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a diary    = kundalik
  a mechanic = usta, mexanik
  a dinner party = kechki ziyofat
  a picnic   = piknik

topics.topic: Mashqlar — O'N UCh DIALOG — HAR BIRIDA BITTA BO'ShLIQ · 2-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
O'N UCh DIALOG — HAR BIRIDA BITTA BO'ShLIQ.

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  I'LL drive you there.
   2  I'M GOING TO wash it later.
   3  I'M GOING TO buy some this afternoon.
   4  I'LL help you.
   5  I'M GOING TO buy some new clothes next week.
   6  I'LL open the window.
   7  I'LL show you how to do it.
   8  I'LL take you to the doctor.
   9  I'M GOING TO visit my parents.
  10  I'LL call a mechanic.
  11  She'S GOING TO have dinner with Paul.
  12  He'S GOING TO work at a restaurant.
  13  I'M GOING TO play basketball with Peter.

  WILL — YETTITA:        1, 4, 6, 7, 8, 10
         (olti dona)
  BE GOING TO — YETTITA: 2, 3, 5, 9, 11, 12, 13


ENG MUHIM QOIDA — QANDAY AJRATISh:

  WILL  →  javob beruvchi AYNI DAMDA qaror qildi
           (oldin bilmagan)

  BE GOING TO  →  javob beruvchi ALLAQAChON
                  rejalashtirgan (oldin bilgan)


IKKI ANIQ IP:

  IP 1 — 'I KNOW' BORMI?
     Agar javob 'I know' bilan boshlansa,
     demak u ALLAQAChON bilgan va rejalashtirgan
     → BE GOING TO.
     (2 va 3-bandlar)

  IP 2 — SAVOL REJA HAQIDAMI?
     'What are you doing next weekend?'
     'What are Sean's plans for the summer?'
     → REJA so'ralmoqda → BE GOING TO.
     (9 va 12-bandlar)

  Qolgan hollarda:
     A biror MUAMMO aytadi →
     B AYNI DAMDA yordam taklif qiladi → WILL.


HAR BIRI ALOHIDA:

   1  A: 'I need to go to the dentist.'
      B: 'Okay, I'LL drive you there.'
      → 'Okay' — ayni damdagi reaksiya. WILL.

   2  A: 'Your shirt is dirty.'
      B: 'I KNOW. I'M GOING TO wash it later.'
      → 'I know' — allaqachon bilgan va
        rejalashtirgan. BE GOING TO.

   3  A: 'We haven't got any tomatoes.'
      B: 'I KNOW. I'M GOING TO buy some this
          afternoon.'
      → 'I know' — allaqachon rejalashtirgan.
        BE GOING TO.

   4  A: 'I don't understand this exercise!'
      B: 'Don't worry, I'LL help you.'
      → 'Don't worry' — ayni damdagi yordam
        taklifi. WILL.

   5  A: 'Why are you so excited?'
      B: 'I'M GOING TO buy some new clothes next
          week.'
      → Hayajonining SABABI — allaqachon
        rejalashtirgan. BE GOING TO.

   6  A: 'It's hot in here.'
      B: 'I'LL open the window.'
      → Ayni damdagi qaror. WILL.

   7  A: 'I can't do this puzzle.'
      B: 'I'LL show you how to do it.'
      → Ayni damdagi yordam taklifi. WILL.

   8  A: 'I'm not feeling well.'
      B: 'I'LL take you to the doctor.'
      → Ayni damdagi qaror. WILL.

   9  A: 'What are you doing next weekend?'
      B: 'I'M GOING TO visit my parents.'
      → REJA so'ralmoqda. BE GOING TO.

  10  A: 'There's something wrong with the car.'
      B: 'I'LL call a mechanic.'
      → Ayni damdagi qaror. WILL.

  11  A: 'Why is she wearing these clothes?'
      B: 'She'S GOING TO have dinner with Paul.'
      → Kiyimining SABABI — allaqachon
        rejalashtirgan. BE GOING TO.

  12  A: 'What are Sean's plans for the summer?'
      B: 'He'S GOING TO work at a restaurant to
          earn some money.'
      → 'PLANS' so'zi bevosita aytilgan.
        BE GOING TO.

  13  A: 'What are you looking for?'
      B: 'My basketball. I'M GOING TO play
          basketball with Peter.'
      → To'pni qidirayotganining SABABI —
        allaqachon rejalashtirgan. BE GOING TO.


NAQSh — UCh TUR:

  A) MUAMMO → YORDAM TAKLIFI  (WILL)
     1, 4, 6, 7, 8, 10-bandlar
     A biror qiyinchilikni aytadi,
     B darhol yordam beradi.

  B) 'I KNOW' → REJA  (BE GOING TO)
     2, 3-bandlar

  C) SABAB TUShUNTIRISh → REJA  (BE GOING TO)
     5, 9, 11, 12, 13-bandlar
     'Why ...?' yoki 'What are ... plans?'
     savoliga javob.


DIQQAT — 5, 11, 13-BANDLAR NEGA 'GOING TO':
  Bu uch bandda javob HOZIRGI HOLATNI
  TUShUNTIRADI:
     nega hayajonlangan? — chunki reja bor
     nega bunday kiyingan? — chunki reja bor
     nega to'pni qidiryapti? — chunki reja bor
  Reja ALLAQAChON mavjud → BE GOING TO.


EGAGA E'TIBOR BERING:
  11-band: 'SHE'S going to ...' (she → is)
  12-band: 'HE'S going to ...'  (he → is)
  Qolganlari: 'I'M going to ...' (I → am)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a mechanic = usta, mexanik
  a puzzle   = boshqotirma
  excited    = hayajonlangan
  to look for = qidirmoq
  something wrong = biror nosozlik

topics.topic: Mashqlar (davomi) — 57-BETDAGI 2-MAShQNING DAVOMI · 2-davomi-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
57-BETDAGI 2-MAShQNING DAVOMI.

JAVOBLAR:
  14  I'LL make you a sandwich.
  15  I'M GOING TO visit my aunt.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  14  A: Qornim ochdi.
      B: Senga buterbrod tayyorlayman.
  15  A: Bugun kechqurun sayrga chiqaylikmi?
      B: Kechirasan, bora olmayman. Xolamnikiga
         boraman.


QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  14  A qornining ochligini AYTDI →
      B AYNI DAMDA buterbrod tayyorlashni taklif
      qildi → WILL.
      Bu — 57-betdagi 'MUAMMO → YORDAM TAKLIFI'
      naqshi.

  15  B taklifni RAD ETADI va SABABINI aytadi.
      Xolasinikiga borish ALLAQAChON
      rejalashtirilgan (shuning uchun bora
      olmaydi) → BE GOING TO.
      Agar 'will' bo'lsa — endigina qaror qilgan
      bo'lardi, lekin unda taklifni rad etishga
      sabab bo'lmasdi.


DIQQAT — 15-BAND MANTIQI:
  'Sorry, I can't' — nega bora olmaydi?
  Chunki BOShQA REJASI bor.
  Reja OLDINDAN mavjud → BE GOING TO.

  Bu — Coursebook 97-betdagi muloyim rad etish
  qolipi bilan bir xil:
  'I'd love to, but I can't. I'm going to ...'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an aunt = xola, amma
  Shall we ...? = ... qilaylikmi? (taklif)

topics.topic: Mashqlar (davomi) — KITOBDAGI NAMUNA · 3b-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  'She'S GOING TO send invitations to her
      friends.'


NEGA 'BE GOING TO':
  Jill ziyofat qilishni REJALAShTIRGAN.
  Bu ishlar uning NIYATLARI —
  aniq vaqti belgilanmagan.

  Mashq boshida ham aytilgan:
  'she'S GOING TO have a party.'


QOLIP:
  She'S GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l + ... .


BARCHA TO'RT GAP:

  1  She's going to send invitations to her
     friends.                          (NAMUNA)
  2  She's going to hire a band.
  3  She's going to make a birthday cake.
  4  She's going to buy coke and crisps.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  U do'stlariga taklifnoma yubormoqchi.
  2  U musiqa guruhini yollamoqchi.
  3  U tug'ilgan kun torti pishirmoqchi.
  4  U kola va chips sotib olmoqchi.


DIQQAT — 1-GAPDA 'HER':
  Ko'rsatmada 'to friends' deyilgan,
  lekin namunada 'to HER friends' —
  ya'ni egalik olmoshi qo'shilgan.
  Gap TABIIYROQ bo'ladi.

DIQQAT — 3-GAPDA 'A':
  Ko'rsatmada 'make/birthday cake',
  gapda esa 'make A birthday cake' —
  artikl qo'shiladi.


DIQQAT — 'MAKE' va 'DO' FARQI:
  'MAKE a cake'  ✓  (yasash, tayyorlash)
  'DO a cake'    ✗
  Shunday: make a sandwich, make dinner,
  make a party (lekin 'HAVE a party' to'g'riroq).

topics.topic: Mashqlar (davomi) — RO'YXAT (5 ta ibora) · 4-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
RO'YXAT (5 ta ibora):
  sell her car, be late for school, fix,
  make a cake, lose weight


HAR GAPDA IKKI QISM:
  1-gap — HOZIRGI DALIL (nima ko'rinib turibdi)
  2-gap — BAShORAT yoki REJA ('be going to')

  Bu — 57-betdagi qoida:
  'be going to' DALILGA asoslangan bashorat
  uchun ham ishlatiladi.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  Jane's putting an ad in the newspaper.
     She IS GOING TO SELL HER CAR.       (NAMUNA)

  2  The washing machine isn't working.
     My father IS GOING TO FIX IT.

  3  I bought some flour and some eggs.
     I AM GOING TO MAKE A CAKE.

  4  Robert is on a diet.
     He IS GOING TO LOSE WEIGHT.

  5  Peter is still in bed.
     He IS GOING TO BE LATE FOR SCHOOL.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Jeyn gazetaga e'lon beryapti.
     U mashinasini sotmoqchi.
  2  Kir yuvish mashinasi ishlamayapti.
     Otam uni tuzatmoqchi.
  3  Men un va tuxum sotib oldim.
     Tort pishirmoqchiman.
  4  Robert parhezda.
     U vazn tashlamoqchi.
  5  Piter hali ham karavotda.
     U maktabga kechikadi.


HAR BIRI QANDAY ANIQLANADI — DALIL → NATIJA:

  1  DALIL: gazetaga e'lon berayapti
     → mashinani SOTMOQChI

  2  DALIL: kir yuvish mashinasi buzilgan
     → otasi uni TUZATMOQChI

  3  DALIL: un va tuxum sotib olindi
     → TORT PIShIRMOQChI
     (un va tuxum — tortning masalliqlari)

  4  DALIL: Robert parhezda
     → VAZN TAShLAMOQChI
     (parhezning maqsadi shu)

  5  DALIL: Piter hali karavotda
     → MAKTABGA KEChIKADI
     DIQQAT: bu REJA emas, BAShORAT!
     Piter kechikishni xohlamaydi, lekin
     dalil shuni ko'rsatadi.


ENG MUHIM — 5-BAND FARQ QILADI:
  1-4-bandlarda 'be going to' — REJA/NIYAT.
  5-bandda esa DALILGA ASOSLANGAN BAShORAT:
  Piter kechikishni REJALAShTIRMAGAN, lekin
  hali karavotda bo'lgani uchun kechikishi
  ANIQ.

  Bu — 'be going to' ning IKKINChI vazifasi
  (57-bet).


EGALARGA E'TIBOR BERING:
  1  She  → 'She IS going to'
  2  My father → 'He IS going to'
  3  I    → 'I AM going to'
  4  He   → 'He IS going to'
  5  He   → 'He IS going to'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an ad (advertisement) = e'lon, reklama
  a washing machine = kir yuvish mashinasi
  to fix       = tuzatmoq, ta'mirlamoq
  flour        = un
  a diet       = parhez
  to be on a diet = parhezda bo'lmoq
  to be late for = ... ga kechikmoq
  still        = hali ham

topics.topic: Mashqlar (davomi) — ENDI UCh XIL KELAJAK ARALAShTIRILGAN — · 6-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
ENDI UCh XIL KELAJAK ARALAShTIRILGAN —
Unit 13 ning eng qiyin mashqi.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  He IS GOING TO BE an artist.        (NAMUNA)
  2  I'm sure Kelly WILL LET you borrow her CDs.
  3  Look at him! He IS GOING TO FALL off his
     bike.
  4  They ARE HAVING dinner at Mario's on Saturday
     evening.
  5  I can't see you at the weekend. I AM VISITING
     my parents.
  6  I'm cold. I WILL PUT ON my jacket.
  7  He IS MEETING Lisa for coffee at noon.
  8  I AM FLYING to Madrid next month.
  9  Don't worry, I WILL CALL the plumber for the
     dishwasher.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  U rasm chizishni yaxshi ko'radi.
     U rassom bo'lmoqchi.
  2  Ishonchim komilki, Kelli senga o'z
     disklarini beradi.
  3  Unga qara! U velosipeddan yiqiladi.
  4  Ular shanba kechqurun 'Mario's' da kechki
     ovqat qilishadi.
  5  Dam olish kunlari sen bilan ko'risha
     olmayman. Ota-onamnikiga boraman.
  6  Sovqotdim. Kurtkamni kiyaman.
  7  U tushda Liza bilan qahva ichgani
     uchrashadi.
  8  Keyingi oy Madridga uchaman.
  9  Xavotir olma, idish yuvish mashinasi uchun
     santexnikni chaqiraman.


UCh QOIDA — QAYSI BIRINI TANLASh:

  BE GOING TO:
     • REJA / NIYAT
     • DALILGA asoslangan bashorat

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS:
     • QAT'IY BELGILANGAN ish (ANIQ VAQT bor)

  WILL:
     • FIKRGA asoslangan bashorat ('I'm sure',
       'I think')
     • AYNI DAMDAGI qaror


HAR BIRI ALOHIDA:

  1  'He LIKES PAINTING.' → NIYAT.
     BE GOING TO.                       (NAMUNA)

  2  'I'M SURE Kelly ...' →
     'I'm sure' = FIKR, ishonch.
     Dalil yo'q → WILL.
     'let sb DO sth' — 'to' YO'Q:
     'let you BORROW' ✓ ('let you to borrow' ✗).

  3  'LOOK AT HIM!' →
     Hozir KO'RINIB turgan DALIL
     (bola muvozanatini yo'qotdi) →
     BE GOING TO.

  4  'ON SATURDAY EVENING' + restoran nomi →
     ANIQ VAQT, joy band qilingan →
     PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

  5  'I CAN'T SEE YOU at the weekend.' →
     Nega ko'risha olmaydi? Chunki BOShQA
     BELGILANGAN ishi bor →
     PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
     ('am going to visit' ham mumkin, lekin
      kelishilgan reja uchun present continuous
      tabiiyroq.)

  6  'I'M COLD.' → AYNI DAMDAGI qaror → WILL.
     'put ON' — ikki so'zli fe'l (kiymoq).

  7  'AT NOON' → ANIQ VAQT →
     PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
     'meet sb FOR coffee' — predlog FOR.

  8  'NEXT MONTH' + 'FLY' (harakat fe'li) →
     PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
     57-bet: harakat fe'llari (come, go, FLY,
     travel, leave) kelajak rejasida present
     continuous da keladi.

  9  'DON'T WORRY' → AYNI DAMDAGI yordam
     taklifi → WILL.


ENG MUHIM — 4, 5, 7, 8-BANDLAR:
  Hammasida ANIQ VAQT bor:
     'on Saturday evening'  (4)
     'at the weekend'       (5)
     'at noon'              (7)
     'next month'           (8)
  → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

  8-bandda qo'shimcha dalil: 'FLY' — harakat
  fe'li.


DIQQAT — 2-BANDDAGI 'LET':
  'let sb DO sth' — 'to' YO'Q!
     'Kelly will let you BORROW her CDs.'  ✓
     'Kelly will let you TO borrow ...'    ✗
  Shunday: 'make sb do sth', 'help sb do sth'.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an artist    = rassom
  to let       = ruxsat bermoq
  to borrow    = qarzga olmoq
  to fall off  = ... dan yiqilmoq
  a jacket     = kurtka
  at noon      = tushda (soat 12 da)
  a plumber    = santexnik ('b' O'QILMAYDI)
  a dishwasher = idish yuvish mashinasi

topics.topic: It / There va mashqlar — QOIDA (56 va 57-betlardan) · 7-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
QOIDA (56 va 57-betlardan):

  Bo'shliqdan keyin SIFAT bormi yoki OT?
     SIFAT  →  IT will be
     OT     →  THERE will be


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  THERE will be FEWER CARS in the future.
  2  IT     will be FOGGY in London tomorrow.
  3  THERE will be SUNSHINE in Madrid next week.
  4  IT     will be HOT in Rome tomorrow.
  5  THERE will be RAIN in Ankara today.
  6  THERE will be LESS POLLUTION in 20 years'
     time.
  7  IT     will be COLD in Prague tomorrow.
  8  THERE will be STRONG WINDS in Paris next
     week.

  IT — UChTA:      2, 4, 7
  THERE — BEShTA:  1, 3, 5, 6, 8


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Kelajakda mashinalar kamroq bo'ladi.
  2  Ertaga Londonda tumanli bo'ladi.
  3  Keyingi hafta Madridda quyoshli bo'ladi.
  4  Ertaga Rimda issiq bo'ladi.
  5  Bugun Ankarada yomg'ir bo'ladi.
  6  20 yildan keyin ifloslanish kamroq bo'ladi.
  7  Ertaga Pragada sovuq bo'ladi.
  8  Keyingi hafta Parijda kuchli shamollar
     bo'ladi.


HAR BIRI — SIFATMI YOKI OT:

  1  'fewer cars'      — OT (ko'plik)   → THERE
  2  'foggy'           — SIFAT ('-y')   → IT
  3  'sunshine'        — OT             → THERE
  4  'hot'             — SIFAT          → IT
  5  'rain'            — OT             → THERE
  6  'less pollution'  — OT             → THERE
  7  'cold'            — SIFAT          → IT
  8  'strong winds'    — OT (ko'plik)   → THERE


ENG MUHIM KUZATUV:
  Sifatlarning hammasi HOLATNI bildiradi
  (foggy, hot, cold) — 'IT' bilan.
  Otlarning hammasi NARSANI bildiradi
  (cars, sunshine, rain, pollution, winds) —
  'THERE' bilan.


DIQQAT — 4 va 7-BANDLAR:
  'hot' va 'cold' — bular ob-havo SIFATLARI,
  '-y' bilan tugamaydi, lekin baribir SIFAT →
  'IT will be'.

  Ot shakllari bo'lardi:
     'There will be HEAT.' (issiqlik)
     'There will be COLD WEATHER.' (sovuq ob-havo)


DIQQAT — 1 va 6-BANDLARDAGI QIYOSIY DARAJALAR:
  'FEWER cars'      — 'few' ning qiyosiy shakli
                      (SANALADIGAN otlar bilan)
  'LESS pollution'  — 'little' ning qiyosiy shakli
                      (SANALMAYDIGAN otlar bilan)

  Bu — Unit 12 dagi noto'g'ri sifatlar:
     few    → fewer  → the fewest
     little → less   → the least

  QOIDA:
     FEWER + SANALADIGAN ot   (fewer cars)
     LESS  + SANALMAYDIGAN ot (less pollution)


ShAHARLAR:
  London  — Britaniya poytaxti
  Madrid  — Ispaniya poytaxti
  Rome    — Italiya poytaxti
  Ankara  — Turkiya poytaxti
  Prague  — Chexiya poytaxti
  Paris   — Fransiya poytaxti

topics.topic: It / There va mashqlar — KITOBDAGI NAMUNA · 8b-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'Tom has toothache, SO HE IS GOING TO visit the
   dentist.'


QOLIP:
  [SABAB], SO + ega + IS/ARE GOING TO + ASOSIY
  fe'l.

  DIQQAT: 'so' dan OLDIN VERGUL.
  'so' — NATIJA bog'lovchisi (57-bet qoidasi).


BARCHA OLTI GAP:

  1  Tom has toothache, so he is going to visit
     the dentist.                       (NAMUNA)

  2  Amanda likes music, so she is going to take
     piano lessons.

  3  Chris wants to go on holiday, so he is going
     to save some money.

  4  Lisa needs to relax, so she is going to stay
     at home.

  5  Dave wants to have a party, so he is going to
     send invitations to his friends.

  6  Jill wants to take some pictures, so she is
     going to borrow a camera.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Tomning tishi og'riyapti, shuning uchun u
     tish shifokoriga bormoqchi.
  2  Amanda musiqani yaxshi ko'radi, shuning uchun
     u pianino darslariga bormoqchi.
  3  Kris ta'tilga bormoqchi, shuning uchun u pul
     yig'moqchi.
  4  Lizaga dam olish kerak, shuning uchun u uyda
     qolmoqchi.
  5  Deyv ziyofat qilmoqchi, shuning uchun u
     do'stlariga taklifnoma yubormoqchi.
  6  Jill surat olmoqchi, shuning uchun u
     fotoapparat qarzga olmoqchi.


OLMOShLAR — DIQQAT:
  Tom, Chris, Dave  →  HE  is going to
  Amanda, Lisa, Jill →  SHE is going to

  Hammasi BIRLIK → 'IS going to'.


ESLATMA — SHU GAPLARNI 'BECAUSE' BILAN HAM
AYTISh MUMKIN:
  'Tom is going to visit the dentist BECAUSE he
   has toothache.'
  Ma'no BIR XIL, faqat tartib TESKARI.

  Lekin kitob 'SO' ni so'ragan — shuning uchun
  SABAB birinchi, NATIJA ikkinchi.

topics.topic: It / There va mashqlar — KITOBDAGI UCh NAMUNA (1-band uchun) · 9b-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI UCh NAMUNA (1-band uchun):

  1) 'Cindy is going to save money BECAUSE she
      wants to buy a car.'
  2) 'Cindy wants to buy a car, SO she is going to
      save money.'
  3) 'Cindy is going to save money TO BUY a car.'

  Demak HAR BIR band uchun UChTA gap!


UCh QOLIP:

  1) BECAUSE (sabab):
     'Cindy is going to [NIYAT] BECAUSE she wants
      to [MAQSAD].'

  2) SO (natija):
     'Cindy wants to [MAQSAD], SO she is going to
      [NIYAT].'

  3) TO + fe'l (maqsad):
     'Cindy is going to [NIYAT] TO [MAQSAD].'


BARCHA BESh BAND — UChTADAN GAP:

─── 1  save money / buy a car ───     (NAMUNA)
  Cindy is going to save money because she wants
  to buy a car.
  Cindy wants to buy a car, so she is going to
  save money.
  Cindy is going to save money to buy a car.

─── 2  study hard / finish university ───
  Cindy is going to study hard because she wants
  to finish university.
  Cindy wants to finish university, so she is
  going to study hard.
  Cindy is going to study hard to finish
  university.

─── 3  take French lessons / get a job in France ───
  Cindy is going to take French lessons because
  she wants to get a job in France.
  Cindy wants to get a job in France, so she is
  going to take French lessons.
  Cindy is going to take French lessons to get a
  job in France.

─── 4  stay at home / relax ───
  Cindy is going to stay at home because she wants
  to relax.
  Cindy wants to relax, so she is going to stay at
  home.
  Cindy is going to stay at home to relax.

─── 5  buy a new dress / go to a party ───
  Cindy is going to buy a new dress because she
  wants to go to a party.
  Cindy wants to go to a party, so she is going to
  buy a new dress.
  Cindy is going to buy a new dress to go to a
  party.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI (har banddan bittadan):
  1  Sindi pul yig'moqchi, chunki mashina sotib
     olmoqchi.
  2  Sindi qattiq o'qimoqchi, chunki universitetni
     tugatmoqchi.
  3  Sindi fransuz tili darslariga bormoqchi,
     chunki Fransiyada ish topmoqchi.
  4  Sindi uyda qolmoqchi, chunki dam olmoqchi.
  5  Sindi yangi ko'ylak sotib olmoqchi, chunki
     ziyofatga bormoqchi.


ESLATMA — UCh ShAKLNING FARQI:
  BECAUSE  →  ergash gapda EGA va FE'L bor
              ('she wants to ...')
  SO       →  ergash gapda EGA va FE'L bor
              ('she is going to ...')
  TO + fe'l →  ergash gapda EGA YO'Q
              ('to buy a car')

  Uchinchi shakl eng QISQA.


Coursebook 95-BETDAGI 8-MAShQ BILAN AYNAN
BIR XIL TUZILISh.

topics.topic: be going to (1)
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI JADVAL — 'BE GOING TO' NING TO'RT
ShAKLI:

 ┌───────────────┬──────────────────────────────┐
 │ AFFIRMATIVE   │ I AM / You ARE / He IS, etc  │
 │ (tasdiq)      │ GOING TO move house.         │
 ├───────────────┼──────────────────────────────┤
 │ NEGATIVE      │ I'M NOT / You AREN'T /       │
 │ (inkor)       │ He ISN'T, etc                │
 │               │ GOING TO move house.         │
 ├───────────────┼──────────────────────────────┤
 │ INTERROGATIVE │ AM I / ARE you / IS he, etc  │
 │ (so'roq)      │ GOING TO move house?         │
 ├───────────────┼──────────────────────────────┤
 │ SHORT ANSWERS │ Yes, I AM / you ARE /        │
 │ (qisqa javob) │      he IS, etc.             │
 │               │ No, I'M NOT / you AREN'T /   │
 │               │     he ISN'T, etc.           │
 └───────────────┴──────────────────────────────┘


ENG MUHIM QOIDA:
  'be going to' da O'ZGARADIGAN QISM faqat
  'BE' fe'li (am / is / are).
  'going to' HECh QAChON o'zgarmaydi.

  TASDIQ:  ega + AM/IS/ARE + going to + fe'l
  INKOR:   ega + AM/IS/ARE + NOT + going to + fe'l
  SO'ROQ:  AM/IS/ARE + ega + going to + fe'l?


DIQQAT — INKORDA 'NOT' QAYERDA:
  'be' fe'lidan KEYIN:
     I AM NOT going to ...   → I'M NOT going to ...
     You ARE NOT going to ... → You AREN'T going to ...
     He IS NOT going to ...  → He ISN'T going to ...

  'I don't going to' XATO —
  'do/does' KERAK EMAS.


DIQQAT — SO'ROQDA 'BE' OLDINGA ChIQADI:
     'Are you going to move house?'  ✓
     'Do you going to move house?'   ✗


DIQQAT — QISQA JAVOBDA 'GOING TO' TAKRORLANMAYDI:
     'Are you going to move house?'
     'Yes, I AM.'          ✓
     'Yes, I am going to.' — to'liq, lekin qisqa
                             javob emas


'MOVE HOUSE' NIMA:
  'to move house' = boshqa uyga ko'chib o'tmoq.
  DIQQAT: 'house' oldidan artikl YO'Q —
  bu turg'un ibora.
examples: Affirmative: I am / You are / He is, etc going to move house.
Negative: I'm not / You aren't / He isn't, etc going to move house.
Interrogative: Am I / Are you / Is he, etc going to move house?
Short answers: Yes, I am / you are / he is, etc. No, I'm not / you aren't / he isn't, etc.
to move house

topics.topic: be going to (2)
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI IKKINChI QUTI:

  'We use BE GOING TO to talk about FUTURE PLANS
   AND INTENTIONS. We use the PRESENT CONTINUOUS
   to talk about FIXED FUTURE ARRANGEMENTS.'

  = 'be going to' ni KELAJAK REJALARI va
    NIYATLARI haqida gapirish uchun ishlatamiz.
    'present continuous' ni esa QAT'IY
    BELGILANGAN kelajak ishlari haqida gapirish
    uchun ishlatamiz.


KITOBDAGI IKKI RASM VA GAP:

  CHAP RASM — plans/intentions (BE GOING TO)
     Yigit qizga gapiryapti:
     'I'M GOING TO fly to Poland SOON.'
     (Yaqinda Polshaga uchmoqchiman.)
     → 'soon' = yaqinda — ANIQ vaqt YO'Q.
       Hali chipta olinmagan, faqat NIYAT.

  O'NG RASM — fixed arrangements
               (PRESENT CONTINUOUS)
     Yigit qo'lida ChIPTA ushlab turibdi:
     'I'M FLYING to Poland AT 7 O'CLOCK.'
     (Soat yettida Polshaga uchaman.)
     → 'at 7 o'clock' = ANIQ vaqt.
       Chipta olingan, hamma narsa TAYYOR.

  DIQQAT: rasmda yigitning qo'lida ChIPTA bor —
  kitob shu bilan farqni KO'RSATMOQDA.


ENG SODDA QOIDA:

     ANIQ VAQT (sana, soat) bormi?
        HA   →  PRESENT CONTINUOUS
        YO'Q →  BE GOING TO


JENNINING XATIDA BU QOIDA ANIQ IShLAGAN:

  BE GOING TO (sana YO'Q):
     'we're GOING TO stay at a fabulous hotel'
     'I'm GOING TO relax'
     'I'm GOING TO work at a cafe'
     'I'm GOING TO join a gym'
     'I'm GOING TO start a computer course'

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS (sana BOR):
     'We're LEAVING ON 1ST JUNE.'
     'We're COMING BACK ... ON 30TH JUNE.'
     'ON 16TH AUGUST we're HAVING a garden party.'

  BEShTA 'be going to' — hech qaysisida sana yo'q.
  UChTA 'present continuous' — uchalasida ham
  sana bor.
  BITTA ISTISNO ham yo'q.


QO'ShIMChA MISOLLAR:

  'I'm going to visit my grandmother.'
     (Buvimnikiga bormoqchiman — qachonligi
      hali aniq emas.)

  'I'm visiting my grandmother on Sunday.'
     (Yakshanba kuni buvimnikiga boraman —
      kelishilgan.)

  'We're going to move house.'
     (Ko'chib o'tmoqchimiz — reja.)

  'We're moving house next Friday.'
     (Keyingi juma ko'chib o'tamiz — sana
      belgilangan.)
examples: We use be going to to talk about future plans and intentions.
We use the present continuous to talk about fixed future arrangements.
plans/intentions — be going to: I'm going to fly to Poland soon.
fixed arrangements — present continuous: I'm flying to Poland at 7 o'clock.
Simple rule: is there a fixed time? Yes → present continuous. No → be going to.
topics.source: Coursebook, 93-bet, 'be going to - present continuous' qutisi

topics.topic: be going to — RO'YXAT (9 ta mashg'ulot) · 5-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
RO'YXAT (9 ta mashg'ulot):
  stay at home            (uyda qolmoq)
  watch TV                (televizor ko'rmoq)
  meet my friends         (do'stlarim bilan
                           uchrashmoq)
  have a party            (ziyofat qilmoq)
  play football           (futbol o'ynamoq)
  study for a test        (imtihonga tayyorlanmoq)
  fly to New Delhi        (Nyu-Delhiga uchmoq)
  listen to music and relax (musiqa tinglab dam
                             olmoq)
  clean my room           (xonamni yig'ishtirmoq)


KITOBDAGI IKKI NAMUNA:
  ✓ 'I'M GOING TO listen to music and relax.'
  ✗ 'I'M NOT GOING TO fly to New Delhi.'


TOPShIRIQ:
  UChTA ✓ gap  +  UChTA ✗ gap = jami OLTITA


QOLIP:
  ✓  I'M GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.
  ✗  I'M NOT GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.

  DIQQAT: 'I' bilan DOIM 'AM' →
  'I'm going to' / 'I'm not going to'.


NAMUNA JAVOB (oltita gap):

  QILMOQChIMAN (✓):
     I'm going to listen to music and relax.
                                        (NAMUNA)
     I'm going to meet my friends.
     I'm going to study for a test.

  QILMOQChI EMASMAN (✗):
     I'm not going to fly to New Delhi.  (NAMUNA)
     I'm not going to have a party.
     I'm not going to clean my room.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  Musiqa tinglab dam olmoqchiman.
  Do'stlarim bilan uchrashmoqchiman.
  Imtihonga tayyorlanmoqchiman.
  Nyu-Delhiga uchmoqchi emasman.
  Ziyofat qilmoqchi emasman.
  Xonamni yig'ishtirmoqchi emasman.


DIQQAT — 'FLY TO NEW DELHI' NEGA NAMUNADA ✗:
  Bu — ro'yxatdagi eng EHTIMOLSIZ ish.
  Kitob uni ataylab ✗ namunasi qilib olgan.


DIQQAT — FE'L BIRIKMALARI:
  'STAY AT home'      — predlog AT, artikl YO'Q
  'WATCH TV'          — 'TV' oldidan artikl YO'Q
  'MEET my friends'   — predlogsiz
  'HAVE a party'      — 'make a party' XATO
  'PLAY football'     — sport oldidan artikl YO'Q
  'STUDY FOR a test'  — predlog FOR
  'FLY TO' + shahar   — predlog TO
  'LISTEN TO music'   — predlog TO
  'CLEAN my room'     — predlogsiz


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a test      = imtihon, nazorat ishi
  to study for = ... ga tayyorlanmoq
  New Delhi   = Nyu-Delhi (Hindiston poytaxti)
  to clean    = tozalamoq, yig'ishtirmoq

topics.topic: be going to / present continuous — TOMNING KUNDALIGI · 6-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
TOMNING KUNDALIGI:

     SATURDAY 4th JULY
     ─────────────────────────────────────
     10 am:  visit the dentist
     11 am:  meet Frank for coffee
      1 pm:  have lunch with Jane
      5 pm:  catch the train to London


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: 'What IS Tom DOING at ten o'clock?'
  SB: 'He'S VISITING the dentist at ten o'clock.'


NEGA PRESENT CONTINUOUS:
  Bu ishlar KUNDALIKKA yozilgan — ya'ni
  QAT'IY BELGILANGAN (fixed arrangements).
  Har birining ANIQ SOATI bor.

  93-betdagi qoida: aniq vaqt bor →
  PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

  'He's GOING TO visit the dentist' bo'lsa —
  shunchaki niyat bo'lardi, kundalikka
  yozilmagan bo'lardi.


QOLIP:
  SAVOL:  What IS + ega + DOING at [soat]?
  JAVOB:  ega + 'S + fe'l-ING + at [soat].


BARCHA TO'RT SAVOL-JAVOB:

  1  SA: What is Tom doing at ten o'clock?
     SB: He's visiting the dentist at ten
         o'clock.                      (NAMUNA)

  2  SA: What is Tom doing at eleven o'clock?
     SB: He's meeting Frank for coffee at eleven
         o'clock.

  3  SA: What is Tom doing at one o'clock?
     SB: He's having lunch with Jane at one
         o'clock.

  4  SA: What is Tom doing at five o'clock?
     SB: He's catching the train to London at five
         o'clock.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Tom soat o'nda nima qiladi? —
     Soat o'nda tish shifokoriga boradi.
  2  Tom soat o'n birda nima qiladi? —
     Soat o'n birda Frank bilan qahva ichgani
     uchrashadi.
  3  Tom soat birda nima qiladi? —
     Soat birda Jeyn bilan tushlik qiladi.
  4  Tom soat beshda nima qiladi? —
     Soat beshda Londonga poyezdga chiqadi.


DIQQAT — 'VISIT THE DENTIST':
  'visit the dentist' = tish shifokoriga bormoq.
  'the dentist' — ANIQ artikl bilan
  ('a dentist' emas), chunki bu turg'un ibora.
  Shunday: 'go to the doctor', 'go to the
  dentist'.

DIQQAT — 'CATCH THE TRAIN':
  'catch a train / bus / plane' = poyezdga
  (avtobusga, samolyotga) chiqmoq, ulgurmoq.
  'to catch' = ushlamoq, lekin transport bilan
  'ulgurib chiqmoq' ma'nosida.
  Aksi: 'to MISS the train' (poyezdni boy bermoq).

DIQQAT — 'MEET sb FOR sth':
  'meet Frank FOR coffee' = Frank bilan qahva
  ichgani uchrashmoq.
  'for' bu yerda MAQSADNI bildiradi.

DIQQAT — SOATLARNI O'QISh:
  10 am → 'ten o'clock' (ertalabki 10)
  11 am → 'eleven o'clock'
   1 pm → 'one o'clock' (kunduzgi 1)
   5 pm → 'five o'clock'
  'am' = tushdan oldin, 'pm' = tushdan keyin.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an arrangement = belgilangan ish, kelishuv
  a dentist      = tish shifokori
  to catch a train = poyezdga chiqmoq
  am / pm        = tushdan oldin / tushdan keyin

topics.topic: be going to / present continuous
topics.rule_uz:
93-BETDAGI QUTINING DAVOMI.

93-betda o'rgangan edik:
  BE GOING TO       →  reja va niyat
  PRESENT CONTINUOUS →  qat'iy belgilangan ish

BU BETDA YANA IKKI VAZIFA:

  • 'We also use BE GOING TO for PREDICTIONS
     BASED ON EVIDENCE IN THE PRESENT.'
    = 'be going to' ni HOZIRGI DALILGA asoslangan
      bashorat uchun ham ishlatamiz.

  • 'We also use the PRESENT CONTINUOUS for
     ACTIONS HAPPENING NOW, at the moment of
     speaking.'
    = 'present continuous' ni HOZIR, gapirayotgan
      paytda sodir bo'layotgan harakat uchun ham
      ishlatamiz.


KITOBDAGI IKKI RASM:

  CHAP RASM — be going to: DALIL
     Odam osmonga qaraydi, osmonda QORA BULUTLAR.
     'There are dark clouds in the sky.
      IT'S GOING TO RAIN.'
     (Osmonda qora bulutlar bor.
