      Yomg'ir yog'adi.)
     → Yomg'ir HALI YOG'MAGAN, lekin DALIL bor
       (qora bulutlar) → 'be going to'.

  O'NG RASM — present continuous: HOZIR
     Xuddi shu odam, endi soyabon ostida,
     yomg'ir yog'moqda.
     'IT'S RAINING.'
     (Yomg'ir yog'yapti.)
     → Yomg'ir HOZIR yog'moqda → present
       continuous.


ENDI 'BE GOING TO' NING IKKI VAZIFASI BOR:

  1) REJA va NIYAT (93-bet)
     'I'm going to start a computer course.'
     → o'zim hal qilganman

  2) DALILGA ASOSLANGAN BAShORAT (94-bet)
     'It's going to rain.'
     → osmonda qora bulutlar bor (KO'RINIB
       TURIBDI)


VA 'PRESENT CONTINUOUS' NING HAM IKKI VAZIFASI:

  1) QAT'IY BELGILANGAN kelajak ishi (93-bet)
     'We're leaving on 1st June.'
     → chipta olingan

  2) HOZIR sodir bo'layotgan harakat (94-bet)
     'It's raining.'
     → ayni damda


QANDAY AJRATISh — ENG SODDA USUL:

  Harakat HOZIR sodir bo'layaptimi?
     HA   →  PRESENT CONTINUOUS ('It's raining')
     YO'Q →  hali bo'lmagan:
              vaqti belgilanganmi?
                 HA   → PRESENT CONTINUOUS
                        ('We're leaving on 1st June')
                 YO'Q → BE GOING TO
                        ('It's going to rain')


QO'ShIMChA MISOLLAR — DALILGA ASOSLANGAN BAShORAT:

  'Look at that car! It'S GOING TO crash!'
     (Ana u mashinaga qara! U urilib ketadi!)
     → dalil: mashina nazoratdan chiqqan

  'She's very pale. She'S GOING TO faint.'
     (U juda oqarib ketgan. Hushidan ketadi.)
     → dalil: rangi oqargan

  'The team is playing badly. They'RE GOING TO
   lose.'
     (Jamoa yomon o'ynayapti. Yutqazadi.)
     → dalil: yomon o'yin


DIQQAT — 'WILL' BILAN FARQI:
  'It'S GOING TO rain.'  → DALIL bor (qora bulut)
  'I think it WILL rain.' → shunchaki FIKR, dalil
                            yo'q
  Ikkalasi ham bashorat, lekin asosi boshqa.
examples: We also use be going to for predictions based on evidence in the present.
There are dark clouds in the sky. It's going to rain.
We also use the present continuous for actions happening now, at the moment of speaking.
It's raining.
be going to: evidence that something is going to happen
present continuous: action happening now
It's going to rain. (evidence) ↔ I think it will rain. (just an opinion)

topics.topic: Reason/Result/Purpose, Will — Sabab/Natija/Maqsad, Will (1)
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI:

  • SABABNI 'BECAUSE' bilan, NATIJANI 'SO' bilan
    ifodalaymiz.
  • SABAB yoki MAQSADNI 'TO + fe'l' bilan ham
    ifodalaymiz (maqsad infinitivi).


UCh NAMUNA — BIR XIL FIKR, UCh XIL SHAKL:

  1) BECAUSE (sabab):
     'She's going to join a gym BECAUSE she wants
      to lose some weight.'
     (U sport zaliga a'zo bo'lmoqchi, CHUNKI vazn
      tashlamoqchi.)

  2) SO (natija):
     'She wants to lose some weight, SO she's
      going to join a gym.'
     (U vazn tashlamoqchi, ShUNING UChUN sport
      zaliga a'zo bo'lmoqchi.)

  3) TO + fe'l (maqsad):
     'She's going to join a gym TO LOSE some
      weight.'
     (U vazn tashlash UChUN sport zaliga a'zo
      bo'lmoqchi.)


ENG MUHIM — GAP TARTIBI:

  BECAUSE:
     [NATIJA] because [SABAB]
     'join a gym'  ←  'wants to lose weight'
     Ya'ni SABAB 'because' dan KEYIN.

  SO:
     [SABAB], so [NATIJA]
     'wants to lose weight'  →  'join a gym'
     Ya'ni NATIJA 'so' dan KEYIN.

  TARTIB TESKARI! Bu — eng ko'p xato qilinadigan
  joy.


'TO + fe'l' (maqsad infinitivi):
  Eng QISQA shakl.
  Ergash gapda EGA YO'Q:
     'to lose some weight'  ✓
     'to she loses weight'  ✗

  DIQQAT: 'because' dan keyin EGA va FE'L bo'ladi
  ('because SHE WANTS'), 'to' dan keyin esa
  faqat FE'L.


QO'ShIMChA MISOLLAR:

  'I'm going to the shop BECAUSE I need some
   milk.'
  'I need some milk, SO I'm going to the shop.'
  'I'm going to the shop TO BUY some milk.'

  'He studies hard BECAUSE he wants to pass his
   exams.'
  'He wants to pass his exams, SO he studies
   hard.'
  'He studies hard TO PASS his exams.'


DIQQAT — 93-BETDAGI Speaking MAShQI BILAN
BOG'LIQ:
  U yerda 'because' yoki 'to-inf' bilan gaplarni
  birlashtirgan edingiz:
     'She is going to join a gym TO LOSE some
      weight.'
     'She is going to relax BECAUSE she's quite
      tired.'
examples: We express reason with because and result with so.
We also express reason or purpose with to-infinitive (infinitive of purpose).
She's going to join a gym because she wants to lose some weight.
She wants to lose some weight, so she's going to join a gym.
She's going to join a gym to lose some weight.
topics.source: Coursebook, 95-bet, 'Expressing Reason, Result or Purpose' qutisi

topics.topic: Reason/Result/Purpose, Will — KITOBDAGI UCh NAMUNA (1-band uchun) · 8b-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI UCh NAMUNA (1-band uchun):

  1) 'Tony is going to save money BECAUSE he wants
      to go on holiday.'
  2) 'Tony wants to go on holiday, SO he is going
      to save money.'
  3) 'Tony is going to save money TO GO on
      holiday.'

  Demak HAR BIR band uchun UChTA gap tuziladi!


QOLIPLAR:

  1) BECAUSE:
     'Tony is going to [NIYAT] BECAUSE he wants to
      [SABAB].'

  2) SO:
     'Tony wants to [SABAB], SO he is going to
      [NIYAT].'

  3) TO + fe'l:
     'Tony is going to [NIYAT] TO [SABAB].'


BARCHA BESh BAND — UChTADAN GAP:

─── 1  save money / go on holiday ───  (NAMUNA)
  Tony is going to save money because he wants to
  go on holiday.
  Tony wants to go on holiday, so he is going to
  save money.
  Tony is going to save money to go on holiday.

─── 2  join a gym / keep fit ───
  Tony is going to join a gym because he wants to
  keep fit.
  Tony wants to keep fit, so he is going to join a
  gym.
  Tony is going to join a gym to keep fit.

─── 3  stop eating sweets / lose weight ───
  Tony is going to stop eating sweets because he
  wants to lose weight.
  Tony wants to lose weight, so he is going to
  stop eating sweets.
  Tony is going to stop eating sweets to lose
  weight.

─── 4  study hard / pass his exams ───
  Tony is going to study hard because he wants to
  pass his exams.
  Tony wants to pass his exams, so he is going to
  study hard.
  Tony is going to study hard to pass his exams.

─── 5  learn English / get a better job ───
  Tony is going to learn English because he wants
  to get a better job.
  Tony wants to get a better job, so he is going
  to learn English.
  Tony is going to learn English to get a better
  job.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI (har banddan bittadan):
  1  Toni pul yig'moqchi, chunki ta'tilga
     bormoqchi.
  2  Toni sport zaliga a'zo bo'lmoqchi, chunki
     sog'lom bo'lmoqchi.
  3  Toni shirinlik yeyishni to'xtatmoqchi, chunki
     vazn tashlamoqchi.
  4  Toni qattiq o'qimoqchi, chunki imtihonlardan
     o'tmoqchi.
  5  Toni ingliz tilini o'rganmoqchi, chunki
     yaxshiroq ish topmoqchi.


DIQQAT — 'STOP EATING':
  'stop' dan keyin fe'l '-ING' oladi:
     'stop EATING sweets'  ✓
     'stop to eat sweets'  — boshqa ma'no
       (yeyish uchun to'xtamoq)

DIQQAT — 'SO' DAN OLDIN VERGUL:
  'Tony wants to go on holiday, SO he is going to
   save money.'
  Vergul SHART.

topics.topic: Reason/Result/Purpose, Will — Sabab/Natija/Maqsad, Will (2)
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI — 'WILL' NING IKKI VAZIFASI:

  We use WILL:

  1) TO MAKE PREDICTIONS (bashorat qilish)
     'In 100 years' time, there WILL BE underwater
      cities.'
     (100 yildan keyin suv ostida shaharlar
      bo'ladi.)
     → Bu shunchaki FIKR, dalil yo'q.

  2) TO MAKE ON-THE-SPOT DECISIONS
     (shu payt qabul qilingan qaror)
     'I'LL HAVE soup first, then steak and chips.'
     (Avval sho'rva, keyin bifshteks va kartoshka
      olaman.)
     → Menyuga qarab AYNI DAMDA hal qildi.


KELASI ZAMON BILAN IShLATILADIGAN VAQT IBORALARI:
     tomorrow              (ertaga)
     soon                  (yaqinda)
     next week/month/etc   (keyingi hafta/oy)
     the day after tomorrow (indinga)
     in 100 years' time    (100 yildan keyin)


ENG MUHIM FARQ — 'WILL' va 'BE GOING TO':

  BASHORATDA:
     'It's GOING TO rain.'
        → DALIL bor (qora bulutlar KO'RINIB
          turibdi)
     'I think it WILL rain.'
        → shunchaki FIKR, dalil YO'Q

  QARORDA:
     'I'M GOING TO join a gym.'
        → OLDINDAN o'ylangan reja
     'I'LL close the window.'
        → AYNI DAMDA hal qilindi
          (sovqotgani uchun)


QANDAY AJRATISh — SODDA USUL:
  Qaror QAChON qabul qilingan?
     ALLAQAChON  →  BE GOING TO
     HOZIRGINA   →  WILL

  Bashorat NIMAGA asoslangan?
     KO'RINIB turgan DALILGA  →  BE GOING TO
     shunchaki FIKRGA         →  WILL


'WILL' NING ShAKLLARI:
  TASDIQ:  ega + WILL + ASOSIY fe'l
              'I will close the window.'
              → 'I'LL close the window.'
  INKOR:   ega + WON'T + ASOSIY fe'l
              'It won't rain.'
  SO'ROQ:  WILL + ega + ASOSIY fe'l?
              'Will it be sunny?'
  QISQA JAVOB:
              'Yes, it will.' / 'No, it won't.'

  DIQQAT: 'will' dan keyin fe'lning ASOSIY shakli
  ('will to go', 'will goes', 'will going' XATO).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a prediction        = bashorat
  an on-the-spot decision = shu payt qabul
                        qilingan qaror
  underwater          = suv ostidagi
  in 100 years' time  = 100 yildan keyin
  the day after tomorrow = indinga
  steak and chips     = bifshteks va qovurilgan
                        kartoshka
examples: We use will to make predictions.
In 100 years' time, there will be underwater cities.
We use will to make on-the-spot decisions.
I'll have soup first, then steak and chips.
Time expressions used with future tenses: tomorrow, soon, next week/month/etc, the day after tomorrow, etc.
will + base form: I'll close the window. It won't rain. Will it be sunny? — Yes, it will. / No, it won't.

topics.topic: Reason/Result/Purpose, Will — Sabab/Natija/Maqsad, Will (3)
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI — ENG QISQA, LEKIN JUDA MUHIM:

  'IT WILL BE + ADJECTIVE (SIFAT)'
     'It will be RAINY tomorrow.'
     (Ertaga yomg'irli bo'ladi.)

  'THERE WILL BE + NOUN (OT)'
     'There will be RAIN tomorrow.'
     (Ertaga yomg'ir bo'ladi.)


ENG MUHIM QOIDA:
  Bo'shliqdan keyin SIFAT bormi yoki OT?

     SIFAT  →  IT will be
     OT     →  THERE will be


OB-HAVO JUFTLIKLARI — SIFAT va OT:

     SIFAT          OT
     ─────────────  ─────────────
     rainy          rain
     sunny          sunshine
     foggy          fog
     snowy          snow
     windy          strong winds
     cloudy         clouds
     stormy         a storm

  Har juftlik uchun ikki xil gap tuzish mumkin:
     'IT will be RAINY tomorrow.'    (sifat)
     'THERE will be RAIN tomorrow.'  (ot)
     Ma'no BIR XIL.


10a-MAShQDAGI NAMUNALAR — AYNAN ShU QOIDA:
  'IT will be SUNNY in Bangkok tomorrow.'
     ('sunny' — SIFAT → IT)
  'THERE will be SUNSHINE in Bangkok tomorrow.'
     ('sunshine' — OT → THERE)


DIQQAT — 'STRONG WINDS' KO'PLIK:
  'THERE WILL BE strong winds.'
  'wind' — sanaladigan ot bo'lishi mumkin;
  ob-havo haqida odatda KO'PLIK: 'strong winds'.

DIQQAT — 'SNOW' va 'SNOWY':
  'snow' — OT (SANALMAYDIGAN) → 'There will be
           SNOW.'
  'snowy' — SIFAT → 'It will be SNOWY.'
examples: It will be + adjective: It will be rainy tomorrow.
There will be + noun: There will be rain tomorrow.
rainy (adj) ↔ rain (noun); sunny ↔ sunshine; foggy ↔ fog; snowy ↔ snow; windy ↔ strong winds
topics.source: Coursebook, 95-bet, 'It will be - There will be' qutisi

topics.topic: be going to (Jill's barbecue) — SAKKIZ MAHSULOT — har birida ✓ yoki ✗ belgisi · 4-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
SAKKIZ MAHSULOT — har birida ✓ yoki ✗ belgisi:

     a  biscuits   ✗   (pechenye)
     b  onions     ✓   (piyoz)
     c  meat       ✓   (go'sht)
     d  pizza      ✗   (pitsa)
     e  chicken    ✓   (tovuq)
     f  bread      ✓   (non)
     g  eggs       ✗   (tuxum)
     h  potatoes   ✗   (kartoshka)

  OLADI (✓):     b, c, e, f  — onions, meat,
                              chicken, bread
  OLMAYDI (✗):   a, d, g, h  — biscuits, pizza,
                              eggs, potatoes


BARCHA SAKKIZ GAP:

  a  She isn't going to buy any biscuits.
  b  She's going to buy some onions.
  c  She's going to buy some meat.
  d  She isn't going to buy any pizza.
  e  She's going to buy some chicken.
  f  She's going to buy some bread.
  g  She isn't going to buy any eggs.
  h  She isn't going to buy any potatoes.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  a  U pechenye sotib olmoqchi emas.
  b  U piyoz sotib olmoqchi.
  c  U go'sht sotib olmoqchi.
  d  U pitsa sotib olmoqchi emas.
  e  U tovuq sotib olmoqchi.
  f  U non sotib olmoqchi.
  g  U tuxum sotib olmoqchi emas.
  h  U kartoshka sotib olmoqchi emas.


ENG MUHIM — 'SOME' va 'ANY':

  TASDIQ gapda   →  SOME
     'She's going to buy SOME onions.'

  INKOR gapda    →  ANY
     'She isn't going to buy ANY biscuits.'

  Bu — Unit 8 ('Enjoy your Meal') qoidasi,
  bu yerda takrorlanmoqda.


QOLIP:
  ✓  She'S GOING TO buy SOME + ot.
  ✗  She ISN'T GOING TO buy ANY + ot.

  DIQQAT: 'not' 'be' fe'lidan KEYIN
  ('is not' → 'isn't').


OTLARNING TURI — DIQQAT:

  SANALADIGAN (ko'plikda):
     biscuits, onions, eggs, potatoes

  SANALMAYDIGAN:
     meat, chicken, bread
     ('a meat', 'a bread' XATO)

  IKKALASI HAM BO'LADI:
     pizza — butun pitsa bo'lsa 'a pizza'
             (sanaladigan), umuman ovqat sifatida
             'pizza' (sanalmaydigan)
     Bu yerda umumiy ma'noda → 'ANY pizza'.

  DIQQAT: 'some' va 'any' IKKALA turda ham
  ishlatiladi — shuning uchun bu mashqda
  chalkashish yo'q.


NEGA ShU MAHSULOTLAR — BARBEKYU MANTIQI:

  OLADI:
     go'sht va tovuq — barbekyuda pishiriladi
     piyoz — go'sht bilan
     non — go'sht bilan yeyiladi

  OLMAYDI:
     pechenye, pitsa — barbekyuga mos emas
     tuxum, kartoshka — uyda bor bo'lsa kerak


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a barbecue = barbekyu (ochiq havoda go'sht
               pishirish)
  biscuits   = pechenye (Amerikada: cookies)
  an onion   = piyoz
  meat       = go'sht (SANALMAYDIGAN)
  chicken    = tovuq (SANALMAYDIGAN — go'sht
               sifatida)
  bread      = non (SANALMAYDIGAN)

topics.topic: be going to / present continuous — 52-BETDAGI 4-MAShQNING DAVOMI — · 4-davomi-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
52-BETDAGI 4-MAShQNING DAVOMI —
yozish uchun bo'sh qatorlar shu betda.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'She ISN'T GOING TO buy ANY biscuits.'


BARCHA SAKKIZ GAP:

  a  She isn't going to buy any biscuits. (NAMUNA)
  b  She's going to buy some onions.
  c  She's going to buy some meat.
  d  She isn't going to buy any pizza.
  e  She's going to buy some chicken.
  f  She's going to buy some bread.
  g  She isn't going to buy any eggs.
  h  She isn't going to buy any potatoes.


QOIDA:
  ✓  →  'She'S GOING TO buy SOME ...'
  ✗  →  'She ISN'T GOING TO buy ANY ...'

  TASDIQ → SOME, INKOR → ANY.

topics.topic: be going to / present continuous — BESh KO'RSATMA · 5a-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
BESh KO'RSATMA:
  1  Where/go?
  2  How/get there?
  3  Where/stay?
  4  Who/go with?
  5  How long/go for?


ENG MUHIM — NEGA PRESENT CONTINUOUS:
  Mashq boshida aytilgan:
  'Hilary has made ALL THE NECESSARY
   ARRANGEMENTS for her trip NEXT MONDAY.'

  Ya'ni hammasi ALLAQAChON kelishilgan —
  chipta olingan, mehmonxona band qilingan.
  → QAT'IY BELGILANGAN ish → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

  (Coursebook 93-bet va Grammar 57-bet qoidasi.)


QOLIP:
  [savol so'zi] + ARE + you + fe'l-ING + ... ?


BARCHA BESh SAVOL:

  1  Where ARE you GOING?
  2  How ARE you GETTING there?
  3  Where ARE you STAYING?
  4  Who ARE you GOING with?
  5  How long ARE you GOING for?


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Qayerga ketyapsan?
  2  U yerga qanday borasan?
  3  Qayerda turasan?
  4  Kim bilan ketyapsan?
  5  Qancha vaqtga ketyapsan?


DIQQAT — PREDLOG GAP OXIRIDA:
  4-savol: 'Who are you going WITH?'
  5-savol: 'How long are you going FOR?'

  Predlog savol so'zi bilan birga oldinga
  ChIQMAYDI — u gap OXIRIDA qoladi.
  Bu — Unit 11 (Workbook 46-bet) qoidasi.


DIQQAT — 'HOW LONG ... FOR?':
  'How long are you going FOR?'
  = Qancha VAQTGA ketyapsan?
  Javob: 'For a week.' (bir haftaga)

  Agar 'for' bo'lmasa, ma'no o'zgaradi.


DIQQAT — 'GET THERE':
  'How are you GETTING THERE?'
  = U yerga qanday borasan? (transport haqida)
  'get there' — predlogSIZ ('get to there' XATO).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  arrangements = kelishilgan ishlar, tayyorgarlik
  necessary    = kerakli, zarur
  a trip       = safar
  to get there = u yerga yetib bormoq

topics.topic: be going to / present continuous — RO'YXAT (10 ta ibora) · 6-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
RO'YXAT (10 ta ibora):
  miss the train, crash, make some tea,
  change it, shout at us, take some photos,
  play in the snow, fall off, sell his house,
  make a cake


HAR GAPDA IKKI QISM:
  1-gap — HOZIRGI DALIL (nima ko'rinib turibdi)
  2-gap — DALILGA ASOSLANGAN BAShORAT
          ('be going to')

  Bu — Grammar 56-57-betlardagi qoida:
  'be going to' hozirgi dalilga asoslangan
  bashorat uchun ham ishlatiladi.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  She IS GOING TO CRASH.            (NAMUNA)
   2  They ARE GOING TO MISS THE TRAIN.
   3  He IS GOING TO SHOUT AT US.
   4  He IS GOING TO TAKE SOME PHOTOS.
   5  He IS GOING TO SELL HIS HOUSE.
   6  He IS GOING TO CHANGE IT.
   7  She IS GOING TO MAKE A CAKE.
   8  He IS GOING TO FALL OFF.
   9  They ARE GOING TO PLAY IN THE SNOW.
  10  He IS GOING TO MAKE SOME TEA.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
   1  U mashinani to'xtata olmayapti!
      U urilib ketadi.
   2  Ular kechikishyapti.
      Ular poyezdni boy berishadi.
   3  Direktor jahli chiqqanga o'xshaydi!
      U bizga baqiradi.
   4  Jimning fotoapparati bor.
      U surat oladi.
   5  Mik 'Sotiladi' taxtachasini o'rnatyapti.
      U uyini sotmoqchi.
   6  Mashinaning g'ildiragi teshilgan.
      U uni almashtiradi.
   7  Oyim retseptga qarayapti.
      U tort pishirmoqchi.
   8  Qara, narvon singan.
      Voy, u yiqiladi.
   9  Ular shapka va qo'lqoplarini kiyishyapti.
      Ular qorda o'ynashmoqchi.
  10  Kevin choynakni qo'yyapti.
      U choy damlamoqchi.


HAR BIRI — DALIL → NATIJA:

   1  Mashinani to'xtata olmayapti → URILADI
   2  Kechikishyapti → POYEZDNI BOY BERIShADI
   3  Direktorning jahli chiqqan → BAQIRADI
   4  Fotoapparati bor → SURAT OLADI
   5  'Sotiladi' taxtachasi → UYINI SOTADI
   6  G'ildirak teshilgan → ALMAShTIRADI
   7  Retseptga qarayapti → TORT PIShIRADI
   8  Narvon singan → YIQILADI
   9  Shapka va qo'lqop kiyishyapti → QORDA
      O'YNAShADI
  10  Choynakni qo'yyapti → ChOY DAMLAYDI


ENG MUHIM — IKKI XIL 'BE GOING TO':

  NIYAT (odam O'ZI hal qilgan):
     5  sell his house
     6  change it
     7  make a cake
     9  play in the snow
    10  make some tea

  BAShORAT (odam XOHLAMAYDI, lekin sodir bo'ladi):
     1  crash
     2  miss the train
     3  shout at us
     8  fall off

  Ikkalasi ham 'be going to' bilan beriladi —
  farqi faqat MA'NODA.


EGALARGA E'TIBOR BERING:
  BIRLIK (She/He) → 'IS going to'
     1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10
  KO'PLIK (They)  → 'ARE going to'
     2, 9


DIQQAT — 6-BANDDAGI 'IT':
  'The car has got a flat TYRE. He is going to
   CHANGE IT.'
  'it' = g'ildirak (tyre).
  'change' bu yerda 'almashtirmoq' ma'nosida.

DIQQAT — 8-BANDDAGI 'FALL OFF':
  'fall OFF' = (narvondan) yiqilmoq.
  Predlog OFF — narsadan tushib ketish.
  Grammar 58-bet, 6-mashqning 3-bandida ham:
  'He is going to fall off his bike.'

DIQQAT — 3-BANDDAGI 'SHOUT AT':
  'shout AT sb' = kimgadir BAQIRMOQ (jahl bilan).
  'shout TO sb' = kimgadir baland ovozda
  gapirmoq (uzoqdan chaqirish).
  Ma'nosi BOShQA!


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to crash        = urilib ketmoq
  to miss a train = poyezdni boy bermoq
  a headmaster    = maktab direktori
  to shout at     = ... ga baqirmoq
  a flat tyre     = teshilgan g'ildirak
  a recipe        = retsept ('RE-si-pi')
  a ladder        = narvon
  gloves          = qo'lqoplar
  a kettle        = choynak (suv qaynatgich)

topics.topic: be going to / present continuous — TO'RT KO'RSATMA va RASM (fikr pufaklarida) · 7-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
TO'RT KO'RSATMA va RASM (fikr pufaklarida):

  1  order / wedding cake
     (to'y torti buyurtma qilmoq)
     Rasmda: uch qavatli to'y torti, ustida
     kelin-kuyov haykalchasi

  2  buy / new clothes
     (yangi kiyim sotib olmoq)
     Rasmda: kostyum, ko'ylak va galstuk

  3  hire / photographer
     (fotograf yollamoq)
     Rasmda: fotoapparatli ayol

  4  send / invitations
     (taklifnomalar yubormoq)
     Rasmda: 'Invitation' yozuvli kartochka

  Pastda Jek va Mendi tasvirlangan — bu ularning
  REJALARI.


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  'They'RE GOING TO order a wedding cake.'


QOLIP:
  They'RE GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l + ... .

  DIQQAT: IKKI kishi (Jack AND Mandy) →
  'THEY ARE' ('They're').


BARCHA TO'RT GAP:

  1  They're going to order a wedding cake.
                                        (NAMUNA)
  2  They're going to buy new clothes.
  3  They're going to hire a photographer.
  4  They're going to send invitations.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Ular to'y torti buyurtma qilishmoqchi.
  2  Ular yangi kiyim sotib olishmoqchi.
  3  Ular fotograf yollashmoqchi.
  4  Ular taklifnomalar yuborishmoqchi.


DIQQAT — ARTIKLLAR:
  1  'A wedding cake'   — artikl BOR (bitta tort)
  2  'new clothes'      — artikl YO'Q
                          ('clothes' DOIM KO'PLIK)
  3  'A photographer'   — artikl BOR (bitta odam)
  4  'invitations'      — artikl YO'Q
                          (ko'plik, noaniq son)


DIQQAT — 'CLOTHES':
  'clothes' — DOIM KO'PLIK shaklda.
  'a clothe' yoki 'clothes is' XATO.
  'These clothes ARE new.' ✓


DIQQAT — 'TO HIRE':
  'hire' = pul evaziga yollamoq / ijaraga olmoq.
  Grammar 58-bet, 3-mashqda ham bor edi:
  'hire a band'.


NEGA 'BE GOING TO', PRESENT CONTINUOUS EMAS:
  Bu ishlar hali ANIQ VAQTGA belgilanmagan —
  faqat REJA.
  Agar sana aytilganda bo'lardi:
     'They're ordering the cake ON FRIDAY.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to get married  = turmushga chiqmoq, uylanmoq
  a wedding       = to'y
  a wedding cake  = to'y torti
  to order        = buyurtma qilmoq
  clothes         = kiyim (DOIM ko'plik)
  to hire         = yollamoq
  a photographer  = fotograf
  an invitation   = taklifnoma

topics.topic: be going to / present continuous — JON VA MERINING KUNDALIGI · 8-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
JON VA MERINING KUNDALIGI:

     Monday    -  take the dog to the vet's
     Tuesday   -  paint the living-room
     Wednesday -  buy a new TV
     Thursday  -  have dinner at the Smith's house
     Friday    -  play tennis with Sue and Bob
     Saturday  -  drive to the beach
     Sunday    -  visit John's parents


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'They'RE TAKING the dog to the vet's ON MONDAY.'


NEGA PRESENT CONTINUOUS:
  Bu ishlar KUNDALIKKA yozilgan —
  ya'ni QAT'IY BELGILANGAN, har birining ANIQ
  KUNI bor.
  (Grammar 57-bet, 1-mashq bilan AYNAN bir xil
   tuzilish.)


QOLIP:
  They'RE + fe'l-ING + ... + ON + [kun].

  DIQQAT: KUN bilan 'ON' predlogi.


BARCHA YETTI GAP:

  1  They're taking the dog to the vet's on
     Monday.                            (NAMUNA)
  2  They're painting the living-room on Tuesday.
  3  They're buying a new TV on Wednesday.
  4  They're having dinner at the Smith's house on
     Thursday.
  5  They're playing tennis with Sue and Bob on
     Friday.
  6  They're driving to the beach on Saturday.
  7  They're visiting John's parents on Sunday.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Dushanba kuni itni veterinarga olib
     borishadi.
  2  Seshanba kuni mehmonxonani bo'yashadi.
  3  Chorshanba kuni yangi televizor sotib
     olishadi.
  4  Payshanba kuni Smitlarnikida kechki ovqat
     qilishadi.
  5  Juma kuni Syu va Bob bilan tennis o'ynashadi.
  6  Shanba kuni plyajga haydab borishadi.
  7  Yakshanba kuni Jonning ota-onasinikiga
     borishadi.


FE'LLARNING '-ING' ShAKLI:
     take  → TAKING     ('-e' TUShADI)
     paint → PAINTING
     buy   → BUYING
     have  → HAVING     ('-e' TUShADI)
     play  → PLAYING
     drive → DRIVING    ('-e' TUShADI)
     visit → VISITING

  DIQQAT: '-e' bilan tugagan fe'llarda 'e'
  TUShADI: take → taking, have → having,
  drive → driving.


DIQQAT — 'THE VET'S':
  'the vet'S' = veterinarning KLINIKASI.
  Apostrof 's' joyni bildiradi (joy nomi
  tushirib qoldirilgan):
     the vet's (surgery)
     the doctor's (surgery)
     the baker's (shop)
     the hairdresser's (salon)

  Grammar 59-bet, 6-mashqning 10-bandida ham
  'take my dog to the vet' bor edi.


⚠ KITOBDA KIChIK TINIS BELGISI XATOSI:
  Payshanba bandida 'at the SMITH'S house'
  deb bosilgan.
  To'g'ri yozilishi: 'at the SMITHS' house'
  (Smitlar oilasi — KO'PLIK, apostrof 's' dan
   KEYIN).

  Taqqoslang:
     the Smith'S house  — bitta Smit familiyali
                          odamning uyi
     the SmithS' house  — Smitlar OILASINING uyi

  Mashq javobiga ta'sir qilmaydi — quyida
  kitobdagi shakl saqlangan.


DIQQAT — 'THE LIVING-ROOM':
  'a living-room' = mehmonxona (uydagi xona).
  Chiziqcha bilan yoziladi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a diary       = kundalik
  a vet         = veterinar
  a living-room = mehmonxona (xona)
  to drive to   = ... ga haydab bormoq

topics.topic: will / be going to — KITOBDAGI NAMUNA · 9b-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'I'm cold. I'LL PUT a jumper ON.'


QOLIP:
  [HOLAT]. I'LL + ASOSIY fe'l + ... .

  Birinchi qism — HOZIRGI holat (sabab).
  Ikkinchi qism — AYNI DAMDA qabul qilingan
                  qaror → WILL.

  (Coursebook 95-bet va Grammar 57-bet qoidasi.)


BARCHA OLTI GAP:

  1  I'm cold. I'll put a jumper on.      (NAMUNA)
  2  There's no milk left. I'll go to the
     supermarket.
  3  I've got toothache. I'll visit the dentist.
  4  It's a sunny morning. I'll have breakfast in
     the garden.
  5  These trousers are dirty. I'll put them in the
     washing machine.
  6  The car isn't working. I'll call a mechanic.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Sovqotdim. Sviter kiyaman.
  2  Sut qolmadi. Supermarketga boraman.
  3  Tishim og'riyapti. Tish shifokoriga boraman.
  4  Quyoshli tong. Bog'da nonushta qilaman.
  5  Bu shim iflos. Ularni kir yuvish mashinasiga
     solaman.
  6  Mashina ishlamayapti. Ustani chaqiraman.


DIQQAT — 'PUT A JUMPER ON':
  'put ON' ikki qismga BO'LINISHI mumkin:
     'put ON a jumper'   ✓
     'put a jumper ON'   ✓
  Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.

  LEKIN olmosh bo'lsa — FAQAT o'rtada:
     'put it ON'   ✓
     'put ON it'   ✗

  5-bandda ham shunday: 'put THEM in ...'


DIQQAT — 'I'LL' NEGA, 'I'M GOING TO' EMAS:
  Bu qarorlar AYNI DAMDA qabul qilinmoqda —
  odam holatni endigina sezdi.
  Agar oldindan rejalashtirilgan bo'lsa,
  'be going to' bo'lardi.

  Taqqoslang:
     'I'm cold. I'LL put a jumper on.'
        → hozirgina qaror qildi
     'It's cold today. I'M GOING TO wear my coat.'
        → ertalab rejalashtirgan

topics.topic: will / be going to — OLTI KO'RSATMA · 10-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
OLTI KO'RSATMA:
  • learn to drive
    (mashina haydashni o'rganmoq)
  • spend more time with my grandchild
    (nevaram bilan ko'proq vaqt o'tkazmoq)
  • buy a dog
    (it sotib olmoq)
  • get a job in an office
    (ofisda ish topmoq)
  • move into a flat in the city centre
    (shahar markazidagi kvartiraga ko'chib o'tmoq)
  • travel around the world
    (dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilmoq)


IKKI ODAM VA ULARNING FIKR PUFAKLARI:

  RASM A — KEKSA AYOL: 'When I retire ...'
           (Nafaqaga chiqqanimda ...)
     a  Sayohat stikerlari yopishtirilgan chamadon
     b  It (kolli)
     c  Buvi va nevara birga o'tirgan

  RASM B — YOSh YIGIT: 'When I get my degree ...'
           (Diplomimni olganimda ...)
     d  Mashina
     e  Shahar osmono'parlari
     f  Ofisda stol ortida telefonda gaplashayotgan
        erkak


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'When I retire I'M GOING TO travel around the
   world.'  (a rasmi)


QOLIP:
  When I [retire / get my degree] I'M GOING TO
  + ASOSIY fe'l + ... .


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  RASM A — 'When I retire ...'
     a  ...I'm going to travel around the world.
                                        (NAMUNA)
     b  ...I'm going to buy a dog.
     c  ...I'm going to spend more time with my
        grandchild.

  RASM B — 'When I get my degree ...'
     d  ...I'm going to learn to drive.
     e  ...I'm going to move into a flat in the
        city centre.
     f  ...I'm going to get a job in an office.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  a  Nafaqaga chiqqanimda dunyo bo'ylab sayohat
     qilaman.
  b  Nafaqaga chiqqanimda it sotib olaman.
  c  Nafaqaga chiqqanimda nevaram bilan ko'proq
     vaqt o'tkazaman.
  d  Diplomimni olganimda mashina haydashni
     o'rganaman.
  e  Diplomimni olganimda shahar markazidagi
     kvartiraga ko'chib o'taman.
  f  Diplomimni olganimda ofisda ish topaman.


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — RASM → KO'RSATMA:

  a  Stikerli ChAMADON → dunyo bo'ylab sayohat
  b  IT (kolli)        → it sotib olish
  c  Buvi va NEVARA    → nevara bilan vaqt
                          o'tkazish
  d  MAShINA           → haydashni o'rganish
  e  ShAHAR binolari   → markazga ko'chib o'tish
  f  OFIS va telefon   → ofisda ish


ENG MUHIM — 'WHEN' ERGASH GAPI:
  'WHEN I retire I'M GOING TO travel ...'

  DIQQAT: 'when' dan keyin KELASI zamon
  IShLATILMAYDI!
     'When I RETIRE ...'        ✓
     'When I WILL retire ...'   ✗
     'When I'm going to retire' ✗

  Ergash gapda PRESENT SIMPLE, asosiy gapda esa
  kelajak shakli.

  Shunday:
     'When I GET my degree, I'M GOING TO ...'
     'When she ARRIVES, I'LL tell her.'


DIQQAT — 'MOVE INTO':
  'move INTO a flat' = kvartiraga KO'ChIB O'TMOQ.
  'into' — ichkariga kirish.
  Taqqoslang: 'move house' (umuman ko'chmoq).

DIQQAT — 'LEARN TO DRIVE':
  'learn TO + fe'l' = ... ni o'rganmoq.
  'learn driving' odatda aytilmaydi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to retire       = nafaqaga chiqmoq
  a degree        = diplom, ilmiy daraja
  a grandchild    = nevara
  to move into    = ... ga ko'chib o'tmoq
  a flat          = kvartira
  the city centre = shahar markazi
  around the world = dunyo bo'ylab

topics.topic: will / be going to — O'N DIALOG · 11-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
O'N DIALOG.

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  I'LL put the heating on.
   2  They'RE GOING TO invite the Jacksons.
   3  I'LL phone the repair man.
   4  I'M GOING TO pick it up this afternoon.
   5  I'm sure he WILL help you.
   6  I'LL bring you an aspirin.
   7  She'S GOING TO play tennis with Ray.
   8  I'LL look in the TV guide.
   9  I'LL take you in the car.
  10  I'M GOING TO phone her this evening.

  WILL — OLTITA:        1, 3, 5, 6, 8, 9
  BE GOING TO — TO'RTTA: 2, 4, 7, 10


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
   1  A: Sovqotdim.
      B: Isitgichni yoqaman.
   2  A: Nega oyim va dadam bunchalik ko'p go'sht
         olishdi?
      B: Ular ertaga Jeksonlarni kechki ovqatga
         taklif qilishmoqchi.
   3  A: Kir yuvish mashinasi ishlamayapti!
      B: Ustaga qo'ng'iroq qilaman.
   4  A: Kurtkam hali ham kimyoviy tozalashda.
      B: Bilaman. Bugun tushdan keyin olib
         kelaman.
   5  A: Uy vazifamni qila olmayapman!
      B: Dadamdan so'ra. Ishonchim komilki, u
         senga yordam beradi.
   6  A: Boshim og'riyapti.
      B: Senga aspirin olib kelaman.
   7  A: Nega Karen krossovka kiygan?
      B: U Rey bilan tennis o'ynamoqchi.
   8  A: Bugun kechqurun televizorda nima bor?
      B: Bilmadim. Teledasturga qarayman.
   9  A: Vokzalga borishim kerak.
      B: Mayli, seni mashinada olib boraman.
  10  A: Buvingga qo'ng'iroq qildingmi?
      B: Hali yo'q, lekin bugun kechqurun
         qo'ng'iroq qilaman.


QOIDA — QANDAY AJRATISh:

  WILL  →  javob beruvchi AYNI DAMDA qaror qildi
  BE GOING TO  →  ALLAQAChON rejalashtirgan


UCh ANIQ IP:

  IP 1 — 'I KNOW' yoki 'Not yet, but ...' bormi?
     → ALLAQAChON rejalashtirgan → BE GOING TO
     (4 va 10-bandlar)

  IP 2 — 'WHY ...?' savoliga javobmi?
     → HOZIRGI HOLATNI tushuntirmoqda,
       demak reja OLDINDAN bor → BE GOING TO
     (2 va 7-bandlar)

  IP 3 — A muammo aytdi, B darhol yordam taklif
     qildi?
     → AYNI DAMDAGI qaror → WILL
     (1, 3, 6, 8, 9-bandlar)

  ALOHIDA — 5-BAND:
     'I'M SURE he ...' → FIKR, bashorat → WILL
     (Grammar 58-bet, 6-mashqning 2-bandi bilan
      bir xil)


HAR BIRI ALOHIDA:

   1  'I'm cold.' → darhol isitgichni yoqishga
      qaror qildi. WILL.

   2  'WHY did Mum and Dad buy so much meat?'
      Ko'p go'sht sotib olinganining SABABI —
      taklif rejasi ALLAQAChON bor.
      BE GOING TO.

   3  'The washing machine isn't working!' →
      darhol ustaga qo'ng'iroq qilishga qaror
      qildi. WILL.

   4  'I KNOW.' → allaqachon bilgan va olib
      kelishni rejalashtirgan. BE GOING TO.

   5  'I'M SURE he ...' → bashorat, dalil yo'q.
      WILL.

   6  'I've got a headache.' → darhol aspirin
      olib kelishga qaror qildi. WILL.

   7  'WHY is Karen wearing her trainers?'
      Krossovka kiyganining SABABI — tennis
      rejasi ALLAQAChON bor. BE GOING TO.

   8  'I'm not sure.' → darhol dasturga qarashga
      qaror qildi. WILL.

   9  'Okay' → ayni damdagi reaksiya. WILL.

  10  'Not yet, BUT I ...' → hali qilmagan, lekin
      kechqurun qilishni REJALAShTIRGAN.
      BE GOING TO.


EGALARGA E'TIBOR BERING:
   2  'They'RE going to'   (they → are)
   7  'She'S going to'     (she → is)
   4, 10  'I'M going to'   (I → am)


DIQQAT — 'PICK IT UP':
  'pick UP' = olib kelmoq, olib ketmoq.
  Olmosh bo'lsa — FAQAT o'rtada:
     'pick IT up'   ✓
     'pick up it'   ✗

DIQQAT — 'THE DRY CLEANER'S':
  'the dry cleaner'S' = kimyoviy tozalash
  ustaxonasi.
  Apostrof 's' joyni bildiradi (53-betdagi
  'the vet's' kabi).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  the heating     = isitish tizimi
  to put the heating on = isitgichni yoqmoq
  a repair man    = ta'mirlovchi usta
  a dry cleaner's = kimyoviy tozalash
  to pick up      = olib kelmoq
  a headache      = bosh og'rig'i
  an aspirin      = aspirin
  trainers        = krossovka (Britaniya)
  a TV guide      = teledastur
  not yet         = hali yo'q

topics.topic: will / be going to — KITOBDAGI UCh NAMUNA (camera uchun) · 12b-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI UCh NAMUNA (camera uchun):

  1) TO + fe'l (MAQSAD):
     'He's going to take a camera TO TAKE
      pictures.'

  2) BECAUSE (SABAB):
     'He's going to take a camera BECAUSE he wants
      to take pictures.'

  3) SO (NATIJA):
     'He wants to take pictures, SO he's going to
      take a camera.'

  Demak HAR BIR narsa uchun UChTA gap!


UCh QOLIP:

  1) 'He's going to take [narsa] TO [maqsad].'
  2) 'He's going to take [narsa] BECAUSE he wants
      to [maqsad].'
  3) 'He wants to [maqsad], SO he's going to take
      [narsa].'


BARCHA TO'RT NARSA — UChTADAN GAP:

─── CAMERA ───                          (NAMUNA)
  He's going to take a camera to take pictures.
  He's going to take a camera because he wants to
  take pictures.
  He wants to take pictures, so he's going to take
  a camera.

─── RADIO ───
  He's going to take a radio to listen to music.
  He's going to take a radio because he wants to
  listen to music.
  He wants to listen to music, so he's going to
  take a radio.

─── MATCHES ───
  He's going to take some matches to light a
  campfire.
  He's going to take some matches because he wants
  to light a campfire.
  He wants to light a campfire, so he's going to
  take some matches.

─── FISHING ROD ───
  He's going to take a fishing rod to catch some
  fish.
  He's going to take a fishing rod because he
  wants to catch some fish.
  He wants to catch some fish, so he's going to
  take a fishing rod.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI (har narsadan bittadan):
  Surat olish uchun fotoapparat olib ketmoqchi.
  Musiqa tinglash uchun radio olib ketmoqchi.
  Gulxan yoqish uchun gugurt olib ketmoqchi.
  Baliq tutish uchun qarmoq olib ketmoqchi.


DIQQAT — ARTIKLLAR:
  'A camera'       — birlik, artikl BOR
  'A radio'        — birlik, artikl BOR
  'SOME matches'   — KO'PLIK → 'some'
                     ('a matches' XATO)
  'A fishing rod'  — birlik, artikl BOR


DIQQAT — UCh ShAKLNING FARQI:
  TO + fe'l  →  ergash gapda EGA YO'Q
                ('to take pictures')
  BECAUSE    →  ergash gapda EGA va FE'L bor
                ('he wants to take pictures')
  SO         →  ergash gapda EGA va FE'L bor
                ('he's going to take a camera')

  Tartib:
     BECAUSE: [natija] because [sabab]
     SO:      [sabab], so [natija]
     TESKARI!


Bu qoida Coursebook 95-bet va Grammar 57, 59-bet
larda ham bir necha marta takrorlangan —
Unit 13 ning eng muhim ko'nikmalaridan biri.

topics.topic: Giving Advice — should / shouldn't — Maslahat berish — should / shouldn't
topics.rule_uz:
SHOULD / SHOULDN'T — NAZARIYA

KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We use SHOULD to say what the right/best
    thing to do is.'
      You SHOULD take regular exercise.
      (= It's a good idea.)

 • 'We use SHOULDN'T to say what isn't the
    right/best thing to do.'
      You SHOULDN'T drop rubbish in the street.
      (= It isn't a good idea.)

 • 'We can also give advice with:
    WHY DON'T YOU ...?
    I THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO ...,
    I DON'T THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO ...'

      Why don't you take regular exercise?
      I think it's a good idea to take regular
        exercise.
      I don't think it's a good idea to eat
        junk food.


TO'LIQ TUSLANISh:

  TASDIQ:
     I should go        we should go
     you should go      you should go
     he should go       they should go
     she should go
     it should go

  INKOR:
     I should not go = I shouldn't go
     (barcha shaxslarda bir xil)

  SO'ROQ:
     Should I go?
     Should he go?
     ...


UCh OLTIN QOIDA:

 1  -S HECH QAChON QO'ShILMAYDI:
       'He should go.'    ✓
       'He shouldS go.'   ✗

 2  'TO' YO'Q:
       'You should take ...'    ✓
       'You should TO take ...' ✗

 3  'DO' KERAK EMAS:
       'Should I go?'      ✓
       'DO I should go?'   ✗
       'I shouldn't go.'   ✓
       'I DON'T should go.' ✗


QISQA JAVOBLAR:
  Should I take an aspirin?
     — Yes, you should. / No, you shouldn't.


UCh XIL MASLAHAT ShAKLI — QIYOSI:

  SHOULD
     'You should take regular exercise.'
     → to'g'ridan-to'g'ri, oddiy

  WHY DON'T YOU ...?
     'Why don't you take regular exercise?'
     → shakli SAVOL, ma'nosi MASLAHAT
     → do'stona taklif

  I THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO ...
     'I think it's a good idea to take regular
      exercise.'
     → yumshoq shaxsiy fikr

  I DON'T THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO ...
     'I don't think it's a good idea to eat
      junk food.'
     → yumshoq salbiy fikr


DIQQAT — INKOR QAYERGA QO'YILADI:
  'I DON'T think it's a good idea to ...' ✓
     (inkor BOSH gapda)
  'I think it ISN'T a good idea to ...'
     (grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri, lekin
      inglizlar birinchi shaklni ishlatadi)


DIQQAT — 'A GOOD IDEA TO + fe'l':
  'a good idea TO TAKE exercise'   ✓
  'a good idea TAKING exercise'    ✗
  'a good idea TAKE exercise'      ✗


DIQQAT — 'WHY DON'T YOU + ASOSIY fe'l':
  'Why don't you TAKE exercise?'    ✓
  'Why don't you TO take exercise?' ✗
  'Why don't you TAKING exercise?'  ✗


MISOLLARDAGI YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  regular exercise = muntazam jismoniy mashq
  to drop rubbish  = axlat tashlamoq
  junk food        = zararli tez ovqat
                     (gamburger, chips va h.k.)


BOG'LIQLIK — COURSEBOOK BILAN:
  Bu qoida Coursebook 99-betdagi
  'Giving Advice' qutisi bilan AYNAN bir xil,
  faqat misollari boshqa.
examples: We use should to say what the right/best thing to do is. You should take regular exercise. (= It's a good idea.)
We use shouldn't to say what isn't the right/best thing to do. You shouldn't drop rubbish in the street. (= It isn't a good idea.)
We can also give advice with: Why don't you ...? I think it's a good idea to ..., I don't think it's a good idea to ...
Why don't you take regular exercise?
I think it's a good idea to take regular exercise.
I don't think it's a good idea to eat junk food.
I / you / he / she / it / we / they SHOULD go. — Should I go? — I shouldn't go.

topics.topic: Must / Mustn't
topics.rule_uz:
MUST — TO'LIQ TUSLANISh

TASDIQ (Affirmative):
     I must stay          we must stay
     you must stay        you must stay
     he must stay         they must stay
     she must stay
     it must stay

SO'ROQ (Interrogative):
     Must I stay?         Must we stay?
     Must you stay?       Must you stay?
     Must he stay?        Must they stay?
     Must she stay?
     Must it stay?

INKOR (Negative):
     TO'LIQ ShAKL         QISQA ShAKL
     I must not stay      I mustn't stay
     you must not stay    you mustn't stay
     he must not stay     he mustn't stay
     she must not stay    she mustn't stay
     it must not stay     it mustn't stay
     we must not stay     we mustn't stay
     you must not stay    you mustn't stay
     they must not stay   they mustn't stay


ENG MUHIM XUSUSIYAT:
  'MUST' BARCHA ShAXSLARDA BIR XIL —
  hech qanday o'zgarish yo'q!

     'He must stay.'   ✓
     'He mustS stay.'  ✗
     'He must stayS.'  ✗


SO'ROQ — 'DO' KERAK EMAS:
     'Must I stay?'     ✓
     'Do I must stay?'  ✗

  MUST ni EGADAN OLDINGA qo'yish yetarli.


INKOR — 'DON'T' KERAK EMAS:
     'I must not stay.' ✓
     'I don't must stay.' ✗

  'NOT' ni MUST dan KEYIN qo'yish yetarli.


'MUSTN'T' TALAFFUZI:
  /ˈmʌsnt/ — 'masnt'
  DIQQAT: birinchi 'T' O'QILMAYDI!
  ('must not' da esa o'qiladi.)


MUST NIMA UChUN IShLATILADI — UCh HOLAT:

 KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

  a)  TO EXPRESS OBLIGATION (majburiyat)
         'You MUST KEEP the room clean.'

  b)  FOR RULES (qoidalar uchun)
         'You MUST BE home by 11 pm.'

  c)  TO GIVE ADVICE (maslahat berish)
         'You MUST SEE a dentist.'
         (I STRONGLY advise you.)


DIQQAT — c) HOLATI ENG NOZIK:
  'MUST' maslahat uchun ham ishlatiladi,
  lekin 'should' dan ANChA KUCHLIROQ:

     'You SHOULD see a dentist.'
        → oddiy maslahat
     'You MUST see a dentist.'
        → QAT'IY maslahat
          ('I strongly advise you')

  Kitob buni qavs ichida aytadi:
  '(I STRONGLY advise you.)'


MUSTN'T NIMANI ANGLATADI:

 KITOBDAGI QOIDA:
  'MUSTN'T means "IT IS FORBIDDEN" or
   "IT ISN'T RIGHT".'

     'You MUSTN'T PARK here.'
     (= It is FORBIDDEN to park here,
        it is AGAINST THE RULE.)


DIQQAT — 'MUSTN'T' va 'DON'T HAVE TO':
  Bu — eng ko'p xato qilinadigan joy!

     MUSTN'T       = mutlaqo QILMASLIK kerak
                     (TAQIQ)
        'You mustn't park here.'
        (Bu yerga qo'yish TAQIQLANGAN.)

     DON'T HAVE TO = qilish ShART EMAS
                     (lekin mumkin)
        'You don't have to park here.'
        (Bu yerga qo'yish shart emas —
         boshqa joyga ham qo'yishingiz mumkin.)

  O'zbek tilida ikkalasi ham 'kerak emas'
  deb tarjima qilinadi — shuning uchun
  adashish oson.


QISQA JAVOBLAR:
  Must I stay?
     — Yes, you must.
     — No, you NEEDN'T. (shart emas)

  DIQQAT: 'No, you mustn't' — BOSHQA ma'no!
     'No, you needn't.'  = qolish shart emas
     'No, you mustn't.'  = qolish TAQIQLANGAN


MISOLLARDAGI YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to stay          = qolmoq
  obligation       = majburiyat
  a rule           = qoida
  forbidden        = taqiqlangan
  against the rule = qoidaga zid
  strongly         = qat'iy, kuchli
  to advise        = maslahat bermoq


⚠ MUHIM BOG'LIQLIK — COURSEBOOK 101-BET:
  Bu betdagi ikki misol Coursebook 101-betning
  11-mashqidagi jadval qatorlarini TASDIQLAYDI:

     'You must KEEP THE ROOM CLEAN.'
        → 'keep the room clean' = MUST ✓

     'You must BE HOME BY 11 PM.'
        → 'be home by 11 pm' = MUST ✓

  Ikkinchisi 101-betda audio uchun ochiq
  qolgan edi — endi kitobning O'ZIDAN
  tasdiqlandi.
examples: AFFIRMATIVE: I must stay / you must stay / he must stay / she must stay / it must stay / we must stay / you must stay / they must stay
INTERROGATIVE: Must I stay? Must you stay? Must he stay? Must she stay? Must it stay? Must we stay? Must they stay?
NEGATIVE (long): I must not stay ... (short): I mustn't stay ...
We use must: a) to express obligation — You must keep the room clean.
We use must: b) for rules — You must be home by 11 pm.
We use must: c) to give advice — You must see a dentist. (I strongly advise you.)
Mustn't means 'it is forbidden' or 'it isn't right'. You mustn't park here. (= It is forbidden to park here, it is against the rule.)

topics.topic: Can/Can't — Could/Couldn't
topics.rule_uz:
COULD — TO'LIQ TUSLANISh

TASDIQ (Affirmative):
     I could swim         we could swim
     you could swim       you could swim
     he could swim        they could swim
     she could swim
     it could swim

SO'ROQ (Interrogative):
     Could I swim?        Could we swim?
     Could you swim?      Could you swim?
     Could he swim?       Could they swim?
     Could she swim?
     Could it swim?

INKOR (Negative):
     TO'LIQ ShAKL         QISQA ShAKL
     I could not swim     I couldn't swim
     you could not swim   you couldn't swim
     he could not swim    he couldn't swim
     she could not swim   she couldn't swim
     it could not swim    it couldn't swim
     we could not swim    we couldn't swim
     you could not swim   you couldn't swim
     they could not swim  they couldn't swim


YASALIShI (FORM) — KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We form the INTERROGATIVE by putting CAN or
    COULD BEFORE THE SUBJECT.'
       CAN THEY swim?  /  COULD THEY swim?

 • 'We form the NEGATIVE by putting the word NOT
    AFTER can or could.'
       They CANNOT / CAN'T swim well.
       They COULD NOT / COULDN'T swim well.


DIQQAT — 'CANNOT' BIR SO'Z:
  'CANNOT'   ✓  (qo'shib yoziladi!)
  'can not'  — kam ishlatiladi
  'CAN'T'    ✓  (qisqa shakl)

  Bu — inglizchadagi yagona modal fe'l
  bo'lib, inkori QO'ShIB yoziladi:
     could not  → couldn't (ayrim)
     must not   → mustn't  (ayrim)
     cannot                 (QO'ShIQ!)


IShLATILIShI (USE) — KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We use CAN to show that someone has the
    ABILITY to do something IN THE PRESENT.
    We use COULD to show that someone HAD the
    ability to do something IN THE PAST.'

       HOZIR:  I CAN swim.
               (Men suza olaman.)
       O'TGAN:  I COULD swim when I was five.
               (Besh yoshimda suza olardim.)

 • 'We also use CAN to give PERMISSION.'
       You CAN watch TV.
       (You are allowed to.)

 • 'We use CAN'T to REFUSE permission.'
       You CAN'T watch TV.
       (You aren't allowed to.)


CAN NING IKKI MA'NOSI:

  1  QOBILIYAT (ability)
        'I can swim.' = suza olaman
        'I can speak English.'

  2  RUXSAT (permission)
        'You can watch TV.' = ruxsat berilgan
        'Can I use your phone?'

  Qaysi ma'no ekanini KONTEKST ko'rsatadi.


COULD — 'CAN' NING O'TGAN ZAMONI:

     HOZIR              O'TGAN
     I can swim.        I could swim.
     I can't swim.      I couldn't swim.
     Can you swim?      Could you swim?

  Misol:
     'I COULD run very fast when I was young,
      but now I CAN'T.'
     (Yosh vaqtimda juda tez yugurardim,
      lekin hozir yugura olmayman.)


DIQQAT — 'COULD' NING IKKINChI VAZIFASI:
  'Could' o'tgan zamondan tashqari,
  ODOBLI ILTIMOS uchun ham ishlatiladi:

     'CAN you help me?'    — oddiy
     'COULD you help me?'  — ODOBLIROQ

  Bu holatda o'tgan zamon ma'nosi YO'Q.


BARCHA MODALLARGA UMUMIY UCh QOIDA:

 1  -S QO'ShILMAYDI:
       he can, he could, he must, he should
       ('he cans' ✗)

 2  'TO' YO'Q:
       'I can swim.'    ✓
       'I can TO swim.' ✗

 3  'DO' KERAK EMAS:
       'Can you swim?'     ✓
       'Do you can swim?'  ✗


QISQA JAVOBLAR:
  Can you swim?
     — Yes, I can. / No, I can't.
  Could you swim when you were five?
     — Yes, I could. / No, I couldn't.


MISOLLARDAGI YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  ability       = qobiliyat
  able          = qodir
  the present   = hozirgi zamon
  the past      = o'tgan zamon
  to allow      = ruxsat bermoq
  allowed       = ruxsat etilgan
  to refuse     = rad etmoq
  the subject   = ega (grammatikada)
  affirmative   = tasdiq
  interrogative = so'roq
  negative      = inkor
examples: AFFIRMATIVE: I could swim / you could swim / he could swim / she could swim / it could swim / we could swim / they could swim
INTERROGATIVE: Could I swim? Could you swim? Could he swim? Could she swim? Could it swim? Could we swim? Could they swim?
NEGATIVE (long): I could not swim ... (short): I couldn't swim ...
We form the interrogative by putting can or could before the subject. Can they swim? / Could they swim?
We form the negative by putting the word not after can or could. They cannot/can't swim well. / They could not/couldn't swim well.
We use can to show that someone has the ability to do something in the present. We use could to show that someone had the ability to do something in the past.
We also use can to give permission. You can watch TV. (You are allowed to.)
We use can't to refuse permission. You can't watch TV. (You aren't allowed to.)

topics.topic: Mashqlar — belgilar va should/shouldn't — OLTI YO'L BELGISI (A-F) · 1-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
OLTI YO'L BELGISI (A-F):

  A  Qizil doira ichida CHIZIB TAShLANGAN
     PIYODA figurasi
  B  Qizil doira ichida chizib tashlangan
     O'NGGA BURILISh strelkasi
  C  Qizil doira, o'rtasida OQ GORIZONTAL
     chiziq (klassik 'KIRISh TAQIQLANGAN'
     belgisi)
  D  Qizil doira ichida chizib tashlangan
     VELOSIPEDChI
  E  Qizil doira ichida chizib tashlangan
     QO'L (biror narsaga tegayotgan)
  F  Qizil doira ichida chizib tashlangan
     odam AXLAT tashlayapti


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  Don't throw rubbish.   →  F
  2  Don't walk.            →  A
  3  Don't ride your bike.  →  D
  4  Don't turn right.      →  B
  5  Don't enter.           →  C
  6  Don't touch.           →  E


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — HAR RASMDAGI ASOSIY
FIGURA:

  PIYODA        →  walk      (yurmoq)
  STRELKA       →  turn      (burilmoq)
  OQ CHIZIQ     →  enter     (kirmoq)
  VELOSIPED     →  ride      (minmoq)
  QO'L          →  touch     (tegmoq)
  AXLAT         →  throw     (tashlamoq)


DIQQAT — 'C' BELGISI:
  Qizil doira + oq gorizontal chiziq —
  butun dunyoda 'NO ENTRY' (kirish taqiqlangan)
  degani. Ichida hech qanday rasm yo'q,
  faqat chiziq.

  Bu belgi bir tomonlama ko'chalarda va
  taqiqlangan kirish joylarida turadi.


DIQQAT — YO'L BELGILARINING TILI:
  Belgilar odatda BUYRUQ MAYLIDA yoziladi:
     'Don't enter.'  /  'No entry.'
     'Don't walk.'   /  'No pedestrians.'

  Ikki xil shakl:
     DON'T + fe'l    (buyruq)
     NO + ot         (qisqa e'lon)

  Misollar:
     No smoking.     = Chekish taqiqlanadi.
     No parking.     = Mashina qo'yish taqiqlanadi.
     No entry.       = Kirish taqiqlanadi.
     No swimming.    = Suzish taqiqlanadi.

  DIQQAT: 'NO + -ING' shakli!
     'No smoking'  ✓
     'No smoke'    ✗


BELGILARNI MODAL BILAN AYTISh:
  Har bir belgini 'mustn't' bilan ham aytish
  mumkin (Coursebook 101-betdagi qoida):

     F  →  You mustn't throw rubbish here.
     A  →  You mustn't walk here.
     D  →  You mustn't ride your bike here.
     B  →  You mustn't turn right.
     C  →  You mustn't enter.
     E  →  You mustn't touch.

  'mustn't' — chunki bular QONUNIY taqiq
  (Grammar 60-bet: 'it is against the rule').


DIQQAT — 'TO ENTER' PREDLOGSIZ:
  'enter the room'      ✓
  'enter INTO the room' ✗

  'enter' o'timli fe'l — to'ldiruvchi
  to'g'ridan-to'g'ri keladi.


DIQQAT — 'TO RIDE':
  ride a bike / a horse / a motorbike
  ride → RODE → RIDDEN (noto'g'ri fe'l)

  Mashina uchun 'ride' emas, 'DRIVE':
     drive a car  ✓
     ride a car   ✗


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to throw rubbish = axlat tashlamoq
  to walk          = yurmoq, piyoda yurmoq
  to ride a bike   = velosiped minmoq
  to turn right    = o'ngga burilmoq
  to enter         = kirmoq
  to touch         = tegmoq
  a meaning        = ma'no
  a sign           = belgi

topics.topic: Mashqlar — belgilar va should/shouldn't — BARCHA JAVOBLAR · 2-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  SHOULD      (meva-sabzavot — foydali)
   2  SHOULD      (ko'zoynak — himoya qiladi)
   3  SHOULDN'T   (og'zi to'la gapirish — qo'pol)
   4  SHOULD      (imtihon oldidan o'qish — foydali)
   5  SHOULDN'T   (zararli ovqat — zarar)
   6  SHOULDN'T   (o'rmonda olov — xavfli)
   7  SHOULD      (uy vazifasi — foydali)
   8  SHOULDN'T   (aerozol — ozonga zarar)
   9  SHOULD      (kasal — shifokorga borish)
  10  SHOULDN'T   (ko'p shirinlik — zarar)

  Ya'ni: SHOULD — 1, 2, 4, 7, 9 (5 ta)
         SHOULDN'T — 3, 5, 6, 8, 10 (5 ta)


OLTIN QOIDA — QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  Ish FOYDALI bo'lsa       →  SHOULD
  Ish ZARARLI/QO'POL bo'lsa →  SHOULDN'T

  Boshqa hech qanday grammatik belgi yo'q —
  faqat MA'NO.


HAR BIRINING KELIB ChIQIShI (Coursebook'dan):

   1  'Eat lots of fruit and vegetables.'
      — CB 98-bet, 1-mashq (health)
   2  'Always wear sunglasses.'
      — CB 103-bet, 17-mashq
   3  'Don't talk with your mouth full.'
      — CB 100-bet (Angliya)
   5  'junk food' — GB 60-bet misoli
   6  'Never light fires in forests.'
      — CB 99-bet, varaqa
   7  'You must do your homework.'
      — CB 102-bet, 13b namunasi
   8  'Do not use aerosols.'
      — CB 99-bet, varaqa
   9  'See the dentist / call the doctor'
      — CB 101-bet, 9b

  Ya'ni butun mashq unitni takrorlaydi.


DIQQAT — 5-BAND, EGA 'PETER':
  'PETER shouldn't eat so much junk food.'

  Ega III shaxs birlik bo'lsa ham,
  'should' O'ZGARMAYDI:
     'Peter shouldn't' ✓
     'Peter shouldnS't' ✗
     'Peter doesn't should' ✗


DIQQAT — 'SO MUCH' va 'SO MANY':
   5  'so MUCH junk food'  — SANALMAYDIGAN
  10  'so MANY sweets'     — SANALADIGAN

  much + sanalmaydigan (food, water, money)
  many + sanaladigan    (sweets, books, cars)

  'so' — kuchaytiruvchi ('shunchalik ko'p').


DIQQAT — 7-BANDDA 'ALWAYS' QAYERDA:
  'You SHOULD ALWAYS do your homework.'

  Ravish MODAL bilan ASOSIY FE'L ORASIGA
  qo'yiladi:
     should ALWAYS do   ✓
     ALWAYS should do   ✗
     should do ALWAYS   (noto'g'ri emas, lekin
                         g'alati)


DIQQAT — 9-BAND, 'GO TO A DOCTOR':
  'He should go to A doctor.'
  Artikl 'A' — qaysi shifokor ekani muhim emas.
  'go to THE doctor' — o'z shifokoringiz.

  'isn't feeling well' — Present Continuous,
  chunki VAQTINChA holat.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  junk food       = zararli tez ovqat
  sweets          = shirinliklar
  a test          = nazorat ishi
  to feel well    = o'zini yaxshi his qilmoq
  aerosols        = aerozollar

topics.topic: Mashqlar — belgilar va should/shouldn't
topics.rule_uz:
SARLAVHA:
  'HOW TO TAKE CARE OF YOUR CAT'
  (Mushugingizni qanday parvarish qilish kerak)

RASM: kattakon ko'zli, yo'l-yo'l mushukcha.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  feed/twice a day
    → You SHOULD feed your cat twice a day.
       (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 2  leave/outside for a long time
    → You SHOULDN'T leave your cat outside for
      a long time.

 3  take/to the vet every six months
    → You SHOULD take your cat to the vet every
      six months.

 4  forget/to fill water bowl
    → You SHOULDN'T forget to fill its water
      bowl.

 5  empty/litter tray once a week
    → You SHOULD empty its litter tray once a
      week.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
 1  Mushugingizni kuniga ikki marta
    ovqatlantirishingiz kerak.
 2  Mushugingizni uzoq vaqt tashqarida
    qoldirmasligingiz kerak.
 3  Mushugingizni har olti oyda veterinarga
    olib borishingiz kerak.
 4  Uning suv idishini to'ldirishni
    unutmasligingiz kerak.
 5  Uning hojatxona lotogini haftada bir marta
    tozalashingiz kerak.


QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  MUSHUKKA FOYDALI  →  SHOULD    (1, 3, 5)
  MUSHUKKA ZARARLI  →  SHOULDN'T (2, 4)

     1  ovqatlantirish     — foydali
     2  uzoq tashqarida qoldirish — xavfli
     3  veterinarga olib borish — foydali
     4  suvni unutish      — zararli
     5  lotokni tozalash   — foydali


QISQARTMA ShAKLNI TO'LIQ GAPGA AYLANTIRISh:

  Kitob chiziqcha bilan qisqa ko'rsatma
  bergan. To'liq gapda EGALIK olmoshi va
  ARTIKL qo'shiladi:

     feed/twice a day
       → feed YOUR CAT twice a day

     leave/outside
       → leave YOUR CAT outside

     take/to the vet
       → take YOUR CAT to the vet

     forget/to fill water bowl
       → forget to fill ITS water bowl

     empty/litter tray
       → empty ITS litter tray


DIQQAT — 'ITS' va 'IT'S' FARQI:
  ITS   = uning (EGALIK olmoshi)
          'its water bowl' = uning suv idishi
  IT'S  = it is / it has (QISQARTMA)
          'it's cold' = sovuq

  Bu — inglizchadagi eng ko'p qilinadigan
  yozma xato!
  Egalik olmoshida APOSTROF YO'Q:
     its ✓   it's ✗ (egalik ma'nosida)


DIQQAT — 4-BANDDAGI IKKI INKOR EMAS:
  'You SHOULDN'T FORGET to fill ...'
  = unutmasligingiz kerak
  = ya'ni ESLAB QOLISHINGIZ kerak

  'shouldn't forget' — ikki inkor emas,
  chunki 'forget' o'zi inkor emas.

  Boshqacha aytish mumkin:
     'You should REMEMBER to fill its water
      bowl.' (bir xil ma'no)


DIQQAT — 'FORGET TO' va 'FORGET -ING':
  'forget TO DO' = qilishni unutmoq
     (qilinmagan)
  'forget DOING' = qilganini unutmoq
     (qilingan, lekin esdan chiqqan)

  Bu yerda 'forget TO FILL' — suvni quyish
  hali qilinmagan.


DIQQAT — TAKRORLANISh IBORALARI:
  TWICE a day      = kuniga ikki marta
  ONCE a week      = haftada bir marta
  EVERY six months = har olti oyda
  three TIMES a day = kuniga uch marta

  DIQQAT: 'once' va 'twice' — maxsus so'zlar
  ('one time', 'two times' kam ishlatiladi),
  lekin uchdan boshlab 'three TIMES'.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to take care of = parvarish qilmoq
  to feed         = ovqatlantirmoq
                    (feed → FED)
  twice a day     = kuniga ikki marta
  to leave        = qoldirmoq (leave → LEFT)
  outside         = tashqarida
  a vet           = veterinar (mol shifokori)
  to fill         = to'ldirmoq
  a bowl          = kosa, idish
  to empty        = bo'shatmoq, tozalamoq
  a litter tray   = mushuk hojatxonasi (lotok)
  once a week     = haftada bir marta


DIQQAT — 'LITTER' SO'ZINING IKKI MA'NOSI:
  Coursebook 103-betda:
     'LITTER' = ko'chadagi axlat
     'Don't drop litter on the beach.'

  Bu yerda:
     'a LITTER TRAY' = mushuk hojatxonasi
     (ichiga maxsus qum solinadi)

  Bir so'z, ikki butunlay boshqa ma'no —
  KONTEKST hal qiladi.
examples: 1 feed/twice a day → You should feed your cat twice a day.
2 leave/outside for a long time → You shouldn't leave your cat outside for a long time.
3 take/to the vet every six months → You should take your cat to the vet every six months.
4 forget/to fill water bowl → You shouldn't forget to fill its water bowl.
5 empty/litter tray once a week → You should empty its litter tray once a week.

topics.topic: Mashqlar — belgilar va should/shouldn't — BARCHA JAVOBLAR · 4-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  MUST
   2  MUSTN'T
   3  SHOULDN'T
   4  CAN'T
   5  CAN
   6  SHOULD
   7  SHOULDN'T
   8  MUSTN'T
   9  SHOULD
  10  CAN'T


UCh SAVOL — HAR BANDDA:

  1) Ma'no IJOBIY mi, SALBIY mi?
  2) MAJBURIYAT mi, MASLAHAT mi, RUXSAT mi?
  3) QONUN/QOIDA mi, shaxsiy fikr mi?


HAR BIRI BATAFSIL:

 1  'You MUST be quiet in class.'
    Jim bo'lish — IJOBIY qoida.
    'shouldn't' bo'lsa ma'no TESKARI bo'lardi
    ('jim bo'lmasligingiz kerak').
    → MUST
    (CB 102-bet, 13a: 'You must be quiet in
     class.')

 2  'When in China, you MUSTN'T kiss anyone in
     public.'
    Xitoyda bu QO'POL — TAQIQ.
    'must kiss' bo'lsa 'o'pishingiz shart'
    degan kulgili ma'no chiqadi.
    → MUSTN'T
    (CB 100-bet, Xitoy matni)

 3  'People SHOULDN'T smoke because it's bad
     for their health.'
    KALIT: 'BECAUSE IT'S BAD' — sabab
    salbiylikni ko'rsatib turibdi.
    → SHOULDN'T

 4  'Speak louder, please. I CAN'T hear you.'
    KALIT: 'Speak LOUDER' — demak hozir
    eshitilmayapti.
    'I can hear you' bo'lsa balandroq gapirish
    kerak bo'lmasdi.
    → CAN'T

 5  'CAN I have a glass of water, please?'
    KALIT: 'PLEASE' — bu ILTIMOS, majburiyat
    emas.
    'Must I have a glass of water?' =
    'suv ichishim shartmi?' — ma'nosiz.
    → CAN

 6  'You SHOULD keep your room tidy.'
    Xonani ozoda tutish — IJOBIY.
    'mustn't' bo'lsa 'ozoda tutmasligingiz
    kerak' degan teskari ma'no chiqadi.
    → SHOULD

 7  'You SHOULDN'T buy pre-packaged food.'
    O'ralgan ovqat ko'p chiqindi hosil qiladi
    — SALBIY.
    → SHOULDN'T
    (CB 99-bet: 'Try NOT to buy pre-packaged
     food.')

 8  'You MUSTN'T fight in class.'
    Urishish — TAQIQLANGAN.
    'can fight' bo'lsa 'urishishingiz mumkin'
    degan ma'no chiqadi.
    → MUSTN'T
    (CB 102-bet, 13a: 6-o'quvchi)

 9  'A: I'm tired.  B: You SHOULD go to bed
     early.'
    KALIT: 'I'M TIRED' — yordam kerak, demak
    IJOBIY maslahat.
    → SHOULD
    (CB 101-bet, 9b: 'Get some sleep.')

10  'A: Can I go to the cinema?
     B: No, you CAN'T.'
    OLTIN QOIDA: QISQA JAVOB savoldagi
    MODALNI TAKRORLAYDI.
       'CAN I ...?'  →  'No, you CAN'T.'
    'shouldn't' bo'lsa savolga mos kelmaydi.
    → CAN'T


ENG MUHIM UCh KALIT:

  A) MA'NO IJOBIY MI?
     ijobiy → must / should / can
     salbiy → mustn't / shouldn't / can't

  B) QISQA JAVOB SAVOLNI TAKRORLAYDI (10-band)
     'Can I ...?' → 'No, you can't.'

  C) KONTEKSTDAGI SABAB (3, 4, 9-bandlar)
     'because it's bad'  → shouldn't
     'Speak louder'      → can't
     'I'm tired'         → should


MUST va SHOULD FARQI (1 va 6-bandlar):
   1  'You MUST be quiet in class.'
      → QOIDA (maktab qoidasi, majburiy)
   6  'You SHOULD keep your room tidy.'
      → MASLAHAT (yumshoqroq)

  Kitob ataylab ikkalasini yonma-yon bergan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  tidy          = ozoda, tartibli
  to keep tidy  = ozoda tutmoq
  louder        = balandroq
  to hear       = eshitmoq (hear → HEARD)
  health        = sog'liq
  the cinema    = kinoteatr
  a glass of water = bir stakan suv

topics.topic: Mashqlar — can/can't/must/mustn't, could/couldn't — VAZIYAT: o'qituvchi bolalarni HAYVONOT BOG'IGA · 5-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
VAZIYAT: o'qituvchi bolalarni HAYVONOT BOG'IGA
olib bormoqda va qoidalarni tushuntiryapti.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  MUST
   2  MUSTN'T
   3  CAN
   4  CAN'T
   5  CAN
   6  CAN
   7  CAN
   8  MUSTN'T
   9  CAN
  10  MUST


TO'LIQ DIALOG (javoblar bilan):

  Teacher:  Okay children, today we are going
            to visit the zoo and there are some
            rules we MUST follow. First, you
            MUSTN'T feed the animals.

  Student:  CAN we touch the animals?

  Teacher:  No, you CAN'T! You are not allowed
            to touch the animals because it's
            dangerous.

  Student:  CAN we take pictures of the animals?

  Teacher:  Yes, you CAN. You CAN take pictures
            but you MUSTN'T bother them.

  Student:  CAN we go anywhere we want?

  Teacher:  No! Everyone MUST stay close to me.


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:

  O'qituvchi: Xo'p bolalar, bugun hayvonot
              bog'iga boramiz va bajarishimiz
              KERAK bo'lgan bir necha qoida bor.
              Birinchidan, hayvonlarni
              ovqatlantirMANG.
  O'quvchi:   Hayvonlarga tegsak BO'LADIMI?
  O'qituvchi: Yo'q, BO'LMAYDI! Hayvonlarga
              tegishga ruxsat yo'q, chunki bu
              xavfli.
  O'quvchi:   Hayvonlarni suratga olsak
              BO'LADIMI?
  O'qituvchi: Ha, BO'LADI. Suratga olishingiz
              MUMKIN, lekin ularni bezovta
              qilMANG.
  O'quvchi:   Xohlagan joyimizga borsak
              BO'LADIMI?
  O'qituvchi: Yo'q! Hamma menga yaqin turishi
              KERAK.


HAR BIRI NEGA:

  1  'rules we ... FOLLOW'
     Qoidaga AMAL QILISh — MAJBURIYAT.
     → MUST

  2  'you ... FEED the animals'
     Hayvonot bog'ida ovqatlantirish
     TAQIQLANGAN.
     → MUSTN'T

  3  '... we TOUCH the animals?'
     SAVOL — RUXSAT so'ralyapti.
     → CAN
     ('Must we touch?' = 'tegishimiz shartmi?'
      — ma'nosiz)

  4  'No, you ...!'
     QISQA JAVOB savoldagi modalni
     TAKRORLAYDI: 'Can we?' → 'you CAN'T'.
     Yana KALIT: 'You are NOT ALLOWED to touch'
     — grammatika qutisidagi ta'rif:
     'can't = you AREN'T ALLOWED to'.
     → CAN'T

  5  '... we TAKE PICTURES?'
     Yana RUXSAT savoli.
     → CAN

  6  'Yes, you ...'
     Qisqa javob: 'Can we?' → 'you CAN'.
     → CAN

  7  'You ... take pictures'
     O'qituvchi hozirgina ruxsat berdi.
     → CAN

  8  'but you ... BOTHER them'
     'BUT' — qarama-qarshilik: ruxsat bor,
     LEKIN taqiq ham bor.
     Bezovta qilish TAQIQLANGAN.
     → MUSTN'T

  9  '... we go anywhere we want?'
     RUXSAT savoli.
     → CAN

 10  'Everyone ... STAY CLOSE to me.'
     Bu — QAT'IY qoida ('No!' bilan
     boshlangan).
     → MUST


OLTIN QOIDA — MASHQNING TUZILIShI:

  O'QUVChI so'raydi  →  DOIM 'CAN ...?'
                        (3, 5, 9)
  O'QITUVChI javob:
     ruxsat beradi   →  CAN     (6, 7)
     rad etadi       →  CAN'T   (4)
     qoida aytadi    →  MUST    (1, 10)
     taqiqlaydi      →  MUSTN'T (2, 8)


DIQQAT — 4-BAND 'MUSTN'T' EMAS, 'CAN'T':
  Ikkalasi ham taqiq, lekin:
  • QISQA JAVOB savoldagi modalni takrorlaydi
    ('Can we?' → 'you can't')
  • Matnning o'zi 'NOT ALLOWED' deydi —
    bu 'can't' ning ta'rifi


DIQQAT — 'ANYWHERE WE WANT':
  'anywhere (that) we want' = xohlagan
  joyimizga
  Coursebook 100-betdagi Yaponiya matnida ham
  bor edi: 'don't sit ANYWHERE YOU LIKE'.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a zoo         = hayvonot bog'i
  to follow rules = qoidalarga amal qilmoq
  to feed       = ovqatlantirmoq
  to touch      = tegmoq
  allowed       = ruxsat etilgan
  dangerous     = xavfli
  to take pictures = suratga olmoq
  to bother     = bezovta qilmoq
  anywhere      = istalgan joyda
  close to      = ... ga yaqin

topics.topic: Mashqlar — can/can't/must/mustn't, could/couldn't — BARCHA JAVOBLAR · 7-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  COULDN'T ... CAN
  2  CAN
  3  COULD
  4  CAN'T
  5  CAN
  6  COULDN'T
  7  COULDN'T ... CAN
  8  COULD


TO'LIQ GAPLAR VA TARJIMASI:

 1  Michael COULDN'T use a computer when he was
    two but he CAN now.
    (Maykl ikki yoshida kompyuterdan
     foydalana olmasdi, lekin hozir oladi.)

 2  Sally is from Paris. She CAN speak French.
    (Salli Parijdan. U fransuzcha gapira oladi.)

 3  COULD you play football when you were five?
    (Besh yoshingizda futbol o'ynay olarmidingiz?)

 4  I CAN'T go to the cinema. I must study for
    a test.
    (Kinoga bora olmayman. Nazorat ishiga
     tayyorlanishim kerak.)

 5  Paul is a chef. He CAN make many delicious
    dishes.
    (Pol oshpaz. U ko'p mazali taomlar tayyorlay
     oladi.)

 6  I lost my keys and I COULDN'T find them
    anywhere.
    (Kalitlarimni yo'qotdim va ularni hech
     qayerdan topa olmadim.)

 7  I COULDN'T count when I was three but I CAN
    now.
    (Uch yoshimda sanay olmasdim, lekin hozir
     olaman.)

 8  COULD you ride a bicycle when you were four?
    (To'rt yoshingizda velosiped mina
     olarmidingiz?)


OLTIN QOIDA — VAQT BELGISINI TOPING:

  O'TGAN ZAMON belgisi bo'lsa  →  COULD/COULDN'T
     'when he WAS two'
     'when you WERE five'
     'when I WAS three'
     'when you WERE four'
     'I LOST my keys'

  HOZIRGI ZAMON belgisi bo'lsa  →  CAN/CAN'T
     'but he ... NOW'
     'She IS from Paris'
     'Paul IS a chef'
     'I MUST study' (hozirgi majburiyat)

  Ya'ni GAPDAGI BOSHQA FE'L zamonni aytib
  turibdi!


HAR BIRI BATAFSIL:

 1  IKKI BO'SHLIQ, IKKI ZAMON:
       'when he WAS two'  → o'tgan → COULDN'T
       'but he ... NOW'   → hozir  → CAN
    Ma'no: ikki yoshida bilmasdi, hozir biladi.
    Shuning uchun birinchisi INKOR, ikkinchisi
    TASDIQ.

 2  'She IS from Paris' — hozirgi zamon.
    Parijliklar fransuzcha gapiradi → QOBILIYAT
    bor.
    → CAN

 3  'when you WERE five' — o'tgan zamon.
    SAVOL shakli → COULD egadan oldin.
    → COULD

 4  'I MUST study for a test' — hozirgi
    majburiyat, shuning uchun kinoga bora
    olmaydi.
    → CAN'T

 5  'Paul IS a chef' — hozirgi zamon.
    Oshpaz — demak QOBILIYATI bor.
    → CAN

 6  'I LOST my keys' — o'tgan zamon (lost).
    Shuning uchun keyingi fe'l ham o'tgan
    zamonda.
    → COULDN'T
    ('anywhere' — inkor gapda 'hech qayerda')

 7  1-band bilan AYNAN bir xil tuzilish:
       'when I WAS three' → COULDN'T
       'but I ... NOW'    → CAN

 8  3-band bilan bir xil: 'when you WERE four'
    → savol, o'tgan zamon
    → COULD


DIQQAT — 6-BANDDA 'ANYWHERE':
  'I couldn't find them ANYWHERE.'
  = hech qayerdan topa olmadim

  INKOR gapda 'anywhere' = 'hech qayerda'.
  TASDIQ gapda 'anywhere' = 'istalgan joyda'
  (5-mashqning 9-bandidagidek).

  Bir so'z, gap shakliga qarab ikki ma'no!


DIQQAT — 'CAN' QOBILIYAT MI, RUXSAT MI:
  Bu mashqda hammasi QOBILIYAT (ability):
     use a computer, speak French, play
     football, make dishes, count, ride a
     bicycle

  4-bandda esa boshqacha: 'I CAN'T go to the
  cinema' — bu qobiliyat emas, VAZIYAT
  (imkoni yo'q, chunki o'qishi kerak).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to use a computer = kompyuterdan foydalanmoq
  French            = fransuz tili
  a chef            = oshpaz (professional)
  delicious         = mazali
  a dish            = taom; likopcha
  to lose           = yo'qotmoq (lose → LOST)
  keys              = kalitlar
  anywhere          = hech qayerda (inkorda)
  to count          = sanamoq
  a bicycle         = velosiped

topics.topic: Mashqlar — can/can't/must/mustn't, could/couldn't — BARCHA JAVOBLAR · 8-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  MUSTN'T
  2  MUST
  3  MUST
  4  MUSTN'T
  5  MUSTN'T
  6  MUST


TO'LIQ GAPLAR VA TARJIMASI:

 1  It's cold. You MUSTN'T leave without your
    jacket.
    (Sovuq. Kurtkasiz chiqmang.)

 2  You MUST eat fruit and vegetables to stay
    healthy.
    (Sog'lom bo'lish uchun meva va sabzavot
     yeyishingiz kerak.)

 3  I MUST go to the post office. I have a
    letter to send.
    (Pochtaga borishim kerak. Yuboradigan
     xatim bor.)

 4  You MUSTN'T speak rudely to your parents.
    (Ota-onangizga qo'pol gapirmang.)

 5  You MUSTN'T park here — it's illegal.
    (Bu yerga mashina qo'ymang — qonunga
     xilof.)

 6  We MUST hurry or we'll miss the bus.
    (Shoshilishimiz kerak, aks holda
     avtobusdan qolamiz.)


HAR BIRIDA SABAB GAPNING ICHIDA:

 1  'IT'S COLD.'
    → kurtkasiz chiqish XAVFLI → MUSTN'T

 2  'TO STAY HEALTHY'
    → maqsad IJOBIY → MUST

 3  'I HAVE A LETTER TO SEND.'
    → sabab bor, borish KERAK → MUST

 4  'RUDELY' (qo'pol)
    → qo'pollik TAQIQLANGAN → MUSTN'T

 5  'IT'S ILLEGAL.'
    → qonun taqiqlagan → MUSTN'T
    (Coursebook 102-bet, 16e-dialog bilan
     AYNAN bir xil!)

 6  'OR WE'LL MISS THE BUS.'
    → 'or' = aks holda; shoshilish ZARUR
    → MUST


OLTIN QOIDA:
  Har bandda IKKINCHI qism (sabab) javobni
  belgilaydi.
     Sabab SALBIY/XAVFLI  →  MUSTN'T
     Sabab MAQSAD/ZARURAT →  MUST


DIQQAT — 6-BANDDAGI 'OR':
  'We must hurry OR we'll miss the bus.'
  'or' = aks holda

  Coursebook 100-betdagi Angliya matnida ham
  bor edi:
  'Never push into a queue OR they'll get
   angry.'

  Tuzilishi:
     [buyruq/must] + OR + [will bilan natija]


DIQQAT — 4-BANDDA 'RUDELY':
  'speak RUDELY' — RAVISH (fe'lni izohlaydi)
  'be RUDE' — SIFAT

     'He speaks rudely.'  ✓ (ravish)
     'He is rude.'        ✓ (sifat)
     'He speaks rude.'    ✗

  Coursebook 100-bet, Xitoy matni:
  'it's very RUDE' (sifat).


DIQQAT — 3-BANDDA 'A LETTER TO SEND':
  'I have a letter TO SEND.'
  = yuboradigan xatim bor

  'ot + TO + fe'l' qurilmasi:
     something to eat   = yeydigan narsa
     a place to stay    = turadigan joy
                          (6-mashqdagi xatda!)
     work to do         = qiladigan ish


DIQQAT — 1-BANDDA 'WITHOUT':
  'leave WITHOUT your jacket' = kurtkasiz
  chiqmoq
  'without' — predlog, keyin OT yoki -ING:
     without a jacket
     without eating


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to leave        = chiqmoq, ketmoq
  without         = ...siz
  a jacket        = kurtka
  to stay healthy = sog'lom bo'lib turmoq
  the post office = pochta bo'limi
  to send         = yubormoq (send → SENT)
  rudely          = qo'pol tarzda
  parents         = ota-ona
  illegal         = qonunga xilof
  to hurry        = shoshilmoq
  to miss the bus = avtobusdan qolmoq

topics.topic: Giving Advice — Maslahat berish
topics.rule_uz:
GRAMMATIKA QUTISI — MASLAHAT BERISH

KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 1 'We use SHOULD to say what the right/best
    thing to do is.'
    You SHOULD use public transport.
    (= It's a good idea.)

 2 'We use SHOULDN'T to say what isn't the
    right/best thing to do.'
    You SHOULDN'T use aerosols.
    (= It isn't a good idea.)

 3 'We can also give advice with:'
    • Why don't you ...?
    • I think it's a good idea to ...
    • I don't think it's a good idea to ...

    Why don't you use public transport?
    I think it's a good idea to use public
      transport.
    I don't think it's a good idea to use
      aerosols.


SHOULD — ENG MUHIM QOIDALAR:

  1  SHOULD dan keyin fe'lning ASOSIY shakli:
        You should USE ...        ✓
        You should to use ...     ✗
        You should USES ...       ✗
        You should USING ...      ✗

  2  Barcha shaxslarda BIR XIL — -S QO'ShILMAYDI:
        I should      we should
        you should    you should
        he should     they should
        she should
        it should

        'He shouldS' — XATO!

  3  Inkor: SHOULD NOT = SHOULDN'T
        You shouldn't use aerosols.
        ('You don't should' — XATO!)

  4  Savol: SHOULD + ega + fe'l
        Should I use public transport?
        ('Do I should ...?' — XATO!)


UCh XIL MASLAHAT ShAKLI — QIYOSI:

  SHOULD           — oddiy, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri
     'You should drink more water.'

  WHY DON'T YOU ?  — do'stona TAKLIF
     'Why don't you drink more water?'
     DIQQAT: shakli SAVOL, ma'nosi MASLAHAT.

  I THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO — yumshoq FIKR
     'I think it's a good idea to drink more
      water.'


DIQQAT — 'WHY DON'T YOU ...?':
  Bu — savol EMAS, MASLAHAT.
  So'zma-so'z: 'Nega ... qilmaysiz?'
  Ma'nosi: '... qilib ko'rsangiz-chi?'

  Tuzilishi:
     Why don't you + [ASOSIY fe'l] + ... ?
     Why don't you USE public transport?
     ('Why don't you TO use' — XATO)


DIQQAT — 'IT'S A GOOD IDEA TO + fe'l':
  'It's a good idea TO USE public transport.' ✓
  'It's a good idea USING ...'                ✗
  'It's a good idea USE ...'                  ✗

  INKORI — 'don't' BOSH gapga qo'yiladi:
     'I DON'T think it's a good idea to use
      aerosols.'                              ✓
     'I think it ISN'T a good idea ...'
      — grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri, lekin
        inglizlar birinchi shaklni ishlatadi.

  Bu — 'inkorni oldinga surish' hodisasi:
     I think he isn't right.  (kam ishlatiladi)
     I DON'T think he is right. (tabiiy)


MASLAHAT BERISHNING BARCHA ShAKLLARI
(ijobiy va salbiy juftlik):

  IJOBIY                     SALBIY
  ────────────────────────   ─────────────────────
  You SHOULD ...             You SHOULDN'T ...
  Why don't you ... ?        (juftligi yo'q)
  I think it's a good        I DON'T think it's a
    idea to ...                good idea to ...


BOG'LIQLIK — BUYRUQ BILAN FARQI:
  BUYRUQ:     'Use public transport.'
              — qat'iy, buyruq ohangi
  MASLAHAT:   'You should use public transport.'
              — yumshoq, tavsiya

  Varaqa (leaflet) BUYRUQ ishlatadi — chunki
  rasmiy e'lon.
  Do'stingizga esa MASLAHAT ishlatasiz.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  advice        = maslahat (SANALMAYDIGAN!)
                  'an advice' XATO
                  'a piece of advice' ✓
  to advise     = maslahat bermoq
  a good idea   = yaxshi fikr
  the right thing = to'g'ri ish
examples: We use should to say what the right/best thing to do is.
You should use public transport. (= It's a good idea.)
We use shouldn't to say what isn't the right/best thing to do.
You shouldn't use aerosols. (= It isn't a good idea.)
We can also give advice with: Why don't you...? I think it's a good idea to ..., I don't think it's a good idea to ...
Why don't you use public transport?
I think it's a good idea to use public transport.
I don't think it's a good idea to use aerosols.

topics.topic: can/can't, must/mustn't (1)
topics.rule_uz:
GRAMMATIKA QUTISI — TO'RT MODAL

KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 1 'We use CAN to give permission.'
      You CAN listen to the radio.
      (= You are ALLOWED to.)
      → RUXSAT BERISH

 2 'We use CAN'T to refuse permission.'
      You CAN'T keep pets in your room.
      (= You AREN'T allowed to.)
      → RUXSAT BERMASLIK

 3 'We use MUST to tell someone to do
    something.' (expressing OBLIGATION)
      You MUST clean your room.
      (= You are OBLIGED to.)
      → MAJBURIYAT

 4 'We use MUSTN'T to tell someone not to do
    something.' (expressing PROHIBITION)
      You MUSTN'T smoke in hospitals.
      (= It's FORBIDDEN.)
      → TAQIQ


TO'RTTASINI BIR JADVALDA:

            RUXSAT        MAJBURIYAT
  IJOBIY    CAN           MUST
            (mumkin)      (shart)

  SALBIY    CAN'T         MUSTN'T
            (mumkin emas) (mutlaqo mumkin emas)


ENG MUHIM FARQ — 'CAN'T' va 'MUSTN'T':

  CAN'T   — ruxsat berilmagan
            'You can't keep pets.'
            (Uy egasi ruxsat bermayapti.)

  MUSTN'T — TAQIQLANGAN, qonun/qoida
            'You mustn't smoke in hospitals.'
            (Bu — qat'iy taqiq.)

  Amalda ikkalasi ko'pincha almashib
  ishlatiladi, lekin 'mustn't' KUChLIROQ.


ENG MUHIM FARQ — 'MUSTN'T' va 'DON'T HAVE TO':

  MUSTN'T       = mutlaqo QILMASLIK kerak
     'You mustn't be late.'
     (Kechikish TAQIQLANGAN.)

  DON'T HAVE TO = qilish ShART EMAS
                  (lekin xohlasangiz mumkin)
     'You don't have to be early.'
     (Erta kelish shart emas.)

  Bu — o'zbek tilida ikkalasi ham 'kerak emas'
  deb tarjima qilinadi, shuning uchun eng
  ko'p xato qilinadigan joy!


BARCHASIDAN KEYIN — ASOSIY ShAKL:
  You can LISTEN ...      ✓
  You can TO listen ...   ✗
  You must CLEAN ...      ✓
  You must TO clean ...   ✗
  He must CLEANS ...      ✗ (-S YO'Q!)


HECH QANDAY ShAXSDA -S QO'ShILMAYDI:
  I can / you can / he can / she can /
  it can / we can / they can
  I must / you must / he must / ...

  'He cans' ✗   'She musts' ✗


SAVOL ShAKLI — 'DO' KERAK EMAS:
  Can I use the telephone?   ✓
  Do I can use ...?          ✗
  Must I make the bed?       ✓
  Do I must ...?             ✗


QISQA JAVOBLAR:
  Can I play music?
     — Yes, you CAN. / No, you CAN'T.
  Must I make the bed?
     — Yes, you MUST. / No, you NEEDN'T.
     (DIQQAT: 'No, you mustn't' — BOSHQA ma'no!
      'mustn't' = taqiq, 'needn't' = shart emas.)


'MUST' va 'HAVE TO' — 12-MAShQDAN:
  12-mashqning namunasi:
     SA: 'Do I HAVE TO make the bed?'
     SB: 'Yes, you do. You MUST make the bed.'

  Ya'ni SAVOLDA 'have to', JAVOBDA 'must'.
  Nega? Chunki 'must' savol shaklida kamroq
  ishlatiladi — 'Do I have to ...?' tabiiyroq.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  permission   = ruxsat
  to allow     = ruxsat bermoq
  allowed      = ruxsat etilgan
  to refuse    = rad etmoq
  obligation   = majburiyat
  obliged      = majbur
  prohibition  = taqiq
  forbidden    = taqiqlangan
examples: We use can to give permission. You can listen to the radio. (You are allowed to.)
We use can't to refuse permission. You can't keep pets in your room. (You aren't allowed to.)
We use must to tell someone to do something. (expressing obligation) You must clean your room. (You are obliged to.)
We use mustn't to tell someone not to do something. (expressing prohibition) You mustn't smoke in hospitals. (It's forbidden.)

topics.topic: can/can't, must/mustn't — VAZIYAT · 11-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
VAZIYAT:
  Mrs Battersby — uy egasi (landlady).
  'a lodger' = ijarachi (birovning uyida
  xona ijaraga oluvchi).
  U yangi ijarachiga UY QOIDALARINI aytyapti.


JADVALDA 10 QATOR, 3 USTUN:
  MUST  |  CAN'T  |  CAN


BU MASHQ AUDIOGA MO'LJALLANGAN, LEKIN
BETNING O'ZI 5 QATORNI TASDIQLAYDI:

 1  KEEP PETS → CAN'T
    Kitobda ✓ allaqachon qo'yilgan (NAMUNA).
    Grammatika qutisi ham aynan shu:
    'You CAN'T keep pets in your room.'
    Jadval ostidagi namuna gap ham:
    'You can't keep pets.'

 2  PLAY LOUD MUSIC → CAN'T
    12-mashqning namuna dialogi:
       SA: 'CAN I PLAY LOUD MUSIC?'
       SB: 'NO, YOU CAN'T.'

 3  USE THE TELEPHONE → CAN
    12-mashqning namuna dialogi:
       SA: 'CAN I USE THE TELEPHONE?'
       SB: 'YES, OF COURSE YOU CAN.'

 4  MAKE THE BED → MUST
    12-mashqning namuna dialogi:
       SA: 'DO I HAVE TO MAKE THE BED?'
       SB: 'Yes, you do. YOU MUST MAKE THE BED.'

 5  KEEP THE ROOM CLEAN → MUST
    Grammatika qutisining misoli:
    'You MUST CLEAN YOUR ROOM.'


QOLGAN 5 QATOR — FAQAT AUDIODAN:
  have parties in the room
  have a TV in the room
  put posters on the walls
  pay the rent on time
  be home by 11 pm

  Bular betning hech yerida yozilmagan.
  Taxmin bilan to'ldirilmadi — audio
