  tinglanganda belgilanadi.
  (Ular quyidagi alohida ro'yxatda
   ko'rsatilgan.)


TASDIQLANGAN 5 QATOR UChUN TO'LIQ GAPLAR:

  You CAN'T keep pets.
  You CAN'T play loud music.
  You CAN use the telephone.
  You MUST make the bed.
  You MUST keep the room clean.


DIQQAT — JADVAL OSTIDAGI NAMUNA:
  Kitob jadval ostiga yozgan:
     'You can't keep pets.'
  Bu — birinchi qatorning to'liq gap shakli.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a lodger      = ijarachi (xona ijarasi)
  a landlady    = uy bekasi (ijaraga beruvchi)
  a landlord    = uy egasi (erkak)
  the rent      = ijara haqi
  on time       = o'z vaqtida
  a poster      = plakat
  loud          = baland (ovoz)
  to make the bed = to'shakni yig'ishtirmoq
  by 11 pm      = kechqurun 11 gacha

topics.topic: can/can't, must/mustn't (2)
topics.rule_uz:
OChIQ QOLGAN 4 QATOR

Quyidagi to'rtta qator betning HECH YERIDA
yozilmagan. Ularni faqat Mrs Battersby ning
nutqini tinglab aniqlash mumkin.

TAXMIN BILAN TO'LDIRILMADI — audio
tinglanganda o'zingiz belgilaysiz.


  1  have parties in the room
     (xonada bazm o'tkazish)
     MUST  /  CAN'T  /  CAN   →  ........

  2  have a TV in the room
     (xonada televizor saqlash)
     MUST  /  CAN'T  /  CAN   →  ........

  3  put posters on the walls
     (devorlarga plakat osish)
     MUST  /  CAN'T  /  CAN   →  ........

  4  pay the rent on time
     (ijara haqini o'z vaqtida to'lash)
     MUST  /  CAN'T  /  CAN   →  ........


BELGILAGANDAN KEYIN GAP TUZISH:

  Agar MUST bo'lsa:
     You MUST pay the rent on time.
  Agar CAN'T bo'lsa:
     You CAN'T have parties in the room.
  Agar CAN bo'lsa:
     You CAN have a TV in the room.


HAR BIRINING LUG'ATI:

  to have a party    = bazm o'tkazmoq
  a TV               = televizor
  a poster           = plakat
  to put ... on the walls = devorlarga osmoq
  the rent           = ijara haqi
  to pay the rent    = ijara haqini to'lamoq
  on time            = o'z vaqtida
  to be home         = uyda bo'lmoq
  by 11 pm           = kechqurun 11 GACHA


DIQQAT — 'BY' va 'UNTIL' FARQI:
  'be home BY 11 pm'
     = 11 GACHA uyga yetib kelish
       (11 dan KEChIKMASDAN)

  'stay home UNTIL 11 pm'
     = 11 GACHA uyda TURISh
       (butun vaqt davomida)

  'by' — oxirgi muddat
  'until' — davomiylik


DIQQAT — 'ON TIME' va 'IN TIME':
  'pay the rent ON TIME'
     = o'z vaqtida, belgilangan kunda
  'arrive IN TIME'
     = ulgurib, kech qolmasdan


DIQQAT — 'BE HOME' — PREDLOG YO'Q:
  'be HOME'      ✓
  'be AT home'   ✓ (ikkalasi ham to'g'ri)
  'go HOME'      ✓
  'go TO home'   ✗ (XATO!)
examples: have parties in the room — MUST / CAN'T / CAN?
have a TV in the room — MUST / CAN'T / CAN?
put posters on the walls — MUST / CAN'T / CAN?
pay the rent on time — MUST / CAN'T / CAN?

topics.topic: must / mustn't — KO'RSATMALAR RO'YXATI (10 ta) · 13a-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KO'RSATMALAR RO'YXATI (10 ta):
  eat in class, chew gum in class,
  write on the walls, keep the classroom clean,
  be quiet in class, cheat in tests,
  sleep in class, talk to each other in class,
  bring pets into school, fight in class


RASMDA 9 TA RAQAMLANGAN O'QUVCHI:

  1  Yashil koftali qiz, og'zidan PUFAK
     chiqib turibdi          → saqich chaynayapti
  2  Sariq sochli bola devorga 'I ♥ KATE' deb
     YOZYAPTI                → devorga yozyapti
  3  Sariq sochli qiz (to'q sariq kofta,
     ayiqcha rasmi), qo'lida qalam, boshini
     yon tomonga burib qarayapti
                             → nusxa ko'chiryapti
  4  Sariq sochli bola boshini partaga qo'yib
     UXLAYAPTI               → uxlayapti
  5  Binafsha koftali bola qo'lida non/pishiriq,
     og'zi ochiq             → OVQAT YEYAPTI
  6  Yashil va jigarrang koftali ikki bola
     bo'yinlashib OLIShYAPTI → urishyapti
  7  Sariq koftali bola tirjayib, g'ijimlangan
     qog'ozlarni OTYAPTI     → sinfni ifloslantiryapti
  8  Qizil koftali qiz partadagi qutidagi
     MUShUKChAGA qo'l cho'zgan
                             → maktabga hayvon olib kelgan
  9  Ikki qiz boshlarini qo'shib PIChIRLAShYAPTI
                             → gaplashyaptilar


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  You MUSTN'T chew gum in class.
  2  You MUSTN'T write on the walls.
  3  You MUSTN'T cheat in tests.
  4  You MUSTN'T sleep in class.
  5  You MUSTN'T eat in class.
  6  You MUSTN'T fight in class.
  7  You MUST keep the classroom clean.
  8  You MUSTN'T bring pets into school.
  9  You MUSTN'T talk to each other in class.

  (be quiet in class → You MUST be quiet in
   class. — alohida o'quvchisi yo'q)


⚠ KITOBNING O'Z XATOSI:

  Kitob namuna sifatida yozgan:
     '1-You mustn't EAT in class.'

  LEKIN rasmda 1-o'quvchi SAQICH CHAYNAYAPTI —
  og'zidan pufak chiqib turibdi.
  OVQAT yeyayotgani esa 5-o'quvchi (binafsha
  koftali bola, qo'lida pishiriq).

  Rasm 5 barobar kattalashtirilib tekshirildi.

  Ehtimol kitob '1-' deganda RO'YXATNING
  birinchi so'zini ('eat in class') nazarda
  tutgan, RASMDAGI 1-o'quvchini emas.

  Ikkala variant ham quyida ko'rsatildi.


DIQQAT — IKKI TA IJOBIY KO'RSATMA:

  Ro'yxatdagi 10 tadan 8 tasi SALBIY
  (mustn't), lekin IKKITASI IJOBIY (must):

     keep the classroom clean
        → You MUST keep the classroom clean.
     be quiet in class
        → You MUST be quiet in class.

  Mashq nomi ham shuni aytadi:
  'what they MUST OR MUSTN'T do'.

  Agar ularni ham 'mustn't' bilan yozsangiz,
  ma'no TESKARI bo'lib qoladi:
     'You mustn't keep the classroom clean' ✗
     (= sinfni toza tutish taqiqlangan!)


DIQQAT — 9 O'QUVCHI, 10 KO'RSATMA:
  'be quiet in class' ga alohida o'quvchi
  to'g'ri kelmaydi — bu butun sinfga tegishli
  umumiy qoida.
  (6-urishuv va 9-gaplashuv ham shovqin
   qiladi, lekin ular boshqa ko'rsatmalarni
   olgan.)
  Taxmin bilan bog'lanmadi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to chew gum   = saqich chaynamoq
  chewing gum   = saqich
  to cheat      = aldamoq, nusxa ko'chirmoq
  a test        = nazorat ishi
  to fight      = urishmoq (fight → FOUGHT)
  quiet         = jim, tinch
  a classroom   = sinfxona
  to bring into = ichkariga olib kirmoq
  each other    = bir-biri
  while in class = darsda, dars davomida

topics.topic: must / mustn't
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'You MUST do your homework.'


QOLIP:
  You MUST + [ASOSIY fe'l] + ...    (majburiyat)
  You MUSTN'T + [ASOSIY fe'l] + ... (taqiq)


NAMUNA QOIDALAR (maktab uchun):

  MUST bilan (nima QILISh kerak):
     You must do your homework.  (NAMUNA)
     You must come to school on time.
     You must wear your school uniform.
     You must listen to the teacher.
     You must put up your hand before you speak.
     You must keep the classroom clean.
     You must be quiet in class.

  MUSTN'T bilan (nima QILMASLIK kerak):
     You mustn't be late for class.
     You mustn't use your mobile phone in class.
     You mustn't run in the corridors.
     You mustn't cheat in tests.
     You mustn't fight with other students.
     You mustn't drop rubbish in the playground.


UChTA QOIDA — NAMUNA JAVOB:
  1  You must do your homework every day.
  2  You must be quiet in class.
  3  You mustn't use your mobile phone in class.


DIQQAT — 'MUST' DAN KEYIN 'TO' YO'Q:
  'You must DO your homework.'    ✓
  'You must TO DO your homework.' ✗


DIQQAT — 'MUSTN'T' va 'DON'T HAVE TO':
  'You MUSTN'T be late.'
     = kechikish TAQIQLANGAN
  'You DON'T HAVE TO be early.'
     = erta kelish SHART EMAS (lekin mumkin)

  Maktab qoidalarida deyarli doim 'mustn't'
  ishlatiladi, chunki qoida — taqiq.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a rule        = qoida
  homework      = uy vazifasi (SANALMAYDIGAN!)
                  'homeworks' XATO
  a uniform     = maktab formasi
  a corridor    = koridor
  a playground  = maktab hovlisi
  to put up your hand = qo'l ko'tarmoq
examples: You must do your homework.
You must come to school on time and listen to the teacher.
You must be quiet in class and keep the classroom clean.
You mustn't be late for class or use your mobile phone in class.
You mustn't run in the corridors or fight with other students.
You mustn't cheat in tests.

topics.topic: should / shouldn't — BARCHA JAVOBLAR · 7-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  SHOULD
  2  SHOULDN'T
  3  SHOULD
  4  SHOULD
  5  SHOULDN'T
  6  SHOULD
  7  SHOULD
  8  SHOULDN'T

  Ya'ni: SHOULD — 1, 3, 4, 6, 7 (5 ta)
         SHOULDN'T — 2, 5, 8 (3 ta)


TO'LIQ GAPLAR VA TARJIMASI:

 1  Kevin has a problem with his eyes. He
    SHOULD see an optician.
    (Kevinning ko'zi bilan muammo bor. U
     ko'zoynak ustasiga borishi kerak.)

 2  People SHOULDN'T drop litter in the
    streets.
    (Odamlar ko'chalarga axlat tashlamasligi
     kerak.)

 3  It's cold outside. You SHOULD put on a
    heavy jacket.
    (Tashqarida sovuq. Qalin kurtka
     kiyishingiz kerak.)

 4  You SHOULD look both ways before crossing
    the street.
    (Ko'chadan o'tishdan oldin ikki tomonga
     qarashingiz kerak.)

 5  You SHOULDN'T swim after eating a big meal.
    (Ko'p ovqat yegandan keyin suzmasligingiz
     kerak.)

 6  Michael SHOULD join a gym to lose weight.
    (Maykl vazn tashlash uchun sport zaliga
     yozilishi kerak.)

 7  When you are on a bus you SHOULD give your
    seat to older people.
    (Avtobusda bo'lganingizda o'rningizni
     keksalarga berishingiz kerak.)

 8  Children SHOULDN'T talk to strangers.
    (Bolalar notanish odamlar bilan
     gaplashmasligi kerak.)


OLTIN QOIDA:
  Ish FOYDALI/XAVFSIZ    →  SHOULD
  Ish ZARARLI/XAVFLI     →  SHOULDN'T


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  KALIT: 'a PROBLEM with his eyes' —
    muammo bor, demak yordam kerak → SHOULD.
    (Coursebook 102-bet, 16a-dialog:
     'You should see an optician.')

 2  Ko'chaga axlat tashlash — ZARARLI
    → SHOULDN'T.
    (Coursebook 99-bet, varaqa)

 3  KALIT: 'IT'S COLD outside' — sovuqda
    qalin kiyim FOYDALI → SHOULD.
    (Grammar 62-bet, 8-mashqning 1-bandi:
     'It's cold. You mustn't leave without
      your jacket.')

 4  Ko'chadan o'tishdan oldin qarash —
    XAVFSIZLIK choralari → SHOULD.

 5  To'la oshqozon bilan suzish — XAVFLI
    → SHOULDN'T.
    (Coursebook 103-bet, 17b:
     'It is dangerous to swim with a full
      stomach.')

 6  KALIT: 'TO LOSE WEIGHT' — maqsad
    IJOBIY → SHOULD.

 7  Keksalarga o'rin berish — ODOBLI ish
    → SHOULD.

 8  Notanish odamlar bilan gaplashish —
    bolalar uchun XAVFLI → SHOULDN'T.


DIQQAT — 'PUT ON' AJRALADIGAN FE'L:
  'PUT ON a heavy jacket'  ✓
  'PUT a heavy jacket ON'  ✓
  'PUT IT ON'              ✓
  'PUT ON IT'              ✗

  Coursebook 101-bet, 9b: 'Put a jumper on.'


DIQQAT — 'BEFORE CROSSING':
  'before CROSSING the street'
  Predlogdan keyin fe'l -ING oladi.

  Yana: 'after EATING' (5-band)


DIQQAT — 'LOOK BOTH WAYS':
  'both ways' = ikki tomonga (chapga va o'ngga)
  'a way' bu yerda = tomon, yo'nalish.


DIQQAT — 'JOIN A GYM':
  'to JOIN a gym/club/team' = a'zo bo'lmoq,
  yozilmoq
  ('to enter a gym' — shunchaki ichkariga
   kirish)

  'to LOSE WEIGHT' = vazn tashlamoq
  (lose → LOST)
  Teskarisi: 'to PUT ON weight' = semirmoq


DIQQAT — 'GIVE YOUR SEAT TO':
  'give something TO somebody' — predlog 'to'.
  'older people' = keksalar
  ('old people' ham to'g'ri, lekin 'older'
   odobliroq).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an optician    = ko'zoynak ustasi
  litter         = axlat
  heavy          = qalin, og'ir
  both ways      = ikki tomonga
  to cross       = kesib o'tmoq
  a meal         = ovqat (bir mahal)
  to join a gym  = sport zaliga yozilmoq
  to lose weight = vazn tashlamoq
  a seat         = o'rindiq, joy
  older people   = keksalar
  a stranger     = notanish odam

topics.topic: should / shouldn't
topics.rule_uz:
SARLAVHA:
  'HOW TO TAKE CARE OF YOUR DOG'
  (Itingizni qanday parvarish qilish kerak)

BESH BAND, HAR BIRIDA RASM va BELGI:
  ✓ = SHOULD    (qilish kerak)
  ✗ = SHOULDN'T (qilmaslik kerak)

  Ya'ni BELGI javobni AYTIB TURIBDI —
  taxmin kerak emas!


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  ✓ take/for a walk three times a day
    → You SHOULD take your dog for a walk
      three times a day.
      (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 2  ✗ keep/cage
    → You SHOULDN'T keep your dog in a cage.

 3  ✓ feed/once a day
    → You SHOULD feed your dog once a day.

 4  ✓ wash/once a week
    → You SHOULD wash your dog once a week.

 5  ✗ leave/at home alone
    → You SHOULDN'T leave your dog at home
      alone.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
 1  Itingizni kuniga uch marta sayrga olib
    chiqishingiz kerak.
 2  Itingizni qafasda saqlamasligingiz kerak.
 3  Itingizni kuniga bir marta
    ovqatlantirishingiz kerak.
 4  Itingizni haftada bir marta
    yuvishingiz kerak.
 5  Itingizni uyda yolg'iz
    qoldirmasligingiz kerak.


RASMLARDA NIMA KO'RINADI:
  1  It sayr uchun tayyor, arqonni tishlab
     turibdi
  2  It QAFASDA (panjara ortida), g'amgin
  3  It kosasi yonida o'tiribdi
  4  It TOG'ORAda yuvinyapti
  5  It 'FIDO' yozuvli budkasida YOLG'IZ


QISQARTMA ShAKLNI TO'LIQ GAPGA AYLANTIRISh:

  Kitob chiziqcha bilan qisqa ko'rsatma
  bergan. To'liq gapda EGALIK olmoshi va
  PREDLOG qo'shiladi:

     take/for a walk
       → take YOUR DOG for a walk

     keep/cage
       → keep YOUR DOG IN A cage

     feed/once a day
       → feed YOUR DOG once a day

     wash/once a week
       → wash YOUR DOG once a week

     leave/at home alone
       → leave YOUR DOG at home alone

  DIQQAT — 2-BANDDA PREDLOG QO'ShILADI:
  'keep/cage' → 'keep your dog IN A cage'
  Bu — eng ko'p unutiladigan joy.


GRAMMAR 61-BET BILAN SOLIShTIRING:
  U yerda AYNAN shunday mashq bor edi, lekin
  MUShUK haqida:
     'HOW TO TAKE CARE OF YOUR CAT'
     feed/twice a day, leave/outside,
     take/to the vet, forget/to fill water
     bowl, empty/litter tray

  Bu yerda IT haqida.
  Farqlar qiziq:
     mushuk — kuniga IKKI marta ovqat
     it     — kuniga BIR marta ovqat


TAKRORLANISh IBORALARI:
  three times a day = kuniga uch marta
  once a day        = kuniga bir marta
  once a week       = haftada bir marta

  DIQQAT:
     once  (bir marta) — 'one time' emas
     twice (ikki marta) — 'two times' emas
     three TIMES (uch marta) — uchdan boshlab
                              'times'


DIQQAT — 'TAKE FOR A WALK':
  'to take somebody FOR A WALK' = sayrga olib
  chiqmoq (turg'un ibora)

  'to GO for a walk' = sayr qilmoq
  'to TAKE somebody for a walk' = birovni
  sayrga olib chiqmoq


DIQQAT — 'LEAVE ... ALONE':
  'leave your dog at home ALONE' = uyda
  YOLG'IZ qoldirmoq

  'alone' — sifat/ravish (yolg'iz).
  DIQQAT: 'lonely' — BOSHQA ma'no
  (yolg'izlikdan qiynalgan).

  Coursebook 100-bet, Yaponiya matni:
  'find a place where you can do it ALONE'.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a dog owner   = it egasi
  to take care of = parvarish qilmoq
  to take for a walk = sayrga olib chiqmoq
  a cage        = qafas
  to feed       = ovqatlantirmoq
  to wash       = yuvmoq
  to leave alone = yolg'iz qoldirmoq
  three times a day = kuniga uch marta
examples: 1 ✓ take/for a walk three times a day → You should take your dog for a walk three times a day.
2 ✗ keep/cage → You shouldn't keep your dog in a cage.
3 ✓ feed/once a day → You should feed your dog once a day.
4 ✓ wash/once a week → You should wash your dog once a week.
5 ✗ leave/at home alone → You shouldn't leave your dog at home alone.

topics.topic: always/never, should, must/mustn't (1)
topics.rule_uz:
JADVAL IKKI USTUNLI:  DO  /  DON'T

Birinchi qatorga kitob ✓ ni ALLAQAChON
'DON'T' ustuniga qo'ygan (namuna).


BARCHA JAVOBLAR (✓ qayerga):

  1  leave the camp fire burning when you go
     to sleep                        →  DON'T
  2  have a torch with you           →  DO
  3  take too many clothes with you  →  DON'T
  4  put your tent up next to a river →  DON'T
  5  keep a lot of money in your tent →  DON'T
  6  leave rubbish behind            →  DON'T
  7  tell your family where you are  →  DO

  Ya'ni: DO — 2 va 7 (2 ta)
         DON'T — 1, 3, 4, 5, 6 (5 ta)


TO'LIQ GAPLAR:

 1  NEVER leave the camp fire burning when you
    go to sleep.
    (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 2  ALWAYS have a torch with you.

 3  NEVER take too many clothes with you.

 4  NEVER put your tent up next to a river.

 5  NEVER keep a lot of money in your tent.

 6  NEVER leave rubbish behind.

 7  ALWAYS tell your family where you are.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
 1  Uxlagani ketayotganda gulxanni yonib
    turgan holda hech qachon qoldirmang.
 2  Doim qo'l fonarini yoningizda olib yuring.
 3  Hech qachon juda ko'p kiyim olmang.
 4  Chodiringizni hech qachon daryo yoniga
    tikmang.
 5  Chodiringizda hech qachon ko'p pul
    saqlamang.
 6  Hech qachon axlat tashlab ketmang.
 7  Doim oilangizga qayerdaligingizni ayting.


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  DON'T — yonayotgan gulxan O'RMON
    YONG'INIGA sabab bo'ladi.
    (Coursebook 99-bet: 'Never light fires in
     forests. Trees will burn.')

 2  DO — fonar kechasi ZARUR (kempingda
    elektr yo'q).

 3  DON'T — ko'p kiyim = OG'IR yuk;
    hammasini o'zingiz ko'tarasiz.

 4  DON'T — daryo TOSHIB ketishi mumkin,
    chodir suv ostida qoladi.

 5  DON'T — chodirni QULFLAB bo'lmaydi,
    pul o'g'irlanadi.

 6  DON'T — axlat tabiatni IFLOSLANTIRADI.
    (Coursebook 99 va 103-betlar)

 7  DO — biror narsa bo'lsa, oilangiz
    sizni QAYERDAN qidirishni biladi.


OLTIN QOIDA:
  DO ustuni    →  ALWAYS + fe'l
  DON'T ustuni →  NEVER + fe'l

  Ikkalasi ham BUYRUQ maylida — ega YO'Q.


DIQQAT — 'PUT YOUR TENT UP':
  'to put up a tent' = chodir tikmoq
  AJRALADIGAN fe'l:
     put your tent up  ✓
     put up your tent  ✓
     put IT up         ✓
     put up IT         ✗


DIQQAT — 'LEAVE ... BURNING':
  'leave the camp fire BURNING'
  = gulxanni YONIB TURGAN holda qoldirmoq

  'leave + ot + -ING' — holatni bildiradi:
     leave the tap running
     leave the door open


DIQQAT — 'LEAVE RUBBISH BEHIND':
  'to leave BEHIND' = ortda qoldirib ketmoq
  'behind' gap oxirida turadi.


DIQQAT — 'TOO MANY':
  'take TOO MANY clothes' = haddan tashqari
  ko'p kiyim
  'too many' + SANALADIGAN
  'too much' + SANALMAYDIGAN

  DIQQAT: 'clothes' — DOIM ko'plikda
  ('a clothe' XATO; birligi 'a piece of
   clothing').


DIQQAT — 'TELL YOUR FAMILY WHERE YOU ARE':
  'tell somebody WHERE you are'
  Ergash gapda so'z tartibi TO'G'RI
  (savol tartibi EMAS):
     'where YOU ARE'    ✓
     'where ARE YOU'    ✗


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  camping        = kemping, chodirda dam olish
  a camp fire    = gulxan
  to burn        = yonmoq
  a torch        = qo'l fonari (britancha;
                   AmE: a flashlight)
  clothes        = kiyim-kechak (DOIM ko'plik)
  a tent         = chodir
  to put up a tent = chodir tikmoq
  next to        = yonida
  to leave behind = ortda qoldirmoq
examples: 1 leave the camp fire burning when you go to sleep — DON'T → Never leave the camp fire burning when you go to sleep.
2 have a torch with you — DO → Always have a torch with you.
3 take too many clothes with you — DON'T → Never take too many clothes with you.
4 put your tent up next to a river — DON'T → Never put your tent up next to a river.
5 keep a lot of money in your tent — DON'T → Never keep a lot of money in your tent.
6 leave rubbish behind — DON'T → Never leave rubbish behind.
7 tell your family where you are — DO → Always tell your family where you are.

topics.topic: always/never, should, must/mustn't — IBORALAR (4 ta) · 10-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
IBORALAR (4 ta):
  you should
  I think it's a good idea
  Why don't you
  I don't think it's a good idea

MATN: Erik Semga xat yozgan (do'kon ochish
haqida).


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  I THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA
  2  I DON'T THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA
  3  YOU SHOULD
  4  WHY DON'T YOU


TO'LIQ XAT (javoblar bilan):

  Dear Sam,

  I'm pleased to hear that you want to open
  your own shop. I'm worried though, that you
  want to ask your friend for the money you
  need.

  I THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA to open a place of
  your own but I DON'T THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA
  to borrow money from your friend because he
  may want to get involved in the shop and that
  can become a problem. Perhaps YOU SHOULD wait
  a little while so that you can make some
  money of your own. WHY DON'T YOU ask the bank
  for a loan?

  Hope to hear from you soon.

                              Love,
                              Eric


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:
  Hurmatli Sem,

  O'z do'koningni ochmoqchi ekaningni eshitib
  xursandman. Lekin kerakli pulni do'stingdan
  so'ramoqchi ekaningdan xavotirdaman.

  Menimcha, o'z joyingni ochish yaxshi fikr,
  lekin do'stingdan qarz olish yaxshi fikr
  emas, chunki u do'konga aralashishni xohlab
  qolishi mumkin va bu muammoga aylanadi.
  Balki biroz kutib, o'zing pul topishing
  kerakdir. Bankdan qarz so'rasang-chi?

  Tez orada javobingni kutaman.

  Mehr bilan, Erik


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — FAQAT GRAMMATIKA:

  1  '... TO OPEN a place of your own'
     Keyin 'TO + fe'l' → 'a good idea TO ...'
     Ma'no IJOBIY ('I'm PLEASED to hear')
     → I THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA

  2  'BUT ... TO BORROW money'
     Yana 'TO + fe'l', lekin oldida 'BUT'
     va sabab salbiy ('can become a PROBLEM')
     → I DON'T THINK IT'S A GOOD IDEA

  3  'Perhaps ... WAIT a little while'
     Keyin 'to' SIZ fe'l ('wait')
     → YOU SHOULD

  4  '... ASK the bank for a loan?'
     Gap SAVOL BELGISI bilan tugaydi!
     → WHY DON'T YOU


UCh BELGI (Grammar 62-bet, 6-mashq bilan
AYNAN bir xil):

  A) 'TO + fe'l' keladi  →  it's a good idea TO
  B) 'to' SIZ fe'l       →  you should
  C) SAVOL BELGISI (?)   →  Why don't you


GRAMMAR 62-BET BILAN SOLIShTIRING:
  U yerda: Tresi → Lindaga (Rimga ko'chish)
  Bu yerda: Erik → Semga (do'kon ochish)

  Tuzilishi AYNAN bir xil:
     1) ijobiy fikr
     2) 'but' + salbiy fikr
     3) 'Perhaps/Maybe' + you should
     4) 'Why don't you ...?'

  Kitob ataylab takrorlagan — qolipni
  mustahkamlash uchun.


DIQQAT — 'OF YOUR OWN':
  'a place OF YOUR OWN' = o'zingizniki
  'your OWN shop' = o'z do'koningiz

  'own' egalikni KUCHAYTIRADI:
     'my own house' = aynan mening uyim


DIQQAT — 'SO THAT':
  'wait a little while SO THAT you can make
   some money'
  'so that' = ... uchun (MAQSAD)

  Grammar 62-bet, 9-mashqning 2-bandi ham
  shu haqda edi:
  'Tonia is saving money SO she can go on
   holiday.'


DIQQAT — 'GET INVOLVED IN':
  'to get INVOLVED IN something' = biror
  ishga aralashmoq


DIQQAT — 'ASK FOR':
  'ask your friend FOR the money'
  'ask the bank FOR a loan'
  'to ask somebody FOR something' = so'ramoq

  DIQQAT: 'ask somebody something' — savol
  berish ('ask me a question');
  'ask somebody FOR something' — narsa
  so'rash.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  pleased        = mamnun, xursand
  your own       = o'zingizniki
  to borrow      = qarz olmoq
  to lend        = qarz bermoq (TESKARISI)
  to get involved in = aralashmoq
  perhaps        = balki
  so that        = ... uchun
  a loan         = qarz, kredit
  to make money  = pul topmoq

topics.topic: always/never, should, must/mustn't (2)
topics.rule_uz:
E'LON MATNI:

  BEARBROOK LIBRARY RULES
  Remember!
   1  Be quiet
   2  No smoking
   3  Return books on time
   4  No eating or drinking
   5  Don't bring pets into the library
   6  Keep books in good condition


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  You MUST be quiet.
    (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 2  You MUSTN'T smoke.

 3  You MUST return books on time.

 4  You MUSTN'T eat or drink.

 5  You MUSTN'T bring pets into the library.

 6  You MUST keep books in good condition.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
 1  Jim bo'lishingiz kerak.
 2  Chekmasligingiz kerak.
 3  Kitoblarni o'z vaqtida qaytarishingiz kerak.
 4  Ovqat yeyish yoki ichish mumkin emas.
 5  Kutubxonaga uy hayvonlarini olib
    kirmasligingiz kerak.
 6  Kitoblarni yaxshi holatda saqlashingiz
    kerak.


OLTIN QOIDA — E'LON ShAKLI JAVOBNI BERADI:

  IJOBIY buyruq  →  MUST
     'BE quiet'                (1)
     'RETURN books on time'    (3)
     'KEEP books in good condition' (6)

  'NO + -ING'    →  MUSTN'T
     'NO SMOKING'              (2)
     'NO EATING OR DRINKING'   (4)

  'DON'T + fe'l' →  MUSTN'T
     'DON'T BRING pets'        (5)

  Ya'ni: 3 ta MUST, 3 ta MUSTN'T.


'NO + -ING' NI GAPGA AYLANTIRISh:

  E'LONDA          →  GAPDA
  'No smoking'     →  'You mustn't SMOKE.'
  'No eating'      →  'You mustn't EAT.'
  'No parking'     →  'You mustn't PARK.'

  DIQQAT: '-ING' TUShIB QOLADI!
     'You mustn't smokING' ✗
     'You mustn't SMOKE'   ✓

  Chunki 'mustn't' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl
  keladi.


DIQQAT — 4-BANDDAGI 'OR':
  'No eating OR drinking'
  → 'You mustn't eat OR drink.'

  INKOR gapda 'and' emas, 'OR':
     'You mustn't eat OR drink.'  ✓
     'You mustn't eat AND drink.' — ma'no
       o'zgaradi (ikkalasini BIRGA qilmaslik)


DIQQAT — 'BRING INTO':
  'bring pets INTO the library'
  'into' — ichkariga HARAKAT.

  Coursebook 102-bet, 13a, 8-o'quvchi:
  'You mustn't bring pets INTO school.'


DIQQAT — 'IN GOOD CONDITION':
  'keep books IN GOOD CONDITION'
  = kitoblarni yaxshi holatda saqlamoq

  'condition' = holat, ahvol.
  'in good/bad condition' — turg'un ibora.


DIQQAT — 'ON TIME' YANA:
  'return books ON time' = kitoblarni o'z
  vaqtida qaytarmoq

  Workbook 57-bet, 6-mashqning 6-bandi ham
  shu edi: 'pay the rent ON time'.


NEGA 'MUSTN'T', 'SHOULDN'T' EMAS:
  Bular KUTUBXONANING RASMIY QOIDALARI —
  maslahat emas, MAJBURIYAT va TAQIQ.

  Grammar 60-bet: 'We use must b) FOR RULES'.


RASM:
  Kutubxonachi ayol stolda kitob ustida
  o'tiribdi, orqasida kitob javonlari.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a library      = kutubxona
  a notice       = e'lon
  quiet          = jim
  to return      = qaytarmoq
  on time        = o'z vaqtida
  to bring into  = ichkariga olib kirmoq
  condition      = holat, ahvol
  in good condition = yaxshi holatda
examples: 1 Be quiet → You must be quiet.
2 No smoking → You mustn't smoke.
3 Return books on time → You must return books on time.
4 No eating or drinking → You mustn't eat or drink.
5 Don't bring pets into the library → You mustn't bring pets into the library.
6 Keep books in good condition → You must keep books in good condition.

topics.topic: always/never, should, must/mustn't — VAZIYAT: o'qituvchi bolalarni MUZEYGA olib · 12-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
VAZIYAT: o'qituvchi bolalarni MUZEYGA olib
bormoqda va qoidalarni tushuntiryapti.

(Grammar 62-betdagi HAYVONOT BOG'I dialogi
bilan AYNAN bir xil tuzilish!)


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  MUST
  2  CAN
  3  CAN'T
  4  MUSTN'T
  5  CAN
  6  CAN'T
  7  MUSTN'T
  8  CAN
  9  CAN


TO'LIQ DIALOG (javoblar bilan):

  Teacher: Today we are going to visit the
           museum children and there are some
           things we need to talk about.
           First you MUST always stay close
           to me.

  S1:      CAN we bring our cameras?

  Teacher: No, you CAN'T! You MUSTN'T take any
           pictures.

  S2:      CAN we bring our lunch with us?

  Teacher: No, you CAN'T! You MUSTN'T eat in
           the museum.

  S3:      Where CAN we eat?

  Teacher: You CAN eat in the restaurant which
           is next to the museum.


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:
  O'qituvchi: Bugun muzeyga boramiz, bolalar,
              va gaplashishimiz kerak bo'lgan
              bir necha narsa bor. Birinchidan,
              doim menga yaqin turishingiz
              KERAK.
  1-o'quvchi: Fotoapparatlarimizni olib
              kelsak BO'LADIMI?
  O'qituvchi: Yo'q, BO'LMAYDI! Suratga
              olMASLIGINGIZ kerak.
  2-o'quvchi: Tushligimizni olib kelsak
              BO'LADIMI?
  O'qituvchi: Yo'q, BO'LMAYDI! Muzeyda ovqat
              yeMASLIGINGIZ kerak.
  3-o'quvchi: Qayerda ovqat yeya olamiz?
  O'qituvchi: Muzey yonidagi restoranda ovqat
              yeyishingiz MUMKIN.


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  'First you ... always STAY CLOSE to me.'
    Bu — QAT'IY qoida → MUST.
    (Grammar 62-bet, hayvonot bog'i dialogining
     oxirgi gapi ham shu edi:
     'Everyone MUST stay close to me.')

 2  '... we BRING our cameras?'
    O'quvchi RUXSAT so'rayapti → CAN.

 3  'No, you ...!'
    QISQA JAVOB savoldagi modalni takrorlaydi:
    'CAN we?' → 'you CAN'T'.

 4  'You ... TAKE ANY PICTURES.'
    Bu — muzeyning TAQIQI → MUSTN'T.
    (Workbook 57-bet, F belgisi:
     'Don't take pictures.')

 5  '... we BRING our lunch?'
    Yana RUXSAT savoli → CAN.

 6  'No, you ...!'
    Yana qisqa javob → CAN'T.

 7  'You ... EAT IN THE MUSEUM.'
    Muzeyda ovqat yeyish TAQIQLANGAN → MUSTN'T.

 8  'WHERE ... we eat?'
    'Where' bilan savol — IMKONIYAT so'ralyapti
    → CAN.

 9  'You ... EAT IN THE RESTAURANT.'
    O'qituvchi RUXSAT beryapti → CAN.


NAQSh — DIALOGNING TUZILIShI:

  O'QUVChI so'raydi  →  DOIM 'CAN'
                        (2, 5, 8)
  O'QITUVChI:
     qoida aytadi    →  MUST    (1)
     rad etadi       →  CAN'T   (3, 6)
     taqiqlaydi      →  MUSTN'T (4, 7)
     ruxsat beradi   →  CAN     (9)


DIQQAT — 'CAN'T' va 'MUSTN'T' YONMA-YON:
  'No, you CAN'T! You MUSTN'T take any
   pictures.'

  Nega ikkalasi?
     'CAN'T'   — SAVOLGA javob (qisqa javob
                 savoldagi modalni takrorlaydi)
     'MUSTN'T' — TAQIQNI kuchaytirish
                 (muzey qoidasi)

  Coursebook 102-bet, 16e-dialogda ham
  shunday edi:
  'No, you can't. You mustn't park here —
   it's illegal.'


DIQQAT — 'ANY' INKORDA:
  'You mustn't take ANY pictures.'
  = hech qanday surat olmang

  INKOR gapda 'some' emas, 'ANY':
     'I don't have ANY money.'  ✓
     'I don't have SOME money.' ✗


DIQQAT — 'WHICH IS NEXT TO':
  'the restaurant WHICH IS NEXT TO the museum'
  = muzey YONIDAGI restoran

  'which' — narsalar uchun ergash gap
  bog'lovchisi ('who' — odamlar uchun).
  'next to' = yonida.


GRAMMAR 62-BET BILAN SOLIShTIRING:

  HAYVONOT BOG'I (Grammar 62)  MUZEY (WB 58)
  ──────────────────────────   ─────────────
  must follow rules            must stay close
  mustn't feed the animals     mustn't take
                               pictures
  Can we touch? — No, you      Can we bring
  can't                        cameras? — No,
                               you can't
  Can we take pictures? —      Can we bring
  Yes, you can                 lunch? — No
  must stay close to me        can eat in the
                               restaurant

  Ikkala dialog ham bir xil qolipda tuzilgan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a museum      = muzey
  a camera      = fotoapparat
  lunch         = tushlik
  a restaurant  = restoran
  next to       = yonida
  which         = qaysiki (narsalar uchun)

topics.topic: Present Perfect — Regular Verb — Present Perfect — to'g'ri fe'l (1)
topics.rule_uz:
TO'G'RI FE'L: work → worked → WORKED
(V2 va V3 BIR XIL)


TASDIQ (Affirmative):

  TO'LIQ SHAKL          QISQA SHAKL
  I have worked         I'VE worked
  you have worked       YOU'VE worked
  he has worked         HE'S worked
  she has worked        SHE'S worked
  it has worked         IT'S worked
  we have worked        WE'VE worked
  you have worked       YOU'VE worked
  they have worked      THEY'VE worked


SO'ROQ (Interrogative):

  Have I worked?        Have we worked?
  Have you worked?      Have you worked?
  Has he worked?        Have they worked?
  Has she worked?
  Has it worked?


INKOR (Negative):

  TO'LIQ SHAKL              QISQA SHAKL
  I have not worked         I HAVEN'T worked
  you have not worked       you HAVEN'T worked
  he has not worked         he HASN'T worked
  she has not worked        she HASN'T worked
  it has not worked         it HASN'T worked
  we have not worked        we HAVEN'T worked
  you have not worked       you HAVEN'T worked
  they have not worked      they HAVEN'T worked


OLTIN QOIDA:
  HAS  →  faqat HE / SHE / IT
  HAVE →  I / YOU / WE / THEY


QISQARTMALAR:
  have  →  'VE      (I've, you've, we've,
                     they've)
  has   →  'S       (he's, she's, it's)
  have not → HAVEN'T
  has not  → HASN'T


⚠ DIQQAT — 'HE'S' UCh MA'NOLI:
  'HE'S worked.'   =  he HAS worked
  'HE'S a doctor.' =  he IS a doctor
  'HE'S working.'  =  he IS working

  Qaysi ekanini KEYINGI SO'Z aytadi:
     keyin V3 kelsa     →  HAS
     keyin ot/sifat     →  IS
     keyin V-ing kelsa  →  IS

  Shu kabi 'IT'S' va 'SHE'S'.


DIQQAT — SO'ROQDA 'DO' KERAK EMAS:
  'Have you worked?'      ✓
  'DO you have worked?'   ✗


DIQQAT — INKORDA 'DON'T' KERAK EMAS:
  'I haven't worked.'     ✓
  'I DON'T have worked.'  ✗


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a regular verb = to'g'ri fe'l
  affirmative    = tasdiq
  interrogative  = so'roq
  negative       = inkor
  long form      = to'liq shakl
  short form     = qisqa shakl
examples: AFFIRMATIVE: I have worked / I've worked • he has worked / he's worked • they have worked / they've worked
INTERROGATIVE: Have I worked? Has he worked? Have they worked?
NEGATIVE: I have not worked / I haven't worked • he has not worked / he hasn't worked
work → worked → worked (regular verb: V2 = V3)

topics.topic: Present Perfect — Regular Verb — Present Perfect — to'g'ri fe'l (2)
topics.rule_uz:
NOTO'G'RI FE'L: buy → bought → BOUGHT
(bu fe'lda V2 va V3 bir xil, lekin
boshqalarida boshqacha bo'lishi mumkin)


TASDIQ (Affirmative):

  TO'LIQ SHAKL          QISQA SHAKL
  I have bought         I'VE bought
  you have bought       YOU'VE bought
  he has bought         HE'S bought
  she has bought        SHE'S bought
  it has bought         IT'S bought
  we have bought        WE'VE bought
  you have bought       YOU'VE bought
  they have bought      THEY'VE bought


SO'ROQ (Interrogative):

  Have I bought?        Have we bought?
  Have you bought?      Have you bought?
  Has he bought?        Have they bought?
  Has she bought?
  Has it bought?


INKOR (Negative):

  TO'LIQ SHAKL              QISQA SHAKL
  I have not bought         I HAVEN'T bought
  he has not bought         he HASN'T bought
  they have not bought      they HAVEN'T bought
  ...


⚠ ENG MUHIM XULOSA:
  TUZILISH IKKALASIDA HAM BIR XIL!

  Faqat FE'LNING III ShAKLI farq qiladi:
     TO'G'RI:   work  →  WORKED
     NOTO'G'RI: buy   →  BOUGHT

  Qolgan hamma narsa (have/has, so'roq,
  inkor, qisqartma) AYNAN bir xil.


NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR — UCh TUR:

  1) UChALASI HAM BOShQA (ABC):
     see    → saw    → SEEN
     go     → went   → GONE
     eat    → ate    → EATEN
     drive  → drove  → DRIVEN
     ride   → rode   → RIDDEN
     fly    → flew   → FLOWN
     do     → did    → DONE
     be     → was/were → BEEN

  2) V2 va V3 BIR XIL (ABB):
     buy    → bought → BOUGHT
     meet   → met    → MET
     find   → found  → FOUND
     have   → had    → HAD
     make   → made   → MADE
     say    → said   → SAID

  3) UChALASI HAM BIR XIL (AAA):
     cut    → cut    → CUT
     put    → put    → PUT
     let    → let    → LET
     read   → read   → READ
            (yozilishi bir xil, O'QILIShI
             boshqa: /riːd/ → /red/)


DIQQAT — RO'YXAT KITOB OXIRIDA:
  Kitob aytadi: 'See list of irregular verbs
  at the end of the book.'

  Noto'g'ri fe'llar YODLANADI — qoida yo'q.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an irregular verb = noto'g'ri fe'l
  to buy = sotib olmoq (buy → BOUGHT)
examples: AFFIRMATIVE: I have bought / I've bought • he has bought / he's bought
INTERROGATIVE: Have I bought? Has he bought? Have they bought?
NEGATIVE: I have not bought / I haven't bought • he has not bought / he hasn't bought
buy → bought → bought (irregular verb)

topics.topic: Present Perfect — Regular Verb — Present Perfect — to'g'ri fe'l (3)
topics.rule_uz:
YASALIShI (FORM) — KITOBDAGI BESh QOIDA:

 1 'We form the present perfect with the
    AUXILIARY VERB have/has and the PAST
    PARTICIPLE of the main verb.'
      I HAVE BOUGHT a new dress.

 2 'We form the past participle of REGULAR
    verbs by adding -ED to the verb.'
      watch - watchED
      bury - burIED

 3 'We form the past participle of IRREGULAR
    verbs DIFFERENTLY.'
      buy - BOUGHT

 4 'We form the INTERROGATIVE by putting
    have/has BEFORE THE SUBJECT PRONOUN.'
      HAS HE washed the car?
      HAVE THEY travelled by plane?

 5 'We form the NEGATIVE by putting NOT
    BETWEEN have/has and the past participle.'
      He HAS NOT / HASN'T washed the car.
      They HAVE NOT / HAVEN'T travelled by
      plane.


'-ED' QO'ShISh QOIDALARI (2-band):

  Oddiy:            watch  →  watchED
  Oxiri 'E':        live   →  livED
                    (faqat -D)
  Oxiri UNDOSh+Y:   bury   →  burIED
                    study  →  studIED
                    (y → I + ED)
  Oxiri UNLI+Y:     play   →  playED
                    (y O'ZGARMAYDI!)
  Bir bo'g'in,
  unli+undosh:      stop   →  stopPED
                    (undosh IKKILANADI)

  Kitob ataylab 'bury - buried' misolini
  bergan — 'y' o'zgarishini ko'rsatish uchun.


IShLATILIShI (USE) — KITOBDAGI IKKI QOIDA:

 ⚠ 1) VAQTI AYTILMAGAN harakat:
    'We use the present perfect for actions
     which happened at an UNSTATED TIME in the
     past. The exact time is NOT IMPORTANT.'

      He HAS WASHED the car.
      (When did he wash it? WE DON'T KNOW
       when; the time is NOT MENTIONED.)

    Bu — Coursebook 106-betda o'rganilgan
    qoida.


 ⚠ 2) O'TMIShDA BOShLANIB, HOZIR HAM DAVOM
    ETAYOTGAN harakat:
    'We ALSO use the present perfect for
     actions which STARTED IN THE PAST and are
     STILL CONTINUING IN THE PRESENT.'

      I HAVE KNOWN Tom for 5 years.
      (5 yil oldin tanishganman va HOZIR HAM
       tanishman.)

    ⚠ BU YANGI QOIDA — Coursebook'da
    to'liq berilmagan!


IKKI QO'LLANIShNI SOLIShTIRING:

  1) 'He has washed the car.'
     → ish TUGAGAN, lekin qachonligi noma'lum
     → natijasi HOZIR ko'rinadi (mashina toza)

  2) 'I have known Tom for 5 years.'
     → ish HALI DAVOM etyapti
     → 5 yil oldin boshlangan, hozir ham
       davom etadi

  Ikkinchi qo'llanishda odatda FOR yoki
  SINCE bo'ladi:
     'I've lived here FOR ten years.'
     'She's worked here SINCE 2010.'


⚠ O'ZBEK TILIDA FARQ:
  'I have known Tom for 5 years.'
  O'zbekchada: 'Tomni 5 yildan beri
  BILAMAN' (hozirgi zamon!)

  Ingliz tilida esa PRESENT PERFECT.
  Bu — o'zbek tilidan farq qiladigan joy,
  shuning uchun ko'p xato qilinadi:
     'I know Tom for 5 years.'      ✗
     'I have known Tom for 5 years.' ✓


VAQT RAVIShLARI (kitobdan):
  'Time adverbs used with the present
   perfect: SINCE, FOR, JUST, ALREADY, YET,
   NEVER, EVER.'

  Yetti so'z — hammasi Coursebook 106-107
  betlarida o'rganilgan.


DIQQAT — 'AUXILIARY VERB':
  'auxiliary verb' = yordamchi fe'l
  ('have/has' bu yerda o'z ma'nosini
   yo'qotgan — faqat zamon yasaydi)

  Solishtiring:
     'I HAVE a car.'      — asosiy fe'l
                            (menda mashina bor)
     'I HAVE bought a car.' — yordamchi fe'l


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an auxiliary verb = yordamchi fe'l
  a past participle = fe'lning III shakli
  a subject pronoun = ega olmoshi
  unstated          = aytilmagan
  exact             = aniq
  to mention        = tilga olmoq
  to continue       = davom etmoq
  to bury           = ko'mmoq
  to wash           = yuvmoq
examples: We form the present perfect with the auxiliary verb have/has and the past participle of the main verb. — I have bought a new dress.
We form the past participle of regular verbs by adding -ed to the verb. — watch - watched, bury - buried
We form the past participle of irregular verbs differently. (See list of irregular verbs at the end of the book.) — buy - bought
We form the interrogative by putting have/has before the subject pronoun. — Has he washed the car? Have they travelled by plane?
We form the negative by putting not between have/has and the past participle. — He hasn't washed the car.

We use the present perfect for actions which happened at an unstated time in the past. The exact time is not important. — He has washed the car. (When did he wash it? We don't know when; the time is not mentioned.)
We also use the present perfect for actions which started in the past and are still continuing in the present. — I have known Tom for 5 years.
Time adverbs used with the present perfect: since, for, just, already, yet, never, ever.

topics.topic: Nazariya — Past Simple, ever/never, just, yet/already, for/since, gone/been (1)
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We use the PAST SIMPLE for an action which
    happened at a STATED TIME in the past.'
      They TRAVELLED to France LAST SUMMER.
      (When? Last summer. The time IS
       MENTIONED.)

 • 'Time adverbs used with the past simple:
    YESTERDAY, TWO/THREE etc DAYS/MONTHS etc
    AGO, LAST MONDAY/WEEK/MONTH, etc.'


⚠ PRESENT PERFECT BILAN FARQI:

  PRESENT PERFECT — vaqt AYTILMAGAN
     'He HAS WASHED the car.'
     (qachonligi noma'lum)

  PAST SIMPLE — vaqt AYTILGAN
     'They TRAVELLED to France LAST SUMMER.'
     (qachon? — o'tgan yozda)

  Bu — butun Unit 15 ning o'zagi.


PAST SIMPLE VAQT RAVIShLARI:
  yesterday          (kecha)
  two days ago       (ikki kun oldin)
  three months ago   (uch oy oldin)
  last Monday        (o'tgan dushanba)
  last week          (o'tgan hafta)
  last month         (o'tgan oy)
  last summer        (o'tgan yozda)
  in 2010            (2010-yilda)
  when I was a child (bolaligimda)


⚠ ENG KO'P XATO:
  'I have seen him YESTERDAY.'      ✗
  'I SAW him yesterday.'            ✓

  'They have travelled LAST SUMMER.' ✗
  'They TRAVELLED last summer.'      ✓


DIQQAT — 'AGO' va 'FOR':
  'two days AGO'  → PAST SIMPLE
     'I arrived two days ago.'
  'FOR two days'  → PRESENT PERFECT
     'I've been here for two days.'

  Ikkalasi ham 'ikki kun', lekin zamonlari
  BOSHQA.


DIQQAT — 'TRAVELLED':
  Britancha: travelLED (IKKI 'L')
  Amerikacha: traveLED (bitta 'L')
  Enterprise — britancha kitob.
examples: We use the past simple for an action which happened at a stated time in the past. — They travelled to France last summer. (When? Last summer. The time is mentioned.)
Time adverbs used with the past simple: yesterday, two/three etc days/months etc ago, last Monday/week/month, etc.

topics.topic: Nazariya — Past Simple, ever/never, just, yet/already, for/since, gone/been (2)
topics.rule_uz:
EVER / NEVER — KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We use EVER in questions and statements.'
      Have you EVER visited Prague?
      Madrid is the best city I've EVER
      visited.

 • 'We use NEVER in statements.'
      I've NEVER visited America.
      (= I HAVEN'T visited America.)


'EVER' IKKI HOLATDA:
  1) SAVOLDA — 'hech qachon ...ganmisiz?'
        'Have you EVER visited Prague?'
  2) USTUN DARAJA bilan — 'ko'rgan eng ...'
        'Madrid is the BEST city I've EVER
         visited.'


'NEVER' — O'ZI INKOR:
     'I've NEVER visited America.'   ✓
     'I haven't NEVER visited.'      ✗ XATO!

  Kitob ikki xil aytish mumkinligini
  ko'rsatadi:
     'I've NEVER visited America.'
     'I HAVEN'T visited America.'
  Ma'nosi bir xil, lekin 'never' KUCHLIROQ.


O'RNI: 'have' va V3 ORASIDA
     'Have you EVER visited ...?'
     'I've NEVER visited ...'


─────────────────────────────────────

JUST — KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We use JUST in statements to show that an
    action finished only A FEW MINUTES
    EARLIER.'
      A: Have you finished your homework?
      B: Yes, I've JUST finished it.


'JUST' = hozirgina, endigina
  Harakat bir necha DAQIQA oldin tugagan.

O'RNI: 'have' va V3 ORASIDA
     'I've JUST finished it.'  ✓
     'I've finished it JUST.'  ✗


DIQQAT — 'JUST' NING BOShQA MA'NOSI:
  'just' — faqat, shunchaki:
     'It's JUST a joke.' (shunchaki hazil)
  Present Perfect bilan esa 'hozirgina'.
examples: We use ever in questions and statements. — Have you ever visited Prague? Madrid is the best city I've ever visited.
We use never in statements. — I've never visited America. (= I haven't visited America.)
We use just in statements to show that an action finished only a few minutes earlier. — A: Have you finished your homework? B: Yes, I've just finished it.

topics.topic: Nazariya — Past Simple, ever/never, just, yet/already, for/since, gone/been (3)
topics.rule_uz:
YET / ALREADY — KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We use ALREADY in STATEMENTS and
    QUESTIONS.'
      Have you done the washing up ALREADY?
      Yes, I have. I've ALREADY done it.

 • 'We use YET in QUESTIONS and NEGATIVES.'
      Have you done the ironing YET?
      No, I haven't. I haven't done the
      ironing YET.


⚠ DIQQAT — 'ALREADY' SAVOLDA HAM BO'LADI:
  Coursebook 106-betda faqat 'tasdiqda'
  deyilgan edi, Grammar Book esa
  'statements AND QUESTIONS' deydi.

  Farqi MA'NODA:
     'Have you done it YET?'
        = oddiy savol (qildingmi?)
     'Have you done it ALREADY?'
        = AJABLANISH (allaqachonmi?
          shunchalik tezmi?)


O'RNI:
  ALREADY — 'have' va V3 ORASIDA
     'I've ALREADY done it.'
     (savolda esa gap oxirida ham bo'ladi:
      'Have you done it ALREADY?')

  YET — DOIM GAP OXIRIDA
     'Have you done the ironing YET?'
     'I haven't done the ironing YET.'


UY IShLARI LUG'ATI (kitob misollaridan):
  'the washing up' = idish yuvish
  'the ironing'    = dazmollash
  'the washing'    = kir yuvish
  'the shopping'   = xarid

  Hammasi 'DO' fe'li bilan:
     do the washing up / the ironing /
     the shopping


─────────────────────────────────────

FOR / SINCE — KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We use FOR to express DURATION.'
      I've worked here FOR seven years.

 • 'We use SINCE to state a STARTING POINT.'
      I've worked here SINCE 1992.


ENG ODDIY FARQ:
  FOR   + QANChA VAQT
          for seven years, for three days,
          for a long time
  SINCE + QAChONDAN BERI
          since 1992, since Monday,
          since last week

  Savol bering: 'qancha vaqt?' → FOR
                'qachondan beri?' → SINCE


DIQQAT — IKKALA MISOL HAM BIR XIL GAP:
  'I've worked here FOR seven years.'
  'I've worked here SINCE 1992.'

  Agar hozir 1999-yil bo'lsa, ikkalasi ham
  bir xil ma'no beradi — faqat boshqacha
  aytilgan!
examples: We use already in statements and questions. — Have you done the washing up already? Yes, I have. I've already done it.
We use yet in questions and negatives. — Have you done the ironing yet? No, I haven't. I haven't done the ironing yet.
We use for to express duration. — I've worked here for seven years.
We use since to state a starting point. — I've worked here since 1992.

topics.topic: Nazariya — Past Simple, ever/never, just, yet/already, for/since, gone/been (4)
topics.rule_uz:
⚠ BU BETDAGI ENG MUHIM QOIDA

KITOBDAGI QOIDA:
  'There are TWO WAYS to form the present
   perfect of the verb GO: HAVE GONE and
   HAVE BEEN, but there is a DIFFERENCE IN
   MEANING.'

  MISOLLAR:

  'Bob and Marie HAVE GONE to Rome.'
     (They went to Rome some time ago and
      they are STILL THERE.)

  'I HAVE BEEN to Rome.'
     (I have visited Rome and COME BACK.
      I am NOT there now.)


ENG ODDIY FARQ:

  HAVE GONE TO  →  KETGAN va HALI U YERDA
     'He has gone to Rome.'
     = U Rimga ketgan (hozir Rimda)

  HAVE BEEN TO  →  BORIB QAYTGAN
     'He has been to Rome.'
     = U Rimda bo'lgan (hozir bu yerda)


QANDAY ESLAB QOLISh:

  GONE — odam YO'Q (ketgan)
  BEEN — odam BOR (qaytgan)

  Yoki:
     'gone' = ketish (harakati)
     'been' = bo'lish (tajribasi)


ShUNING UChUN:

  'I HAVE GONE to Rome.'  — deyarli
     ISHLATILMAYDI! (chunki agar Rimda
     bo'lsangiz, bu gapni aytolmaysiz)

  'I HAVE BEEN to Rome.'  ✓
     (tajriba haqida)

  Ya'ni O'ZINGIZ haqingizda deyarli doim
  'BEEN' ishlatasiz.


MISOLLAR YONMA-YON:

  'Where's Tom?' — 'He HAS GONE to the shops.'
     (do'konda, hali qaytmagan)

  'Have you ever been to Paris?' —
  'Yes, I HAVE BEEN there twice.'
     (borgan va qaytgan)

  'My parents HAVE GONE to Turkey.'
     (hozir Turkiyada)

  'My parents HAVE BEEN to Turkey.'
     (borishgan va qaytishgan)


BOG'LIQLIK — COURSEBOOK:
  104-bet, 1-mashq:
     'Have you ever BEEN there?'
  106-bet, 11-mashq:
     'I've BEEN to Spain.'
     'I've never BEEN to China.'
  107-bet, 16-mashq:
     'Have you BEEN to Palacio Real yet?'
     (Pol borib qaytgan, shuning uchun 'been')

  Coursebook'da deyarli doim 'been'
  ishlatilgan — endi nega ekani ma'lum.


DIQQAT — PREDLOG:
  'have been TO Rome'   ✓ (borgan)
  'have been IN Rome'   — boshqa ma'no
     ('Rimda bo'lganman' — ichkarida,
      masalan 'I've been in Rome for a week')

  'have gone TO Rome'   ✓


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a difference in meaning = ma'no farqi
  still     = hali ham
  to come back = qaytmoq
examples: There are two ways to form the present perfect of the verb go: have gone and have been, but there is a difference in meaning.
Bob and Marie have gone to Rome. (They went to Rome some time ago and they are still there.)
I have been to Rome. (I have visited Rome and come back. I am not there now.)
Where's Tom? — He has gone to the shops. / Have you ever been to Paris? — Yes, I have been there twice.
topics.source: Grammar Book, 65-bet, 'Have gone (to) - Have been (to)' qutisi

topics.topic: Mashqlar — Present Perfect — BARCHA JAVOBLAR · 1-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  She has lived in Brazil SINCE 1992.
    (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)
 2  He has been ill FOR three days.
 3  They haven't visited their grandparents
    SINCE last month.
 4  I have been a policeman FOR twenty years.
 5  Karen hasn't been home SINCE October.
 6  He hasn't travelled by boat SINCE last
    summer.
 7  I haven't been to Paris FOR six years.
 8  Jack has worked in Canada FOR ten years.
 9  She hasn't been abroad FOR two years.
10  Jeff hasn't called SINCE Monday.


FOR yoki SINCE — TAQSIMOT:

  FOR (davomiylik) — 2, 4, 7, 8, 9:
     three days, twenty years, six years,
     ten years, two years

  SINCE (nuqta) — 1, 3, 5, 6, 10:
     1992, last month, October,
     last summer, Monday

  Ya'ni beshtadan teng!


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — OXIRGI QISMGA QARANG:

  RAQAM + vaqt birligi  →  FOR
     'three days', 'twenty years'

  YIL, OY, KUN, 'last ...'  →  SINCE
     '1992', 'October', 'Monday',
     'last month', 'last summer'


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
 1  U 1992-yildan beri Braziliyada yashaydi.
 2  U uch kundan beri kasal.
 3  Ular o'tgan oydan beri buvilarinikiga
    bormagan.
 4  Men yigirma yildan beri militsionerman.
 5  Karen oktyabrdan beri uyda bo'lmagan.
 6  U o'tgan yozdan beri qayiqda sayohat
    qilmagan.
 7  Olti yildan beri Parijga bormaganman.
 8  Jek o'n yildan beri Kanadada ishlaydi.
 9  U ikki yildan beri chet elga chiqmagan.
10  Jeff dushanbadan beri qo'ng'iroq qilmagan.


HAR BIRIDA NIMA QO'ShILADI:

  1) HAVE / HAS
     ega III shaxs birlik → HAS
     (1, 2, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10-bandlar)
     qolganlarida → HAVE
     (3, 4, 7-bandlar)

  2) FE'LNING III ShAKLI (V3):
     live   → LIVED
     be     → BEEN
     visit  → VISITED
     travel → TRAVELLED
     go     → BEEN (quyiga qarang!)
     work   → WORKED
     call   → CALLED

  3) 'NOT' bo'lsa → HAVEN'T / HASN'T
     (3, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10-bandlar)

  4) FOR yoki SINCE


⚠ 7-BAND HAQIDA MUHIM IZOH:

  'I/not go/to Paris/six years'

  Javob: 'I HAVEN'T BEEN to Paris for six
         years.'

  NEGA 'BEEN', 'GONE' EMAS?
  Bu betdagi grammatika qutisi tushuntiradi:
     'have GONE to' = ketgan va HALI U YERDA
     'have BEEN to' = borib QAYTGAN

  'I haven't GONE to Paris' — g'alati
  (o'zim haqimda 'gone' ishlatilmaydi).
  'I haven't BEEN to Paris' ✓

  Kitob ataylab shu bandni qo'ygan — yangi
  qoidani sinash uchun.


DIQQAT — 5 va 9-BANDLARDAGI 'BE':
  5  'Karen hasn't BEEN home since October.'
  9  'She hasn't BEEN abroad for two years.'

  Bu yerda 'be' — 'bo'lmoq' ma'nosida
  (harakat emas).

  'be HOME' — predlog YO'Q
     ('be at home' ham to'g'ri)
  'be ABROAD' — predlog YO'Q
     ('go abroad' = chet elga chiqmoq)


DIQQAT — 2 va 4-BANDLARDAGI 'BE':
  2  'He has BEEN ill for three days.'
     = uch kundan beri kasal (HOZIR HAM)
  4  'I have BEEN a policeman for twenty
     years.'
     = yigirma yildan beri militsionerman
       (HOZIR HAM)

  Bu — 64-betdagi IKKINCHI qo'llanish:
  o'tmishda boshlanib, HOZIR HAM davom
  etayotgan holat.

  O'zbekchada HOZIRGI zamon bilan tarjima
  qilinadi!


DIQQAT — 'TRAVELLED' (6-band):
  Britancha: travelLED (IKKI 'L')
  Amerikacha: traveLED


DIQQAT — 'BY BOAT' (6-band):
  'travel BY boat / BY plane / BY car'
  Transport 'BY' bilan, ARTIKLSIZ.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  ill          = kasal
  grandparents = bobo-buvi
  a policeman  = militsioner
  abroad       = chet elda
  to call      = qo'ng'iroq qilmoq
  by boat      = qayiqda

topics.topic: Mashqlar — Present Perfect
topics.rule_uz:
JADVAL — UCh EGA, TO'RT ISh:

            go to  eat     travel  take a
            the    Mexican to      boat
            opera  food    Europe  trip
  ────────  ─────  ──────  ──────  ──────
  Tom         ✗      ✓       ✓       ✗
  Andrea      ✓      ✗       ✗       ✓
  The Smiths  ✓      ✗       ✓       ✗


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA (Tom):

  'Tom HASN'T BEEN to the opera, BUT he HAS
   EATEN Mexican food. He HAS ALSO TRAVELLED
   to Europe, BUT he HASN'T TAKEN a boat trip.'


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 ANDREA:
  'Andrea HAS BEEN to the opera, BUT she
   HASN'T EATEN Mexican food. She HASN'T
   TRAVELLED to Europe, BUT she HAS TAKEN a
   boat trip.'

  Tarjimasi: Andrea operaga borgan, lekin
  meksika taomini yeb ko'rmagan. U Yevropaga
  sayohat qilmagan, lekin qayiqda sayohat
  qilgan.


 THE SMITHS:
  'The Smiths HAVE BEEN to the opera, BUT they
   HAVEN'T EATEN Mexican food. They HAVE
   TRAVELLED to Europe, BUT they HAVEN'T TAKEN
   a boat trip.'

  Tarjimasi: Smitlar operaga borishgan, lekin
  meksika taomini yeb ko'rishmagan. Ular
  Yevropaga sayohat qilishgan, lekin qayiqda
  sayohat qilishmagan.


⚠ UCh MUHIM NUQTA:

 1) 'GO TO THE OPERA' → 'HAVE BEEN TO':
    Namuna 'Tom hasn't BEEN to the opera'
    deydi, 'hasn't GONE' emas!

    Chunki bu betdagi qoida:
       'have BEEN to' = borib qaytgan
                        (TAJRIBA)
       'have GONE to' = hali u yerda

    Jadvalda TAJRIBA haqida so'ralyapti,
    shuning uchun DOIM 'been'.

 2) 'THE SMITHS' — KO'PLIK:
    'The Smiths HAVE been ...'  ✓
    'The Smiths HAS been ...'   ✗

    'the Smiths' = Smitlar (butun oila),
    shuning uchun KO'PLIK va olmoshi 'THEY'.

    (Workbook 53-betda ham shu haqda edi:
     'the SmithS' house' — apostrof o'rni.)

 3) 'BUT' NING O'RNI:
    Namuna har ikki ishni 'BUT' bilan
    bog'laydi:
       [1-ish], BUT [2-ish].
       [3-ish], BUT [4-ish].

    Chunki har juftlikda biri ✓, biri ✗.


V3 ShAKLLARI (jadvaldagi fe'llar):
  go     →  went     →  BEEN / GONE
  eat    →  ate      →  EATEN
  travel →  travelled →  TRAVELLED
  take   →  took     →  TAKEN

  DIQQAT: 'eaten', 'taken' — '-EN' bilan.


OLMOShLAR:
  Tom        →  HE   →  has
  Andrea     →  SHE  →  has
  The Smiths →  THEY →  have


DIQQAT — 'ALSO' NING O'RNI:
  Namunada: 'He HAS ALSO TRAVELLED to Europe'
  'also' — 'has' va V3 ORASIDA.

  Xuddi 'already', 'just', 'never' kabi.

  Andrea uchun 'also' kerak emas, chunki
  uning uchinchi ishi ✗ (inkor).


DIQQAT — 'MEXICAN FOOD':
  Millat sifatlari BOSH HARF bilan:
     Mexican food, Chinese food,
     Italian food, Turkish coffee


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  the opera    = opera
  Mexican food = meksika taomi
  Europe       = Yevropa
  to take a boat trip = qayiqda sayohat qilmoq
  the Smiths   = Smitlar (oila)
examples: Tom hasn't been to the opera, but he has eaten Mexican food. He has also travelled to Europe, but he hasn't taken a boat trip.
Andrea has been to the opera, but she hasn't eaten Mexican food. She hasn't travelled to Europe, but she has taken a boat trip.
The Smiths have been to the opera, but they haven't eaten Mexican food. They have travelled to Europe, but they haven't taken a boat trip.

topics.topic: Mashqlar — Present Perfect va Past Simple — BARCHA JAVOBLAR · 3-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  ALREADY      9  NEVER
   2  FOR         10  EVER
   3  JUST        11  FOR
   4  NEVER       12  YET
   5  EVER        13  SINCE
   6  YET         14  JUST
   7  SINCE       15  NEVER
   8  ALREADY


UCh OLTIN QOIDA — HAMMASINI HAL QILADI:

  A) GAP TASDIQMI, INKORMI, SAVOLMI?
     TASDIQ  →  already, just, never
     INKOR   →  yet
     SAVOL   →  yet, ever

  B) 'FOR' MI, 'SINCE' MI?
     raqam + vaqt birligi  →  FOR
     yil, oy, kun, 'last'  →  SINCE

  C) 'EVER' MI, 'NEVER' MI?
     SAVOLDA yoki USTUN DARAJA bilan → EVER
     TASDIQ gapda (inkor ma'no)      → NEVER


HAR BIRI BATAFSIL:

 1  'YES, we have ... visited the Statue of
     Liberty.'
    KALIT: 'YES' — gap IJOBIY.
    'never' inkor ma'no berardi.
    → ALREADY

 2  'a teacher ... thirty years'
    'thirty years' — DAVOMIYLIK.
    → FOR

 3  'Yes, I have ... called her.'
    'ever' tasdiq gapda ishlatilmaydi.
    'just' = hozirgina — mos.
    → JUST

 4  'NO, I have ... been to Egypt.'
    KALIT: 'NO' — gap SALBIY.
    'have never been' = bormaganman.
    → NEVER

 5  'HAVE YOU ... been to a football match?'
    KALIT: bu SAVOL.
    Savolda 'ever' ishlatiladi.
    → EVER

 6  'I HAVEN'T finished my homework ...'
    KALIT: INKOR gap.
    'already' inkorda ishlatilmaydi.
    → YET

 7  'in Rio ... 1984'
    '1984' — YIL, ANIQ NUQTA.
    → SINCE

 8  'They have ... bought a computer.'
    TASDIQ gap.
    'yet' tasdiqda ishlatilmaydi.
    → ALREADY

 9  'Tracy has ... seen snow.'
    TASDIQ shakldagi gap, lekin ma'no
    INKOR (qorni ko'rmagan).
    'ever' tasdiq oddiy gapda ishlatilmaydi.
    → NEVER

10  'Cairo is the BEST place I've ... visited.'
    KALIT: 'THE BEST' — USTUN DARAJA.
    Bu qurilmada DOIM 'ever'.
    → EVER

11  'at university ... three years'
    'three years' — DAVOMIYLIK.
    ('already' bu yerda mos kelmaydi —
     u vaqt miqdorini bildirmaydi.)
    → FOR

12  'The boat ... HASN'T LEFT ...'
    KALIT: INKOR gap.
    → YET

13  'Gary hasn't been abroad ... last summer.'
    'last summer' — ANIQ NUQTA.
    → SINCE

14  'Yes, I have ... packed it.'
    'since' bu yerda ma'nosiz.
    'just' = hozirgina — mos.
    → JUST

15  'I have ... travelled by train.'
    TASDIQ shakl, INKOR ma'no.
    → NEVER


⚠ 9 va 15-BANDLAR — ENG NOZIK:
  Gap TASDIQ shaklda ('has seen', 'have
  travelled'), lekin ma'no INKOR.

  'Tracy has NEVER seen snow.'
     = Treysi qorni hech qachon ko'rmagan

  'ever' bu yerda XATO, chunki 'ever' faqat
  savolda yoki ustun daraja bilan keladi.


⚠ 10-BAND — USTUN DARAJA QURILMASI:
  'the BEST place I've EVER visited'
  Bu qurilmada 'ever' TASDIQ gapda keladi —
  yagona holat.

  Coursebook 106-bet: 'Brazil is the best
  place I've ever visited.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  the Statue of Liberty = Ozodlik haykali
  a football match = futbol o'yini
  Rio  = Rio-de-Janeyro
  Malta = Malta
  abroad = chet elda
  a suitcase = chamadon
  by train = poyezdda

topics.topic: Mashqlar — Present Perfect va Past Simple
topics.rule_uz:
SAKKIZ KO'RSATMA, HAR BIRIDA (Yes) yoki (No).

KITOBDA IKKI NAMUNA BERILGAN (1 va 2).


IKKI QOLIP:

  (Yes) bo'lsa:
     A: Has/Have ... [V3] ... YET?
     B: Yes, ... has/have ALREADY [V3] ...

  (No) bo'lsa:
     A: Has/Have ... [V3] ... YET?
     B: No, ... hasn't/haven't [V3] ... YET.


BARCHA SAKKIZ DIALOG:

 1  (they/visit/San Diego) - (Yes)
    A: Have they visited San Diego YET?
    B: Yes, they have ALREADY visited San
       Diego.
       (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 2  (she/have/breakfast) - (No)
    A: Has she had breakfast YET?
    B: No, she hasn't had breakfast YET.
       (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 3  (Bill/do/the shopping) - (No)
    A: Has Bill done the shopping YET?
    B: No, he hasn't done the shopping YET.

 4  (Laura/finish/her homework) - (Yes)
    A: Has Laura finished her homework YET?
    B: Yes, she has ALREADY finished her
       homework.

 5  (they/buy/their tickets) - (Yes)
    A: Have they bought their tickets YET?
    B: Yes, they have ALREADY bought their
       tickets.

 6  (Bill/do/the ironing) - (No)
    A: Has Bill done the ironing YET?
    B: No, he hasn't done the ironing YET.

 7  (Mike/visit/the Louvre) - (Yes)
    A: Has Mike visited the Louvre YET?
    B: Yes, he has ALREADY visited the Louvre.

 8  (you/tidy/your room) - (No)
    A: Have you tidied your room YET?
    B: No, I haven't tidied my room YET.


⚠ UCh MUHIM NUQTA:

 1) HAS yoki HAVE?
    Bill, Laura, Mike, she  →  HAS
    they, you               →  HAVE

 2) JAVOBDA EGA OLMOSHGA AYLANADI:
    'Bill' → 'HE'
    'Laura' → 'SHE'
    'Mike' → 'HE'
    'they' → 'THEY'

 3) 8-BANDDA EGALIK OLMOShI O'ZGARADI:
    Savol:  'Have YOU tidied YOUR room?'
    Javob:  'No, I haven't tidied MY room.'

    'your' → 'MY' (chunki javob beruvchi
    o'zi haqida gapiryapti).

    Bu — eng ko'p unutiladigan joy!


V3 ShAKLLARI:
  visit  →  VISITED   (to'g'ri)
  have   →  HAD       (V2 = V3)
  do     →  DONE
  finish →  FINISHED  (to'g'ri)
  buy    →  BOUGHT    (V2 = V3)
  tidy   →  TIDIED    (y → i + ed)


DIQQAT — 'TIDIED':
  tidy → TIDIED (undoshdan keyingi 'Y' →
  I + ED).
  Grammar 64-bet: 'bury → buried' bilan bir
  xil qoida.


DIQQAT — 'HAVE BREAKFAST':
  'to HAVE breakfast/lunch/dinner' = yemoq
  Present Perfect da: 'has HAD breakfast'

  Ikki marta 'have' — biri yordamchi, biri
  asosiy fe'l:
     'she HAS HAD breakfast'
      ↑yordamchi ↑asosiy (V3)


UY IShLARI (3, 6-bandlar):
  do the shopping = xarid qilmoq
  do the ironing  = dazmollamoq


RASM:
  Ko'rfazdagi qayiqlar va orqada osmono'par
  binolar — SAN DIEGO (1-band).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  San Diego = San-Diyego (AQSh, Kaliforniya)
  breakfast = nonushta
  a ticket  = chipta
  the ironing = dazmollash
  the Louvre = Luvr muzeyi

4 A: Has Laura finished her homework yet? B: Yes, she has already finished her homework.

topics.topic: Mashqlar — Present Perfect va Past Simple — BARCHA JAVOBLAR · 6-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  FOR   nine years    (NAMUNA)
   2  SINCE Monday
   3  SINCE 1971
   4  FOR   a day
   5  SINCE last month
   6  FOR   six weeks
   7  FOR   a weekend
   8  SINCE December
   9  FOR   five days
  10  SINCE yesterday
  11  SINCE last night
  12  FOR   a week

  Ya'ni: FOR — 1, 4, 6, 7, 9, 12 (6 ta)
         SINCE — 2, 3, 5, 8, 10, 11 (6 ta)

  Oltitadan TENG!


OLTIN QOIDA:

  FOR   +  QANChA VAQT (davomiylik)
     nine years, a day, six weeks,
     a weekend, five days, a week

  SINCE +  QAChONDAN BERI (nuqta)
     Monday, 1971, last month, December,
     yesterday, last night


QANDAY AJRATISh — IKKI BELGI:

  A) 'A' yoki RAQAM bilan boshlansa → FOR
        FOR nine years
        FOR A day
        FOR six weeks
        FOR A weekend
        FOR five days
        FOR A week

  B) KUN, OY, YIL nomi yoki 'LAST',
     'YESTERDAY' → SINCE
        SINCE Monday      (kun nomi)
        SINCE 1971        (yil)
        SINCE December    (oy nomi)
        SINCE LAST month
        SINCE YESTERDAY
        SINCE LAST night


⚠ ENG NOZIK JUFTLIKLAR:

   4  FOR a day       ↔  10  SINCE yesterday
      (bir kun davomida)  (kechadan beri)

   7  FOR a weekend   ↔   2  SINCE Monday
      (bir dam olish       (dushanbadan beri)
       kuni davomida)

  12  FOR a week      ↔   5  SINCE last month
      (bir hafta          (o'tgan oydan beri)
       davomida)

  Farqi: 'A' bilan boshlansa MIQDOR;
  aniq nom bo'lsa NUQTA.


DIQQAT — 11-BAND, 'LAST NIGHT':
  'SINCE last night' = o'tgan kechadan beri

  DIQQAT: 'last night' — Past Simple
  ko'rsatkichi ham bo'lishi mumkin
  ('I went there LAST NIGHT'), lekin
  'since' bilan kelsa — Present Perfect.

  Farqi:
     'I saw him LAST NIGHT.'      (Past Simple)
     'I haven't seen him SINCE LAST NIGHT.'
                                  (Pres. Perf.)


DIQQAT — 10-BAND, 'YESTERDAY':
  'SINCE yesterday' = kechadan beri ✓
  'FOR yesterday' — XATO (ma'nosiz)

  Lekin 'yesterday' o'zi (since siz) —
  Past Simple ko'rsatkichi:
     'I saw him YESTERDAY.'


QO'ShIMChA MISOLLAR:

  FOR:
     for two hours, for ten minutes,
     for a month, for ages, for a long time,
     for ever

  SINCE:
     since 2010, since April, since Christmas,
     since I was a child, since he left,
     since this morning


DIQQAT — 'SINCE' + GAP:
  'since' dan keyin TO'LIQ GAP ham keladi:
     'since I was a child'
     'since he left'
  Bunda gap PAST SIMPLE da bo'ladi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a weekend = dam olish kunlari
  December  = dekabr
  a week    = hafta

topics.topic: Mashqlar — Present Perfect va Past Simple — BARCHA JAVOBLAR · 7-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  HOW LONG have you lived in Turkey?
    (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)
 2  Sophie has NEVER been to the opera before.
 3  I've JUST finished my homework.
 4  He has been working in Hungary SINCE 1993.
 5  No, I haven't paid it YET.
 6  HOW LONG have you worked here?
 7  Yes, I have JUST cleaned it.
 8  I have NEVER been fishing before.
 9  Have you EVER been on a canoe trip?


⚠ DIQQAT — RO'YXAT BILAN BO'ShLIQ SONI
MOS KELMAYDI:

  Ro'yxatda 7 so'z: yet, how long, never,
  since, just, for, ever
  Bo'shliqlar: 9 ta

  Demak ba'zi so'zlar IKKI marta ishlatiladi:
     HOW LONG — 1 va 6-bandlar
     NEVER    — 2 va 8-bandlar
     JUST     — 3 va 7-bandlar

  Va 'FOR' UMUMAN ishlatilmaydi —
  kitob ro'yxatga ortiqcha so'z qo'shgan.


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  '... have you lived in Turkey?'
    Savol MUDDAT haqida → HOW LONG.
    (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 2  'Sophie has ... been to the opera BEFORE.'
    KALIT: 'BEFORE' (ilgari) — tajriba haqida.
    TASDIQ shakl, INKOR ma'no → NEVER.

 3  'I've ... finished my homework.'
    TASDIQ gap, harakat yaqinda tugagan
    → JUST.
    ('yet' tasdiqda ishlatilmaydi;
     'ever' oddiy tasdiqda ishlatilmaydi.)

 4  'He has been working in Hungary ... 1993.'
    '1993' — YIL, ANIQ NUQTA → SINCE.

 5  'No, I HAVEN'T paid it ...'
    KALIT: INKOR gap → YET (gap oxirida).

 6  '... have you worked here?'
    Savol MUDDAT haqida → HOW LONG.
    (1-band bilan bir xil.)

 7  'Yes, I HAVE ... cleaned it.'
    TASDIQ gap, 'Have you cleaned your room?'
    savoliga javob → JUST (hozirgina).
    (Ro'yxatda 'already' YO'Q, shuning uchun
     'just'.)

 8  'I have ... been fishing BEFORE.'
    KALIT: 'BEFORE' — tajriba haqida.
    → NEVER (2-band bilan bir xil).

 9  'HAVE YOU ... been on a canoe trip?'
    KALIT: bu SAVOL → EVER.


⚠ 'BEFORE' SO'ZI — MUHIM KALIT:
  2 va 8-bandlarda 'before' bor.

  'have never ... BEFORE' = ilgari hech
  qachon ...magan

  'before' tajriba haqidagi gaplarda
  'never' yoki 'ever' bilan keladi:
     'Have you been there BEFORE?'
     'I've NEVER been there BEFORE.'


DIQQAT — 4-BANDDAGI 'HAS BEEN WORKING':
  'He HAS BEEN WORKING in Hungary since 1993.'

  Bu — PRESENT PERFECT CONTINUOUS
  (have been + V-ing).

  Enterprise 1 da bu zamon o'rganilmaydi,
  lekin kitob misolda ishlatgan.

  Ma'nosi: 1993-yildan beri ishlaydi va
  HOZIR HAM ishlaydi.

  Present Perfect bilan ham aytish mumkin:
     'He HAS WORKED in Hungary since 1993.'


DIQQAT — 'GO FISHING':
  'to go fishing' = baliq ovlagani bormoq
  Present Perfect da: 'have BEEN fishing'

  Shu kabi:
     go swimming → have been swimming
     go shopping → have been shopping
     go skiing   → have been skiing

  DIQQAT: 'GONE' emas, 'BEEN' —
  chunki qaytib kelgan (Grammar 65-bet
  qoidasi).


DIQQAT — 'A CANOE TRIP':
  'a canoe' = kanoe (yengil qayiq)
  O'qilishi: /kəˈnuː/ — 'kanu:'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  How long ...?  = qancha vaqtdan beri?
  before         = ilgari
  Hungary        = Vengriya
  a phone bill   = telefon hisobi
  to pay         = to'lamoq (pay → PAID)
  to go fishing  = baliq ovlagani bormoq
  a canoe        = kanoe
  a canoe trip   = kanoeda sayohat

topics.topic: Present Perfect (have/has + past participle) — JADVAL IKKI USTUNLI · 8-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
JADVAL IKKI USTUNLI:
  AFFIRMATIVE (tasdiq) / NEGATIVE (inkor)

Kitob ba'zi kataklarni to'ldirib bergan
(qizil rangda), qolganini o'zingiz
to'ldirasiz.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  TASDIQ (Affirmative):
     I / you            HAVE  cleaned
                        (kitob bergan)
     he / she / it      HAS   cleaned
                        (kitob bergan)
     we / you / they    HAVE  cleaned  ←

  INKOR (Negative):
     I / you            HAVEN'T cleaned
                        (kitob bergan)
     he / she / it      HASN'T  cleaned  ←
     we / you / they    HAVEN'T cleaned  ←


TO'LIQ TUSLANISh:

  TASDIQ:
     I have cleaned          we have cleaned
     you have cleaned        you have cleaned
     he has cleaned          they have cleaned
     she has cleaned
     it has cleaned

  INKOR:
     I haven't cleaned       we haven't cleaned
     you haven't cleaned     you haven't cleaned
     he hasn't cleaned       they haven't cleaned
     she hasn't cleaned
     it hasn't cleaned


OLTIN QOIDA — JUDA ODDIY:

  HAS  →  faqat HE / SHE / IT bilan
  HAVE →  qolgan HAMMASI bilan
          (I, you, we, they)

  Inkor:
     hasn't  = has not
     haven't = have not


YASALIShI:
  HAVE / HAS  +  fe'lning III shakli (V3)

  'clean' — TO'G'RI fe'l, shuning uchun
  V3 = V2 = 'cleaned'.


QISQARTMALAR (og'zaki nutqda):
     I have    →  I'VE
     you have  →  YOU'VE
     he has    →  HE'S
     she has   →  SHE'S
     it has    →  IT'S
     we have   →  WE'VE
     they have →  THEY'VE

  DIQQAT — 'HE'S' IKKI MA'NOLI:
     'He'S cleaned it.'  = he HAS cleaned
     'He'S a doctor.'    = he IS a doctor

  Qaysi ekanini KEYINGI SO'Z aytadi:
     keyin V3 kelsa  →  HAS
     keyin ot/sifat  →  IS


DIQQAT — FE'LNING III ShAKLI (V3):

  TO'G'RI fe'llar: V2 = V3 (ikkalasi ham -ed)
     clean → cleaned → CLEANED
     visit → visited → VISITED
     stay  → stayed  → STAYED

  NOTO'G'RI fe'llar: V3 boshqa bo'lishi
  mumkin
     see   → saw   → SEEN
     be    → was   → BEEN
     do    → did   → DONE
     go    → went  → GONE
     eat   → ate   → EATEN
     ride  → rode  → RIDDEN
     drive → drove → DRIVEN
     fly   → flew  → FLOWN

  Ba'zilarida V2 = V3:
     buy   → bought → BOUGHT
     meet  → met    → MET
     have  → had    → HAD


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  affirmative     = tasdiq shakli
  negative        = inkor shakli
  past participle = fe'lning III shakli
  to clean        = tozalamoq

topics.topic: Present Perfect (have/has + past participle) — Present Perfect (have/has + III shakl) (1)
topics.rule_uz:
GRAMMATIKA QUTISI — ENG MUHIM QOIDA


KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We form the PRESENT PERFECT with HAVE/HAS
    and the PAST PARTICIPLE of the main verb.'

 • 'We use the PRESENT PERFECT to talk about an
    action which happened in the past,
    WITHOUT SAYING WHEN it happened.'
      He's BEEN to Spain.
      (We don't know WHEN he went to Spain.)

 • 'We use the PAST SIMPLE to talk about an
    action which happened at a DEFINITE TIME
    in the past.'
      He WENT to Spain LAST MONTH.
      (When did he go to Spain? Last month —
       definite time.)

 • 'TIME ADVERBS used with the PRESENT PERFECT:
    ever, just, yet, already, for, since, etc.'

 • 'TIME ADVERBS used with the PAST SIMPLE:
    yesterday, two/three/etc days/months/etc
    ago, last Monday/week/month, etc.'


O'ZBEKChA — BUTUN UNITNING KALITI:

  VAQT AYTILMAGAN  →  PRESENT PERFECT
     'He's been to Spain.'
     (Qachon borgani NOMA'LUM)

  VAQT AYTILGAN    →  PAST SIMPLE
     'He went to Spain last month.'
     (Qachon? — o'tgan oyda)


VAQT RAVIShLARI — IKKI RO'YXAT:

  PRESENT PERFECT bilan:
     ever      (hech qachon — savolda)
     never     (hech qachon — inkorda)
     just      (hozirgina)
     yet       (hali)
     already   (allaqachon)
     for       (... davomida)
     since     (... dan beri)

  PAST SIMPLE bilan:
     yesterday        (kecha)
     two days ago     (ikki kun oldin)
     three months ago (uch oy oldin)
     last Monday      (o'tgan dushanba)
     last week        (o'tgan hafta)
     last month       (o'tgan oy)
     in 2010          (2010-yilda)


⚠ ENG KO'P XATO:
  'I have seen him YESTERDAY.'      ✗
  'I SAW him yesterday.'            ✓

  'I have gone to Spain LAST MONTH.' ✗
  'I WENT to Spain last month.'      ✓

  ANIQ VAQT ravishi bo'lsa, Present Perfect
  ISHLATILMAYDI!


DIQQAT — 'AGO' va 'FOR' FARQI:
  'two days AGO'  → Past Simple
     'I saw him two days ago.'
  'FOR two days'  → Present Perfect
     'I have been here for two days.'

  Ikkalasi ham 'ikki kun' haqida, lekin:
     ago = O'TMISHDAGI nuqta
     for = HOZIRGACHA davom etgan muddat


NEGA BU FARQ MUHIM:

  'He WENT to Spain.'
     → borgan va (ehtimol) qaytgan; o'tmish
       tugagan

  'He HAS BEEN to Spain.'
     → tajribasi bor; hozirga aloqador

  'He HAS GONE to Spain.'
     → hali u yerda!


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  past participle = fe'lning III shakli
  the main verb   = asosiy fe'l
  an action       = harakat
  definite time   = aniq vaqt
  a time adverb   = vaqt ravishi
examples: We form the present perfect with have/has and the past participle of the main verb.
We use the present perfect to talk about an action which happened in the past, without saying when it happened. — He's been to Spain. (We don't know when he went to Spain.)
We use the past simple to talk about an action which happened at a definite time in the past. — He went to Spain last month.
Time adverbs used with the present perfect: ever, just, yet, already, for, since, etc.
Time adverbs used with the past simple: yesterday, two/three/etc days/months/etc ago, last Monday/week/month, etc.

topics.topic: Present Perfect (have/has + past participle) — Present Perfect (have/has + III shakl) (2)
topics.rule_uz:
105-BETDAGI XATDAN:


JEK QILGAN UCh ISh (HAS DONE):

 1  He HAS VISITED the Khan al-Khalili bazaar.
    Xatdan: 'I've already VISITED the Khan
    al-Khalili bazaar.'

 2  He HAS SEEN the Pyramids and the Sphinx.
    Xatdan: 'I have also SEEN the Pyramids and
    the Sphinx at Giza.'

 3  He HAS BEEN TO a traditional restaurant.
    Xatdan: 'I've BEEN TO a traditional
    restaurant.'


JEK QILMAGAN IKKI ISh (HASN'T DONE):

 1  He HASN'T BEEN on a boat trip down the
    River Nile.
    Xatdan: 'I HAVEN'T BEEN on a boat trip down
    the River Nile yet.'

 2  He HASN'T VISITED the Egyptian Museum.
    Xatdan: 'and I HAVEN'T VISITED the Egyptian
    Museum.'


⚠ DIQQAT — OLMOSh VA FE'L O'ZGARADI:

  Xatda BIRINChI shaxs:
     'I HAVE visited ...'
     'I HAVEN'T been ...'

  Javobda UChINChI shaxs:
     'HE HAS visited ...'
     'HE HASN'T been ...'

  Ya'ni 'have' → 'HAS' ga o'zgaradi
  (chunki 'he' — III shaxs birlik).

  Bu — mashqning eng ko'p unutiladigan qismi!


QANDAY TOPILADI — XATDA IKKI GURUH:

  Xatning 2-XATBOShISI — QILGAN ishlar
  (hammasi TASDIQ Present Perfect)

  Xatning 3-XATBOShISI — QILMAGAN ishlar
  ('There are a lot of things I HAVEN'T
    DONE YET' bilan boshlanadi)

  Kitob ataylab shunday tuzgan.


QO'ShIMChA — XATDAGI PAST SIMPLE GAPLAR
(bular bu mashqqa KIRMAYDI):
     'We visited it on Tuesday.'
     'I bought some souvenirs.'
     'I saw them yesterday.'
     'I even rode a camel.'
     'Abdullah took me there last night.'
     'I tried couscous and falafel.'

  Bular Past Simple da, chunki ANIQ VAQT
  aytilgan yoki tafsilot berilgan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to find      = topmoq
  three things = uchta narsa/ish
examples: 1 He HAS visited the Khan al-Khalili bazaar.
2 He HAS seen the Pyramids and the Sphinx at Giza.
3 He HAS been to a traditional restaurant.
1 He HASN'T been on a boat trip down the River Nile.
2 He HASN'T visited the Egyptian Museum.

topics.topic: Present Perfect (have/has + past participle) — JADVAL IKKI USTUNLI · 10-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
JADVAL IKKI USTUNLI:
  INTERROGATIVE (so'roq) / SHORT ANSWERS
  (qisqa javoblar)


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  HAVE I/we/you/they BEEN to Turkey?
     Yes, I/we/you/they  HAVE.
     No,  I/we/you/they  HAVEN'T.

  HAS he/she/it BEEN to Turkey?
     Yes, he/she/it  HAS.
     No,  he/she/it  HASN'T.


OLTIN QOIDA — QISQA JAVOB SAVOLDAGI
YORDAMChI FE'LNI TAKRORLAYDI:

     'HAVE you been ...?'  →  'Yes, I HAVE.'
     'HAS he been ...?'    →  'Yes, he HAS.'

  Savol qaysi so'z bilan boshlansa, javobda
  ham o'sha so'z qoladi.


SO'ROQ ShAKLI QANDAY YASALADI:

  HAVE / HAS  +  EGA  +  V3  + ... ?

     Have you been to Turkey?
     Has he been to Turkey?
     Have they visited Spain?

  DIQQAT: 'DO' KERAK EMAS!
     'Have you been ...?'    ✓
     'DO you have been ...?' ✗


QISQA JAVOBDA ASOSIY FE'L TAKRORLANMAYDI:
     'Yes, I have.'              ✓
     'Yes, I have been.'         (ortiqcha)
     'Yes, I have been to Turkey.' (juda
                                    ortiqcha)

  Faqat 'have/has' qoladi.


DIQQAT — TO'LIQ ShAKL QISQA JAVOBDA:
  IJOBIY javobda QISQARTMA IShLATILMAYDI:
     'Yes, I HAVE.'   ✓
     'Yes, I'VE.'     ✗

  SALBIY javobda esa qisqartma odatiy:
     'No, I HAVEN'T.' ✓
     'No, I have not.' ✓ (rasmiyroq)

  Bu — barcha qisqa javoblarga taalluqli
  qoida ('Yes, I AM' ✓ / 'Yes, I'M' ✗).


SAVOL SO'ZI BILAN — QISQA JAVOB BO'LMAYDI:
  'WHERE have you been?'
     → 'To Turkey.' (qisqa javob emas,
        to'ldiruvchi)
  'HOW LONG have you been here?'
     → 'Since Monday.'

  Faqat HA/YO'Q savollariga qisqa javob
  beriladi.


BOG'LIQLIK — 105-BETDAGI DIALOG:
     SA: 'HAS Jack VISITED the bazaar?'
     SB: 'Yes, he HAS.'

  Aynan shu qoida ishlatilgan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  interrogative = so'roq shakli
  a short answer = qisqa javob
  Turkey        = Turkiya

topics.topic: Present Perfect + Ever/Never (1)
topics.rule_uz:
GRAMMATIKA QUTISI

KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We use EVER in QUESTIONS and STATEMENTS.'
      Have you EVER visited Brazil?
      Brazil is the best place I've EVER
      visited.

 • 'We use NEVER in STATEMENTS.'
      I've NEVER visited Cyprus.
      I haven't visited Cyprus.


'EVER' NING IKKI IShLATILIShI:

  1) SAVOLDA — 'hech qachon ...ganmisiz?'
        'Have you EVER visited Brazil?'
        'Have you EVER been to Egypt?'

     Bu yerda 'ever' = umr davomida biror
     marta.

  2) USTUN DARAJA bilan — 'ko'rgan eng ...'
        'Brazil is the BEST place I've EVER
         visited.'
        'It's the MOST beautiful city I've EVER
         seen.'

     Qolip: the + [ustun daraja] + ... +
            I've EVER + V3

     DIQQAT: bu qurilmada 'ever' TASDIQ
     gapda keladi, lekin baribir Present
     Perfect bilan.


'NEVER' — FAQAT TASDIQ ShAKLDA:

     'I've NEVER visited Cyprus.'  ✓
     'I haven't NEVER visited.'    ✗ XATO!

  'never' O'ZI INKOR ma'noni beradi,
  shuning uchun 'haven't' bilan BIRGA
  ishlatilmaydi.

  Ikki xil aytish mumkin:
     'I've NEVER visited Cyprus.'   (never)
     'I HAVEN'T visited Cyprus.'    (haven't)

  Ma'nosi bir xil, lekin 'never' KUCHLIROQ.


'EVER' va 'NEVER' QAYERDA TURADI:

  'have' va V3 ORASIDA:
     Have you EVER visited ...?
     I've NEVER visited ...
     I've EVER visited ...

  'Have you visited EVER?' — XATO.


JAVOB BERISh:

  'Have you ever been to Brazil?'
     Yes, I have.
     No, I haven't.  /  No, I've never been
                        there.


DIQQAT — 'EVER' TASDIQ ODDIY GAPDA
IShLATILMAYDI:
     'I have ever been to Spain.'  ✗
     'I have been to Spain.'       ✓

  'ever' faqat:
     • savolda
     • ustun daraja qurilmasida
     • inkorda ('I haven't ever ...' — bu
       'I've never ...' bilan bir xil)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  ever      = hech qachon (savolda)
  never     = hech qachon (inkor ma'noda)
  a statement = darak gap
  Brazil    = Braziliya
  Cyprus    = Kipr
examples: We use ever in questions and statements. — Have you ever visited Brazil?
Brazil is the best place I've ever visited.
We use never in statements. — I've never visited Cyprus.
I haven't visited Cyprus.

topics.topic: Present Perfect + Ever/Never (2)
topics.rule_uz:
O'N MAMLAKAT:
  Australia, Turkey, Greece, Mexico, Italy,

KITOBDAGI IKKI NAMUNA:

  BORGAN bo'lsangiz:

  BORMAGAN bo'lsangiz:

DIQQAT — BU ShAXSIY MAShQ:
  Javob har kimda BOSHQA bo'ladi — o'z

  Quyida NAMUNA javoblar berilgan
  (o'zbekistonlik o'quvchi uchun eng
  ehtimolli variant).


NAMUNA JAVOBLAR (10 mamlakat):

    beautiful country I've ever visited.
