 8  I've never been to Poland.
 9  I've never been to Brazil.
10  I've never been to China.

  (Bu — faqat namuna. O'z javobingizni
   yozing!)


USTUN DARAJA QOLIPI — BATAFSIL:

  'It's the BEST country I've EVER visited.'

  Boshqa variantlar:
     'It's the MOST BEAUTIFUL country I've
      ever visited.'
     'It's the MOST INTERESTING place I've
      ever seen.'
     'It's the BIGGEST city I've ever been to.'

  Qolip:
     It's the + [USTUN DARAJA] + [ot] +
     I've EVER + [V3].

  DIQQAT: 'that' tushirib qoldirilgan —
  to'liq shakli:
     'the best country THAT I've ever visited'


DIQQAT — 'BEEN TO' PREDLOG:
  'I've been TO Spain.'  ✓
  'I've been IN Spain.'  — boshqa ma'no
                           (ichkarida bo'lish)
  'I've been Spain.'     ✗


DIQQAT — MAMLAKAT NOMLARIDA ARTIKL:
  Ro'yxatdagi 10 mamlakatning HAMMASI
  ARTIKLSIZ:
     Australia, Turkey, Greece, Mexico, Italy,
     Canada, Spain, Poland, Brazil, China

  ISTISNOLAR (bu ro'yxatda yo'q):
     the USA, the UK, the Netherlands,
     the Philippines

  (Grammar 63-bet, 10-mashq qoidasi.)


DIQQAT — 'NEVER' O'RNI:
  'I've NEVER been to China.'  ✓
  'I never have been ...'      ✗
  'I've been never ...'        ✗

  'never' — 'have' va V3 ORASIDA.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Australia = Avstraliya
  Turkey    = Turkiya
  Greece    = Gretsiya
  Mexico    = Meksika
  Italy     = Italiya
  Canada    = Kanada
  Spain     = Ispaniya
  Poland    = Polsha
  Brazil    = Braziliya
  China     = Xitoy
examples: I've been to Spain. It's the best country I've ever visited.
I've never been to China.
I've never been to Australia. / I've never been to Greece. / I've never been to Mexico.
I've been to Turkey. It's the most beautiful country I've ever visited.
It's the most interesting place I've ever seen. / It's the biggest city I've ever been to.
Kitobdagi 10 mamlakat: Australia, Turkey, Greece, Mexico, Italy, Canada, Spain, Poland, Brazil, China.

topics.topic: Present Perfect + Ever/Never (3)
topics.rule_uz:
YETTI KO'RSATMA:
  • visit Prague? - last summer
  • ride a camel? - no
  • stay in a big hotel? - last winter
  • eat Chinese food? - last Sunday
  • meet a famous person? - no
  • drive a bus? - no
  • fly in a plane? - a month ago

SIFATLAR:
  exciting, fantastic, amazing, delicious,
  great, awful, horrible, terrible, disgusting


KITOBDAGI IKKI NAMUNA:

  SA: Have you EVER VISITED Prague?
  SB: Yes, I HAVE.
  SA: WHEN DID you VISIT Prague?
  SB: Last summer. It was exciting.

  SA: Have you EVER RIDDEN a camel?
  SB: No, I HAVEN'T. I've NEVER RIDDEN a camel.


IKKI QOLIP:

  A) JAVOB 'HA' bo'lsa (vaqt berilgan):
     SA: Have you ever [V3] ...?
     SB: Yes, I have.
     SA: When did you [V1] ...?
     SB: [vaqt]. It was [sifat].

  B) JAVOB 'YO'Q' bo'lsa:
     SA: Have you ever [V3] ...?
     SB: No, I haven't. I've never [V3] ...


BARCHA YETTI DIALOG:

 1  SA: Have you ever VISITED Prague?
    SB: Yes, I have.
    SA: When did you VISIT Prague?
    SB: Last summer. It was EXCITING.
        (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 2  SA: Have you ever RIDDEN a camel?
    SB: No, I haven't. I've never RIDDEN a
        camel.
        (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 3  SA: Have you ever STAYED in a big hotel?
    SB: Yes, I have.
    SA: When did you STAY in a big hotel?
    SB: Last winter. It was FANTASTIC.

 4  SA: Have you ever EATEN Chinese food?
    SB: Yes, I have.
    SA: When did you EAT Chinese food?
    SB: Last Sunday. It was DELICIOUS.

 5  SA: Have you ever MET a famous person?
    SB: No, I haven't. I've never MET a famous
        person.

 6  SA: Have you ever DRIVEN a bus?
    SB: No, I haven't. I've never DRIVEN a bus.

 7  SA: Have you ever FLOWN in a plane?
    SB: Yes, I have.
    SA: When did you FLY in a plane?
    SB: A month ago. It was AMAZING.


⚠ ENG MUHIM QISM — III ShAKL (V3):

  Savolda V3, javobda V1 ishlatiladi!

  SAVOL (Present Perfect)   JAVOB (Past Simple)
  ─────────────────────     ──────────────────
  Have you ever VISITED?    When did you VISIT?
  Have you ever RIDDEN?     (—)
  Have you ever STAYED?     When did you STAY?
  Have you ever EATEN?      When did you EAT?
  Have you ever MET?        (—)
  Have you ever DRIVEN?     (—)
  Have you ever FLOWN?      When did you FLY?

  DIQQAT: 'did' dan keyin fe'l ASOSIY
  shaklda!
     'When did you EAT?'    ✓
     'When did you ATE?'    ✗
     'When did you EATEN?'  ✗


UCh ASOSIY ShAKL (mashqdagi fe'llar):

  visit  →  visited  →  VISITED   (to'g'ri)
  ride   →  rode     →  RIDDEN
  stay   →  stayed   →  STAYED    (to'g'ri)
  eat    →  ate      →  EATEN
  meet   →  met      →  MET
  drive  →  drove    →  DRIVEN
  fly    →  flew     →  FLOWN

  DIQQAT: 'ridden', 'eaten', 'driven',
  'flown' — bularni YODLASh kerak.


SIFATLAR IKKI GURUHDA:

  IJOBIY:
     exciting  (hayajonli)
     fantastic (ajoyib)
     amazing   (hayratlanarli)
     delicious (juda mazali — faqat OVQAT)
     great     (zo'r)

  SALBIY:
     awful      (juda yomon)
     horrible   (dahshatli)
     terrible   (dahshatli)
     disgusting (jirkanch — ko'pincha OVQAT)

  DIQQAT: 'delicious' va 'disgusting'
  asosan OVQAT haqida ishlatiladi, shuning
  uchun 4-bandga (Chinese food) mos keladi.


DIQQAT — 'FLY IN A PLANE':
  'to fly IN a plane' = samolyotda uchmoq
  ('to fly ON a plane' ham uchraydi,
   lekin 'in' standart)


DIQQAT — 'A MONTH AGO':
  'a month AGO' — PAST SIMPLE ko'rsatkichi.
  Shuning uchun javob: 'A month ago.'
  va 'It WAS amazing.'

  DIQQAT: 'ago' bilan Present Perfect
  ISHLATILMAYDI!


RASM:
  Otliq bronza haykal — Pragadagi mashhur
  Avliyo Vatslav haykali (Wenceslas Square).
  1-bandga ('visit Prague') ishora.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Prague       = Praga (Chexiya poytaxti)
  a famous person = mashhur odam
  to fly       = uchmoq (fly → flew → FLOWN)
  exciting     = hayajonli
  awful        = juda yomon
  terrible     = dahshatli
examples: SA: Have you ever visited Prague? SB: Yes, I have. SA: When did you visit Prague? SB: Last summer. It was exciting.
SA: Have you ever ridden a camel? SB: No, I haven't. I've never ridden a camel.
SA: Have you ever stayed in a big hotel? SB: Yes, I have. SA: When did you stay in a big hotel? SB: Last winter. It was fantastic.
SA: Have you ever eaten Chinese food? SB: Yes, I have. SA: When did you eat Chinese food? SB: Last Sunday. It was delicious.
SA: Have you ever met a famous person? SB: No, I haven't. I've never met a famous person.
SA: Have you ever driven a bus? SB: No, I haven't. I've never driven a bus.
SA: Have you ever flown in a plane? SB: Yes, I have. SA: When did you fly in a plane? SB: A month ago. It was amazing.

topics.topic: Present Perfect + Yet/Already
topics.rule_uz:
GRAMMATIKA QUTISI

KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We use ALREADY in POSITIVE STATEMENTS.'
 • 'We use YET in QUESTIONS and NEGATIVES.'

 MISOLLAR:
    Have you packed your suitcase YET?
    No, I haven't. I haven't packed it YET.
    Yes, I have. I've ALREADY packed it.


QISQA JADVAL:

  ALREADY  →  TASDIQ gapda
              'I've ALREADY packed it.'

  YET      →  SAVOLDA
              'Have you packed it YET?'
           →  INKORDA
              'I haven't packed it YET.'


QAYERDA TURADI:

  ALREADY — 'have' va V3 ORASIDA:
     'I've ALREADY packed it.'
     'She has ALREADY left.'

     (Ba'zan gap oxirida ham keladi, lekin
      o'rtada turgani standart.)

  YET — GAP OXIRIDA:
     'Have you packed it YET?'
     'I haven't packed it YET.'

     'Have you YET packed it?' — XATO.


MA'NOLARI:

  ALREADY = allaqachon
     Kutilganidan ERTAROQ bo'lgan ish.
     'I've already packed.' = kutmagan
     edingiz, lekin men allaqachon
     yig'ib bo'ldim.

  YET = hali
     Kutilayotgan, lekin HALI bo'lmagan ish.
     'I haven't packed yet.' = hali
     yig'madim (lekin yig'ishim kerak).

  Ya'ni 'yet' KUTILAYOTGAN ishni bildiradi.


DIQQAT — 'YET' va 'STILL':
  'I haven't packed YET.'
     = hali yig'madim (neytral)
  'I STILL haven't packed.'
     = hali ham yig'madim (sabrsizlik,
       ajablanish)

  'still' — 'haven't' dan OLDIN.


DIQQAT — 'ALREADY' SAVOLDA:
  Ba'zan savolda ham ishlatiladi, lekin
  AJABLANISH ma'nosida:
     'Have you ALREADY packed?'
     = Allaqachon yig'ib bo'ldingizmi?
       (Shunchalik tezmi?)

  Oddiy savolda esa 'yet':
     'Have you packed YET?'


BOG'LIQLIK — 105-BETDAGI XAT:
  'I've ALREADY visited the bazaar.'
     (tasdiq)
  'I haven't been on a boat trip YET.'
     (inkor)
  'There are a lot of things I haven't
   done YET.'
     (inkor)

  Jekning xati bu qoidani aynan ishlatgan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  already     = allaqachon
  yet         = hali
  to pack     = (yukni) yig'moq
  a suitcase  = chamadon
  a positive statement = tasdiq gap
examples: We use already in positive statements.
We use yet in questions and negatives.
Have you packed your suitcase yet?
No, I haven't. I haven't packed it yet.
Yes, I have. I've already packed it.

topics.topic: Present Perfect + yet / already / just — VAZIYAT: Toni va Enn Parijda ta'tilda · 13-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
VAZIYAT: Toni va Enn Parijda ta'tilda.

JADVALDA YETTI ISh:
  visit the Eiffel Tower

  go to Versailles        →  ✗ (qilishmagan)

  Qolgan BESh qator faqat AUDIODAN
  aniqlanadi (quyidagi alohida ro'yxatga
  qarang).


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA DIALOG:

  SA: Have they visited the Eiffel Tower YET?
  SB: Yes, they have ALREADY visited the

  SA: No, they HAVEN'T been to Versailles YET.


IKKI QOLIP:

  ✓ bo'lsa:
     'Have they [V3] ... YET?'
     'Yes, they have ALREADY [V3] ...'

  ✗ bo'lsa:
     'Have they [V3] ... YET?'
     'No, they HAVEN'T [V3] ... YET.'


⚠ 'YET' va 'ALREADY' NING O'RNI —
NAMUNADA ANIQ KO'RINADI:

  SAVOLDA:  'yet' — GAP OXIRIDA
     'Have they visited the Eiffel Tower YET?'

  TASDIQ JAVOBDA:  'already' — 'have' va V3
     ORASIDA

     'they haven't been to Versailles YET.'


PARIJDAGI YETTI JOY — NIMA EKANI:

  the Eiffel Tower — Eyfel minorasi (1889)
  Versailles — Versal saroyi (Parij tashqarisida)
  the Galleries Lafayette — mashhur universmag

  Notre Dame — Notr-Dam sobori


DIQQAT — FE'LLARNING V3 ShAKLI:
  visit  →  VISITED   (to'g'ri fe'l)
  go     →  BEEN / GONE
  see    →  SEEN

  DIQQAT: 'go to Versailles' savolda
  'have they BEEN to Versailles' bo'ladi —
  chunki ular u yerdan QAYTGAN bo'lardi.
  ('have they GONE' = hali u yerda degani.)

  Kitobdagi namuna aynan shunday:
  'Have they BEEN to Versailles yet?'


RASM:
  Eyfel minorasi va oldidagi favvoralar
  (Trocadéro bog'idan ko'rinish).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an activity   = mashg'ulot, ish
  to tick       = ✓ qo'ymoq
  a cross       = ✗ belgisi
  the Eiffel Tower = Eyfel minorasi
  a tower       = minora
  to go shopping = xarid qilgani bormoq
  an arch       = ark, tok
  a boat trip   = qayiqda sayohat

topics.topic: Present Perfect + yet / already / just (2)
topics.rule_uz:
GRAMMATIKA QUTISI

KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We use JUST in statements to show that an
    action finished only A FEW MINUTES EARLIER.'

 MISOL:
    A: Have you packed your suitcase yet?
    B: Yes, I've JUST packed it.


'JUST' NING MA'NOSI:
  'just' = hozirgina, endigina

  Harakat BIR NECHA DAQIQA oldin tugagan.

     'I've JUST arrived.'    = hozirgina keldim
     'She's JUST left.'      = u endigina ketdi
     'We've JUST finished.'  = endigina
                               tugatdik


QAYERDA TURADI:
  'have' va V3 ORASIDA:
     'I've JUST packed it.'  ✓
     'I've packed it JUST.'  ✗
     'JUST I've packed it.'  ✗

  Xuddi 'already' kabi.


UCh RAVIShNI SOLIShTIRING:

  JUST     — hozirgina (bir necha daqiqa
             oldin)
             'I've just packed it.'

  ALREADY  — allaqachon (kutilganidan
             ertaroq)
             'I've already packed it.'

  YET      — hali (kutilayotgan, lekin hali
             bo'lmagan)
             'I haven't packed it yet.'

  Hammasi Present Perfect bilan.
  JUST va ALREADY — TASDIQDA, o'rtada.
  YET — SAVOL/INKORDA, gap oxirida.


DIQQAT — 'JUST' NING BOShQA MA'NOLARI:
  'just' — faqat (only)
     'I have JUST one question.'
  'just' — aynan
     'That's JUST what I wanted.'
  'just' — shunchaki
     'The food was JUST delicious.'
     (105-betdagi Jekning xatidan!)

  Present Perfect bilan esa 'hozirgina'.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  just    = hozirgina, endigina
  earlier = oldinroq
  to pack = (yukni) yig'moq
examples: We use just in statements to show that an action finished only a few minutes earlier.
A: Have you packed your suitcase yet? B: Yes, I've just packed it.

topics.topic: Present Perfect + yet / already / just (3)
topics.rule_uz:
BESh KO'RSATMA:
  1  book a table
  2  pack our swimming costumes
  3  find the tickets
  4  talk to the receptionist
  5  meet Steve


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: Have you BOOKED a table YET?
  SB: Yes, I've JUST BOOKED it.


QOLIP:
  SA: Have you [V3] ... YET?
  SB: Yes, I've JUST [V3] it/them/him.


BARCHA BESh DIALOG:

 1  SA: Have you BOOKED a table YET?
    SB: Yes, I've JUST BOOKED it.
        (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 2  SA: Have you PACKED our swimming costumes
        YET?
    SB: Yes, I've JUST PACKED THEM.

 3  SA: Have you FOUND the tickets YET?
    SB: Yes, I've JUST FOUND THEM.

 4  SA: Have you TALKED to the receptionist
        YET?
    SB: Yes, I've JUST TALKED to HIM.
        (yoki 'to HER')

 5  SA: Have you MET Steve YET?
    SB: Yes, I've JUST MET HIM.


⚠ ENG NOZIK QISM — OLMOSh TO'G'RI TANLANIShI:

  BIRLIK narsa    →  IT
     'a table'         → it

  KO'PLIK narsa   →  THEM
     'swimming costumes' → them
     'the tickets'       → them

  ERKAK odam      →  HIM
     'the receptionist' → him (yoki her)
     'Steve'            → him

  Bu — mashqning eng ko'p xato qilinadigan
  joyi!


V3 ShAKLLARI:
  book  →  booked  →  BOOKED   (to'g'ri)
  pack  →  packed  →  PACKED   (to'g'ri)
  find  →  found   →  FOUND    (V2 = V3)
  talk  →  talked  →  TALKED   (to'g'ri)
  meet  →  met     →  MET      (V2 = V3)


DIQQAT — 4-BANDDAGI PREDLOG:
  'talk TO the receptionist'
  'to talk TO somebody' — predlog 'to'.

  Javobda ham saqlanadi:
     'I've just talked TO him.'


DIQQAT — 5-BANDDA PREDLOG YO'Q:
  'MEET Steve' — predlogsiz.
     'meet somebody'  ✓
     'meet WITH somebody' — amerikacha,
        rasmiy uchrashuv uchun

  Javobda: 'I've just met HIM.'


VAZIYAT — BU DIALOGLAR NIMA HAQIDA:
  Beshala ko'rsatma TA'TILGA TAYYORGARLIK
  haqida:
     stol band qilish (restoranda)
     cho'milish kiyimlarini yig'ish
     chiptalarni topish
     administrator bilan gaplashish
     Stiv bilan uchrashish

  Ya'ni ikki kishi jo'nashdan oldin
  ro'yxatni tekshirmoqda.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to book a table   = stol band qilmoq
  a swimming costume = cho'milish kiyimi
  to find           = topmoq (find → FOUND)
  a ticket          = chipta
  a receptionist    = administrator
  to meet           = uchrashmoq (meet → MET)
examples: 1 SA: Have you booked a table yet? SB: Yes, I've just booked it.
2 SA: Have you packed our swimming costumes yet? SB: Yes, I've just packed them.
3 SA: Have you found the tickets yet? SB: Yes, I've just found them.
4 SA: Have you talked to the receptionist yet? SB: Yes, I've just talked to him.
5 SA: Have you met Steve yet? SB: Yes, I've just met him.

topics.topic: Present Perfect + For/Since
topics.rule_uz:
GRAMMATIKA QUTISI

KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 • 'We use FOR to express DURATION.'
      I've been here FOR five days.

 • 'We use SINCE to state a STARTING POINT.'
      I've been here SINCE Monday.


ENG ODDIY FARQ:

  FOR    +  QANChA VAQT (davomiylik)
            for five days
            for two years
            for a long time
            for ten minutes

  SINCE  +  QAChONDAN BERI (boshlanish nuqtasi)
            since Monday
            since 1987
            since last week
            since I was a child


QANDAY ESLAB QOLISh:

  Savol bering: 'QANChA VAQT?' yoki
  'QAChONDAN BERI?'

     'five days'  → qancha vaqt?  → FOR
     'Monday'     → qachondan?    → SINCE
     'two years'  → qancha vaqt?  → FOR
     '1987'       → qachondan?    → SINCE

  Ya'ni:
     RAQAM + vaqt birligi  →  FOR
     ANIQ NUQTA (kun, sana, yil)  →  SINCE


MISOLLAR YONMA-YON:

  FOR                    SINCE
  ─────────────────      ──────────────────
  for three days         since Monday
  for two years          since 2010
  for a week             since last week
  for ten minutes        since 5 o'clock
  for a long time        since I came here
  for ages               since my birthday

  DIQQAT — 'a week' va 'last week':
     FOR a week    = bir hafta davomida
     SINCE last week = o'tgan haftadan beri


DIQQAT — 'SINCE' + TO'LIQ GAP:
  'since' dan keyin GAP ham kelishi mumkin:
     'I've been here SINCE I ARRIVED.'
     'I haven't seen him SINCE HE LEFT.'

  Bunda gap PAST SIMPLE da bo'ladi.


IKKALASI HAM PRESENT PERFECT BILAN:
  'I've been here for five days.'  ✓
  'I am here for five days.'  — boshqa ma'no
                                (reja)
  'I was here for five days.' — o'tmish
                                (tugagan)

  Present Perfect — harakat HALI DAVOM
  etayotganini ko'rsatadi.


DIQQAT — 'FOR' TUShIRIB QOLDIRILIShI MUMKIN:
  'I've been here (for) five days.'
  Og'zaki nutqda 'for' ba'zan tushiriladi.
  'since' esa HECH QAChON tushirilmaydi.


DIQQAT — 'AGO' BILAN ADAShTIRMANG:
  'five days AGO'  →  PAST SIMPLE
     'I arrived five days ago.'
  'FOR five days'  →  PRESENT PERFECT
     'I've been here for five days.'

  Ikkalasi ham 'besh kun' haqida, lekin
  zamonlari BOSHQA.


BOG'LIQLIK — 105-BETDAGI XAT:
  'I've been here SINCE MONDAY.'
  Jekning xati aynan shu qurilmani
  ishlatgan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  duration       = davomiylik
  a starting point = boshlanish nuqtasi
  for            = ... davomida
  since          = ... dan beri
examples: We use for to express duration. — I've been here for five days.
We use since to state a starting point. — I've been here since Monday.
for three days / for two years / for a week — since Monday / since 2010 / since last week
I've been here since I arrived. I haven't seen him since he left.

topics.topic: irregular verbs, been/gone — noto'g'ri fe'llar, been/gone
topics.rule_uz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   INFINITIVE  PAST SIMPLE  PAST PARTICIPLE
   (V1)        (V2)         (V3)
   ──────────  ───────────  ───────────────
 1  buy         BOUGHT       BOUGHT
 2  eat         ATE          EATEN
 3  do          DID          DONE
 4  see         SAW          SEEN
 5  make        MADE         MADE
 6  take        TOOK         TAKEN
 7  give        GAVE         GIVEN
 8  ride        RODE         RIDDEN
 9  leave       LEFT         LEFT
10  meet        MET          MET


IKKI GURUHGA BO'LINADI:

  A) V2 = V3 (bir xil) — 4 ta:
       buy   → bought → BOUGHT
       make  → made   → MADE
       leave → left   → LEFT
       meet  → met    → MET

  B) V2 ≠ V3 (boshqa) — 6 ta:
       eat   → ate   → EATEN
       do    → did   → DONE
       see   → saw   → SEEN
       take  → took  → TAKEN
       give  → gave  → GIVEN
       ride  → rode  → RIDDEN

  DIQQAT: B guruhning HAMMASI '-EN' yoki
  '-NE' bilan tugaydi:
     eaten, done, seen, taken, given, ridden


QAYERDA IShLATILADI:

  V2 (Past Simple):
     'I BOUGHT some souvenirs.'
     'I SAW them yesterday.'
     'I RODE a camel.'

  V3 (Present Perfect):
     'I have BOUGHT some souvenirs.'
     'I have SEEN them.'
     'I have RIDDEN a camel.'


HAR BIRI COURSEBOOK'DA UChRAGAN:

  buy   →  105-bet: 'I BOUGHT some souvenirs'
  eat   →  106-bet: 'Have you ever EATEN
           Chinese food?'
  do    →  105-bet: 'things I haven't DONE
           yet'
  see   →  105-bet: 'I have also SEEN the
           Pyramids'
  make  →  108-bet: 'they can MAKE your visit
           a nightmare'
  take  →  105-bet: 'Abdullah TOOK me there'
  give  →  100-bet: 'GIVE it with both hands'
  ride  →  105-bet: 'I even RODE a camel'
  leave →  100-bet: 'LEAVE your shoes at the
           door'
  meet  →  106-bet: 'Have you ever MET a
           famous person?'


⚠ ENG KO'P ADAShTIRILADIGANLAR:

  eat:   ATE (V2) ≠ EATEN (V3)
     'I ATE it yesterday.'      ✓
     'I have EATEN it.'         ✓
     'I have ATE it.'           ✗

  see:   SAW (V2) ≠ SEEN (V3)
     'I SAW him.'               ✓
     'I have SEEN him.'         ✓
     'I have SAW him.'          ✗

  ride:  RODE (V2) ≠ RIDDEN (V3)
     'I RODE a camel.'          ✓
     'I have RIDDEN a camel.'   ✓


DIQQAT — 'LEAVE' IKKI MA'NOLI:
  'to leave' = ketmoq; qoldirmoq
     'The boat has LEFT.' (ketdi)
     'LEAVE your shoes at the door.'
       (qoldiring)

  V2 = V3 = LEFT.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  the infinitive = fe'lning boshlang'ich shakli
  past simple    = o'tgan zamon (V2)
  past participle = III shakl (V3)
examples: 1 buy — bought — bought
2 eat — ate — eaten
3 do — did — done
4 see — saw — seen
5 make — made — made
6 take — took — taken
7 give — gave — given
8 ride — rode — ridden

topics.topic: irregular verbs, been/gone — QOIDA (betdagi qutidan) · 6-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
QOIDA (betdagi qutidan):

  'Mark HAS GONE to Spain.'
     (He went to Spain some time ago and he
      is STILL THERE.)

  'I HAVE BEEN to Spain.'
     (I have visited Spain and COME BACK.
      I am NOT there now.)


ENG ODDIY FARQ:
  GONE  →  ketgan va HALI U YERDA (odam YO'Q)
  BEEN  →  borib QAYTGAN (odam BOR)


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  BEEN
  2  GONE
  3  BEEN
  4  GONE
  5  BEEN


HAR BIRI NEGA — KALIT GAPGA QARANG:

 1  'I have ... to the USA. I WENT THERE LAST
     SUMMER.'
    KALIT: 'I went there LAST SUMMER' — demak
    borib QAYTGAN (hozir AQShda emas).
    → BEEN

 2  'GEORGE ISN'T IN GREECE. He has ... to
     Italy.'
    KALIT: 'George ISN'T in Greece' — u
    boshqa joyda, ya'ni ITALIYADA.
    → GONE (hali u yerda)

 3  'HAVE YOU EVER ... to Bali?'
    KALIT: 'EVER' — TAJRIBA haqida savol.
    Tajriba = borib qaytish.
    → BEEN

 4  'My parents have ... to Portugal.
     THEY'LL BE BACK NEXT WEEK.'
    KALIT: 'They'll be BACK next week' —
    demak HOZIR Portugaliyada.
    → GONE

 5  'I have NEVER ... to Egypt, BUT I WANT TO
     GO one day.'
    KALIT: 'I want to GO one day' — hali
    bormagan, tajriba yo'q.
    → BEEN
    ('I have never GONE' — ishlatilmaydi)


⚠ ENG ODDIY BELGI — KEYINGI GAP:

  'I WENT there last summer.'  → BEEN (1)
  'He ISN'T in Greece.'        → GONE (2)
  'They'll be BACK next week.' → GONE (4)
  'I want to GO one day.'      → BEEN (5)

  Ya'ni har bandda YONIDAGI gap javobni
  aytib turibdi!


⚠ MUHIM QOIDA — 'I HAVE GONE' DEYARLI
IShLATILMAYDI:

  Agar o'zingiz haqingizda gapirsangiz,
  DOIM 'BEEN':
     'I have BEEN to the USA.'   ✓
     'I have GONE to the USA.'   ✗ (g'alati)

  Chunki agar AQShda bo'lsangiz, bu gapni
  ayta olmaysiz!

  'GONE' faqat BOShQA odam haqida:
     'He has GONE to Italy.'
     'My parents have GONE to Portugal.'

  Mashqda ham shunday:
     BEEN — 1, 3, 5 (I / you)
     GONE — 2, 4 (George / my parents)


BOG'LIQLIK — COURSEBOOK:
  104-bet: 'Have you ever BEEN there?'
  106-bet: 'I've BEEN to Spain.'
           'I've never BEEN to China.'
  107-bet: 'Have you BEEN to Palacio Real
            yet?'

  Coursebook'da deyarli doim 'been' —
  chunki hammasi TAJRIBA haqida.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Greece   = Gretsiya
  Italy    = Italiya
  Bali     = Bali (Indoneziya oroli)
  Portugal = Portugaliya
  to be back = qaytmoq

topics.rule_uz:
JADVAL — UCh EGA, TO'RT ISh:

                go to  eat      travel  ride a
                Italy  Chinese  by      horse
                       food     plane
  ─────────────  ─────  ───────  ──────  ──────
  Greg             ✗      ✓        ✓       ✗
  Tina             ✓      ✗        ✗       ✓
  Mr & Mrs Brown   ✓      ✗        ✓       ✗


═══ 8a) SAVOL-JAVOB ═══

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: HAS Greg BEEN to Italy?
  SB: No, he HASN'T.
  SA: HAS he EATEN Chinese food?
  SB: Yes, he HAS.


BARCHA SAVOL-JAVOBLAR:

 GREG:
  Has Greg been to Italy?      — No, he hasn't.
  Has he eaten Chinese food?   — Yes, he has.
  Has he travelled by plane?   — Yes, he has.
  Has he ridden a horse?       — No, he hasn't.

 TINA:
  Has Tina been to Italy?      — Yes, she has.
  Has she eaten Chinese food?  — No, she hasn't.
  Has she travelled by plane?  — No, she hasn't.
  Has she ridden a horse?      — Yes, she has.

 MR & MRS BROWN:
  Have Mr and Mrs Brown been to Italy?
                               — Yes, they have.
  Have they eaten Chinese food?
                               — No, they haven't.
  Have they travelled by plane?
                               — Yes, they have.
  Have they ridden a horse?
                               — No, they haven't.


═══ 8b) GAPLAR ═══

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA (Greg):
  'Greg HASN'T BEEN to Italy, BUT he HAS EATEN
   Chinese food. He HAS ALSO TRAVELLED by
   plane, BUT he HASN'T RIDDEN a horse.'


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 TINA:
  'Tina HAS BEEN to Italy, BUT she HASN'T
   EATEN Chinese food. She HASN'T TRAVELLED by
   plane, BUT she HAS RIDDEN a horse.'

 MR & MRS BROWN:
  'Mr and Mrs Brown HAVE BEEN to Italy, BUT
   they HAVEN'T EATEN Chinese food. They HAVE
   ALSO TRAVELLED by plane, BUT they HAVEN'T
   RIDDEN a horse.'


⚠ UCh MUHIM NUQTA:

 1) 'GO TO ITALY' → 'HAVE BEEN TO':
    Namuna 'Has Greg BEEN to Italy?' deydi,
    'GONE' emas!

    Chunki jadvalda TAJRIBA haqida
    so'ralyapti (borib qaytish).
    Workbook 60-bet, 6-mashq qoidasi:
       'have BEEN to' = tajriba
       'have GONE to' = hali u yerda

 2) 'MR & MRS BROWN' — KO'PLIK:
    'HAVE they been ...?'  ✓
    'HAS they been ...?'   ✗
    Olmoshi: THEY.

 3) 'ALSO' NING O'RNI:
    Namunada: 'He HAS ALSO TRAVELLED by
    plane.'
    'also' — 'has' va V3 ORASIDA.

    DIQQAT: Tina uchun 'also' KERAK EMAS,
    chunki uning uchinchi ishi INKOR
    ('She HASN'T travelled by plane').


V3 ShAKLLARI:
  go     →  BEEN (bu holatda)
  eat    →  EATEN
  travel →  TRAVELLED (britancha, IKKI 'L')
  ride   →  RIDDEN

  DIQQAT: 'eaten' va 'ridden' — '-EN' bilan.


GRAMMAR 65-BET BILAN SOLIShTIRING:
  U yerda AYNAN shunday jadval bor edi:
     Tom / Andrea / The Smiths
     go to the opera, eat Mexican food,
     travel to Europe, take a boat trip

  Bu yerda esa:
     Greg / Tina / Mr & Mrs Brown
     go to Italy, eat Chinese food,
     travel by plane, ride a horse

  Tuzilishi AYNAN bir xil — kitob ataylab
  takrorlagan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Italy       = Italiya
  Chinese food = xitoy taomi
  by plane    = samolyotda
  to ride a horse = ot minmoq
examples: SA: Has Greg been to Italy? SB: No, he hasn't. SA: Has he eaten Chinese food? SB: Yes, he has.
Has Tina been to Italy? — Yes, she has. Has she eaten Chinese food? — No, she hasn't. Has she travelled by plane? — No, she hasn't. Has she ridden a horse? — Yes, she has.
Have Mr and Mrs Brown been to Italy? — Yes, they have. Have they eaten Chinese food? — No, they haven't.
Greg hasn't been to Italy, but he has eaten Chinese food. He has also travelled by plane, but he hasn't ridden a horse.
Tina has been to Italy, but she hasn't eaten Chinese food. She hasn't travelled by plane, but she has ridden a horse.
Mr and Mrs Brown have been to Italy, but they haven't eaten Chinese food. They have also travelled by plane, but they haven't ridden a horse.

topics.topic: uch zamon, Present Perfect ravishlari — OLTI DIALOG — BARCHA JAVOBLAR · 10-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
OLTI DIALOG — BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  A: HAVE YOU BEEN to the bazaar yet?
    B: Yes, I WENT there yesterday.
       I BOUGHT some souvenirs.

 2  A: What ARE YOU DOING tonight? Would you
       like to go to the cinema?
    B: I'm sorry, I can't. I AM HAVING dinner
       with some friends.

 3  A: How long HAVE YOU BEEN here?
    B: We HAVE BEEN here for three days.
       We ARRIVED on Monday morning.

 4  A: Where DOES MIKE LIVE?
    B: He LIVES in the city centre.

 5  A: HAVE YOU VISITED them yet?
    B: No, not yet. I AM GOING there this
       afternoon.

 6  A: HAVE YOU BOUGHT the tickets yet?
    B: No, I haven't. I AM GOING TO BUY them
       this afternoon.


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1a 'YET' → PRESENT PERFECT savoli.
    'go' → 'BEEN' (borib qaytish, tajriba).
    → HAVE YOU BEEN

 1b 'YESTERDAY' → ANIQ VAQT → PAST SIMPLE.
    → WENT

 1c O'sha safar haqida → PAST SIMPLE.
    buy → BOUGHT.

 2a 'TONIGHT' + reja haqida savol →
    PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
    → ARE YOU DOING

 2b 'I'm sorry, I can't' — sababi REJA bor →
    PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
    'have dinner' = kechki ovqat yemoq.
    → AM HAVING

 3a 'HOW LONG' → PRESENT PERFECT.
    → HAVE YOU BEEN

 3b 'FOR three days' → PRESENT PERFECT.
    → HAVE BEEN

 3c 'ON MONDAY MORNING' → ANIQ VAQT →
    PAST SIMPLE.
    → ARRIVED

 4a 'Where ... Mike live?' — DOIMIY holat
    (qayerda yashaydi) → PRESENT SIMPLE.
    'Mike' — III shaxs birlik → DOES.
    → DOES MIKE LIVE

 4b 'He ... in the city centre.'
    PRESENT SIMPLE, III shaxs → LIVES.

 5a 'YET' → PRESENT PERFECT savoli.
    → HAVE YOU VISITED

 5b 'THIS AFTERNOON' — yaqin kelajak REJA →
    PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
    → AM GOING

 6a 'YET' → PRESENT PERFECT savoli.
    buy → BOUGHT.
    → HAVE YOU BOUGHT

 6b 'THIS AFTERNOON' — REJA →
    BE GOING TO.
    → AM GOING TO BUY


⚠ 1a-BAND HAQIDA MUHIM IZOH:
  Qavsda '(you/go)' yozilgan, lekin javob
  'HAVE YOU BEEN'.

  Nega? Chunki B javob beradi: 'Yes, I WENT
  there YESTERDAY' — ya'ni borib QAYTGAN.

  Workbook 60-bet, 6-mashq qoidasi:
     'have BEEN to' = borib qaytgan
     'have GONE to' = hali u yerda


⚠ 5b va 6b — FARQI:

  5b  'I AM GOING there this afternoon.'
      → PRESENT CONTINUOUS (harakat 'go')

  6b  'I AM GOING TO BUY them this afternoon.'
      → BE GOING TO (harakat 'buy')

  Ikkalasida ham 'going' bor, lekin:
     5b — 'go' fe'lining o'zi
     6b — 'be going to' qurilmasi

  Bu — mashqning eng chalkash joyi!


⚠ 4-BAND — YAGONA PRESENT SIMPLE:
  Boshqa hamma dialoglar Present Perfect,
  Past Simple yoki kelajak haqida, lekin
  4-dialog DOIMIY holat haqida:
     'Where DOES Mike LIVE?'
     'He LIVES in the city centre.'

  'live' — doimiy holat, shuning uchun
  Present Simple.

  DIQQAT: savolda 'DOES ... LIVE' (asosiy
  shakl), javobda 'LIVES' (-S bilan).


DIQQAT — 'HAVE DINNER':
  'I am HAVING dinner with some friends.'
  'have' = yemoq → Continuous BO'LADI.

  Workbook 61-bet, 7-mashqda ham shu edi:
  'She's HAVING breakfast.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a bazaar    = sharq bozori
  the cinema  = kinoteatr
  to have dinner = kechki ovqat yemoq
  the city centre = shahar markazi
  this afternoon = bugun tushdan keyin
  a ticket    = chipta

topics.topic: savol-javob, to'g'ri gap — BARCHA JAVOBLAR · 11-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  f      5  e
  2  a      6  c
  3  d      7  g
  4  h      8  b


⚠ OLTIN QOIDA — QISQA JAVOB SAVOLDAGI
FE'LNI TAKRORLAYDI (5, 6, 7-bandlar):

  'ARE you going ...?'  →  'Yes, I AM.'   (5-e)
  'HAVE you ever ...?'  →  'No, I HAVEN'T.'
                                            (6-c)
  'WILL it be ...?'     →  'No, it WON'T.' (7-g)


QOLGAN BESh BAND — SAVOL SO'ZI BO'YIChA:

 1  'WHEN DID you go to Rome?'
    → PAST SIMPLE savoli → o'tgan vaqt
    → 'Two years AGO.' (f)
    (KITOBDA STRELKA ChIZILGAN — NAMUNA)

 2  'HOW LONG have you been here?'
    → MUDDAT so'ralyapti
    → 'SINCE Saturday.' (a)

 3  'HOW OFTEN do you go to the cinema?'
    → ChASTOTA so'ralyapti
    → 'ONCE A WEEK.' (d)

 4  'WHAT IS Jack DOING at the moment?'
    → HARAKAT so'ralyapti (Present Continuous)
    → 'He's SLEEPING.' (h)

 8  'WHEN ARE you LEAVING for your holiday?'
    → KELAJAK vaqti so'ralyapti
    → 'NEXT WEEK.' (b)


⚠ 1 va 8-BANDLAR — ENG NOZIK JUFTLIK:

  Ikkalasi ham 'WHEN' bilan boshlanadi,
  lekin ZAMONI boshqa:

   1  'When DID you GO to Rome?'
         PAST SIMPLE (o'tgan)
      → 'Two years AGO.' (o'tgan)

   8  'When ARE you LEAVING for your holiday?'
         PRESENT CONTINUOUS (kelajak reja)
      → 'NEXT WEEK.' (kelajak)

  Ya'ni savolning ZAMONI javobning
  yo'nalishini belgilaydi.


⚠ 2 va 3-BANDLAR — YANA BIR JUFTLIK:

   2  'HOW LONG have you been here?'
      → MUDDAT → 'Since Saturday.'

   3  'HOW OFTEN do you go to the cinema?'
      → ChASTOTA → 'Once a week.'

  'How LONG' ≠ 'How OFTEN'!
     How long  = qancha vaqtdan beri
     How often = qanchalik tez-tez


DIQQAT — 2-BANDDAGI 'SINCE SATURDAY':
  'How long have you been here?'
  'SINCE Saturday.' (shanbadan beri)

  Javob 'FOR two days' ham bo'lishi mumkin
  edi, lekin ro'yxatda 'since' berilgan.


DIQQAT — 7-BANDDAGI 'WON'T':
  'won't' = will not
  'Will it be cold?' → 'No, it WON'T.'

  DIQQAT: 'willn't' degan shakl YO'Q!


GRAMMAR 67-BET BILAN SOLIShTIRING:
  U yerda AYNAN shunday mashq bor edi
  (10-mashq), faqat boshqa savollar bilan.
  Kitob qoidani takrorlagan.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

 1  When did you go to Rome?
    → f  Two years ago.        (NAMUNA)
 2  How long have you been here?
    → a  Since Saturday.
 3  How often do you go to the cinema?
    → d  Once a week.
 4  What is Jack doing at the moment?
    → h  He's sleeping.
 5  Are you going to stay at a hotel?
    → e  Yes, I am.
 6  Have you ever been to India?
    → c  No, I haven't.
 7  Will it be cold in London tomorrow?
    → g  No, it won't.
 8  When are you leaving for your holiday?
    → b  Next week.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Rome      = Rim
  How often ...? = qanchalik tez-tez?
  once a week = haftada bir marta
  India     = Hindiston
  won't     = will not
  to leave for = ... ga jo'namoq

topics.topic: savol-javob, to'g'ri gap — BARCHA JAVOBLAR · 12-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  a  (NAMUNA)
  2  b
  3  b
  4  a
  5  b
  6  a
  7  a


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  a) 'ARE YOU GOING OUT tonight?'  ✓
    b) 'DO you go out tonight?'      ✗
    'tonight' — kelajakdagi REJA →
    PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
    'Do you go out' — odat haqida bo'lardi.
    (KITOBDA ✓ QO'YILGAN)

 2  a) 'Tony READS a book at the moment.' ✗
    b) 'Tony IS READING a book at the
        moment.'                          ✓
    'AT THE MOMENT' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

 3  a) 'What HAVE YOU DONE yesterday?'   ✗
    b) 'What DID YOU DO yesterday?'      ✓
    ⚠ 'YESTERDAY' — ANIQ VAQT, shuning
    uchun PRESENT PERFECT ISHLATILMAYDI.

 4  a) 'Have you ever EATEN snake?'      ✓
    b) 'DID you ever EAT snake?'         ✗
    'EVER' — TAJRIBA haqida →

    ('Did you ever ...?' amerikachada

 5  a) 'We've BEEN to Malta LAST SUMMER.' ✗
    b) 'We WENT to Malta last summer.'    ✓
    ⚠ 'LAST SUMMER' — ANIQ VAQT →
    PAST SIMPLE.

 6  a) 'He's FLYING to Athens tonight.'   ✓
    b) 'He HAS FLOWN to Athens tonight.'  ✗

    'has flown' — o'tmish, 'tonight' bilan
    mos kelmaydi.

 7  a) 'He WAS BORN on 6th May, 1959.'    ✓
    b) 'He BORN on 6th May, 1959.'        ✗
    ⚠ 'to be born' — DOIM 'be' fe'li bilan:
       'He WAS born.'  ✓
       'He born.'      ✗


⚠ MAShQNING ASOSIY DARSI — UCh XATO TURI:

  A) PRESENT PERFECT + ANIQ VAQT (3, 5)
     'What have you done YESTERDAY?'  ✗
     'We've been to Malta LAST SUMMER.' ✗

     Bu — Unit 15 ning eng muhim qoidasi!

  B) NOTO'G'RI ZAMON (1, 2, 6)
     'at the moment' → Continuous
     'tonight' (reja) → Continuous

  C) FE'L TUShIB QOLGAN (7)
     'He born' — 'was' yo'q.


DIQQAT — 7-BAND, 'TO BE BORN':
  'to be born' = tug'ilmoq

  DOIM 'be' fe'li bilan:
     'I WAS BORN in 1990.'
     'She WAS BORN in Tashkent.'
     'When WERE you BORN?'

  O'zbekchada 'tug'ildim' — bir so'z, lekin
  inglizchada IKKI so'z ('was born').

  Bu — o'zbek tilidan farq qiladigan joy.


DIQQAT — 6-BANDDAGI 'FLOWN':
  fly → flew → FLOWN

  'He HAS FLOWN to Athens' — grammatik
  jihatdan to'g'ri, lekin 'tonight' bilan
  mos kelmaydi (kelajak).


DIQQAT — 4-BANDDAGI 'SNAKE':
  'Have you ever eaten SNAKE?'
  'snake' bu yerda ARTIKLSIZ — chunki
  OVQAT sifatida (sanalmaydigan).

     'a snake' = ilon (hayvon)
     'snake' = ilon go'shti (ovqat)

  Shu kabi: 'chicken' (tovuq go'shti),
  'fish' (baliq go'shti).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to go out   = tashqariga chiqmoq
  a snake     = ilon
  Malta       = Malta
  Athens      = Afina
  to be born  = tug'ilmoq
  to fly      = uchmoq (fly → flew → FLOWN)

topics.topic: savol-javob, to'g'ri gap
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

  'I've NEVER BEEN to London, BUT I've BEEN
   to Paris. I WENT to Paris A YEAR AGO.
   It WAS FANTASTIC.'


QOLIP — UCh GAP:

  1) 'I've NEVER [V3] ..., BUT I've [V3] ...'
     (tajriba: biri yo'q, biri bor)
  2) 'I [V2] ... [ANIQ VAQT].'
     (qachon — Past Simple)
  3) 'It WAS [sifat].'

SO'ZLAR:

  FE'LLAR (doira ichida):
     go, visit, eat, make, play

  OTLAR:
     museum, zoo, London, Chinese food,
     Paris, a cake, football, a pizza,
     Italian food, basketball

  SIFATLAR (baho uchun):
     fantastic, fun, delicious, disgusting,
     horrible, interesting, exciting, boring


QAYSI FE'L QAYSI OT BILAN:

  GO TO      →  London, Paris, the zoo,
                the museum
  VISIT      →  London, Paris, the museum,
                the zoo
  EAT        →  Chinese food, Italian food,
                a cake, a pizza
  MAKE       →  a cake, a pizza
  PLAY       →  football, basketball


BARCHA NAMUNA JAVOBLAR:

 1  I've never been to London, but I've been
    to Paris. I went to Paris a year ago.
    It was fantastic.
    (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 2  I've never visited the museum, but I've
    visited the zoo. I visited the zoo last
    month. It was interesting.

 3  I've never eaten Chinese food, but I've
    eaten Italian food. I ate Italian food
    last week. It was delicious.

 4  I've never made a cake, but I've made a
    pizza. I made a pizza yesterday. It was
    disgusting!

 5  I've never played basketball, but I've
    played football. I played football on
    Sunday. It was fun.


V3 va V2 ShAKLLARI:
  go    →  went    →  BEEN / GONE
  visit →  visited →  VISITED
  eat   →  ate     →  EATEN
  make  →  made    →  MADE
  play  →  played  →  PLAYED

  DIQQAT: birinchi gapda V3, ikkinchi gapda
  V2!
     'I've EATEN Italian food.'  (V3)
     'I ATE it last week.'       (V2)


⚠ ENG MUHIM — 'GO' NING IKKI ShAKLI:
  'I've never BEEN to London.'  ✓
  'I've never GONE to London.'  ✗

  O'zingiz haqingizda DOIM 'been'
  (Workbook 60-bet, 6-mashq qoidasi).


SIFATLAR IKKI GURUHDA:
  IJOBIY:  fantastic, fun, delicious,
           interesting, exciting
  SALBIY:  disgusting, horrible, boring

  DIQQAT: 'delicious' va 'disgusting' —
  asosan OVQAT haqida.


O'YIN QOIDALARI:
  • Ikki jamoa
  • NAVBATMA-NAVBAT
  • Har to'g'ri gap = 1 ochko
  • Eng ko'p ochko — g'olib


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a museum   = muzey
  a zoo      = hayvonot bog'i
  a cake     = tort, pirog
  Italian food = italyan taomi
  basketball = basketbol
  fun        = qiziq, zavqli
  interesting = qiziqarli
  exciting   = hayajonli
  boring     = zerikarli
examples: I've never been to London, but I've been to Paris. I went to Paris a year ago. It was fantastic.
I've never visited the museum, but I've visited the zoo. I visited the zoo last month. It was interesting.
I've never eaten Chinese food, but I've eaten Italian food. I ate Italian food last week. It was delicious.
I've never made a cake, but I've made a pizza. I made a pizza yesterday. It was disgusting!
I've never played basketball, but I've played football. I played football on Sunday. It was fun.

topics.topic: Personal Pronouns — Namuna: Look at her! · 6-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
Namuna: Look at her!

RASMLAR:
  1) ayol            → her
  2) sirk artisti (erkak) → him
  3) kenguru (hayvon)     → it
  4) bir guruh erkaklar   → them

QOIDA: 'at' — predlog, undan keyin DOIM obyekt shakli keladi.

topics.topic: a/an - the — a/an - the (artikllar)
topics.rule_uz:
ASOSIY QOIDA:

  A/AN — biror narsa haqida BIRINCHI MARTA gapirganda
  THE  — ILGARI AYTILGAN narsa haqida gapirganda

  MISOL:
     There's A jeep outside.       (birinchi marta)
     THE jeep belongs to Mr Jones. (o'sha jip haqida)

  Hikoyadan misol:
     Look ... A canoe!             (birinchi marta)
     David starts paddling ... in THE canoe.  (o'sha qayiq)

THE QO'YILADI:

  • daryo nomlari      → the Amazon River
  • dengiz nomlari     → the Black Sea
  • okean nomlari      → the Atlantic
  • tog' tizmalari     → the Alps
  • millat nomlari     → the English
  • oila nomlari       → the Browns
  • qabila nomlari     → the Jivaro Indians

THE QO'YILMAYDI:

  • atoqli otlar       → Jane, Athens
  • mamlakat nomlari   → Britain, Brazil
  • ovqat nomlari      → breakfast, lunch, dinner
  • sport/o'yin nomlari → tennis, football

A yoki AN — QAY BIRI?
  UNDOSH tovush oldidan → A   (a jeep, a canoe)
  UNLI tovush oldidan   → AN  (an article, an aeroplane)
  DIQQAT: yozilishiga emas, TOVUSHGA qaraladi.

ESLATMA — MAMLAKAT NOMLARIDA ISTISNO:
  Ko'plik yoki 'union/kingdom/republic' so'zi bo'lsa THE:
     the USA, the UK, the Netherlands, the Philippines
  Oddiy mamlakat nomlarida THE yo'q:
     Brazil, Britain, Uzbekistan
examples: We use a/an to talk about something for the first time.
We use the to talk about something we have mentioned before.
the names of rivers — the Amazon River
the names of seas — the Black Sea
the names of oceans — the Atlantic
mountain ranges — the Alps
nationalities — the English
the names of families — the Browns

topics.topic: will (predictions) — will (bashorat)
topics.rule_uz:
WILL — KELASI ZAMON

  TASDIQ       I/you/he, etc  WILL go.
  INKOR        I/you/he, etc  WON'T (will not) go.
  SO'ROQ       WILL I/you/he, etc  go?
  QISQA JAVOB  Yes, I/you/he, etc WILL.
               No,  I/you/he, etc WON'T.

KITOBDAGI QOIDA:
  'will' ni BASHORAT qilish uchun ishlatamiz.
     I think the Jivaro Indians WILL catch them.
     Perhaps Sandra WILL hit her head.

UCH MUHIM QOIDA:

  1) HAMMA EGA UCHUN BIR XIL — WILL.
     I will, he will, they will — -S YO'Q.
     'he wills' XATO.

  2) KEYINGI FE'L ASOSIY SHAKLDA, 'to' SIZ:
        He will go.        ✓
        He will to go.     ✗ XATO
        He will goes.      ✗ XATO
        He will went.      ✗ XATO

  3) 'DO/DOES/DID' KERAK EMAS:
        Will he go?        ✓
        Does he will go?   ✗ XATO

QISQARTMA:
  will not → WON'T  (/wəʊnt/)
  DIQQAT: 'willn't' shakli YO'Q.
  Og'zaki nutqda: I'll, you'll, he'll, we'll, they'll

BASHORAT SO'ZLARI ('will' bilan birga keladi):
  I think ...    = menimcha ...
  I hope ...     = umid qilaman ...
  Perhaps ...    = ehtimol ...
  Maybe ...      = balki ...
  I'm sure ...   = ishonchim komil ...
examples: I/you/he, etc will go.
I/you/he, etc won't (will not) go.
Will I/you/he, etc go?
Yes, I/you/he, etc will. — No, I/you/he, etc won't.
We use will to make predictions.
I think the Jivaro Indians will catch them.
Perhaps Sandra will hit her head.

topics.topic: will (predictions) — KITOBDAGI NAMUNA · 7-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  It will be boiling hot tomorrow, so don't forget to take
  your hat.

QOLIP:
  It WILL BE [ob-havo] tomorrow, SO don't forget to take
  your [buyum].

UCH DIQQAT:

  1) 'It will BE' — 'will' dan keyin 'be' asosiy shaklda
     ('It will is' XATO).

  2) 'SO' — natijani bog'laydi (shuning uchun).
     Oldidan VERGUL qo'yiladi.

  3) 'take YOUR hat' — egalik olmoshi ishlatiladi
     ('take the hat' emas).

topics.topic: will (predictions) — KO'RSATMALAR · 8-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
KO'RSATMALAR:
  they/die
  they/break their legs
  a crocodile/eat them
  they/drown
  they/hurt themselves
  David/save Sandra
  the Jivaro Indians catch/kill them
  the Jivaro Indians/help them

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  The Jivaro Indians will catch and kill them.
  They won't help them.

QOLIP:
  IJOBIY:  [ega] WILL [fe'l].
  SALBIY:  [ega] WON'T [fe'l].

Kitob BITTA ijobiy va BITTA salbiy bashorat so'raydi,
lekin quyida barcha ko'rsatmalar bo'yicha namunalar
berilgan — mashq qilish uchun.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to die           = o'lmoq
  to break         = sindirmoq
  a crocodile      = timsoh
  to drown         = cho'kib ketmoq
  to hurt oneself  = jarohat olmoq
  to save          = qutqarmoq
  to kill          = o'ldirmoq

DIQQAT — 'THEMSELVES':
  'hurt THEMSELVES' = o'zlarini jarohatlashmoq.
  Harakat egaga qaytsa, o'zlik olmoshi ishlatiladi:
     myself, yourself, himself, herself,
     ourselves, yourselves, themselves

topics.topic: Self-Assessment — Grammar — UCH XIL FE'L aralash · 5-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
UCH XIL FE'L aralash:

  'to be'    — am / is / are
  'have got' — have got / has got
  oddiy fe'l — Present Simple (-s, do/does, don't/doesn't)

HAR BIRIDA BOSHQA QOIDA:
  to be:      savol — fe'l oldinga chiqadi (Where IS Juan from?)
  have got:   savol — 'Has he got ...?', inkor — 'hasn't got'
  oddiy fe'l: savol — 'Does he live?', inkor — 'doesn't live'

'to be' va 'have got' bilan do/does ISHLATILMAYDI!

topics.topic: Module Self-Assessment 3 — Grammar — HAMMASI PAST SIMPLE — Unit 9-11 ning asosiy · 5-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
HAMMASI PAST SIMPLE — Unit 9-11 ning asosiy
grammatikasi.

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  When WAS the last time you TIDIED your room?
  2  They WENT to Malta last month.
  3  Yesterday we CUT the grass, then we WASHED
     the car.
  4  When we WENT to Europe last year we DROVE
     through France and Italy.
  5  They DIDN'T PLAY my favourite song at the
     concert yesterday.
  6  The last time I HAD a haircut was two weeks
     ago.
  7  My sister MADE a beautiful cake yesterday and
     I COOKED dinner.
  8  Sally DIDN'T VISIT her grandparents last
     Christmas, so she WROTE them a letter.
  9  Yesterday we TOOK the camera with us, but we
     DIDN'T TAKE any pictures.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Oxirgi marta qachon xonangni yig'ishtirgan
     eding?
  2  Ular o'tgan oy Maltaga borishdi.
  3  Kecha biz o'tni o'rdik, keyin mashinani
     yuvdik.
  4  O'tgan yili Yevropaga borganimizda,
     Fransiya va Italiya orqali haydab o'tdik.
  5  Ular kechagi konsertda mening sevimli
     qo'shig'imni ijro etishmadi.
  6  Oxirgi marta sochimni ikki hafta oldin
     oldirganman.
  7  Opam kecha ajoyib tort pishirdi, men esa
     kechki ovqat tayyorladim.
  8  Salli o'tgan Rojdestvoda buvasi va buvisiga
     bormadi, shuning uchun ularga xat yozdi.
  9  Kecha biz fotoapparatni o'zimiz bilan olib
     ketdik, lekin hech qanday surat olmadik.


ENG MUHIM BANDLAR:

  1-BAND ALDAMChI:
     'When ...... (be) the last time you ......
      (tidy) your room?'
     Birinchi bo'shliq — SAVOL: 'When WAS ...?'
     Ikkinchi bo'shliq — ERGASh gap: 'you TIDIED'
     ('did' KERAK EMAS!).
     Grammar 54-bet, 9-mashqda ham aynan shu
     qolip bor edi.

  3-BAND — 'CUT' O'ZGARMAYDI:
     cut → CUT → CUT (noto'g'ri fe'l).
     'Yesterday we CUT the grass' — shakl bir xil,
     lekin 'Yesterday' o'tgan zamonni ko'rsatadi.
     'cutted' XATO.

  6-BAND — IKKI ZAMON BELGISI:
     'The last time I ...... (have) a haircut WAS
      two weeks ago.'
     Bu ERGASh gap, savol emas → 'HAD'.
     'was' allaqachon gapda bor.

  8-BAND — INKOR + NATIJA:
     'Sally DIDN'T VISIT ... SO she WROTE ...'
     'didn't' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl (visit).
     write → WROTE (noto'g'ri fe'l).

  9-BAND — TASDIQ + INKOR JUFTLIGI:
     'we TOOK the camera, BUT we DIDN'T TAKE any
      pictures.'
     Bir fe'l ikki xil shaklda:
        TASDIQ → TOOK (o'tgan shakl)
        INKOR  → DIDN'T TAKE (asosiy shakl)
     DIQQAT: 'any' — INKOR gapda.


NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR BU MAShQDA:
  be    → was / were
  go    → went
  cut   → cut        (O'ZGARMAYDI)
  drive → drove
  have  → had
  make  → made
  write → wrote
  take  → took

TO'G'RI FE'LLAR:
  tidy → tidIED   ('-y' → -IED)
  wash → washed
  cook → cooked


DIQQAT — 'TIDY' YOZILIShI:
  tidy → '-y' dan oldin UNDOSH ('d') →
  '-y' tushadi, '-IED' qo'shiladi: TIDIED.
  'tidyed' XATO.

topics.topic: Module Self-Assessment 3 — Grammar — RO'YXAT (11 ta) · 6-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
RO'YXAT (11 ta):
  have got, wasn't, were, couldn't, was, weren't,
  is, are, can, could, haven't got

  11 ta so'z va 11 ta bo'shliq → har biri
  AYNAN BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  Today she IS a famous film star, but when
     she was twenty years old she WASN'T.

  2  There ARE six members in the band now.
     Three years ago there WERE only four members.

  3  A: COULD you play the guitar well when you
        were twelve?
     B: No, I COULDN'T, but I CAN play it well now.

  4  I HAVE GOT five brothers, but I HAVEN'T GOT
     any sisters.

  5  When I WAS young, there WEREN'T any
     nightclubs in the town.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Bugun u mashhur kino yulduzi, lekin yigirma
     yoshida bunday emas edi.
  2  Hozir guruhda oltita a'zo bor. Uch yil oldin
     esa faqat to'rtta a'zo bor edi.
  3  A: O'n ikki yoshingda gitarani yaxshi chala
        olarmiding?
     B: Yo'q, chala olmasdim, lekin hozir yaxshi
        chala olaman.
  4  Mening beshta akam bor, lekin opa-singlim
     yo'q.
  5  Men yosh bo'lganimda, shaharda tungi klublar
     yo'q edi.


ASOSIY QOIDA — HAR BANDDA HOZIRGI va O'TGAN
QARAMA-QARShI QO'YILGAN:

  1  TODAY she IS ...  ↔  when she WAS twenty ...
     she WASN'T
     → hozir: IS,  o'tmish: WASN'T

  2  ... in the band NOW: ARE
     ↔ THREE YEARS AGO: WERE
     → hozir: ARE,  o'tmish: WERE

  3  when you WERE twelve: COULD
     ↔ NOW: CAN
     → o'tmish: COULD/COULDN'T,  hozir: CAN

  4  I HAVE GOT ...  ↔  I HAVEN'T GOT ...
     → ikkalasi ham HOZIRGI, biri tasdiq,
       biri inkor

  5  When I WAS young ...  ↔  there WEREN'T ...
     → ikkalasi ham O'TGAN


VAQT BELGILARI — IPNI BERADI:
  'Today', 'now'          →  HOZIRGI zamon
                             (is, are, can,
                              have got, haven't got)
  'when she was twenty',
  'three years ago',
  'when you were twelve',
  'when I was young'      →  O'TGAN zamon
                             (was, wasn't, were,
                              weren't, could,
                              couldn't)


DIQQAT — 2 va 5-BANDLARDA 'THERE':
  'THERE ARE six members'   (hozir, ko'plik)
  'THERE WERE four members' (o'tmish, ko'plik)
  'THERE WEREN'T any nightclubs' (o'tmish, inkor)

  'there is/are' = bor
  'there was/were' = bor edi


DIQQAT — 5-BANDDA 'ANY':
  'there WEREN'T ANY nightclubs'
  INKOR gapda 'any' ishlatiladi ('some' emas).
  4-bandda ham: 'I HAVEN'T GOT ANY sisters.'


DIQQAT — 3-BAND: 'COULD' = O'TMIShDAGI QOBILIYAT
  'CAN' — hozirgi qobiliyat
  'COULD' — o'tmishdagi qobiliyat
  Savolda 'when you WERE twelve' → o'tgan zamon →
  'COULD you ...?'
  Grammar 55-bet, 12-mashqning 10-bandi ham shu.

topics.topic: Module Self-Assessment 3 — Grammar (davomi) — YETTI DIALOG, HAR BIRIDA IKKI TANLOV · 7-mashq
topics.rule_uz:
YETTI DIALOG, HAR BIRIDA IKKI TANLOV
(jami 14 ta).

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  1  A: MORE beautiful than
     B: isn't as CLEVER as

  2  A: the MOST LUXURIOUS hotel of all
     B: on the NOISIEST street in Rome

  3  A: Was Claire SCARED ...?
     B: she screamed DESPERATELY

  4  A: much BIGGER than
     B: the MOST expensive of all

  5  A: prettier THAN that one
     B: the cheapest OF all

  6  A: CHEAPER than the blue shoes
     B: Are they AS comfortable as ...?

  7  A: Did the footballers play WELL?
     B: They played very BADLY.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  A: Krisning fikricha, Jenni Meridan
        go'zalroq.
     B: Ha, lekin u Merichalik aqlli emas.
  2  A: Bu hammasidan hashamatli mehmonxona.
     B: Lekin u Rimdagi eng shovqinli ko'chada.
  3  A: Kler sherlarni ko'rganda qo'rqib ketdimi?
     B: Ha, va u jon-jahdi bilan qichqirdi.
  4  A: Semning mototsikli Tom yoki Franknikidan
        ancha kattaroq.
     B: U shuningdek hammasidan qimmat.
  5  A: Bu ko'ylak ana unisidan chiroyliroq.
     B: Ha, va u hammasidan arzon ham.
  6  A: Qora tuflilar ko'k tuflilardan arzonroq.
     B: Ular ko'klarichalik qulaymi?
  7  A: Futbolchilar kecha yaxshi o'ynadimi?
     B: Yo'q, o'ynashmadi. Ular juda yomon
        o'ynashdi.


QOIDALAR — TO'RT GURUH:

  A) DARAJA TANLASh (1A, 2A, 2B, 4A, 4B, 6A)
     'THAN' bor        →  QIYOSIY
     'the ... of/in'   →  ORTTIRMA
     'much'            →  QIYOSIY

  B) 'AS ... AS' — ODDIY ShAKL (1B, 6B)
     'isn't as CLEVER as'  ('cleverer' XATO)
     'as COMFORTABLE as'   ('much' XATO)

  C) BOG'LOVChI TANLASh (5A, 5B)
     QIYOSIY   →  THAN
     ORTTIRMA  →  OF / IN

  D) SIFAT ↔ RAVISh (3A, 3B, 7A, 7B)
     'be' fe'lidan keyin  →  SIFAT (scared)
     boshqa fe'ldan keyin →  RAVISH (desperately,
                              well, badly)


ENG ALDAMChI BANDLAR:

  1B: 'isn't as CLEVERER as' XATO.
      'as ... as' orasiga ODDIY shakl.

  3A: 'Was Claire SCARY or SCARED?'
      'scary'  = qo'rqinchli (NARSA haqida)
      'scared' = qo'rqib ketgan (ODAM haqida)
      Kler — ODAM → SCARED.
      'a scary film' ✓ / 'a scared film' ✗

  6B: 'Are they AS comfortable AS ...?'
      Gapda ikkinchi 'as' bor → birinchi ham 'as'.
      'much comfortable as' XATO —
      'much' faqat QIYOSIY daraja bilan.

  7A/7B: 'play WELL' / 'played BADLY'
      'play' — FE'L → RAVISH kerak.
      good → WELL (noto'g'ri ravish)
      bad  → BADLY
      'play good' va 'played bad' XATO.


DIQQAT — 4-BANDDA IKKI DARAJA YONMA-YON:
  A: 'much BIGGER than'    → QIYOSIY (ikki narsa)
  B: 'the MOST expensive of all' → ORTTIRMA
     (hammasidan)
  Bir dialogda ikkala daraja ham.

topics.topic: Possessives (Possessive Case)
topics.rule_uz: Egalikni ko'rsatish uchun otga 's qo'shiladi (Tom's book — Tomning kitobi). Ko'plik -s bilan tugasa, faqat apostrof qo'yiladi (the boys' room). Possessive adjectives: my, your, his, her, its, our, their.
examples: This is Ann's bag.
my father's car
Their house is big.

topics.topic: Subject Pronouns
topics.rule_uz: Subject pronouns (kishilik olmoshlari) gap egasi o'rnida keladi: I (men), you (sen/siz), he (u – erkak), she (u – ayol), it (u – jonsiz/hayvon), we (biz), they (ular).
examples: I am a student.
She is my sister.
They are at home.

topics.topic: Articles: a / an
topics.rule_uz: 'A' va 'an' — noaniq artikllar, birlikdagi sanaladigan otlar oldida. Undosh tovush oldida 'a' (a book), unli tovush oldida 'an' (an apple) ishlatiladi.
examples: a car
an orange
She is a doctor.

topics.topic: Have got
topics.rule_uz: 'Have got' egalik bildiradi (… bor). I/you/we/they have got, he/she/it has got. Inkor: haven't got / hasn't got. So'roq: Have you got...? / Has she got...?
examples: I have got a brother.
She has got brown eyes.
Have you got a pen?

topics.topic: Object Pronouns
topics.rule_uz: Object pronouns (to'ldiruvchi olmoshlar) fe'l yoki predlogdan keyin keladi: me (meni), you (seni), him (uni – erkak), her (uni – ayol), it (uni), us (bizni), them (ularni).
examples: Call me later.
I know him.
She likes them.

topics.topic: Prepositions
topics.rule_uz: Joy predloglari narsaning qayerdaligini bildiradi: in (ichida), on (ustida), under (tagida), next to (yonida), behind (orqasida), in front of (oldida), between (orasida).
examples: The book is on the table.
The cat is under the chair.
She is next to me.

topics.topic: Plurals
topics.rule_uz: Ko'plik odatda '-s' qo'shiladi (book → books). '-s, -ss, -sh, -ch, -x' bilan tugasa '-es' (box → boxes). Undosh+y bo'lsa, y→i+es (baby → babies). Ba'zilar tartibsiz: man → men, child → children, foot → feet.
examples: one book, two books
a box, three boxes
a man, two men

topics.topic: Present Continuous
topics.rule_uz: Present Continuous hozir sodir bo'layotgan ishni bildiradi. Tuzilishi: am/is/are + fe'l-ing. Inkor: am/is/are + not + -ing. So'roq: Am/Is/Are + ega + -ing?
examples: I am reading a book.
She is sleeping now.
What are you doing?

topics.topic: Can (ability)
topics.rule_uz: 'Can' qobiliyat yoki ruxsat bildiradi (… ola olmoq). Hamma shaxs uchun bir xil: I/you/he/she/we/they can. Undan keyin fe'l asosiy shaklda keladi. Inkor: can't (cannot). So'roq: Can you...?
examples: I can swim.
She can't drive.
Can you help me?

topics.topic: Past Simple
topics.rule_uz: Past Simple o'tgan zamonda tugagan ishni bildiradi. To'g'ri fe'llarga '-ed' qo'shiladi (play → played). Tartibsiz fe'llar o'zgaradi (go → went, have → had). Inkor: didn't + fe'l. So'roq: Did + ega + fe'l?
examples: I played football yesterday.
She went to school.
Did you see him?

topics.topic: Present Perfect
topics.rule_uz: Present Perfect o'tmishda bo'lib, hozir bilan bog'liq ishni bildiradi. Tuzilishi: have/has + fe'lning 3-shakli (V3). Inkor: haven't/hasn't + V3. So'roq: Have/Has + ega + V3?
examples: I have finished my homework.
She has visited London.
Have you eaten?

topics.topic: The Verb 'to be'
topics.rule_uz: 'To be' fe'li (am/is/are) shaxsga qarab o'zgaradi: I am, he/she/it is, you/we/they are. Inkor: am not / isn't / aren't. So'roq: Am I...? / Is he...? / Are they...?
examples: I am happy.
He is a teacher.
Are you ready?
